name: Prophero
description: What they do A digital-first tool for property investors that combines the power of automation, AI, and good old-fashioned human expertise to simplify, streamline, and optimise the end-to-end property buying process. Why we’re excited ‍ PropHero are taking emotion out of the property buying decision to help drive returns; and their early swathes of repeat purchasers are proof they’re on to a winning formula.

name: Samphire Neuroscience
description: What they do A neurotechnology company that makes products to enhance women’s health and lifestyles. Their first device is a headband that alleviates key symptoms of menstrual cycles including: brain fog, fatigue, mood variability and pain. Why we’re excited ‍ This science-backed tech solution is tackling notable gender imbalances in the neuroscience world by solving a largely unaddressed and ignored problem. Not to mention, it’s being built by two of our very own AfterWork community members!

name: Swingvision
description: What they do ‍ Swing Vision lets aspiring tennis players access professional-grade real-time shot tracking, video analysis, and umpiring using just a mounted smartphone. Why we’re excited This passionate team is pushing the boundaries of machine learning and computer vision, for a growing and engaged consumer group, hungry to improve their game.

name: Tirtyl
description: What they do ‍ A direct-to-consumer business in zero-waste household cleaning and personal care, with a focus on dissolvables that ensure they don’t ship water. Why we’re excited ‍ Strong macro tailwinds, stellar operations and logistics and founders as passionate about building teams as they are creating impact? We subscribe!

name: Wagetap
description: What they do ‍ Wagetap app allows you to access a portion of your wage in real time, by integrating with the company's payroll and adjusting payslips for withdrawals. Why we’re excited ‍ Beyond solving a functional need for employees, Wage Tap operates as a tool to help employers recruit, retain, and engage their workforce.

name: 3Bee
description: 3Bee is a leading naturetech company specializing in biodiversity monitoring and protection through advanced sensors, analysis tools, and regenerative initiatives. By integrating technology with nature, 3Bee develops innovative solutions to monitor and restore ecosystems, ensuring a sustainable balance between human activity and the environment. Investors GROW

name: AI Palette
description: AI Palette is a Singapore-based company founded in 2018 to disrupt the traditional product innovation approach used by all major companies in the Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector. New FMCG products currently have a failure rate of at least 85%, which translates into annual losses of up to $40B for big food and beverage brands. To solve this problem, AI Palette is developing a cloud-based SaaS platform that utilizes big-data analytics to scan millions of data points across multiple geographies to deliver a faster, cheaper and more accurate understanding of consumers’ tastes and developing trends in flavour preferences.

name: Aigen
description: Aigen is an agrobotics company that makes small autonomous weeding robots. The robots are completely solar powered and use a combination of mechanical and electrical weeding dependent on the size of the weed. Aigen’s first market will be the sugar beets where farmers face glyphosate resistant weeds and regulatory pressure to get rid of glyphosate all together.

name: Alpine Bio
description: Nobell has discovered how to transform plants into living bioreactors to produce real dairy proteins. Nobell is launching with a plant based cheese that uses real casein, which gives cheese its unique stretchiness, meatiness, and mouthfeel. Why we invested Magi Richani was able to build an extremely talented team and has shown a remarkable ability to marshal resources. Potential to shake up vegan cheese market which currently has few to no good products. Consumers are demanding plant based alternatives without compromise.

name: Amatera Biosciences
description: Amatera is dedicated to advancing plant evolution, focusing on developing sustainable, climate-resilient coffee and perennial crop varieties. It began with coffee due to its vast global consumption—estimated at a trillion cups yearly, expected to triple by 2050—while rising temperatures may halve suitable growing areas. Amatera seeks to address this challenge by creating coffee varieties capable of meeting future demand.

name: Apeel Sciences (acquired Impact Vision)
description: Apeel Sciences makes edible coatings for produce that increases their shelf life. They claim that their product, Apeel, can make avocados, citrus and other types of fruit last twice as long and that their coating is tasteless and made from plant materials.They acquired Impact Vision, one of our portfolio companies which is how we became a shareholder. Investors AgFunder , Andreessen Horowitz

name: Aquaconnect
description: Aquaconnect is transforming India’s $5 billion shrimp industry with AI-driven farm management and an integrated marketplace. Its mobile app optimizes feed, monitors water quality, and predicts disease outbreaks, helping smallholder farmers increase efficiency and yields. As South Asia’s largest aquaculture network, Aquaconnect connects over 25,000 Indian shrimp farmers with banks, insurers, certification bodies, and exporters. By digitizing transactions and providing real-time insights, Aquaconnect is modernizing aquaculture and strengthening the seafood supply chain. Investors AgFunder , Omnivore Partners

name: Atinary
description: Atinary is transforming chemistry R&D with a no-code machine learning platform that accelerates discovery and optimization by 10x to 100x. By making research faster, cheaper, and more efficient, Atinary is enabling industry leaders in chemistry and life sciences to develop breakthrough products at unprecedented speeds. Founded by Harvard-trained experts in AI, machine learning, and chemistry, the company is also driving global efforts in accelerated materials discovery. With a massive market spanning biotech, pharma, and advanced materials, Atinary is poised to redefine the future of scientific innovation.

name: Atomo Coffee
description: Atomo makes coffee without the coffee beans. They do so by reverse engineering coffee’s aroma, flavor, color, caffeine content and mouthfeel with upcycled and sustainable ingredients. By recreating coffee using its molecular building blocks, Atomo gains precision control over the end product and is able to avoid undesirable traits and fine-tune certain characteristics.

name: Azaneo
description: Azaneo is revolutionizing sustainable farming with a chemical-free, non-thermal weeding solution that eliminates weeds using precise pulsed electrical fields (PEF). Unlike traditional herbicides like glyphosate, which face growing regulatory and environmental concerns, Azaneo’s non-invasive technology offers a scalable, energy-efficient alternative that protects crops and preserves soil health. As global demand for glyphosate-free, sustainable weed control rises, Azaneo is at the forefront of agricultural innovation, enabling farmers to transition toward safer, eco-friendly crop management. Founded 2022 Investors

name: Bear Flag Robotics
description: Bear Flag Robotics retrofits conventional tractors with proprietary hardware and software and turns them into autonomous tractors. They are addressing the issues of labor availability, cost, efficiency, consistency and they have the potential to work 24 hours/day, increasing the number of planting turns. Today, Bear Flag is focused on tilling and they have started paid pilots with some of California’s largest growers.

name: Bite Ninja
description: Bite Ninja has created a gig economy marketplace for restaurants to address the massive and ongoing labor shortage while providing employees with a safe and competitively-compensated position. Working primarily with restaurant drive-through operations, Bite Ninja provides business owners and managers with proprietary plug-and-play software and a pool of qualified, trained and vetted freelancers to take customer orders remotely. This also includes their patent pending NinjaQ system which is like a call center for drive-throughs allowing order takers to be routed to a drive-through only when a customer is present, meaning restaurants can reduce the number of order takers needed on shift greatly increasing labor efficiency and reducing costs. Resturanasts can ue their own staff or fill labor gaps with Bite Ninja is also working on the forefront of AI technology for the drive-through business segment.

name: Black Sheep Foods
description: Black Sheep Foods is a plant-based food company. They are cataloging and recreating the flavor of meat from a variety of animals that no other plant-based company is working on. Specifically, BSF is focusing on building a flavor platform around branched chain fatty acids that give certain types of meats their characteristic profile. Their first product is a plant-based lamb burger. Wchy We Invested Exceptional product – our entire team was impressed with it. Ismael and Sunny are extremely hard-working entrepreneurs and have previous experience in the alternative protein space. Plant-based lamb is the first of its kind and the market for sheep meat is massive.

name: Bluemethane
description: Bluemethane captures methane from water sources like wastewater and reservoirs, preventing its release as a greenhouse gas and converting it into bioenergy to support cleaner energy solutions. Investors AgFunder

name: Braintree Technologies
description: Braintree Technologies leverages drones, AI, IoT, and GIS to address agricultural challenges in Southeast Asia, particularly in the oil palm industry. The company offers solutions like plantation inventory tracking, precise pesticide spraying, and topography planning, all of which are accessible via a user-friendly cloud-based app. Investors 500 Startups , GROW

name: Brightseed
description: Brightseed is using AI to discover natural functional medicines in common food crops. Sofia Elizondo COO (Middle), is the former head of business development at Hampton Creek and ex-BCG with an MBA from Stanford. Jim Flatt CEO (Left) was the R&D head for Martek which sold to DSM for $1.1B and then went on to be CTO of Craig Venter’s Synthetic Genomics, before becoming CTO at Hampton Creek. Lee Chae CTO (Right), developed Hampton Creek’s AI platform for discovering functional ingredients in plants; he has a Berkeley PhD and did his postdoc at Stanford. The round was led by Horizons Ventures (Li Ka-shing’s venture fund) and was oversubscribed.

name: CarbonFarm
description: CarbonFarm provides satellite-verified carbon credits to help rice farmers accurately quantify emissions and farm sustainably. Investors Racine2, TechMind, Ponderosa, Climate Capital, BPI France, AgFunder

name: Cellular Agriculture
description: Cellular Agriculture Ltd. was the first UK startup focused on cultivated protein, specifically cell-based meat. The company develops bioreactor technology to enable a scalable, sustainable production of cultured meat, fish, shellfish, insects, and milk. In 2018, with InnovateUK funding, it created a proof-of-concept bioreactor system, publicly displayed at Nemo Science Museum in Amsterdam in 2019—the first automated cultured meat system demonstrated worldwide. Investors Innovate UK, GROW

name: CH4 Global
description: CH4 Global is building a sustainable, globally-scaled supply of unique seaweed products to minimize methane emissions from livestock. Today, livestock are responsible for 14.5% of global anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions, the most destructive of which is methane (86x more potent than CO2 at warming the atmosphere). There are about 1.5B domestic cows in the world – each of which releases 70 to 120 kg of methane per year – and that number is growing as demand for beef and dairy continues to climb. Together with other grazing animals, cows contribute about 40% of annual methane output accelerating global warming. To address the mounting issue of methane from cattle, CH4 Global is executing an effective approach to reduce methane output using a specific red seaweed, Asparagopsis. Asparagopsis contains high concentrations of bromoform, which disrupts methane gas production in cow guts that would otherwise be released in burps. By supplementing cattle diets with levels as low as 0.5% bromoform from high quality Asparagopsis, CH4 Global intends to reduce cow methane output by up to 90%.

name: Chinova Bioworks
description: Chinova Bioworks is a Canadian bio-foodtech company for the $2B food and beverage preservatives market. Founded by Natasha Dhayagude, David Brown, and Dr. Tanzania Huq, Chinova’s flagship product Chiber, is a natural preservative that capitalizes on the antimicrobial properties of chitosan, a biopolymer they derive from mushrooms. Chiber is a clean label alternative in a market dominated by artificial preservatives. As an all natural product that is high in fiber, Chiber can provide health benefits to consumers while providing food and beverage producers with the ability to satisfy consumer demand for natural, safe, fresh and nutritious products. Chinova can produce formulations for broad-spectrum protection against spoiling microorganisms like bacteria, yeast and mold. They can also make exclusive formulations that target specific strains of microorganisms to meet the needs of specific clients. It is tasteless, odorless and is high in dietary fiber. Chinova is an alumni of the RebelBio accelerator.

name: CommonGround
description: CommonGround is a farmland leasing and sales platform streamlining transactions for all stakeholders. By creating a dual-sided marketplace, it expands access for farmers while maximizing returns for landowners through competitive bidding. Brokers and farm managers benefit from GroundOS, a B2B SaaS solution that digitizes operations and facilitates land auctions. With major land brokers like Mossy Oak and LandGuys onboard, CommonGround has already facilitated $2 million in land leases, increasing landowner returns by 40%. Investors AgFunder

name: Cromatic
description: Cromatic is revolutionizing the R&D domain by launching a digital platform specifically designed to optimize the outsourced R&D ecosystem. This platform facilitates a marketplace connecting vetted Contract Research Organizations (CROs) with biotech and pharmaceutical companies and offers an integrated dashboard for comprehensive project management. This dashboard encompasses functionalities for project onboarding, billing and payments, status monitoring, data analysis, milestone tracking, and facilitates streamlined communication across projects. Cromatic’s solution addresses the industry’s pervasive challenges, including the difficulty in accessing detailed CRO information, misalignment of expectations leading to expensive outcomes, lack of effective project management tools, and inconsistent data formatting across multiple projects. Cromatic is founded by CEO Ann Lin, a Stanford PhD and biotech entrepreneur, and CTO Anne Chen, a former software engineer at Meta. Why we invested Exceptional young, hungry team with pedigree. Large market with limited competition.

name: Dataspan.ai
description: Dataspan specializes in enhancing AI for computer vision by synthesizing data needed for training algorithms. It excels in situations where real data is scarce, creating virtual datasets that mirror real-world variables. This approach is pivotal for developing reliable machine learning models that require diverse training inputs, particularly for rare or unique scenarios. Dataspan’s offerings are key for improving detection accuracy in systems that must identify subtle or infrequent defects. By filling data gaps with high-quality synthetic inputs, Dataspan ensures that AI applications function effectively even in the most data-scarce environments. Why we invested The synthetic data market is experiencing rapid growth and Dataspan is well positioned to take advantage of it. Dataspan’s approach using expert knowledge to improve dataset provides a unique value proposition.

name: DeHaat
description: DeHaat is a technology-led platform offering end-to-end agriculture services to Indian farmers with an aim to improve the value chain efficiency. Through the use of a hybrid digital platform and an on-the-ground network of trained “micro-entrepreneurs”, they provide smallholder farmers with seed, fertilizer, equipment, crop advisory services, and market linkage through a network of hubs that aggregates smallholder production to institutional buyers. Their proprietary technology and established supply and sales channels position them very well for rapid expansion. Why we invested Scrappy team that has achieved a lot with limited resources. Solving major pain points in a large but broken and fragmented supply chain. Lots of adjacent whitespace (geography, crop type, finance, distribution).

name: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is using cutting-edge science to create sustainable, premium high-value ingredients to promote human health and well-being. Founded 2024 Investors CSIRO,

name: Eion
description: Eion is an enhanced rock weathering company. They put crushed olivine on agricultural fields which increases the pH (lowers the acidity) as a direct subsitute for aglime. Additionally it permanently sequesters carbon out of the air and turns it into rock. They can sequester up to 1 ton per acre per year depending on the acidity of the field. This is one of the few startups we’ve seen, not just in ag, but in general, that has the potential to sequester carbon on a massive scale. They have secured a supply agreement with Sibelco, the largest olivine producer in the world. They also joined in the round as an investor. Why we invested We believe using olivine is the right approach to this problem. There are many forms of ERW out there, but we believe that the carbon sequestration potential of olivine is the only one that can make this feasible in the long run.

name: Eratani
description: Eratani is transforming Indonesia’s agricultural value chain with a farmer-first, end-to-end digital platform that enhances productivity, financial access, and market connectivity for smallholder farmers. With a primary focus on paddy farming, Eratani is tackling critical sector challenges, from financing gaps and input quality to post-harvest offtake and distribution inefficiencies. Founded 2021

name: Fable
description: Fable is an Australian food company creating shiitake mushroom-based meat alternatives that deliver the taste and texture of conventional meat using all-natural ingredients. Founded in 2019 by Michael Fox, Jim Fuller, and Chris McLoghlin, Fable offers plant-based braised beef, pulled pork, and burger patties, as well as ready-made meals like stroganoff and rogan josh. Available in major Australian retailers and food service outlets, Fable is rapidly scaling as demand for sustainable, clean-label meat alternatives grows. Investors AgFunder , Blackbird Ventures

name: Faeth Therapeutics
description: Faeth is cancer therapeutic startup building a platform to treat cancer through food’s effect on metabolism. The premise of the company is that cancer therapeutics have traditionally been incremental with few major improvements in the ways we approach treatments, despite there being additional dimensions to human biology that can be leveraged. More specifically, Faeth is developing dietary approaches to treating cancers, often in conjunction with established therapeutics (e.g. drugs). The company was started by high-profile oncologists and cancer biologists from some of the best institutes in the world (Cornell, Columbia, Cambridge, Crick Institute, and Sloan Kettering) including Lew Cantley, whose name has appeared on potential Nobel Prize lists . Over the last decade, these scientists discovered that due to differences in the metabolic behavior of many cancers, nutritional modifications such as nonessential amino acid starvation can dramatically impact or even suppress cancer proliferation with little to no effects on normal cells. A number of these papers have been published in high-profile journals like Nature and Science.

name: FieldIn
description: FieldIn is a farm management software company that has developed software that provides fruits, nuts and vegetables farmers with actionable data to improve efficiency, transparency and production in the field. Their spraying and harvesting software indicate the optimal timing of the event. It provides real-time tracking, alerts for missed rows or overspraying, and provides a quality report summarizing all actions. They claim they can improve profit per acre by up to $300 with their managing system alone. Why we invested Strong traction with over 300K acres managed currently. Customers rave about the product and claim they can’t go without anymore – 0% customer churn in last 12 months Strong leadership team with extensive experience in farming and software building.

name: Future Fields
description: Future Fields is revolutionizing cellular agriculture with the world’s first cost-effective, scalable, and animal-free cell growth media. Initially founded as a cultivated meat company, Future Fields pivoted to solving one of the industry’s biggest challenges – reducing the cost of growth factors essential for lab-grown meat production. Their proprietary protein expression system slashes production costs by 1,000x, eliminating the need for fetal bovine serum and enabling scalable, customizable media for diverse cell lines. By making cellular agriculture economically viable, Future Fields is driving the next agricultural revolution. Investors GROW , Others Undisclosed, Y Combinator

name: Fyto
description: Fyto is unlocking sustainable agriculture with aquatic plants. Through their automated and distributed technology platform, Fyto produces premium, affordable, nutrient-dense crops with radically lower carbon emissions. The company serves multiple markets, including feed, food, and biofertilizer.

name: Ganaz
description: Ganaz is building the Gusto for food and agricultural workers. They build software to onboard, train, communicate with and pay these essential workers. Most workforce management systems and financial services solutions are created for white collar workers and they don’t work for agriculture and food manufacturing. Employers are facing increasing margin pressure and a worsening labor shortage, while workers face lost wages due to predatory financial services. Ganaz automates labor-intensive processes like hiring, training, communication and payday and helps attract and retain good workers.

name: Green Rebel
description: Green Rebel is redefining plant-based eating in Southeast Asia with clean-label, locally inspired meat alternatives. Founded in Jakarta and domiciled in Singapore, the company tailors its plant-based chicken, beef, and veggie protein products to regional tastes. With deep roots in the industry – co-founders Helga Angelina and Max Mandias previously built Burgreens, Indonesia’s largest plant-based QSR – Green Rebel has quickly gained traction. Their products are the best-selling plant-based brand on Tokopedia and have expanded from 50 to 440 Starbucks locations in Indonesia within a month. As a first mover in the market, Green Rebel is driving the future of sustainable food across the region. Investors Unovis, AgFunder ,

name: Hwy Haul
description: Hwy Haul is a digital freight platform for fresh produce. Today, fresh produce in the US travels between 2 million farms and over 40,000 retailers in a convoluted, non-transparent, and oftentimes low-quality supply chain involving 500,000 refrigerated trucks. Worse yet, there is a shortage of 175,000 drivers, which is expected to double within the next few year. Hwy Haul has built a two-sided shipping marketplace focused on organizing and streamlining the complex refrigerated produce distribution market. With key features including ‘on the spot’ pricing and booking, load temperature tracking, re-routing capabilities, delay prediction, and enhanced functionality around handling rejected deliveries. The company is rapidly building a satisfied customer base. Hwy Haul’s growth over the last 12 months has been very impressive.

name: Hyphen
description: Hyphen is a California based robotic kitchen company building a full-stack food automation platform. They’ve built a modular robotic kitchen that is able to make bowls and smoothies using an integrated system where each container is automatically moved through the setup and ingredients are added through various dispensers that each hold a separate ingredient. The dispensers can hold almost anything from rice, meat and lettuce to cut-up fruit. They have an impressive list of customers and a stacked customer pipeline containing some of the biggest brands in the QSR industry.

name: ImpactVision
description: ImpactVision applies machine learning to hyperspectral imagery in food processing to measure freshness and quality, and for foreign object detection in a rapid and non-invasive way. They are currently looking at four use cases for their technology: assessing beef in the supply chain by measuring pH, color, and tenderness; foreign object detection during processing to prevent product recalls; analysis of fruit for ripeness; and inter-species classification of fish. ImpactVision was born out of Singularity University and has already won several awards including: Startup with the Best Impact on Nutrition, awarded by Nestle, at Reimagine Food’s Prometheus Accelerator 2016; 2nd Prize at WIRED Retail’s Startup Competition 2016; Best Solution for a Better World at Seeds & Chips 2017; People’s Choice at FoodBytes NYC 2017, and the Golden Blender Pitch Award at Mixing Bowl 2017.

name: IntegriCulture
description: IntegriCulture is a Tokyo-based cellular agriculture company focused on developing cell culturing systems and products. IntegriCulture’s patented CulNet System uses “feeder” organ cells that naturally secrete the growth factors that cell cultures need. Importantly, this bypasses the need for the cost-prohibitive addition of recombinant growth factors. The system is capable of culturing cells of any type and from any species, making it a platform for a large variety of purposes. IntegriCulture was founded in October 2015 by Yuki Hanyu (CEO) and Ikko Kawashima (CTO). The company emerged out of a nonprofit, cultured meat initiative founded by Yuki called the Shojinmeat Project

name: Intelligent Growth Solutions
description: IGS has developed a proprietary power, communication and operations platform for controlled environment agriculture (CEA). These three components have been designed into a unique single core power and communications system that is managed by a bespoke SaaS and data control platform. The core of the IGS technology is a 3-phase AC power system that simulates continuous DC power, and in doing so, greatly reduces equipment complexity and cost while providing significant power savings of 50% in addition to decreasing installation costs by 80%. This technology has the potential to materially change the way indoor growing is undertaken and vastly improves the potential for successful farming given the cost savings this system provides. There are a wide variety of applications of this technology across all forms of CEA as well as the commercial and retail lighting sectors. Why we invested Quality leadership with experience of building large businesses with multiple successful exits backed by a very strong technical founder. Game changing technology that materially reduces both capital and operational costs, creating profitability in a sector struggling with razor thin margins. IGS technology is applicable to numerous markets where lighting installation, operation and control constitute a material business cost.

name: Intello Labs
description: Intello Labs does quality assessment of food commodities using computer vision and AI. The company helps food businesses (growers, traders, retailers, food service companies, exporters, etc.) improve their customer satisfaction and cut down losses. Investors GROW , Saama Capital

name: Invest Inya Farmer
description: IIF allows individuals to invest directly in farming without owning a farm. The platform connects consumers with farmers, enabling investments in agricultural products like crops, livestock, or oysters via a smartphone app. Farmers gain capital to improve cash flow and reduce risk, while investors earn returns in 3-12 months and support agriculture. IIF operates as a member-owned co-operative, offering unique, low-risk opportunities to back farmers and profit from farming production cycles. Founded 2021 Investors Investible,

name: Juicy Marbles
description: Juicy Marbles produces plant-based wholecut meats with a partiular focus on marbling. Today the team is selling steaks and tenderloins through their website and are frequently sold out. Why we invested Impressive and resourceful team that is able to execute quickly and effectively. Great branding: sticky name, great design and good social media presence. Build-in-public mindset. They were able to launch one of the first plant-based wholecuts and they’re planning to iterate the product contiously while in the market.

name: Jüsto
description: Jüsto is a fresh eGrocery retailer based in Mexico City. The company believes that mastering fresh is the key to owning the eGrocery space. Current in-store pick-and-pack suffers from poor selection and quality, long and inefficient logistics, and inventory that is frequently out of stock since there’s rarely real-time monitoring of what’s on the retail shelf. Jüsto resolves these inefficiencies with small local fulfilment warehouses. The company was founded by the ex-President and CEO of Cabify ($1.4b) and the ex-CEO of Groupon Mexico.

name: Kita Agritech
description: Kita is transforming the agrifood supply chain by integrating technology, financial services, and market intelligence. Rather than just acting as a middleman, Kita empowers farmers with better access to financing, lower-cost agri-inputs, and real-time market insights, enabling them to make smarter pricing and production decisions. Through its partnership with relevant stakeholders and financial institutions, Kita is helping farmers access credit, better quality inputs and more transparent prices. Kita is reducing reliance on intermediaries, stabilizing pricing, and ensuring that both farmers and businesses benefit from a more streamlined, data-driven supply chain. Investors Altara Ventures, Gentree

name: Klim
description: Klim facilitates the shift of farmers towards regenerative agriculture, leveraging a dedicated app to guide them in adopting sustainable practices for improved yields. Through the app, farmers document their progress, enabling Klim to issue carbon credits for these eco-friendly practices to companies aiming to reduce their carbon emissions. This process provides farmers with an additional income source. Klim distinguishes itself by fostering a community for knowledge exchange among farmers and focuses on “insetting” carbon within the supply chains of its food company clients, rather than merely offering generic carbon offsets. Why we invested Exceptional team, especially CEO Robert Gerlach who understands how to make nature-based carbon solutions rigorous and widely implemented. Strong initial traction with large players such as Nestlé. Solution that puts farmers first and ensures rapid adoption.

name: Kula Bio
description: Kula Bio is a Boston based startup that is making organic and sustainable nitrogen through nitrogen fixing microbes that can replace synthetic nitrogen and the Haber-Bosch Process. The technology comes out of Dan Nocera’s lab at Harvard. Currently, nitrogen fixing microbes cannot survive in the soil for very long because they get outcompeted. Kula Bio gives these microbes an advantage by “supercharging” them. Basically part of the mass of the microbes in converted into a bioplastic that functions as a battery and supplies energy to the microbes enabling them to live for weeks instead of hours. Kula’s technology is plant agnostic and they can feed any type of crop since they produce nitrogen in the soil and not in the plant. Because the microbes only produce nitrogen when it’s needed, there is no nitrogen runoff.

name: Layrr
description: LAYRR engineers materials at the atomic level to overcome thermal bottlenecks limiting modern industries like data centres and EVs. By applying ultra-thin nano-coatings to commodity powders, the company transforms them into high-performance metamaterials with significantly improved thermal conductivity. This enables cooler chips, lighter components, and more efficient systems, while dramatically reducing material development time from years to weeks and allowing the same upgraded material to be used across multiple manufacturing formats. Investors AgFunder

name: LYRO Robotics
description: Lyro Robotics is revolutionizing the fresh produce supply chain with advanced robotic pick-and-pack solutions. Leveraging AI and intelligent manipulation technology, their robots tackle labor-intensive tasks, boosting efficiency and accuracy for items like sweet potatoes, avocados, and melons. With a flexible robot-as-a-service model, Lyro eliminates the need for large capital investments, making it ideal for seasonal packing needs. Investors AgFunder , GROW

name: Meatiply
description: Founded in 2021 by researchers from Singapore’s Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Meatiply specialises in the development and production of novel functional ingredients through cell cultivation technologies to enhance both the sensory and nutritional properties of food. By integrating its ingredients into innovative consumer products, Meatiply enables its partners to address consumer demand for improved taste and health benefits, while simultaneously reducing reliance on traditional animal supply chains. In December 2023, Meatiply secured $3.75 million in seed funding co-led by AgFunder and Wavemaker Partners, with participation from SEEDS Capital, to enhance its R&D capabilities and scale up production. Founded 2021 Investors Wavemaker, Better Bite Ventures,

name: Mimetic Medicines
description: Mimetic Medicines is developing a pipeline of novel, long-acting, non-opioid drug candidates for chronic pain. Mimetic’s drug candidates take advantage of the company’s proprietary short lipidated peptide (“SLiP”) platform to target ion channel / scaffold protein complexes that become dysregulated in patients with chronic pain.

name: Mimio
description: Mimio Health is pioneering the first supplement designed to mimic the metabolic effects of fasting without requiring dietary restrictions. Rooted in cutting-edge metabolomics research, Mimio’s formulation is based on bioactive fasting metabolites identified through extensive screening and validation. Studies have shown that Mimio’s approach enhances cellular antioxidant capacity by up to 3x, reduces inflammation by 10x, and extends lifespan in model organisms Investors AgFunder

name: Modern Synthesis
description: Modern Synthesis is a London-based biomaterials company focusing on replacing non-woven materials such as leather. They create a layer of microbial cellulose and then reinforce it with scaffolding to give it extra strength. Additionally, they are able to customize the material by genetically modifying the microbes to express certain traits e.g. modifying the microbes to express melanin to get a naturally black material. Founded 2020 Why we invested Exceptional team – Jen, the CEO, is a great storyteller and very knowledgeable about the space. Ben, the CTO, has a strong technical pedigree and communicates effectively. They work well together and have a strong sense of product, brand, and design.

name: MycoWorks
description: MycoWorks creates high quality leather alternatives from mycelium marketed as Reishi. This material is found in fungi and consists of a mass of branching, thread-like hyphae, which supplies its strength. Reishi can be dyed, tanned and imprinted and has the same versatility as leather which means customers can use it in a wide variety of products. MycoWorks has partnerships with some of the most well-known brands in sportswear and fashion. Why we invested Amazing product qualities that in some cases may even be superior to leather. Strong team with CEO that previously raised $65M Scaling risk seems low with copy and paste production modules using dry fermentation.

name: OlsAro
description: OlsAro is a high-impact Swedish agtech startup focusing on solutions to meet the challenges of a growing population and decreasing arable land. By leveraging AI and cutting-edge plant biotechnologies, OlsAro specializes in developing wheat varieties that are resilient to environmental stressors, with an initial focus on salt tolerant wheat. OlsAro has also initiated development of additional traits in wheat such as heat tolerance and nitrogen use efficiency. OlsAro’s breakthrough solutions could potentially introduce an additional growing season for local farmers by making otherwise unfarmable land farmable again. Investors Future Food Fund, PINC, FLORA Ventures, Mudcake, AgFunder

name: Phagos Biotech
description: Phagos is a French biotechnology startup founded in 2021, focused on combating antibiotic resistance using bacteriophages – natural predators of bacteria. Based in Paris, the company develops personalized, sustainable phage therapies as an alternative to antibiotics, initially targeting animal health, particularly in farming. Investors Hoxton Ventures, GROW , Others Undisclosed

name: Plantik Biosciences
description: Plantik Biosciences focuses on developing heat-tolerant crops through advanced genome-editing technology, aiming to address the challenges posed by climate change to global agriculture. By targeting the “dark genome”—less-understood regulatory elements in plant DNA—Plantik has created a platform that accelerates the breeding process, producing high-heat-tolerant tomatoes in just 12 months compared to the five to eight years required by traditional methods.

name: Propagate
description: Propagate is building an offering that includes agroforestry farm design, agroforestry implementation and management, and agroforestry financing, together with a pipeline of products that further establish and maintain the first fully integrated agroforestry platform. Resistance to US agroforestry adoption is largely attributed to three main causes: challenges in accessing agroforestry farm design knowledge, lack of labor and resource access for appropriate implementation and management, and a market gap in financing products available for agroforestry projects. Propagate launched in 2017 with the intention of addressing each of these three hurdles with purpose-built and integrated solutions: farm planning and management software, an agroforestry labor and inputs marketplace, and an agroforestry finance arm. Why we invested Propagate is uniquely positioned to build an integrated solution that addresses all major obstacles to agroforestry adoption. No other venture in the world has such a platform, and no other venture appears suited to build it. Large, untapped market.

name: Rarebird
description: Rarebird is creating jitter-free coffee using Paraxanthine (Px) instead of caffeine. Paraxanthine offers the benefits of caffeine—like increased alertness and productivity—without causing anxiety or jitters. Px is less toxic and has a shorter half-life than caffeine. With 70% of Americans drinking coffee and a third sensitive to caffeine, Rarebird targets a substantial market. Why we invested An original wedge into a high margin $450b market Sexy market: coffee isn’t a vitamin, it’s a narcotic. N-of-1 type company

name: Resurrect Bio
description: Resurrect Bio is a plant biotech start-up is focused on enhancing the immune systems of crop species. Traditionally, plant breeders have improved crops for traits like yield and drought tolerance, often at the expense of immune resistance genes. Modern monocultures remain evolutionarily stagnant while pests and pathogens continuously adapt, overcoming crop R-genes. Climate change exacerbates the issue by spreading diseases to new regions, broadening the range of threats farmers face. Investors AgFunder

name: Root AI
description: Root AI makes autonomous robots for greenhouse harvesting. Their first robot is focused on cherry tomato picking, but they plan to move cross crop before 2021. Root has converted several MoU’s to paid contracts ahead of schedule. This is partially due to Covid-19, which puts pressure on the labor force in greenhouses.

name: Science For Society
description: S4S Technologies is a decentralized agri-processing platform that empowers women farmers by providing solar-powered food dehydration technology to process and supply shelf-stable, nutrition-rich food ingredients to the food and beverage industry, reducing waste and enhancing sustainability. Investors Chiratae Ventures, GROW , Others Undisclosed

name: Seadling
description: Seadling is a seaweed biotech company based in Borneo that develops sustainable, high-quality seaweed-based ingredients to enhance the well-being of animals, plants, and humans. They use innovative farming and processing technologies to create functional products, such as pet food ingredients and plant biostimulants, while collaborating with local communities to promote environmental sustainability and improve livelihoods. Investors Katapult Oceans, AgFunder ,

name: Sentera
description: Sentera is a full-stack drone mapping company that provides growers with spatial maps and alerts for stand count, nitrogen stress, pest and disease. The CEO headed Lockheed Martin’s UAV division which he grew from startup to $110M in revenues in eight years.

name: Singrow
description: Singrow is pioneering climate-resilient strawberry cultivation through biotechnology and vertical farming innovations. Their proprietary white (Crystal) and hybrid Ruby red strawberries are bred to withstand heat and humidity, enabling efficient local production in tropical and subtropical regions where commercial strawberry cultivation is typically unfeasible. By growing locally, Singrow significantly reduces both the carbon footprint and costs associated with imported strawberries, which are often harvested underripe and lack full sweetness. With a brix score of at least 12 – double that of standard commercial strawberries – Singrow’s varieties rival premium Japanese and Korean imports but at a fraction of the price. Beyond breeding, Singrow has developed a patent-protected hydroponic racking system that optimizes airflow, mitigates humidity challenges, and facilitates robotic harvesting. Targeting China and Southeast Asia, which account for over half of the $15 billion global strawberry market, Singrow employs a partnership and licensing model with large state-owned enterprises to ensure scalability and IP protection. Investors AgFunder , GROW

name: Solinftec
description: Solinftec is an IoT based farm management system designed to optimize the farming process to save growers money. Founded by a group of process engineers (think Six-Sigma for ag), Solinftec is one of the world’s largest and most successful new generation agtech companies. Solinftec is deployed on over 12 million acres and monitoring over 20k pieces of equipment. The company commands over 50% of the Brazilian sugarcane acres. Since 2015 they have grown their market share in Brazil from 20% of all sugarcane acreage to 50% in 2017 and they’ve never lost a customer. In the past two years, they’ve grown their team from 64 to 180. In 2017 Solinftec expanded to row crops with the goal of being active on 5 million acres of row crops by the end of 2018. This year Solinftec is running pilots with five major growers in the US to adopt their system to smaller row crop farms.

name: Supplant
description: As artificial sweeteners are to the beverage industry, Supplant will be to the food industry. They have developed a natural 1:1 drop-in sugar substitute for the food market. Supplant has 20% of the sweetness of sugar while retaining all the bulking and functional properties of sugar such as texture, structure, browning, caramelisation, and crystallisation with less than 40% of the calories. Supplant is produced through conventional fermentation methods using some of the most abundant agricultural sidestreams. At scale they expect to bring the cost down to below that of sugar.

name: Sylvarum
description: Sylvarum focuses on enhancing crop yields through electrostimulation technology. By integrating electrical and magnetic stimuli with AI, the company accelerates plant growth, boosts resistance to pests and diseases, and controls plant metabolism at a molecular level.

name: Tablepointer
description: TablePointer is a Singapore-based company founded in 2019 that provides an AI-driven energy management platform for small and medium commercial facilities. Its subscription-based service uses IoT devices and self-optimizing algorithms to monitor and reduce energy consumption, offering immediate savings and sustainability benefits with no upfront costs Founded 2019 Investors ENGIE, Wavemaker,

name: Tevel
description: Declining farm labor is the single largest problem facing orchard farmers today. Harvesting labor costs can repreresent 50% of an average farm’s operating expenses, a figure that is expected to increase by 50% over the next decade. Tevel’s mission is to support orchard farmers and workers with on-demand, fully autonomous flying robots and bring harvesting automation to the global market. Tevel has developed Flying Autonomous Robots (FARs) that integrate AI, computer vision, image processing and machine learning with advanced sensors, processors and aeromechanics to deliver effective, versatile and affordable harvesting technology.

name: Trace Genomics
description: Trace Genomics is a pioneer in the use of hi-definition genomics to activate the hidden insights in soil for healthier soils and a healthier planet. Through innovation in genomics, soil science and machine learning, Trace Genomics creates a pathway to deliver targeted database insights and actions at cost-speed-scale-accuracy for partners who are advancing modern farming solutions for a net-zero food production system. Founded 2015

name: Tractor Junction
description: Tractor Junction, established in 2018 and headquartered in Rajasthan, operates as India’s premier digital marketplace for farmers. The company enables transactions involving the purchase, sale, financing, insurance, and maintenance of both new and pre-owned tractors and agricultural machinery. It provides transparent pricing, comprehensive specifications, comparison tools, and expert evaluations for an extensive range of products, including over 300 tractor models, more than 75 harvesters, and over 580 implements from leading manufacturers such as Mahindra, John Deere, and Sonalika. The company is committed to transforming the rural automotive ecosystem. Founded 2018 Investors Info Edge, Rockstart,

name: Tray
description: TRAY is an Arizona-based startup reimagining the Point-of-Sale system around self-service. Where most restaurant POS systems were built for back-of-the-house ordering, TRAY’s DNA from the beginning was built for on-demand service for the consumer. TRAY is a complete point of sale system for the enterprise that specializes in self-service ordering and, unlike other legacy POS companies, it was built with self-service at its core, not as an afterthought. Since 2013, the company has grown quickly by fulfilling an underserved need in the restaurant and amusement and entertainment industries for integrated self-service technology. While TRAY has the capability to offer an end-to-end solution, it is just as happy integrating the self-serve system with a client’s legacy POS system – this is a key differentiator from competitors.

name: Umaro Foods
description: Umaro Foods makes plant-based meat alternatives using red seaweed for a superior taste, texture and nutritonal profile. Their first product is a delicious bacon. Why we invested Exceptional product. Best plant-based bacon we’ve tried. Clean label which makes it more appealing to a large customer base which is attracted to plant-based products, but put off by the heavy processing and long ingredient lists. Scrappy team.

name: UnReal Milk
description: UnReal Milk (Brown Foods) is pioneering cell-based dairy, using mammary epithelial cells to produce real cow’s milk without the animal. Unlike traditional cell ag approaches, their process eliminates cells from the final product, dramatically reducing costs. As the first company to successfully secrete cow’s milk in a lab, UnReal Milk is launching with cheese and will expand to milk as costs decline, offering a scalable, sustainable alternative to conventional dairy. Investors AgFunder , Y Combinator

name: Varaha
description: Varaha is on a mission to become the world’s largest nature-based carbon credit manager. As global demand for verified carbon offsets continues to rise, Varaha is poised to lead the transition towards scalable, high-integrity carbon markets, empowering land stewards and investors alike. description: Verdant is a Robotics-as-a-Service company creating autonomous robots focused on crop spraying and thinning. Their first robots are focused on automated chemical spraying and apple thinning.

name: Vertical Oceans
description: Vertical Oceans is a Singapore-based company focused on sustainable aquaculture, producing premium shrimp using AI-driven technology and a balanced ecosystem of shrimp, fish, and algae. They emphasize eco-friendly practices with zero waste, no chemicals, and a farm-to-fork delivery in under eight hours, aiming to protect oceanic resources while providing fresh, high-quality seafood. name: Wittaya Aqua
description: Wittaya Aqua is a Toronto-based startup that leverages AI and data analytics to enhance aquaculture efficiency, profitability, and sustainability. Its platform consolidates data across the seafood supply chain, offering tools for feed optimization, farm management, and performance forecasting. The company supports multiple species globally and aims to expand in Asia while reducing environmental impact and production risks for farmers. Founded 2018 Investors GROW

CuraSen’s drugs are small molecules, given as oral tablets, designed to directly activate certain receptor populations in the brain and periphery to compensate for decline of the adrenergic system driven by aging and neurologic disease.

name: DEM BioPharma
description: DEM BioPharma is a private company pioneering the next generation of immunotherapeutics that unleash the innate immune system to eliminate tumors by targeting ‘don’t eat me’ (DEM) and ‘eat me’ (EM) signals on cancer cells, macrophages, and other myeloid effector cells. The Company’s approach builds on the groundbreaking functional genomics research and discoveries in macrophage biology from its scientific co-founders, Drs. Jonathan Weissman and Kipp Weiskopf of the Whitehead Institute and Dr. Michael Bassik of Stanford University. The proprietary CHoMP™ platform (Co-culture with Human Myeloid Phagocytes) utilizes CRISPR-based functional genomic screens in human cancer cells and/or primary macrophages to discover and validate new DEM and EM signals that could profoundly induce and enhance cancer cell elimination through increased phagocytosis.

name: DispatchHealth

name: Edgewood Oncology

BTX-A51 is an investigational, first-in-class, small molecule, multi-selective kinase inhibitor of CK1α, CDK7, and CDK9 that synergistically co-targets master regulators of cancer to activate programmed cell death or apoptosis. BTX-A51 holds promise in acute myeloid leukemia and genetically defined solid tumors, which are the focus of ongoing clinical programs.

name: eGenesis
description: eGenesis is a gene-editing and a genome-engineering company developing human-compatible organs and cells. eGenesis’ goal is to transform the field of transplantation by offering safe and effective organs and cells to patients in need. The Company harnesses gene editing technology including CRISPR to address the key issues that have impeded xenotransplantation to date. eGenesis’ development pipeline includes lead programs for kidney and islet cell transplants as well as earlier-stage programs focused on other solid organs.

name: Free Market Health
description: Free Market Health is a healthcare technology company on a mission to bring the needs of payers, providers, and patients into healthy alignment. FMH believes that today’s referral and reimbursement ecosystem often fails patients. The Company believes that only an unbiased partner that provides compelling value for all stakeholders can mend this broken ecosystem. And they believe this unbiased partner must help align resources, risk, and accountability transparently and unwaveringly.

name: Harbor Health
description: Harbor Health was created by people who have spent decades trying to make health better, including those who provide health to those who figure out how to pay for it. Harbor Health’s mission is to make the entire health system work better for consumers so that everyone can achieve optimal health.

name: ImmuneID
description: ImmuneID is a precision immunology company using its proprietary platform to simultaneously identify and therapeutically target millions of antibody interactions that drive immune diseases. The Company is employing its massively parallel, multiplexed, and unbiased systems to develop therapeutics for autoimmunity, severe allergy, oncology and infectious disease.

name: Kelonia
description: Kelonia is pioneering a new wave of genetic medicines using its next-generation gene delivery platform. The Company’s simple and elegant cutting-edge in vivo gene delivery technology uses a few potent lentiviral vector-like particles to precisely and efficiently deliver in vivo genetic cargo to the desired target tissue, and only that tissue, every time. With an initial focus on developing transformational therapies for solid tumors and hematologic cancers, Kelonia is building a pipeline of genetic medicines for a wide range of diseases, with the bold goal of bringing genetic medicines to every patient in need.

name: KymaThera
description: KymaThera is a discovery-stage biotechnology company developing best-in-class medicines for serious diseases. KymaThera’s leadership team brings decades of experience advancing small-molecule therapeutics from concept to clinic, with a record of success spanning multiple therapeutic areas and dozens of development candidates and approved medicines.

name: Lassen Therapeutics
description: Lassen Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotech developing first-in-class antibodies as potential treatments for fibrosis, thyroid eye disease, and oncology. The Company’s lead candidate, LASN01, is a first-in-class monoclonal antibody targeting IL-11 receptor (IL-11R). IL-11 is a central mediator of fibrosis and blocking its activity has the potential to offer a novel modality for treatment of Thyroid Eye Disease (“TED”) and other fibrotic diseases.

name: Marathon Health
description: Everside Legacy Holdco LLC (Marathon Health) fka NEAPH Holdings LLC (Everside Health fka Paladina Health) is a leader in providing advanced primary care in the U.S. to 2.5 million eligible patients across a combined base of nearly 650 employer and union-sponsored clients. The Company delivers direct primary care, mental health, occupational health, musculoskeletal, and pharmacy services through a footprint of over 720+ health centers in 41 states, in addition to 50 state access to virtual care services. Marathon is transforming healthcare delivery through a patient-first approach, providing more convenient access to in-person and virtual care, leading to better health outcomes for patients and meaningful cost-of-care savings. Emphasizing a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, Marathon focuses on nurturing a positive work environment and recruiting exceptional talent. This commitment ensures Marathon leads with expertise and compassion in healthcare. Marathon is a five-time Modern Healthcare Best Places to Work in Healthcare winner and a six-time Best in KLAS award winner for employer-sponsored healthcare services, most recently in 2024

name: MBrace Therapeutics
description: MBrace is a private biotechnology company with a primary focus on developing new treatments for patients with cancer, based on the Selection of Phage Accessible Recombinant Targeted Antibodies (“SPARTA”) technology pioneered by the founders of the Company. The goal is to develop, validate, and optimize therapeutically functional, anti-tumor monoclonal human recombinant antibodies and use these validated human antibodies to make antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for novel targets in solid tumors.

name: Novome Biotechnologies
description: Novome Biotechnologies, Inc. is a biotechnology company focused on engineering defined activities into the human gut microbiota to treat chronic diseases. The Company has developed the first-ever platform for controlled colonization of the gut with engineered bacteria, enabling first-in-class living therapeutics: Genetically Engineered Microbial Medicines (GEMMs).

name: PatientsLikeMe
description: PatientsLikeMe (Paulus Holdings Limited DBA Fuze Healthis) a technology-powered home health screening, genomics and pharmacy services provider committed to transforming patient experiences and enabling its healthcare partners – including care providers, health plans, employers and life sciences companies – to excel in an outcomes-focused system. Through digitally led capabilities and services, Fuze Health enables people to manage their health from home across the full lifecycle of care, providing access to testing for many common conditions, genomic sequencing, pharmacy services including medication delivery and virtual care support. Fuze Health’s scalable technology-enabled B2B solutions help leading healthcare organizations enhance patient experiences, care and health outcomes.

name: Progentos Therapeutics
description: Progentos is developing first-in-class compounds to induce endogenous oligodendrocyte progenitor cells to remyelinate axons in patients suffering from MS and other demyelinating diseases. Combining expertise in chemistry, biology, and in vivo models, Progentos discovers and develops novel small-molecule drugs to regenerate tissues in patients with degenerative diseases.

name: Qihan Biotech
description: Qihan Biotech is a biotechnology company applying genome-editing technology to develop novel cell therapies and organs for transplantation. The Company’s mission is to use high throughput, multiplexable genome editing in combination with expertise in transplantation immunology to create immunologically privileged allogeneic cells and xenogeneic organs for use as therapies to treat cancer, organ failure, and other important medical conditions.

name: Scithera
description: Scithera, Inc. is a new company founded by Brendan Eckelman in San Diego. Brendan was the founder and CSO of Inhibrx, a protein engineering company that has had a great deal of clinical success, and a two-part exit through a product acquisition by Sanofi, and a public company progressing multiple programs, all of which Brendan was a significant part of discovery and development. Brendan and his team are focused on novel Antibody Drug Conjugates (“ADC”) for oncology and auto immune disease.

name: The Vets fka BetterVet
description: The Vets fka BetterVet is a full-service veterinary practice on wheels supported by a powerful digital platform.

name: Transcarent
description: Transcarent is a health experience company that puts people in charge of their health and care. It uses a combination of software, technology, data science, and health guides to empower consumers with unbiased information, trusted guidance, and access to high-value care. This leads to better care, better outcomes, and more cost-effective decisions.

name: Tyra Biosciences
description: Tyra Biosciences is a public precision oncology company focused on developing purpose-built therapies to overcome tumor resistance and improve outcomes for patients with cancer. Using its proprietary platform, TYRA is initially focused on developing a pipeline of selective inhibitors of the FGFR family members, which are altered in approximately 7% of all cancers. Its lead product is candidate TYRA-300 (for bladder cancer) and TYRA-200 (for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma).

name: United Musculoskeletal Partners Holdings ("UMP")
description: United Musculoskeletal Partners Holdings is a private orthopedics company currently with three large metropolitan markets, multiple outpatient surgical facilities, orthopedics hospitals, and ancillary services, including radiology and physical therapy.

name: Vir Biotechnology
description: Vir Biotechnology is a public clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on powering the immune system to transform lives by discovering and developing medicines for serious infectious diseases and cancer. Its clinical-stage portfolio includes infectious disease programs for chronic hepatitis delta and chronic hepatitis B infections and multiple double-masked T-cell engagers across validated targets in solid tumor indications. Vir Biotechnology also has a preclinical portfolio of programs across a range of infectious diseases and oncologic malignancies.

name: 0G
description: 0G (fka Zero Gravity) aims to unlock the full potential of the Web3 era by providing reliable tools to create Web3 apps and dependable data storage and access services. 0G provides advanced modular infrastructure and tools for seamless Web3 development, leveraging cutting-edge data availability and storage solutions to enable the creation of scalable, secure applications with real-time, trusted on-chain data.

name: 10Beauty
description: 10Beauty is revolutionizing the U.S. nail care industry with a fully autonomous robotic manicure machine that delivers salon-quality results with industrial-level precision and at a reduced price point. The company's modular, cost-effective design, powered by high-resolution cameras and real-time computer vision, facilitates broad adoption and enables efficient deployment across retail stores, salons, spas, and other hitherto untapped locations (e.g., gyms, hotels, etc.).

name: 1mind
description: 1Mind tackles the rising cost and complexity of enterprise sales by replacing fragmented go-to-market roles with a single AI “Superhuman” that runs live calls, answers questions, and drives deals forward. Its photoreal avatars integrate with CRMs, knowledge bases, and meeting platforms to deliver always-on selling that’s faster, more consistent, and infinitely scalable.

name: 1Up
description: 1up streamlines enterprise sales by quickly delivering precise answers from secure, integrated knowledge sources using advanced language models. Businesses of all sizes use 1up to promptly and securely address sales questions, RFPs, and security questionnaires, increasing productivity tenfold.

222 is an in-real-life platform for shared experiences, helping people operate and optimize their social networks. The company’s platform uses AI to facilitate social network expansion for its users, while sending targeted foot traffic and consumer insights to partnered venues.

name: 3X Genetics
description: 3X Genetics offers medical screening solutions and follow-up testing to proactively identify genetic disorders such as the most common form of myotonic dystrophy. 3X Genetics seeks to screen the world's population for myotonic dystrophy, a genetic disorder that causes progressive muscle weakness, and other disorders such as Huntington’s Disease.

44.01 offers a CO2 storage solution using a proprietary carbon mineralization process to permanently capture CO2 underground, generating high-quality, durable carbon credits. The company’s technology accelerates the natural weathering process, turning CO2 into harmless rock, enabling industries to safely and efficiently eliminate their captured carbon dioxide.

name: 50cut
description: 50CUT by Joyn Foods is a food-tech platform that blends mushroom mycelium with ground meat to boost flavor, nutrition, and sustainability — without sacrificing taste or function. Using a proprietary upcycling fermentation process, it delivers a scalable, cost-saving solution for chefs and foodservice operators in the $298B U.S. meat market.

name: 5x
description: 5X is the modern data stack as a managed service that enables companies to generate ROI from data without having to worry about building data infrastructure. 5X platform lets companies automatically consolidate data technology vendors into a single platform without building any functionality or integrations themselves.

name: 6d.ai
description: 6D is an augmented reality cloud platform designed for AR apps and intended to build a comprehensive, real-time 3D map of the world. The company’s platform constructs a real-time dense mesh from crowd-sourced data for use in 3D mapping and multi-user AR experiences.

name: 8base
description: 8base is a low-code, full stack development platform helping entrepreneurs and creators in established companies bring their product visions to life faster, better, and more economically. The platform helps users deliver client projects faster while increasing their margins and reducing reliance on scarce and expensive software development talent.

name: Aalo Atomics
description: Aalo Atomics builds compact nuclear reactors that are small enough to fit in a garage but powerful enough to electrify a city. Its cutting-edge 10-megawatt electric reactors are designed to provide clean, cost-effective energy, transforming the nuclear industry and supporting global decarbonization efforts.

name: Aatmunn
description: Aatmunn (formerly Guardhat) has pioneered software-based safety and efficiency solutions that prevent major industrial accidents like forklift accidents, gas leaks, and radiation exposure. With its innovative Industrial Internet of People (IIoP) platform enhanced by AI and a unified data fabric, Aatmunn has made significant strides in predictive hazard detection and emergency response.

name: Aazzur
description: AAZZUR is reinventing how banks are built; how banking data is used to increase satisfaction, retention and monetization; and how fintechs work with banks. AAZZUR’s platform provides financial institutions and companies with a unified API that allows them to easily and cost-effectively integrate with multiple financial products.

name: Abatable
description: Abatable has developed a platform that helps companies navigate the complexity of voluntary carbon markets and steer to net-zero carbon. Abatable has developed a platform that helps companies navigate the complexity of voluntary carbon markets and build a credible, rigorous path to net-zero carbon.

name: Abingdon Software Group
description: Abingdon Software Group (ASG) acquires local, founder-owned VMS (vertical market software-as-a-service) businesses in Europe and the U.S. There are ~40,000 such businesses globally. The company is focused on a decentralized model: acquired companies will be run independently by their original management, while ASG provides best practices enabling these companies to thrive. This not only lowers risk vs. centralizing, but also keeps good managers motivated.

name: AC Momento
description: AC Momento is football's premier online auction house, bringing fans game-worn jerseys and memorabilia sourced directly from their favorite clubs and athletes. AC Momento sources jerseys and memorabilia via exclusive agreements with top clubs and athletes. Its mobile app provides digital certificates of authenticity, live in-game bidding, personal player collections, and soon a platform for secondary sales.

name: Accolade
description: Accolade is an independent health and benefits solution designed to improve experience, outcomes, and cost of medical care. They use personalized advocacy and the latest technology to help achieve consistent, favorable results in the healthcare field.

name: Accordance
description: Accordance is an AI copilot designed for accounting, tax, and finance professionals, enhancing productivity and simplifying complex workflows to alleviate the pressures of a shrinking CPA workforce. Leveraging reasoning-capable LLMs fine-tuned by experts in the field, Accordance equips CPAs with advanced tools to tackle challenges in the financial services industry.

name: Acorn Genetics
description: Acorn Genetics is building a fast, low-cost DNA detection platform that works anywhere — no lab, enzymes, or cold storage required. Its solid-state, disposable device delivers results in under 30 minutes, unlocking powerful genomic tools for agriculture, food safety, and global biosecurity.

name: Activ Surgical
description: Activ Surgical is the developer of an AI-augmented surgical platform. Their hardware-agnostic surgical software allows minimally invasive surgical systems (laparoscopes, arthroscopes and robots) to autonomously collaborate with surgeons.

name: Active Protective
description: Tango develops smart belts to reduce traumatic injury after a fall by using 3D motion sensors and wearable airbag technology. The belts are designed for seniors with comfort and function in mind, and send digital alerts to caregivers for fall notification.

name: Activeloop
description: Activeloop offers a database that automatically connects unstructured data to machine learning models for more efficient deployment of enterprise-grade, LLM-based products. Its unique storage format is optimized for deep-learning and LLM-based applications, enabling efficient use of unstructured data such as videos, images, and audio and reducing the risk of project failures.

name: Adapt
description: Adapt is building a unified AI layer that connects a company’s existing tools to provide shared context, proactive insights, and automated actions across the business. By acting as a central “AI computer” rather than another point solution, Adapt helps teams move faster with less manual coordination and guesswork.

name: AdaptX
description: AdaptX (formally MDmetrix) is a healthcare data analytics, visualization, and AI company that serves hospitals and surgery centers. Users can understand outcomes, compare approaches, improve their care, and monitor results — letting them easily leverage their own data.

name: AdeptID
description: AdeptID is a social-impact venture that uses machine learning to improve job mobility for people in the workforce who do not have college degrees. The company identifies transferable skills for any job, which it uses to recommend overlooked talent being sought by clients such as large employers and training providers. It also provides API access for product leaders and developers at talent software companies.

name: Adora
description: Adora is a smart digital tool built by menopause clinicians and women’s health experts to help women manage their health during menopause. Aiming to be sold via employee benefit programs, the app’s chatbot-style approach guides users to find solutions for symptoms, including gynecologist consultation, sleep therapy, and exercise or diet changes.

name: Adventr
description: Adventr’s SaaS platform allows users to design, distribute, and analyze interactive, viewer-driven video content. It features interactive user options like mobile play, customized social sharing, pre-roll ad network compatibility, and more.

name: Adyton
description: Adyton builds secure, mobile-first software for frontline operations, delivering real-time data, accountability, team comms, and task management at the tactical edge. Deployed across 120+ Department of Defense units, its platform replaces paper-based workflows with edge-deployed tools built for speed, security, and decision-making.

name: Aescape
description: Aescape is a robotics-enabled massage platform offering a customizable experience that mimics human touch. The company automates soft tissue treatment and brings actionable measurement to massage therapy using a system of sensing, AI, and robotics.

name: Aethero Space
description: Aethero, in partnership with NVIDIA, delivers radiation-hardened edge computers for in-space AI workloads, offering 20x more processing power and 5x longer durability than competitors. By enabling real-time, on-orbit data processing and autonomy, Aethero reduces data costs, minimizes reliance on ground staff, and accelerates AI adoption in space.

name: After Thought
description: After Thought is advancing AI technology with a framework designed for high reliability, explainability, and controllability that can have real-world impacts in critical areas such as robotics, defense, and healthcare. After Thought aims to build human-like AI systems that will unlock high-impact, low-fault-tolerance applications now out of reach for current GenAI models.

name: AfterHour
description: AfterHour is a social media platform where users can swipe through other users’ stock portfolios with real numbers, sharing and viewing positions and trades. The pseudonymous but verified platform is designed for the rapidly growing group of investors who use social media for investing decisions and who value transparency, social communication, fun, and trustworthiness.

name: AGI
description: AGI is an applied AI lab developing vertical AI agents that autonomously execute complex tasks, starting with its AI Travel Companion, which automates bookings, trip coordination, payments, and real-time issue resolution. Specializing in travel and commerce, AGI builds deep, defensible AI capabilities while also pioneering REAL Bench, an industry-first benchmark for evaluating AI agent reliability and success.

name: Agile Stacks
description: Agile Stacks provides enterprise clients with an automated cloud development and deployment service platform. They use composable stacks, full stack automation, integrated security, and other software components needed for cloud operations.

name: Agolo
description: Agolo’s content summarization platform is designed to help companies fight information overload. Its neural network training is powered by an extensive dataset of human-written summaries, enabling users to consume information more efficiently.

name: AI.Reverie
description: AI.Reverie offers a suite of synthetic data and vision APIs to help businesses train their machine learning algorithms and improve AI accuracy. Users can generate diverse, accurate training data at scale, making the process affordable, fast, and productive.

name: Aiden
description: Aiden is an automated IT management platform that ensure every device is automatically configured, updated, and secured to a company’s specs. Its AI-powered solution centralizes software deployment, patch management, and compliance maintenance.

name: AIQ Solutions
description: AIQ Solutions has developed a medical software platform that provides unique intelligence and early predictions about cancer treatment effectiveness and toxicity risk. Its platform is the only technology that can quantify and characterize treatment response for each individual lesion and organ system, providing insights for pharmas and biotechs and guiding healthcare providers in real-time treatment decisions.

name: Air Company
description: Air Company provides a scalable, carbon-negative alternative to petroleum by using proprietary technology that mimics photosynthesis to turn CO2 into sustainable aviation fuel. Targeting both defense and commercial markets, Air Company aims to significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions and revolutionize production standards across multiple industries.

name: Airbase
description: Airbase has developed a comprehensive spend management platform for small and midsize companies that combines bill payments, corporate cards, and expense reimbursements. Their platform brings three products into a single system: all-inclusive accounts payable automation, software-enabled corporate cards, and simplified employee expense reimbursements. It provides a faster close, better visibility, and improved control over non-payroll spend

name: AirMyne
description: AirMyne is building a system that efficiently captures carbon dioxide from the atmosphere at an industrial scale and permanently stores it in deep geological formations. Compared to other direct air capture (DAC) technologies, Airmyne’s C02 removal process involves much lower energy use, capex / opex costs, and complexity.

name: AIVideo
description: AIVideo (formerly Infotbot) uses AI to effortlessly create complete, informative videos with scripts, visuals, voiceovers, and effects, making complex topics easily understandable and shareable. Unique features include animated diagrams, historical photos, web links, and more, all generated from a single prompt.

name: AKA Identity
description:
AKA Identity (formerly Project Arch) is built for IT and Security teams to provide continuous IAM (Identity and Access Management data transformation for autonomous capabilities in the enterprise.
Its authentication and authorization platform allows companies to perform at once what used to require multiple solutions, automating manual actions with repeatability and scalability.

name: Akiba Digital
description: Akiba is a credit-scoring solution for African small and medium businesses. The company’s system helps lenders, banks, fintechs, and retailers quickly extend credit, BNPL, and cash advances to customers using service AI and machine learning.

name: Aklivity
description: Aklivity provides an API platform that simplifies connecting apps and services to event-driven systems that detect customer engagement events in real time (such as placing an item in an ecommerce cart). With Aklivity, teams can achieve a unified, event-driven architecture that supports the latest generation of mobile, web, IoT, and hybrid cloud initiatives. Its platform gives businesses the ability to deliver rich customer experiences and data-driven business operations such as real-time preventive maintenance, IoT analytics, and diagnostics.

name: Akorda
description: Akorda is an AI-based platform for legal contract analysis, workflow, and standardization, allowing teams to manage execution risk. It aims to resolve open issues quickly, track approvals, and sign contracts faster, working better with fewer resources.

name: Akselos
description: Akselos develops engineering simulations for offshore oil and gas and power system industries, making digital twins a reality. Their products help augment risk-based inspections while implementing accurate, physics-based simulations.

name: Akto
description: Cybersecurity provider Akto aims to mitigate cyberthreats by providing organizations with a platform to create a real-time inventory of APIs and prevent sensitive data leaks. Akto’s platform deploys in minutes to mirror traffic from a customer’s cloud, providing an instant inventory of APIs that saves developers months of back and forth.

name: Akua
