description: Akua produces and markets tasty, nutritious, plant-based food made with ocean-farmed kelp. Their sustainable seagreens products are vegan, gluten-free, soy-free, and low in calories. They source kelp from ocean farms that require no fresh water, land, or fertilizer — positively impacting the environment.

name: Alba
description: Alba enables parents from Latin America to instantly book trusted, licensed caregivers from their own social networks. The platform connects users with vetted caregivers and allows them to monitor every step of their loved one’s care.

name: Albacore
description: Albacore develops high-performance, unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) that deliver low-cost, scalable undersea autonomy for intelligence, surveillance, and deterrence. Modular, long-range, and swarming-capable, the micro-subs address gaps for special ops and defense, enabling missions not possible with expensive, slow-to-field legacy UUVs.

name: Aleph
description: Aleph’s cloud-based enterprise software simplifies the e-commerce process in Latin America. Their platform connects all three actors in the commercial chain — brands, wholesale distributors, and retailers — by providing catalog standardization, marketplaces, logistics, traceability, and other services.

name: Aleph Farms
description: Aleph Farms produces beef steaks using the natural cells of a cow. Their process cultivates whole cuts of meat from lab-grown cow cells in 3 to 4 weeks.

name: Algolux
description: Algolux is the developer of an autonomous vision and imaging technology. The company uses machine learning, computational imaging, and image processing to enable vehicles and devices to "see" the world, even in adverse conditions.

name: Algorand
description: Algorand develops open source, public blockchain technology based on a pure proof-of-stake consensus protocol. They help traditional and decentralized financial businesses improve scalability and transaction finality.

name: ALIGNMT
description: ALIGNMT AI provides healthcare organizations with a platform to govern, monitor, and mitigate the risks of AI systems in real time, ensuring safety, fairness, and compliance with emerging regulatory standards. Through its embedded audit agents and vertical focus on healthcare, ALIGNMT offers a proactive safeguard for hospitals, insurers, and health IT vendors as AI becomes central to clinical and operational decision-making.

name: Alison AI
description: Alison AI provides enterprise customers with AI-powered marketing intelligence and analysis for online video performance, leveraging data-driven insights to optimize creative development. By identifying top-performing elements and offering intelligent competitive analysis, Alison reduces the need for costly A/B testing, ensuring resources are directed towards content that drives results.

name: Alix
description: Alix aims to disrupt traditional estate settlement methods with a robust, automated technology that offers comprehensive services at a fraction of existing costs. Its product includes tools to help build a will and trust in just minutes, online document storage, creation of an inventory of assets, and easy updating of documents based on evolving family needs and changes to customers’ assets.

name: Allevi
description: Allevi develops 3D bioprinters and bioinks intended to cure disease, test novel drugs, and eliminate the organ waiting list. They aim to develop versatile technology that simplifies the designing and engineering of 3D tissues.

name: AllHere
description: AllHere is a conversational AI solution for K-12 education. Their chatbot subscription SaaS platform is offered to schools and school districts on a per-student pricing basis.

name: Alli Connect
description: Alli Connect is a mental health B2B SaaS solution that uses proprietary AI-based algorithms to match patients with therapists who are best suited to that person’s needs. It will first focus on offering companies matching and counseling services to provide employees a support system, improving engagement, loyalty, and retention.

name: Allium Engineering
description: Allium Engineering produces corrosion-resistant steel rebar that delivers stainless-grade durability at much lower cost than solid stainless alternatives, targeting the massive infrastructure repair market for bridges, ports, and coastal structures. Its patented laser-cladding technology deposits a thin stainless steel layer onto standard carbon steel, which partner mills then roll into finished rebar using existing equipment.

name: Allset
description: Allset is an all-in-one app that helps you message customers, book appointments and accept payments – with one tap.

name: Allstar
description: Allstar enables gamers to be a short-form video creator through next-generation creator tools and infrastructure. Allstar's technology allows gamers to quickly record, customize, and share their best gaming and esports moments across various platforms and devices

name: Alpaca
description: Alpaca uses AI to match tenants and landlords and guide them through the rental process. They connect users with hundreds of housing groups and listings on social networks.

name: Alto Experience
description: Alto is a premium brand in the rideshare space that provides on-demand ride-hailing and delivery services via company-owned fleets driven by full-time employees. Unlike other rideshare options, Alto’s drivers are W2 employees who undergo background checks and extensive training — giving customers a safe, consistent, and trusted experience at competitive prices.

name: AltoIRA
description: Alto is an alternative asset-investing platform intended to administer self-directed individual retirement accounts. Users can invest retirement savings in private equity, venture capital, cryptocurrency, and other assets.

name: Altro
description: Altro is building a platform that helps young adults build credit through nontraditional ways

name: Alva Energy
description: Alva Energy upgrades turbines and secondary systems at existing nuclear plants to add 200–300 MW of clean, firm power. A standardized delivery model unlocks gigawatts for the grid in under five years — faster and cheaper than new builds.

name: Alvee
description: Alvee's healthcare software offers data on health equity and factors impacting health outcomes, aiding providers in maximizing reimbursement for these services and assisting patients in overcoming care barriers. Alvee uses predictive analytics to empower payers and providers to proactively identify, act on, and track social needs for their patients and helps them to pinpoint and address racial disparities.

name: Alviere
description: Alviere (formerly Mezu) provides a single-integration API that streamlines and automates the delivery of financial products. They offer businesses branded FDIC-insured bank accounts, debit cards, cross-border currency exchange, risk and fraud prevention, and more.

name: Alyce
description: Alyce offers an AI-powered corporate gifting platform that better personalizes gifts for each recipient. Personal social data helps companies choose custom gifts. Recipients have the option to exchange it for something else or donate to a charity of their choice.

name: American Gene Technologies
description: American Gene Technologies develops gene and cell therapy drugs that treat infectious diseases, monogenic disorders, and cancers. The drugs use a proprietary gene-delivery platform to develop patented gene and cell therapies that cure these diseases.

name: American Supercritical
description: American Supercritical offers a modular, supercritical carbon dioxide power block that attaches to existing gas turbines at data centers, converting waste heat into additional electricity and lifting overall efficiency. Its unit is designed for brownfield retrofit onto turbines already in service, letting operators capture significantly more power from the same fuel without replacing existing assets.

name: Americana
description: Americana operates at the intersection of non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and physical assets. Its NFTA Universal Chip allows customers to bring any valuable off-chain physical asset on-chain, providing the security and benefits that the blockchain offers. The company’s small NFTA chip can be embedded on any physical object, collectible, artwork, or other valuable asset to secure its value on the blockchain. Once assets are on-chain, Americana’s platform will facilitate their exchange through its marketplace.

name: Amigo
description: Amigo builds infrastructure that enables healthcare organizations to safely deploy patient-facing AI agents, powering automated support across intake, triage, medication management, and post-visit workflows. Its simulation-first platform trains and validates AI agents in synthetic patient environments before live deployment, providing the safety controls and audit trails needed to move healthcare AI beyond pilot programs.

name: AminoChain
description: AminoChain is revolutionizing the $115B biobank market with a decentralized biobank that connects hospitals, biobanks, and pharmaceutical companies to streamline the licensing of biosamples and data. The platform also incentivizes sample donorship by compensating donors with royalties to increase sample utilization and accelerate scientific research.

name: Ammobia
description: Ammobia is reinventing ammonia production with modular, fossil-free systems that run on just air, water, and renewable electricity. Its compact Synloop units cut costs and emissions — enabling clean, on-site ammonia for agriculture, hydrogen transport, and industrial use.

name: Ampool
description: Ampool enables high speed analysis of data stored locally or in the cloud. It accesses data stored across all silos in real time while running sub-second queries.

name: Analog
description: Analog is a groundbreaking protocol that allows different blockchain networks to communicate seamlessly, solving a key challenge in the crypto space. By enabling cross-chain interactions, it opens the door to more versatile applications in finance, supply chain management, and beyond, potentially transforming how blockchain technology is used in daily life.

name: Andromeda Surgical
description: Andromeda Surgical operates at the intersection of surgical technology and AI, aimed at enhancing surgical procedures through advanced robotics. For its beachhead market, Andromeda is applying AI to solve technical challenges deterring the widespread adoption of an effective procedure for enlarged prostate, a condition affecting about half of all men.

name: Anduin Transactions
description: Anduin is a deep tech company focused on streamlining private market transactions and eliminating friction caused by complex, manual, error-prone processes and fragmented systems Its platform can integrate with existing client systems and processes to track investor engagement through actionable insights and streamline the fund subscription process.

name: ANRA
description: ANRA is a cloud-based, unmanned air-traffic management platform for commercial drone operators and civil governments. The company provides management, data analytics, FAA compliance, resource management, and maintenance information in a single platform.

name: Ansel
description: Ansel (formerly Brella) offers an innovative supplemental health insurance plan that allows employees to choose their coverage level to offset health insurance deductibles, cost-sharing and other recovery-related expenses. It collaborates with brokers and employers to provide employees with cash for any of 13,000+ covered conditions that can be used for medical bills or recovery needs, while its technology ensures swift claim approvals and payments issued within hours.

name: Anthology
description: Anthology aims to enhance biomanufacturing by optimizing genomes of various organisms in a sustainable and cost-competitive way. The technology’s diverse applications include materials and food commodities, enzymes, protein therapeutics, and industrial chemicals.

name: Anycart
description: Anycart combines features of grocery delivery services and recipe websites in a single platform. Users can shop for any meal and order the requisite groceries, with free home delivery or store pickup from grocery stores in 200+ cities.

name: Anything World
description: Anything World is an AI-enabled middleware platform that helps developers build interactive 3D experiences for games, images, and video production — at lower costs and speeds 40% faster than alternatives. The platform combines voice computing and 3D rendering with layers of behavioral intelligence. Its 600,000 digital assets can easily be integrated into any 3D world, and its voice-controlled system can seamlessly populate 3D environments.

name: Anyware Robotics
description: Anyware Robotics develops AI-powered mobile robots for heavy-duty tasks like warehouse box unloading — improving safety, efficiency, and costs in the $250B+ handling and logistics market. Its flagship robot lifts boxes up to 65 pounds, operates safely in open environments, and can be purchased or supplied via a Robotics-as-a-Service model, providing scalable and reliable warehouse solutions.

name: Anzen Insurance
description: Anzen combines ML and NLP tools to help businesses prevent or mitigate insurance claims related to founder, management, or shareholder liability. Anzen also provides a marketplace of its preferred network of carrier partners, using AI to pre-underwrite risks, map the risk appetite of dozens of carriers, compare quotes, and help close coverage faster and more efficiently.

name: Anzu.io
description: Anzu is an advertising platform and analytics tool for the gaming industry. Their patented real-time 3D tracking provides marketers with accurate viewer metrics and the ability to target user personas seamlessly in-game.

name: ApertureData
description: ApertureData provides a high-performance data management solution that makes visual assets easily manageable for machine learning and other applications. Its visual data management system, ApertureDB, accelerates and simplifies ML-based applications. It enables media, entertainment, medical imaging, and other types of companies to gain insights from their large collection of images, videos, and associated high-dimensional data.

name: Apollo Atomics
description: Apollo Atomics is a nuclear energy company redesigning how reactors are made, replacing the traditional custom construction model with factory-produced, transportable systems sized for data centers and grid-scale power. Its core innovation is a compact steam generator that transfers the same energy as a conventional unit at a fraction of the size, enabling the entire plant to be manufactured, tested, and delivered in a fraction of the time and cost of a traditional nuclear facility.

name: Appify
description: "Appify helps businesses build custom applications to address a range of digitization needs, from simple data entry to more complex workflows." A no-code, drag and drop model with customizable application sets enables technical and non-technical users to build mobile apps.

name: Applied XL
description: Applied XL is an AI company that monitors massive databases and provides industry-specific updates in real time, such as new treatments and new ways of diagnosing diseases. The company creates digital sensors for detecting changes in industry-specific data powered by the latest machine learning techniques and editorial algorithms. The AXL intelligence platform delivers real-time alerts by detecting highly relevant shifts in clinical trials data.

name: AppMap
description: AppMap reduces developer work by providing continuous runtime behavior, observability, mapping, and dynamic quality feedback in the code editor to improve software performance, stability, and security. AppMap reveals key data missing from the software development process during the moment of code creation, directly in the code editor.

name: Apprentice Health
description: Apprentice Health develops software that helps care teams keep their workdays personalized, smooth, on-time, and profitable. It offers scheduling, analytics, and analysis that enable healthcare professionals to create high-performance workflows.

name: Aprende Institute
description: Apprende (Learn) has developed the leading online education platform for vocational training in LatAm and the U.S. Hispanic market, offering a wide array of online certifications and courses. Their platform integrates technology and digital media with traditional instruction-led activities, helping employees and students improve her work skills, start their own business, or embark on a new career. It monitors student progress, promotes engaged learning, and provides students a flexible, customized learning experience that is accessible on any device.

name: Aqua
description: Aqua serves as the operational infrastructure for financial advisors to offer alternative assets private equity, private credit, real estate, and venture to retail investor Aqua is an AI-native platform that services some of most respective fund managers giving advisors a simple, compliant path to alts.

name: Aquabyte
description: Aquabyte’s aquaculture monitoring systems use cameras and machine learning to improve fish farming efficiency. The platform uses computer vision technology to offer real-time sea lice counts, biomass estimation, and feed optimization.

name: Arable Labs
description: Arable Labs provides farmers with a hardware and software suite to efficiently and scalably collect crop data. The platform leverages AI and machine learning to help farmers optimize when and how much to irrigate, fertilize, and use pesticides.

name: Arc Technologies
description: ArcFI provides SaaS companies with fast, non-dilutive growth capital, delivered through a seamless, consumerized enterprise technology experience. By integrating with customers’ backend financial systems through its secure customer portal, ArcFi can make real-time underwriting decisions algorithmically to provide software companies with instant capital without seeing dilution or taking on debt.

name: Arcadia Power
description: Arcadia has developed a clean energy tech platform that provides individuals and organizations greater transparency into their energy usage. Their platform provides easy access to clean energy via a mobile-optimized dashboard to manage, track, and view energy usage. This gives homeowners, businesses, and others greater control over what energy they support, how much it costs, and how they pay.

name: Arch Lending
description: Arch offers wealth management for next-gen investors in alternative markets such as crypto, private shares, and venture capital — filling a need that traditional financial institutions have largely ignored. With a focus on higher-income individuals who invest heavily in alternative assets, Arch allows users to take out a single loan collateralized by a combined portfolio, initially focusing on cryptocurrencies.

name: Architect.io
description: Architect is an end-to-end, DevOps-as-a-Service platform that serves modern software architecture needs by helping teams collaborate and achieve deployment, networking, and security automation all at once. Architect’s innovative Architecture-as-Code framework automates tedious time-consuming and error-prone tasks, allowing software developers to extend other microservices, secure their applications, and more rapidly deploy to production and on-demand environments.

name: Arcus
description: Arcus (formerly Regalii) has built a two-way, real-time API that connects financial service providers with merchants. The API allows banks and financial service providers’ customers to connect bills and payments directly to their bank and credit cards.

name: Arda Therapeutics
description: Arda Therapeutics is taking aim at chronic disease and aging by eliminating the pathogenic cells that drive these conditions, providing safer and better treatments for conditions like fibrosis and autoimmune diseases. Leveraging its proprietary machine learning discovery engine, Arda pinpoints pathogenic cells, offering more effective treatments with fewer side effects compared to traditional approaches.

name: Ardius
description: Ardius is a research and development tax credit management platform. Their solution discovers R&D tax credits, provides tax forms for filing, and generates comprehensive reports for validation and compliance for SMBs.

name: Area 2 Farms
description: Area 2 Farms blends technological innovation with an automized, community-centric approach to farming that reduces transportation needs and boosts local food economies. Area 2’s indoor farms leverage a patented robotic system for efficient, diverse crop production while prioritizing healthy soil and sustainable agriculture practices.

name: Arise
description: Arise provides virtual care services for eating disorders, connecting users to inclusive support from mental health therapists, dietitians, and peers. With a trauma-informed, holistic approach, Arise addresses various stages of patient conditions with immediate and long-term support.

name: Arris Composites
description: Arris Composites, developer of next-gen composites for mass market applications designed to address the scalability problem of 3D printing and the steep costs and limitations of composite manufacturing.

name: Arrive
description: Arrive is a scalable, friction-free drive-up and reservation parking service for consumers and enterprise customers. They partner with companies, brands, and municipalities of all kinds to provide seamless parking and other mobility-related services.

name: Arrows
description: Arrows helps software companies onboard new customers, ensuring that those customers get up and running with new digital products as quickly as possible. Arrows replaces spreadsheets or project management tools with a shared onboarding plan with tasks, checklists, and email reminders.

name: Artiphon
description: Artiphon is dedicated to making smart, playful instruments that everyone can enjoy. Their flagship products are Orba, a handheld synth/looper, and INSTRUMENT 1, a MIDI controller that lets you strum, bow, tap, slide, and drum any sound on a single interface.

name: Artisan
description: Artisan AI automates sales outreach by integrating AI-driven personalization, lead qualification, and follow-up sequences into a single platform. Artisan replaces legacy tools by handling lead discovery, research, and hyper-personalized email engagement, allowing sales teams to focus on high-value relationships.

name: Ascend Elements
description: Ascend Elements has created an IP-protected recycling process focused on lithium-ion batteries for Electric Vehicles, a market projected to rapidly grow (>30% CAGR) over the next decade. Ascend Elements enables not just the recycling of battery chemicals but also the re-production of cathode materials — one of the more costly components of Li-ion batteries — all with a 59% lower cost of goods vs. producing from virgin raw materials.

name: Ascent
description: Ascent is a hardware-enabled SaaS platform that provides real-time situational awareness and actionable insights for firefighters, special forces, and SWAT teams. Via a single dashboard, the platform gives incident commanders real-time information on their team's location and condition, while mapping and monitoring the battle space.

name: Aslan
description: Aslan addresses the crisis of mass shootings by deploying self-guided AI agents that detect early-stage “leakage” in online communities and alert law enforcement before violence occurs. Its dashboard surfaces intent signals, risk indicators, and message context — offering a proactive alternative to reactive tools like OSINT and gun detection.

name: Assembly
description: Assembly (formerly Copilot) is a client portal platform that enables professional services businesses run by enabling clients to send messages, make payments, sign contracts, and access custom apps. It also offers internal tools, AI-powered assistance, and greater extensibility through third-party integrations and custom apps.

name: Assort Health
description: Assort Health builds AI agents for the healthcare front door, helping provider organizations automate administrative work that determines whether patients can actually access care — scheduling, referrals, intake, outreach, payment collection, and follow-up. Its platform integrates into existing electronic health record systems, encoding specialty-specific workflows and compounding accuracy across every patient interaction to reduce labor costs, improve schedule utilization, and deliver a better patient experience.

name: Astra
description: Astra is a mobile app that allows consumers to optimize their cash flow through automated bank transfers. The app lets users transfer cash between their checking and savings accounts, to enable an easier, more intuitive cash-flow processes.

name: Astro Mechanica
description: Astro Mechanica is developing the world’s first electric-adaptive engine, capable of delivering unmatched versatility and efficiency and suitable for everything from commercial airliners to orbital launches. Unlike existing engines, its engine is efficient at any speed — from subsonic to hypersonic — powering aircraft that can launch payloads to orbit for 3x cheaper or fly 3x faster than regular aircraft.

name: Astrus
description: Astrus streamlines the microchip design process by automating analog layout using state-of-the-art AI. Automating this process helps launch hardware products more quickly by reducing hardware iterations and manual work.

name: Asylon Robotics
description: Asylon Robotics deploys autonomous security drones and robot dogs that automatically patrol facilities and respond to alarms, monitored 24/7 by its remote operations center. Asylon’s robotic systems, equipped with computer vision and AI, deliver faster, more scalable protection with 30% cost savings compared to traditional security guards.

name: Atero AI
description: Atero AI is set to transform the $81 billion AI server market with its solution that significantly boosts GPU efficiency and reduces costs for complex AI/ML workloads demanding high computational power. Atero AI improves how efficiently GPUs are used in AI/ML systems, boosting their average usage from 35% to 99% with its technology, RDMA Enabled Workload Orchestration.

name: Atlas
description: Atlas (formerly Trading TV) enables users to invest in professionally managed portfolios organized by themes that its analysts believe will provide alpha-generating performance over the long term. Examples of portfolio themes include Sports and Entertainment, Young Money (FinTech), Sustainability and ESG, Future of Work, and Recession Ready.

name: Atom Computing
description: Atom computing develops highly scalable neutral-atom quantum computers to accelerate timelines to useful quantum. Using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms, the company works with researchers, governments, and enterprises to help unlock the enormous potential of quantum computing applications.

name: Atomic Supply
description: Atomic Supply is revolutionizing inventory management with an AI-powered platform that streamlines planning, reduces costs, and eliminates reliance on spreadsheets or rigid legacy systems. By analyzing transaction-level data, it improves forecasting, optimizes stock levels, and enables faster, data-driven decision-making.

name: Atomic8
description: Atomic8 offers a Slack app that helps managers and contributors on distributed teams to be more productive and efficient in their work and collaboration. Distributed team members provide inputs and leverage AI to find actionable insights and move projects forward while reducing unnecessary time spent in meetings.

name: Attest Technologies Limited
description: Attest is a B2B SaaS market research platform designed to offer on-demand consumer insights. Its platform enables companies to engage directly with 100+ million consumers across 45+ countries.

name: Audioshake
description: Audioshake has developed a music creation platform that helps musicians, audio engineers, and others to deconstruct music tracks into stems (vocals, guitars, drums, etc.), creating new uses for music. Their patented AI technology can take any song — no matter how it was recorded — and break it into its stems, enabling it to be used in instrumentals, sampling, remixes, and more. In addition to expanding creativity, the platform incorporates licensing information to protect copyright owners.

name: Audit Sight
description: Audit Sight eliminates manual work for auditors, diligence, and private equity providers by automating financial transaction verification. Through the use of APIs to collect company records and verify the records to third-party data sources, Audit Sight makes it easy for auditors to access the data they need quickly and with minimal impact on their clients.

name: Aurelius Systems
description: Aurelius Systems builds a lightweight, AI-powered laser turret designed to autonomously detect and destroy fast, low-flying drones at near-zero marginal cost. Combining real-time threat elimination with battlefield intelligence, Aurelius aims to create a globally networked defense mesh against modern drone warfare.

name: Aurora
description: Aurora has developed an Ethereum Virtual Machine and a powerful cross-chain bridge that delivers a turnkey solution for developers to operate their apps on Aurora’s Ethereum-compatible platform. Their platform enables developers to launch Ethereum decentralized apps on Aurora within minutes by clicking on other Ethereum contracts and assets. The Aurora Engine and Bridge provide a scalable, future-safe solution that speed up transaction throughput and lower costs.

name: Aurora Insight
description: Aurora Insight delivers a map of wireless spectrum connectivity in a more efficient manner than traditional methodologies. Users can stay ahead of deployments and harness the radio environment with data-driven insights on spectrum and wireless networks.

name: Autonomys
description: Autonomys (fka Subspace Labs) is a decentralized AI platform that integrates distributed storage, computing power, and various applications to develop AI-powered tools securely. Its unique identity protocol enables safe interactions between humans and AI, making it the only network of its kind that combines the groundbreaking potential of Web3 and AI.

name: AVA
description: AVA has developed a lightweight health device that monitors and filters pollutants for better respiratory health. The AVA Breathe is a personal air purifier that filters out pollens, allergens, and particulate matter while tracking local air quality.

name: Ava Protocol
description: Ava Protocol (fka OAK Network) lets developers efficiently automate functions across blockchains (including Ethereum), without compromising privacy, revolutionizing how decentralized systems handle automated operations. Ava ensures that only the final result of a transaction is visible on public blockchains, enhancing decentralized applications with secure scheduling and automation for use cases like DeFi, NFTs, and gaming.

name: Avalanche
description: Avalanche is developing compact, 3x4 foot fusion microreactors — called Orbitrons — that deliver clean, 5kW modular power for data centers, defense, autonomous systems, and space. Designed for rapid prototyping and mass manufacturing at a fraction of traditional costs, Avalanche pairs cost-effective design with fast iteration to accelerate de-risking and deployment.

name: AvantStay
description: AvantStay’s booking service specializes in six-guest-plus group bookings at 1,000+ vacation rental homes the company manages in some 100 U.S. cities. AvantStay delivers a highly-curated experience using a proprietary tech suite to power bookings, operationalize in-field and remote management, and activate elevated consumer touchpoints.

name: Aviator
description: Aviator is a productivity platform that helps software teams scale without introducing cumbersome workflow overhead for their developers. With Aviator’s productivity-oriented tools, engineers save up to 10 hours a week on their code-submission and testing processes, plus many other tasks.

name: Avoca
description: Avoca AI provides an AI-powered workforce for service businesses where inbound calls directly generate revenue. By handling, routing, and coaching customer interactions around the clock, Avoca helps companies capture more bookings while improving consistency and customer experience.

name: Aware Healthcare
description: Aware Healthcare is a national network of therapists delivering data-driven, high-quality, easier to find, personalized mental health care. The platform measures 1000+ biomarkers across five areas of health and then surfaces aggregated insights to the patient. Via a smartphone app and desktop dashboard, Aware Healthcare provides quantitative measures of a patient's cognition, sociability, sleep patterns, mobility, and vitals to deliver personalized, evidence-based care.

name: Axiom Space
description: Axiom is opening new markets in low-Earth orbit (LEO) through operating end-to-end missions to the International Space Station while privately developing its successor — a permanent commercial destination in Earth's orbit. Its low-cost LEO platform access supports research, testing of exploration-enabling technologies, and in-space manufacturing to create new opportunities for industries, governments, and educators and enable future human space exploration.

name: Axoft
description: Axoft has developed novel brain implants using soft, durable, brain-like polymer material that can be utilized for a wide array of neurological diseases. Bridging the gap between electronic and biological materials, Axoft’s nanofabricated brain implants do not harm the central nervous system and can reside in the body for the long term. The implants target conditions such as seizures and movement disorders such as Parkinson's Disease.

name: Ayar Labs
description: Ayar Labs is an in-package optical I/O company that aims to make data transmission more efficient by replacing traditional copper wires with interconnects that move data using light waves. The company is disrupting the traditional performance, cost, and efficiency curves of the semiconductor and computing industries by delivering a 1000x improvement in interconnect bandwidth density at 10x lower power.

name: Ayraa AI
description: Ayraa is an AI-driven intelligent workplace security and operations platform. It allows users to manage security and engagement through all stages of the employee lifecycle, using machine learning techniques for content processing and detection.

name: Aztec
description: Aztec is the privacy layer for Web3, allowing users to confidentially access world-class DeFi services on Ethereum with up to 100x cost-savings. Aztec’s allows users to privately connect to Ethereum’s decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem — including popular apps Uniswap, Lido, and Aave — through either bridge contracts or their own SDK.

name: Azumo
description: Azumo develops proprietary lighting technology that converts thin and inexpensive plastics into efficient, powerful light sources. It can be used for a large variety of devices, from displays on users’ electronics to lighting fixtures in their homes.

name: B Generous
description: B Generous is a credit platform for the philanthropic sector. Its platform allows donors to “Donate Now, Pay Later” through an instant credit-granting process that can be embedded into any nonprofit’s donation process.

name: Babylon
description: Babylon solves security issues for Proof-of-Stake (PoS) blockchain-based algorithms that secure many cryptocurrencies. Babylon’s Proof-of-Work (PoW) chain provides a timestamp of events happening on the PoS chain. This includes checkpointing, issuance of fraud proofs, stalling evidence, and censored transactions.

name: Bacon
description: Bacon Work is a virtual marketplace for gig workers and freelancers seeking flexible work shifts and for companies wanting to fill open shifts with temporary independent contract workers. Bacon’s platform allows employers to post part-time or temporary jobs, check the rating and background of individual applicants, and connect with applicants in real time to fill positions.

name: Badge
description: Badge is a mobile wallet automation platform that makes it easy for companies and marketers to create dynamic digital wallet experiences in Apple, Google, and Samsung wallets. Featuring a no-code pass builder, push notifications, location-based services, and a marketing automation suite, their platform enables marketers to create customer-first connections with personalized and location based push notifications.

name: Baffle.io
description: Baffle develops cybersecurity software that ensures data remains encrypted across a variety of areas, aiming to reduce data hacks and breaches. It ensures that data is protected not only on-premise or in the cloud, but also in databases or cached in memory.

name: Bainbridge Health
description: Bainbridge is a health safety software platform designed by clinicians to reduce medication errors. The platform allows clinicians to focus on decisions, making medication data easily available and simple to aggregate, analyze, and act on.

name: Ballers
description: Ballers creates membership-driven, urban social clubs anchored in sports like squash, padel, and soccer, and layered with food, fitness, culture, and events. Designed as modern third spaces, the clubs provide a vibrant alternative to traditional clubs where members can play, connect, and belong.

name: Balsa
description: Balsa is a command center for all the tools that engineers use. The product will be the project management interface for developer tools.

name: Banana
description: Banana is a no-code, machine learning platform that enables developers to train, deploy, and run custom models. Their platform makes it easier for users to compartmentalize and parse through information, bringing ML superpowers to any developer. Think of it as a Github for machine learning.

name: Bandit ML
description: Bandit ML is a SaaS solution that optimize incentives, promotions, and pricing strategies for e-commerce merchants. Using machine learning, their platform sends the right offer at the right time to online customers automatically, boosting profit and retention.

name: Barnwell Bio
description: Barnwell Bio turns farm waste into real-time disease monitoring using metagenomic sequencing, helping prevent costly livestock outbreaks like avian flu. Its platform provides actionable data for farmers and veterinarians — offering early detection, nutrition insights, and sustainability metrics through a scalable, subscription-based model.

name: Barnyard
description: Barnyard is a new game studio that is focused on creating innovative, high-quality, and engaging experiences within Epic’s (creator of Fortnite) ecosystem. The seasoned team will leverage its 25-year gaming expertise to develop superior AAA games on Fortnite Creative 2.0 Platform, supporting Epic's aim to become a launchpad for new game types.

name: Base Venture
description: FIS (formerly Base Venture) is a technology company developing software for the private fund management industry through a Data Visualization Portal. Their software blends analysis, automated integration, and a dashboard for asset managers and fund administrators.

name: Baseball United
description: Baseball United is the first pro baseball league in the Middle East and Indian subcontinent, aiming to inspire one billion fans through youth development, media production, partnerships, and nonprofit outreach. A sanctioned MLB winter league, Baseball United's inaugural All-Star Showcase reached 200 million households across 127 countries, and several of its owners are baseball legends.

name: Basebuild
description: Basebuild gives real estate teams real-time visibility over financial operations and cheaper access to capital. Its all-in-one finance platform provides a B2B payments network, payment cards, and access to financing. Its tools enable real estate developers to make smarter decisions faster through real-time budgets and a system of record. Developers can tie payments to performance with tightly integrated approvals and payment workflows and get paid faster through easier access to capital.

name: Basil Systems
description: Basil Systems is a comprehensive industry knowledgebase of medtech and pharma data, The company aggregates information from disconnected sources into one platform that professionals across multiple industries will be able to leverage. Serving healthcare providers, OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers), regulatory agencies, purchasing groups, and insurers, the platform provides analytics and insights that guide strategic healthcare product development.

name: Batch
description: Batch (formerly BACH) is a mobile app that streamlines the planning and organization of group events, including bachelor/bachelorette parties, by providing a unified platform for booking and collaboration. It also works with suppliers of related products and services to weave their existing processes into Batch's mobile app.

name: Battleface
description: Battleface is a tech company providing travel insurance coverage solutions — including emergency medical, travel, and claims assistance services — to individuals and groups all over the world. The company connects travelers to customized insurance solutions that deliver the right insurance at the right price — where and when they need it. Battleface’s ability to write and reinsure its own risk gives it greater control of the data and financial value generated by its customers.

name: BE Therapeutics
description: BE Therapeutics develops technology that can engineer functional brain tissue to replace the tissue impaired by age-related damage. It aims to commercialize this tissue and methodology for pre-clinical and clinical applications, with an initial focus on repairing damage caused by strokes.

name: Beacon Biosignals
description: Beacon Biosignals uses sleep EEG and AI to create reliable brain biomarkers, helping drug developers run faster, more precise trials for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders Its FDA-cleared at-home headband and large, real-world neurophysiology datasets turn nighttime brain activity into objective measures that de-risk studies and support approvals.

name: Beam
description: Beam (formerly Slai) helps developers quickly build machine learning-powered applications without the pain of managing their own infrastructure. Instead of spending months building their own ML platforms, developers use Beam’s platform to run their code on serverless GPUs, deploy highly performant APIs, and rapidly prototype ML.

name: Beam Benefits
description: Beam Benefits (formerly Beam Dental) is a digitally-native employee benefits company that offers dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental health coverage for employers of all sizes. Beam simplifies and modernizes the ancillary benefits industry through its intuitive online platform, self-service tools, AI-powered underwriting, and thoughtful coverage for improved overall wellness.

name: Beam Organics
description: Beam Organics is a CBD consumer products company that is reimagining wellness by pairing high-quality ingredients with innovative products. Their four lines of THC-free CBD products — Balance, Performance, Recovery, and Sleep — target a wellness-minded community.

name: BeatpulseLabs
description: BeatpulseLabs builds the data infrastructure layer for generative AI companies developing audio, video, speech, and music models, providing fully annotated, IP-compliant multimedia datasets customized to each client's specific training requirements. The company combines exclusive broadcaster partnerships with proprietary annotation tools and petabyte-scale ingestion capabilities, delivering both curated datasets and specialized labeling services that enable AI researchers to focus on building models rather than sourcing content.

name: Beekin
description: Beekin has developed a real estate management platform that uses proprietary and third-party data to help landlords make better decisions to reduce inefficiencies and risks. Their platform is aimed at REITs and private equity fund landlords. It provides a big data and AI-powered solution to find and retain tenants, adopt data-based marketing strategies, and provide better customer service.

name: Beem
description: Beem is an AI-powered Smart Wallet app helping Americans make payments, cover emergencies, file taxes, save on insurance, and more, In determining instant cash advances, Beem uses a proprietary algorithm designed to free customers from the need for credit checks and income restrictions that traditional sources of credit impose.

name: BEGin
description: BEGiN created HOMER (formerly Speakaboos), an interactive reading subscription program for children that is delivered via web, mobile, and tablet devices. The platform uses methods designed to keep kids reading, including highlighting tools and engaging touchscreen interactions.

name: Believer
description: Believer aims to be the next big name among gaming studios, disrupting the “box product” mindsets of past games with a new era of non-linear, multi-player, open gameplay. The company will leverage frontier technology (AI, cloud computing, ML-augmented production, game engines) to accelerate game development and integrate with other content experiences such as TV / film, music, and sports.

name: Belli
description: Belli is a modern air cargo OS that streamlines booking, load planning, and billing with AI and embedded payments, cutting invoicing and settlement from weeks to hours. Its APIs connect with warehouse scanners, flight-planning tools, and accounting systems to ensure seamless data flow and unlock underused belly space.

name: Belong Health
description: Belong Health offers regional payers the infrastructure and expertise to manage Medicare Advantage and Special Needs Plans for seniors and complex-need populations gated by regulatory and operational barriers. Through joint ventures and its AI-powered platform, Belong drives earlier interventions, better care coordination, and patient-centered coverage in a rapidly growing, $800B market.

name: Beltways
description: Beltways is revolutionizing short-range mobility with high-speed, energy-efficient moving walkways designed for airports, campuses, and urban centers. The company’s scalable and reliable transit system minimizes downtime, reduces costs, and provides a smarter alternative to outdated trams and slow-moving walkways.

name: Bench IQ
description: Bench IQ offers an Al-powered assistant that provides law firms and corporate and government litigators with strategic intelligence on judges and attorneys.

name: Bend Financial
description: Bend Financial is a tech-enabled HSA management platform. Their solution uses AI to offer personalized guidance that enables customers to optimize tax benefits and health spending.

name: Benepass
description: Benepass provides benefit cards that help improve and simplify employee access to benefits. Their platform enables employers to manage their benefits policies by distributing funds via prepaid debit cards to employees, and it eases onboarding and offboarding.

name: Benny
description: Benny is a lending platform that helps employees participate in their company’s employee stock purchase plans (ESPP). Through loans from Benny, employees can contribute to company ESPPs without impacting their take-home pay — and later split the created value with 80% to the employee and 20% to Benny.

name: Better Life Partners
description: Better Life Partners is helping people address Opioid Use Disorder and achieve their recovery goals with techniques tailored to their individual situation. Their program combines the best evidence-based practices into a community-based delivery model

name: Better Mortgage
description: Better is a real estate mortgage lending platform that gives users a faster, lower cost digital mortgage experience backed by customer support. They have streamlined the mortgage process to eliminate fees, unnecessary steps, and unneeded appointments.

name: Betterleave
description: Betterleave is a B2B2C bereavement care platform that provides personalized, clinical care to employees (via their employers) experiencing grief and loss. Besides offering grief support from care coordinators and experts, Betterleave provides employees with personalized funeral, memorial, and estate coordination services.

name: BetterView
description: Betterview provides software and services that capture, organize, and analyze data for buildings and properties to unlock valuable insight. Insurance companies can manage property risk by using insight, workflow tools, and a geospatial predictive analytics platform.

name: BetterYou.ai
description: BetterYou has developed a digital wellness coach app that drives health insurance savings for employers by helping employees spend more time on activities that boost their overall wellness. The platform enables users to set goals for physical health, social connections, education, and mindfulness, then maps how users can spend their time and provides helpful nudges

name: BeyondHQ
description: BeyondHQ is a location intelligence solution helping companies analyze new markets for expansion. Their real-time collaborative SaaS platform helps companies run talent and real estate analyses to explore new markets.

name: BeyondTrucks
description: BeyondTrucks provides small trucking companies an end-to-end financial platform that integrates into a trucking company's operations. The platform combines credit and debit cards, revenue finance, and easy-to-use software to automate finance and operational workflows. This helps trucking companies run more efficiently while establishing a system of record that gives them access to better priced credit.

name: Big Wolf
description: Big Wolf is a developer, live operator, and publisher of mobile games. The company uses its narrative-based game engine to quickly produce high-quality games, in a transformative game development process that can be compared to ‘Roblox for interactive stories.’

name: BigRoom
description: BigRoom is a SaaS platform for live video production. Its proprietary AI analyzes thousands of visual and audio factors in real time across multiple camera feeds, seamlessly editing and producing professional-grade video content on the fly.

name: Billables
description: Billables.ai is centralizing activity data to automate the operations of professional services firms (e.g., lawyers, consultants, agencies, accountants), starting with billing and invoicing. Using LLMs, Billable integrates with Microsoft, Zoom, and G Suite to auto-generate customized billing reports, replacing traditional manual processes.

name: Bionaut Labs
description: Bionaut Labs develops microscale wireless robots called Bionauts, designed to safely and precisely navigate to deep and hard-to-reach locations within the human body for the delivery of diverse medical therapies. Utilizing modular design and magnetic propulsion, Bionauts are capable of delivering therapeutic and diagnostic payloads across a range of tissue types, revolutionizing the measurement, analysis, and treatment of human diseases.

name: Bionic Health
description: Bionic Health clinic changes the way patients approach their health and wellness by using state-of-the-art medical research and machine learning. Bionic combines the latest in longevity medicine, frequent comprehensive diagnostics, and cutting-edge machine learning to deliver individualized patient treatment plans.

name: Birch
description: Birch (fka She’s Well) is an AI-powered healthcare technology company tackling the global healthcare worker shortage by converting clinical conversations into accurate, real-time structured notes. Designed to reduce clinician burnout and enhance patient care, Birch’s AI improves diagnostic accuracy and streamlines workflows, all while prioritizing safety, ethics, and health equity.

name: BirdStop
description: Birdstop provides autonomous drone systems that cut emergency response times from 10 minutes to under 60 seconds by launching from fixed perches and flying beyond visual line of sight. Its FAA-approved, all-in-one platform gives municipalities and enterprises fine-tuned, real-time aerial surveillance without the hassle of piecing together hardware, software, and regulatory approvals.

name: BistroCat
description: BistroCat has developed the world's first automated wet cat food feeder that doesn't require ice packs or refrigeration, providing healthier meals without the mess. The patented technology ensures cats receive healthy, wet meals on their schedule, reducing health risks and enhancing care with comprehensive tracking and analysis tools.

name: Bit Fry Game Studios
description: Bit Fry is building a franchise of fantasy sports-themed video games that lets players create their own metaverse of competitions and competitors based on real athletes. Players can switch famous athletes between teams and sports (LeBron plays football) and combine attributes from different players. The result is an addictive, arcade-like experience that Bit Fry will leverage by generating revenue on custom-created assets (NFTs), which players can use across the company’s game metaverse.

name: Bit.io
description: Bit.io helps developers become immediately productive with any Postgres database, making uploading and sharing databases as easy as editing a Google Doc. Bit.io’s offers the first truly serverless Postgres that, with a single click, can be spun up, shared with others, and edited instantly in a browser – no sign-up or provisioning required.

name: Bitwave
description: Bitwave is the leading enterprise-focused digital asset management platform designed to provide visibility and transparency in tax, accounting, and compliance for cryptocurrency, DeFi, and NFTs. Bitwave helps enterprise finance and accounting departments manage and integrate digital assets with traditional bookkeeping and internal systems.

name: Bizzen
description: Bizzen is an AI-driven platform that streamlines construction workflows by automating project evaluation, contract estimation, and invoicing for home service providers. By leveraging voice AI and proprietary data, Bizzen enhances productivity, reduces lag time, and enables SMB contractors to assess and manage projects hands-free in real-time.

name: Blade
description: Blade was a B2B payment-processing platform that extended a debit card global payment network for use with digital currencies. It enabled a single payment card to debit multiple accounts, enabling companies to make cross-border/FX payments to suppliers.

name: Bland AI
description: Bland AI builds AI voice agents for healthcare, financial services, and other high-volume sectors that automate complex enterprise phone interactions, enabling companies to replace human call centers with conversational AI that handles lengthy, multi-step customer workflows. The company operates a vertically integrated voice stack with proprietary transcription and inference models, enabling it to deliver cost-effective automation while maintaining performance and compliance standards required by enterprises.

name: Blank Bio
description: Blank Bio is building RNA foundation models to make designing mRNA medicines faster, cheaper, and more precise — tackling a problem where the possible sequences for a single mRNA exceed the stars in the universe. Its models, already used by Sanofi and GSK, outperform leading alternatives and support applications from personalized therapies and cancer vaccines to virtual cell modeling.

name: BlastPoint
description: BlastPoint is an analytics platform that combines location and mapping information from many sources with customers’ private data. Their predictive AI-powered platform answers customer engagement problems, granting businesses useful insights.

name: Blaze
description: Blaze (fka Almanac) is an AI-powered marketing tool designed to help solo entrepreneurs create on-brand content in half the time, streamlining the creation process from brainstorming to publishing. Blaze empowers small businesses to compete with big tech by providing a comprehensive platform that combines tools like Canva, Google Docs, ChatGPT, and Shopify into one powerful solution.

name: Block.a
description: Block.a simplifies the apartment rental process by introducing the world's first unified leasing system for property owners and managers. The company provides AI agents for instant listing responses, organized tours for occupied apartments, control apps for self-guided tours, and automated data collection.

name: BlockFi
description: BlockFi develops loans, trading, and a number of other financial services for cryptoassets. Users can earn interest in crypto and significantly increase their Bitcoin, Ether, and Gemini Dollar (GUSD) balances over time.

name: Bloom Energy
description: Bloom Energy delivers sustainable, cost-effective electricity for organizations. It manufactures and installs solid oxide fuel cells for onsite distributed power generation, reducing users’ carbon footprint.

name: Bloomfilter
description: Bloomfilter is developer of an enterprise software planning application that provides complete visibility into software development projects in order to improve the process and outcomes. The application leverages process mining and predictive algorithms to help teams identify process bottlenecks, predict project outcomes, and deliver more software on time and within budget.

name: Blue Note Therapeutics
description: Blue Note Therapeutics has developed a platform that makes mental health care more easily available to cancer patients. Their platform helps reduce anxiety, depression, and other distress related to cancer by delivering clinically validated, prescription mental health therapies to patients via their own mobile devices.

name: BlueQubit
description: BlueQubit’s provides quantum computing infrastructure software to simplify the development, testing, and deployment of quantum applications. Its platform enables enterprise, defense, and academic customers to run quantum algorithms on some of the most sophisticated quantum processors available, such as those developed by IBM and NVIDIA.

name: Bluesky
description: Bluesky is an open, decentralized social media platform designed to give users control over their experience, fostering creativity and community while ensuring independence from corporate ownership. Built on the open-source AT Protocol, Bluesky envisions a social ecosystem that fosters innovation, enabling users and developers to collaborate freely across interconnected platforms.

name: Bluespace.ai
description: BlueSpace develops software that helps maximize the advances and advantages of 4D LiDAR sensor technologies. It increases the safety of autonomous vehicles, accelerating adoption and increasing efficiency across trunk transit routes.

name: Bluewhite
description: Bluewhite specializes in robotic kits that can be retrofitted to conventional tractors, allowing them to operate autonomously in the field. The solution combines adaptable networking and robotics technologies and can be customized to any grower’s operation using IoT, edge-computing resources and private wireless networks.

name: BlueX Trade
description: BlueX aims to be the online category-leading payment solution for cross-border B2B freight logistics and trade, providing AI-driven insights for shipments. As a B2B payment and pay-later platform, BlueX enables supply chain players worldwide to bring their freight transactions online.

name: Boardroom
description: Boardroom is addressing the fragmented governance landscape with a simple, transparent platform for stakeholder management over DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations) and protocols. Its platform allows many different governance tools to plug into a single seamless framework that can serve an organization through all stages of its governance lifecycle — helping members make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.

name: Boldin
description: Boldin (fka NewRetirement) is an AI-powered financial planning platform with personalized retirement planning, financial wellness tools, and collaborative features for individuals, enterprises, and financial advisors. Using AI technology, the comprehensive planning and modeling engine analyzes thousands of scenarios to provide financial planning at scale.

name: BoldVoice
description: BoldVoice helps advanced English learners improve pronunciation and speaking confidence through an AI-guided training experience built for global professionals. By pairing Hollywood-level coaching with a rapidly growing speech dataset, the platform delivers personalized feedback that accelerates real-world fluency.

name: Bolster
description: Bolster is a tech-enabled executive search firm that connects companies with leadership talent for full-time, on-demand, and board roles. The company combines the power of experienced recruiters with an intelligent search platform to surface the best candidates and deliver a superior search experience, with flat fees and transparent pricing.

name: Bolto
description: Bolto (fka Onnix and Crew) is an AI-powered hiring platform that finds, vets, and onboards top global developers, enabling companies to quickly scale engineering teams. By handling sourcing, assessments, and HR services, Bolto streamlines hiring, ensuring developers start shipping quality code in days, not weeks.

name: BosonQ PSI
description: BosonQ Psi (BQP) is revolutionizing engineering simulations with BQPhy, a quantum-powered platform designed to eliminate bottlenecks caused by outdated simulation algorithms. The platform enables industries like aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing to reduce development time, cut costs, and explore a wider range of design options without sacrificing quality.

name: Boston Geospatial
description: Boston Geospatial is enabling single-pipe access to a number of satellite data providers. Their geospatial data platform allows this data to be searchable and comparable and provides tools for improved analysis.

name: Boulder Care
description: Boulder Care is a digital clinic offering long-term support and treatment for opioid addiction and other substance use disorders. Collaborating across medical, behavioral, and psychosocial dimensions, Boulder’s team delivers evidence-based care and helps participants work toward their individual goals. Through innovative partnerships with leading national health plans like Blue Cross Blue Shield, Boulder’s progressive payment arrangements realign incentives to reward outcomes and reduce total cost of care. Its model has resulted in a Net Promoter Score of 91 and 12-month retention rates that are two times higher than the average outpatient program.

name: Boundless Immigration
description: Boundless provides immigrants with tools, information, and personalized support to navigate the naturalization process. Its service provides new immigrants with access to an immigration lawyer and allows them to file critical paperwork online affordably.

name: BrandGuard
description: BrandGuard (formerly Nova) is an AI-powered brand governance platform that helps organizations ensure all marketing content stays consistent with brand guidelines, tone, and regulatory requirements. The company’s platform automatically reviews text, images, and other creative assets generated by people or AI, enabling marketing teams to accelerate approvals, maintain brand consistency, and safely scale AI-powered content creation.

name: Brave Care
description: Brave Care is a tech-enabled platform powering integrated care solutions via virtual and brick and mortar clinics. It integrates primary, urgent, and virtual care into a single consumer experience, providing a comprehensive pediatric solution.

name: Brave Health
description: Brave Health is a virtual clinic expanding access to high-quality mental-health and substance-abuse treatment for those who may not have access to such treatments in an office setting. Brave Health is a licensed Medicaid + Medicare provider (some states pending) and accepts most insurance, with the goal of reducing customer cost and location barriers. Patients are matched in their state with licensed psychiatrists, nurses, and counselors located across the country.

name: Bravo Sierra
description: Bravo Sierra is building an original lifestyle CPG ecosystem centered around a military brand ethos.

name: Breach Insured
description: Breach is a provider of insurance for digital assets, such as cryptocurrencies, that are vulnerable to cyberattack. Its solution allows users to configure a single insurance policy to manage all of their crypto risk.

name: Bridger Group
description: Bridger uses AI to transform small- and medium-sized accounting firms by automating repetitive tasks like data entry and transaction reconciliation, reducing inefficiencies and errors. This approach allows accountants to focus on higher-value services, enhancing productivity and client satisfaction while addressing industry-wide skill shortages.

name: Brightside
description: Brightside is a comprehensive financial health platform that partners with employers to give employees and their families the financial care they need, while improving productivity and retention. Brightside offers support for employees’ unique financial situation and easy access to a curated selection of financial products. Its mobile app and financial assistants are backed by proprietary financial methodology and modern behavioral science.

name: Brio Systems
description: Brio Systems is a health management company focused on measuring the impact of lifestyle changes to "nudge" changes in behavior. They provide a blood-testing service which offers personalized actionable insights and a clear plan for attaining health goals.

name: Briq
description: Briq is an AI-driven platform that revolutionizes financial operations in construction, automating and streamlining payments, planning, budgeting, and forecasting. It seamlessly integrates with major industry applications such as Autodeck and Salesforce, providing contractors with comprehensive financial workflow management with copilot functionality to optimize efficiency.

name: Build A Rocket Boy
description: BUILD A ROCKET BOY is a video game studio focused on the future of AAA games with its solution called EVERYWHERE for the next generation of gamers. EVERYWHERE is built from the ground up to enable emerging forms of interactive entertainment within games. It also provides the ability for players to generate content in an open-world within EVERYWHERE.

name: Bundle
description: Powered by a two-sided marketplace and project management tools, Bundle connects builders and suppliers on one platform, streamlining procurement with technology and saving stakeholders time and money. With Bundle, builders get access to real-time pricing and lead times all in one place — and with a few clicks rather than hundreds of calls and emails. Suppliers benefit from a digitized sales process, custom e-commerce, and access to data to better predict demand.

name: Burq
description: Burq is a network of delivery networks. Burq consolidates thousands of delivery providers into one platform so companies can easily offer the fastest and cheapest delivery option to their customers. With Burq’s API and delivery management software product, customers can deploy a highly cost- and service-optimized delivery capability with near zero implementation and management effort.

name: Burrow
description: Burrow is a direct-to-consumer furniture retailer. Their patented, modular designs permit the company’s products to be delivered through the UPS, assembled without tools, and easily disassembled to facilitate future moves.

name: Burst
description: Burst (Formerly Float) modernizes health spending by enabling HSA payments to work seamlessly across in-store, online, and subscription commerce. By handling eligibility and compliance behind the scenes, Float helps merchants capture high-intent health dollars while giving consumers a frictionless checkout experience.

name: BusRight
description: BusRight provides a cloud-based bus “control center” that increases the safety and efficiency of fleets, which represent the largest mass transit system in the country. BusRight provides a cloud-based bus “control center” that increases the safety and efficiency of fleets, which represent the largest mass transit system in the country.

name: Busy Co
description: Busy Co. (fka Busy Beauty) develops wipes that reduce the amount of time needed for a beauty routine, offering portable cleanliness solutions for customers on the go. They offer environmentally friendly face, body, and deodorizing wipes which are all TSA-approved.

name: Buzzer
description: Buzzer is a notification-driven mobile platform for the personalization and discovery of live sports. Its app aggregates and organizes live sports streams and allows its users to set up customized alerts based on their preferences.

name: C1
description: C1 (formerly ConductorOne) is the first multi-agent identity security platform built for the agentic AI era, protecting human, non-human, and AI identities across all apps and infrastructure. C1 automates 99% of identity tasks — from access approvals to risk assessments — helping security and IT teams reduce breaches, streamline compliance, and make identity security effortless.

name: Cabana
description: Cabana is an upscale mobile lodging company. The company's growing fleet of customized, luxury vans are designed to provide the amenities of a hotel room with the flexibility of an RV.

name: Cache
description: Cache is an AI platform that automates cash management by executing transfers between multiple accounts, helping consumers and banks boost savings, cut costs, and improve outcomes. Unlike traditional budgeting tools, Cache integrates with financial institutions to optimize funds automatically, simplifying money management for users and giving banks a competitive edge.

name: Cafler
description: Cafler is an all-in-one online marketplace connecting car owners with services like maintenance, insurance, parking, financing, and rentals through a seamless mobile app. By simplifying operations and enhancing efficiency, Cafler strives to become the ultimate super app for vehicle owners and businesses.

name: Cake AI
description: Cake AI is building AI project infrastructure that removes complexity and cost barriers, empowering businesses to adopt AI/ML faster and more easily. Cake’s integrated platform solves the entire AI infrastructure problem for customers 10x faster and 10x cheaper than alternatives.

name: Cala Health
description: Cala Health has developed the first Medicare-approved wearable device that provides non-invasive, personalized hand tremor relief for Parkinson’s disease and Essential Tremor patients. Using its proprietary “TAPS” technology, the watch-like device stimulates wrist nerves, providing up to 90 minutes of tremor relief per session with an average 64% tremor reduction.

name: CamberCloud
description: CamberCloud is a cloud-based computing platform tailored for scientific research, enabling researchers to process large datasets and run complex simulations without needing to manage traditional hardware. With its scalable, low-code interface and pay-as-you-go pricing, Camber democratizes high-performance computing, accelerating discovery across fields like genomics, chemistry, and astronomy.

name: Cambium
description: Cambium designs next-gen biomaterials using nature-derived molecular building blocks with a discovery-to-manufacturing platform. By integrating computational design with in-house advanced manufacturing, the company delivers mission-ready materials for aerospace, defense, and extreme-environment applications.

name: Cambium Carbon
description: Cambium Carbon’s circular economy model works with cities and other partners to save fallen city trees from landfills and decomposition. It reroutes this wood to local businesses (e.g., mills, furniture manufacturers, etc.) for reuse and subsequently channels revenues into planting projects. Cambium has a marketplace model. On one side, it provides local manufacturing clientele with larger-scale orders, as well as inventory tracking and management, an ecommerce platform, and business analytics. On the other side, it offers product retailers the opportunity to get product sourced and built locally via reclaimed wood, while also avoiding huge nationwide shipping and logistics costs.

name: Cambrian BioPharma
description: Cambrian BioPharma is developing medicines and therapies that treat specific diseases and then deploys them as preventative medicines to lengthen longevity and healthy years. To advance research targeting the biological drivers of aging, they have organized as a Distributed Development Company that combines the advantages of a venture capital fund with an incubator to develop new therapeutics.

name: Campus Ink
description: Campus Ink helps universities and athletes launch personalized, digital NIL Stores — offering athlete-specific, co-licensed apparel that engages fans and drives revenue. The platform supports real-time design updates, flexible order volumes, and culturally relevant product launches that benefit both schools and players.

name: Camu
description: Camu (formerly Latitude) is an AI-powered platform that automates the entry, validation, and correction of tax documents in ERPs, simplifying one of the most complex and error-prone processes in Brazil. By cross-referencing data against Brazil’s vast, constantly changing tax regulations, it helps companies stay compliant, reduce costs, and streamline supplier interactions at scale.

name: Canela Media
description: Canela Media is a minority- and female-owned digital media company dedicated to reaching the U.S. Hispanic audience. They provide culturally relevant programming in Spanish and English, as well as an advertising platform powered by first party data that connects companies to Hispanic viewers.

name: Canid
description: Canid simplifies pediatricians’ work by managing the complexity of their vaccine operations at no cost to them. Canid automates vaccine workflows, oversees purchase and inventory, verifies patient insurance, and submits bills. It also delivers a user-friendly view into patients' complete vaccine records, plus resources to educate parents on the latest vaccine research.

name: Canvas Construction
description: Canvas is a construction robotics company using machine learning to automate drywall installation. Its proprietary system uses a modified JLG lift, robotic arm, and sensors backed by machine learning to automate drywall installation.

name: Capella Space
description: Capella Space develops cost-effective SAR satellites that are able to see through clouds, at night, and even underground. It offers a more detailed solution to traditional imaging satellites and provides a more accurate and detailed view of the Earth.

name: Capra Biosciences
description: Capra Biosciences uses proprietary bioreactors and a specific biofilm-forming microbe to transform low-cost feedstocks into a variety of useful chemicals with industrial and commercial applications. The company's unique reactors make bio-based chemical manufacturing cost-competitive vs. petroleum-based products while reducing environmental impact.

name: Capture Technologies
description: Capture Technologies is an online platform intended to use an AI-based algorithm in order to connect people across the world. Users can search for a community based on news, events, and location, and connect with other like-minded users.

name: Car IQ
description: Car IQ connects fleet-owned cars directly to service and payment networks, using the data from the transaction to create new revenue opportunities. It is a service gateway for fleets. Payments can be initiated directly from the vehicle.

name: Carbo Culture
description: Carbo Culture rapidly converts waste biomass into functional carbons, which keep CO2 from the atmosphere for thousands of years, making a tangible impact in the carbon credit market. Its patented Carbolysis technology converts biomass produced through the photosynthesis process into biochar — a carbon-rich material that can replenish soils by promoting nutrient and water storage — while also generating renewable energy in the process.

name: CarbonCapture
description: CarbonCapture develops and deploys direct air capture (DAC) machines that can be connected in large arrays to remove massive amounts of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Its groundbreaking modular, open-system architecture equips the company’s platform to provide plug-and-play upgrades, mass production, unlimited scalability, and rapid technology iterations.

name: Carelinx
description: CareLinx is an online marketplace for sourcing and managing in-home care for elderly and chronically ill patients. Users can connect with licensed caregivers, and an online component allows it to offer prices of up to 25% less than standard agencies.

name: Careswitch
description: Careswitch is solving the caregiver shortage by making it easier for agencies and caregivers to make more money in home care.

name: CarPutty
description: Carputty is developing innovative technology to protect buyers and clear the smoke that the old dealership model uses to cloud the automotive finance and vehicle value experience. Carputty simplifies the process in one app, saving buyers time and money.

name: Carro
description: Carro is an e-commerce sales platform that enables brands to sell more products and increase brand awareness through partnerships with other brands and influencers. They allow users to discover the influencers who engage with their brand, streamline gifting, and track mentions on social media.

name: Carry1st
description: Carry1st is a full-stack publisher of social games and interactive content with a focus on Africa’s dynamic, rapidly growing mobile and gaming market. Publishing for some of global gaming’s biggest names and launching its own games, Carry1st is also positioned to offer capabilities such as payments, e-commerce, search, and enhanced messaging.

name: Carta
description: Carta helps private companies, public companies, and investors manage their cap tables, valuations, investments, and equity plans. It helps private companies and lawyers streamline how they manage equity and helps investors manage their portfolios.

name: Cartwheel
description: Cartwheel partners with schools to deliver fast, equitable mental healthcare via telehealth, offering therapy, medication support, and care coordination that begins in seven days for over 90% of referred cases. By embedding in schools and accepting insurance, Cartwheel reduces staff burnout and student crises while earning 92% student satisfaction.

name: CaseMark
description: CaseMark offers an AI platform that streamlines legal workflows, ensuring data privacy and efficient task automation for legal professionals.
