Its suite of advanced AI productivity tools integrates within existing workflows to automate case summaries, narrative deposition summaries, immigration reference letters, and other repetitive tasks.

name: Cash
description: Cash is an app born from the idea of ​​managing money in an easier, more fun, and comfortable way. Users can securely load money into their account and then use the app to pay for over 100 digital and basic services, such as electricity, water, and phone.

name: Casper
description: Casper develops mattresses which are sold directly to consumers, aiming to eliminate commission-driven, inflated prices. Its mattresses are made with American materials and ergonomic alignment for deep sleep. They also sell pillows and weighted blankets.

name: Cassidy AI
description: Cassidy is an AI automation platform that connects with tools like Slack, Salesforce, Notion, and Google Drive, enabling teams to automate complex workflows using real-time company knowledge—without coding. Unlike static, traditional automation tools that require frequent IT support, Cassidy adapts to new data and decisions, helping teams automate high-stakes tasks such as RFP processing and customer support with significantly less effort.

name: CatalyzeX

name: Definely
description: Definely is an AI-powered legal technology platform that enhances the efficiency and accuracy of drafting, reviewing, and proofreading legal documents. It offers tools for managing definitions and references, accessing precedent clauses, identifying document errors, and analyzing PDFs — all within a seamless, context-aware interface designed for legal professionals.

name: Deliverr
description: Deliverr is a tech-enabled, asset-light fulfillment service that allows any online merchant to offer free two-day delivery across any channel. These channels may include Shopify, eBay, or the merchant’s own website, boosting e-commerce sales.

name: Dentologie
description: Dentologie is reinventing the dentistry experience by creating the first digitally native, consumer-centric dentistry chain. The company is attracting new dental school grads with above-market comp and patients seeking the kind of convenient, pleasant, and technology-centric service that they’ve grown accustomed to in other facets of life.

name: Deserve
description: Deserve offers credit cards using machine learning and many non-traditional data points that correlate to the user’s credit worthiness. With no credit history or deposit required, users can prequalify in just seconds, with no impact to credit score.

name: Determined AI
description: Determined AI is a machine learning tech company that revolutionizes the way deep models are trained and deployed. The company reduces time-to-market by increasing developer productivity, improving resource utilization, and reducing risk.

name: DevRev
description: At a time when product-led growth (PLG) software is increasing in prevalence, DevRev’s end-to-end development platform connects creators more directly with customers to help them build products, support end users, and grow their businesses. Its platform leverages data, design, and machine intelligence to encourage developer / customer collaborations and bring customer needs and requirements to the fore as developers build new features, fix bugs, or address test regressions.

name: Dexai
description: Dexai Robotics aims to revolutionize the food industry with Alfred, a food-prep robot. This sleek, hygienic sous chef operates with unique machine-learning algorithms to provide efficient, automated kitchen help. Alfred’s hardware (a food safe-certified robotic arm, assistant arm, camera, tool changer, base, and computer) is customized to kitchen layouts and tasks in about 2-3 weeks. The first iteration of Alfred is for food assembly of dishes such as salads and grain bowls.

name: Dextrous Robotics
description: Dextrous Robotics is working to change how logistics companies operate by building robotic manipulation solutions for the industry. The company is developing robots with unique grasping and manipulation capabilities that will automate the unloading of boxes from shipping containers.

name: Diamond Age
description: Diamond Age creates large-scale robotic systems to reduce the cost and time it takes to build single-family homes. Its Robotics-as-a-Service system combines 3D printing, mechatronics, and robotics to backfill the massive labor shortage and drive construction cycle times down.

name: Diem
description: Diem is building a social search engine to scale candid conversations among women, turning private discussions on topics like health, career moves, and relationships into public and credible resources. By combining a Large Language Model with user-contributed stories, Diem provides AI-generated responses enriched with real anecdotes, creating a trusted network for sharing valuable information.

name: Digiphy
description: Digiphy is a no-code QR-marketing platform that creates contextually relevant digital experiences for physical products and customer touchpoints. With Digiphy’s smart packaging tools and storytelling templates, brands seamlessly bridge the physical to digital, going beyond the label to increase sales, validate authenticity, and build brand loyalty.

name: Digisure
description: DigiSure is an insurance, verification, and trust platform serving large marketplaces in the sharing economy by providing accurate individualized underwriting on a per usage or per rental basis. It enables data collection, machine learning, and more.

name: Digital Asset Holding
description: Digital Asset Holdings operates the Canton Network, a blockchain infrastructure platform that enables financial institutions to transact with full privacy while remaining connected to a global, interoperable network. Its architecture allows banks, asset managers, and market infrastructure providers to settle trades atomically and maintain confidential transactions across applications, eliminating the traditional tradeoff between privacy and connectivity in institutional finance.

name: Dimension
description: Dimension (formerly Trash Warrior) is an on-demand waste management and janitorial services platform. Dimension makes it easy for companies of any size to book reliable and accountable waste management services online and nationwide. Dimension pairs business customers with providers that match their needs based on customer preferences and location as well as provider details and rankings in the platform. It also considers factors such as availability, sustainability requirements, and pricing when pairing customers with providers.

name: Dimension Bio
description: Dimension Bio (fka Dimension Inx) develops regenerative therapies using BioNidum™, a 3D-printed, bioinspired system that transforms cells into implantable, tissue-like structures. Its lead program targets liver failure by providing immediate supplemental function to stabilize patients and support recovery without the need for a transplant.

name: Dirac
description: Dirac is revolutionizing manufacturing design with AI-driven automated work instructions, quickly transforming complex mechanical designs into clear 3D renderings and animations. Initially focused on the auto and home audio sectors, Dirac’s technology streamlines the production process, significantly reducing time from concept to product.

name: Distance
description: Distance (fka Rare Circles) is an AI-powered sales automation platform helping service businesses book jobs, handle customer conversations, and manage follow-ups 24/7. With its virtual agent, Distance aims to help small teams scale like enterprises — boosting revenue, cutting admin work, and retaining over 80% of profits.

name: Distributional
description: Distributional is developing a modern platform for robust and repeatable AI testing and evaluation to ensure AI systems are safe, reliable, and secure. By providing tools for continuous monitoring, test case generation, and result analysis, Distributional helps organizations trust and frequently deploy AI products.

name: Ditto AI
description: Ditto AI is a dating app that eliminates swiping and small talk by using AI to curate matches, schedule dates, and provide personalized conversation starters. With verified users, built-in safety measures, and strong results — 69% of users get a date vs. 25% on Tinder — Ditto delivers a safer, more effective online dating alternative.

name: Divergent
description: Divergent Technologies is a platform that intends to revolutionize the automobile manufacturing process. They enable automakers to design and build new cars quickly, while lowering capital investment, production costs, and any potential environmental footprint.

name: Divibank
description: Divibank is a fintech that provides capital to Latin American startups and SMEs to boost their digital advertising programs through revenue-share agreements. Divibank has developed predictive models that look at customers’ ad performance, financials, and other data to generate funding offers.

name: Divinia
description: Divinia (formerly liberio.io) is a natural language processing company whose technology allows unsupervised machine learning to understand the sentiment of text. Its technology is available as a subscription search offering or SEO service with a transactional click-based pricing model

name: DNA Media
description: DNA Media (fka Revel) is a generative-AI video SaaS platform that allows users to create short movies with just a prompt, covering marketing, social media, product demos, and narrative formats. By leveraging AI models, the platform makes video production intuitive and efficient, enabling businesses to produce high-quality, multilingual videos at scale without advanced editing tools.

name: DNABlock
description: DNABlock is a 3D animation platform that enables users to create 3D avatars and cinema-quality animated content and mint the NFT. On DNABlock’s virtual production platform, users with no animation knowledge can take their characters and narratives from concept to creation, producing photorealistic 3D avatars and cinema-quality animated content and easily mint an NFT of the results.

name: DocStation
description: DocStation is a platform for pharmacies that leverages advanced technology and workflow automations to streamline documenting and billing. The company’s full-stack software suite includes features for claims management, real-time eligibility checks, automated prior authorization, billing insurance, and revenue cycle management.

name: Dog Spot
description: DogSpot (formerly Dog Parker) develops dog houses and dog parking services for U.S. retailers. They allow the owners to keep their dog in a safe place while shopping or running errands, and the houses come with heat and air conditioning for comfort.

name: Domo
description: Domo develops intuitive software solutions for enterprise users. The software uses data science and real-time insights in order to connect employees with disparate data residing in silos across their organization in order to improve business results.

name: Doms
description: Dom’s hybrid kitchen and market redefines the neighborhood market into a place that elevates the ready-to-eat grocery segment to a restaurant-quality experience. Augmented by a digital strategy and e-commerce rollout, Dom’s ready-made food selections offer personalized and varied food options, while their restaurant features unique community experiences.

name: Dono
description: Dono modernizes title production with instant ownership verification powered by AI and backed by expert review, replacing days of manual research with real-time accuracy. Its platform delivers commitment-ready reports with instant access to deeds, liens, and legal documents, improving speed, precision, and scalability for title firms and lenders.

name: Doorvest
description: Doorvest has developed a real estate investing platform that helps investors identify and buy single-family rental properties. Their investor portal and advisory services enable investors to own high-yield rental homes entirely online. Doorvest works with each investor to create an investment plan and then buys, renovates, rents, and manages the property.

name: DOTS
description: DOTS has developed the first commercial allergen-detection device that is simple to use, economical, and portable. Their revolutionary diagnostics platform spans consumer and industrial applications, and primarily detects dangerous allergens in food.

name: Dough
description: Dough is a feminist-inspired marketplace that discovers and promotes products made by women. They provide items from female-founded brands in areas such as fashion, skin-care, and home decor. Users can shop for a curated selection daily.

name: Downstream Impact
description: Downstream is a platform that helps brands and agencies use automation to manage, scale, and optimize e-commerce advertising campaigns. The company optimizes businesses’ individual Amazon advertising to maximize their performance and efficiency.

name: Drip
description: Drip (Dripshop.live) is a rapidly growing live shopping marketplace for physical and digital collectibles, allowing interested parties to socialize and participate in digital trading, sales, and auctions. The company plans to build a token-enabled, community-owned, live, and social commerce platform. Unlike most other live shopping marketplaces, it offers web capability, crypto payments, gamification, native simulcasting, and OBS support.

name: Driveway
description: Driveway is a platform that connects customers with autobody technicians who can fix cars at a home or office. They eliminate the overhead of fixed locations while performing professional repairs ranging from minor parts replacement to dent repair, all guaranteed for life.

name: Droplette
description: Droplette's patented, hand-held facial skincare device generates a powerful, yet gentle nano-mist to infuse scientifically proven active ingredients deep into the skin--delivering 10x the outcomes of topical creams and serums. Droplette is using its platform technology to operate a successful direct-to-consumer facial skincare business model. It sells its micro-infuser device up front, plus tiered subscription options for infusion capsules which contain the active skincare ingredients.

name: Dropstat
description: Dropstat provides AI-powered workforce and cost-automation software tailored for hospitals seeking to optimize staffing expenses, with an initial focus on nurses. The platform works alongside scheduling and payroll systems with algorithms that identify & fill chronic and urgent shift gaps with the safest, most cost-efficient staff member available.

name: Duality
description: Duality is a QA company that aims to increase safety and improve time to market for companies operating autonomous robotics. They aim to improve robot understanding of humans and robot-human interaction to create a better-running workplace.

name: dub
description: Dub is a social investing platform that gives experts in asset management the ability to share their insights and thematic portfolios. Through an easy-to-use app, the platform provides fund managers, industry experts, and financial influencers a simple way to make their investment wisdom actionable for regular individuals and distribute it globally.

name: dubdubdub
description: Dubdubdub is building an omni-channel crypto wallet that gives users the ability to interact and engage within the wallet ecosystem. Dubdubdub provides consumers with a centralized hub for various on-chain activities — improving engagement and ensuring users can interact with the blockchain without needing to think about it. It also significantly improves crypto wallet safety by implementing biometric, two-factor authentication, and spam filtering.

name: Duffl
description: Duffl seeks to build the world’s first net-carbon-neutral delivery service by bringing snacks and groceries to college students within 10 minutes via electric scooters. Duffl uses data to wholesale in-demand products and deliver them from retail storefronts on college campuses using scooters and a student-driven workforce. They also use interactive promotional events to foster communities on the campuses they serve.

name: Dune Security
description: Dune Security provides an AI-driven platform that assesses an organization’s Employee Security Posture in real-time, offering personalized training to mitigate employee risk. Dune targets the vital 8% of employees driving 80% of cybersecurity risk while delivering personalized, machine learning-based training to all employees tailored to their risk profile.

name: Duplo
description: Duplo is a fintech that allows B2B companies in Africa to receive and make payments easily. Its platform enables businesses to digitize their receivables and payables, reduce time-to-cash, lower transaction costs, and generate more revenue from their business customers.

name: DUST Identity
description: DUST technology helps organizations solve complex supply chain security needs by using microscopic diamonds to securely link physical items with their digital records so they can be verified, authenticated, and ultimately trusted. Microscopic diamonds are applied to physical objects through common materials such as coatings, prints, stickers, or even a pen with DUST ink. The diamonds’ random position generates a unique identifier, recorded in a blockchain ledger and verified through proprietary scanners connected to DUST’s online portal.

name: Dyna Robotics
description: Dyna builds general-purpose robotic systems that combine foundation models with low-cost hardware to automate repetitive tasks in commercial settings. Its platform is designed for practical deployment and quickly adapts to different workflows — making automation more accessible and useful across industries like foodservice, grocery, and hospitality.

name: Dynasty
description: Dynasty is a digital platform for creating and managing living trusts more quickly and affordably than traditional trustee services. Dynasty’s trusts offer comprehensive protection from taxes, lawsuits, creditors, and divorce, making them ideal for estate and succession planning.

name: E25Bio
description: E25Bio is a medical device company developing a finger-stick blood diagnostic test designed to detect dangerous mosquito-borne diseases. The test can be used at home or in a clinic, allowing fast and early diagnosis for people in the equatorial belt.

name: Earli
description: Earli has developed proprietary biomarker technology that allows for the early detection of cancer, enabling earlier intervention than currently possible with existing diagnostic methods. Earli's solution biologically forces cancer cells to produce synthetic biomarkers not typically present in the human body, thereby revealing themselves and making them more precisely localizable for preemptive treatment.

name: Early Bird
description:
"EarlyBird is a fintech gifting platform that simplifies investing for parents, while empowering friends and family to seamlessly gift financial contributions to the children in their life.
The platform allows parents to create accounts, invest money, and accept gifts from friends and family, all at a low monthly fee."

name: Earth Funeral
description: Earth specializes in a proprietary process called “soil transformation,” an environmentally friendly alternative to burial and cremation. With zero CO2 emissions or waste, the process gently transforms the body into nutrient-rich soil, which loved ones can distribute themselves and / or send to a conservation site.

name: EasyKnock
description: EasyKnock offers technology-enabled, residential sale-leaseback services that enable homeowners to receive the money they need to achieve their financial and life goals. Its Sell and Stay service gives homeowners cash for their home’s value with the option of buying back it back or moving at any time. MoveAbility is for homeowners planning on a near-term move, giving them cash for their home’s value without requiring a rushed move.

name: Eclipse System
description: Eclipse (formerly Pelvalon) is a medical device company addressing women’s fecal incontinence. The treatment that the company provides involves no drugs or surgery but a vaginal insert that allows women to discreetly control their bowel movement via a detachable pump.

name: Eclypsium
description: Eclypsium is a cybersecurity company addressing the major security loopholes that exist in network devices. It protects organizations from the foundation of their computing infrastructure upward, controlling the risk and stopping threats inside the firmware of laptops, servers, and networking infrastructure.

name: eddii
description: Eddii is revolutionizing diabetes tracking and management, aiming to humanize and gamify the management of this chronic condition. Its mobile application platform — designed to particularly incentivize children — offers an inviting and fun experience, providing all of the necessary support for monitoring diabetes.

name: Eden
description: Eden (fka as Eva) is on a mission to transform healthcare through AI and technological innovation, exemplified by its ground-breaking product, Eden Portal. Eden Portal offers patients seamless access to their medical history and provides doctors with advanced diagnostic tools, all while ensuring top-notch security and privacy.

name: Edge Payments
description: Edge’s modern payments platform services every legal industry that accepts payments — starting with those labeled as “high risk” (e.g., fantasy sports, spirits, subscription services) and therefore excluded from more traditional payment processors. By offering unbiased payment solutions, Edge is able to increase conversions for merchants and streamline operations in one easy-to-use platform.

name: EdgeRunner AI
description: Edgerunner AI delivers secure, on-device AI agents that run entirely offline — offering a ChatGPT-like experience without internet access for maximum privacy and control. Built for defense and mission-critical use, it compresses vast knowledge into portable assistants that support frontline tasks like logistics, maintenance, and mission planning.

name: Edgescale AI
description: Edgescale AI is addressing the need for scalable AI implementation in operational systems, particularly in sectors like manufacturing, with its cloud-rooted, AI-driven 5G network. The company aims to revolutionize the $950B+ smart manufacturing tech market by bringing AI to real-world applications on the factory floor and across the industrial corridor.

name: EduFi
description: EduFi is Pakistan’s first “Study Now, Pay Later” platform, creating value through school-funded discounts and institutional partnerships while offering students fast, interest-free education loans with funds sent directly to universities. Now expanding into Saudi Arabia, EduFi supports financial institutions with an AI-driven credit-scoring engine and liquidity portal and deepens school adoption through a free ERP system that streamlines campus operations.

name: EeroQ
description: EeroQ is an innovator in the field of quantum hardware, building a universal quantum computer using electrons on helium. EeroQ’S patented approach to quantum computing chips involves trapping electrons on helium. This allows for greater efficiency within a smaller chip and a uniquely scalable form factor.

name: Eigen Therapeutics
description: Eigen Therapeutics is a precision medicine company building an automated platform to develop more effective cancer treatments at scale. Eigen's automated platform will genetically fingerprint cancer cells, telling it how to make cancer more vulnerable to treatment.

name: Elastio
description: Elastio is a cloud-native data recovery and backup platform that safeguards cloud data from risks posed by ransomware, application failures, and storage security vulnerabilities. In addition to cost-savings from threat mitigation, Elastio also provides storage cost-savings through its proprietary backup technology.

name: Elevated Retreats
description: Elevated Retreats (formerly The Villa Life) helps companies plan unforgettable offsites, leadership retreats, and incentive trips — powered by AI and delivered with white-glove service. The company curates all the details, from destination to flights, itinerary, and on-site support.

name: Elevent
description: Elevent has developed a currated marketplace that connects companies with experience providers to deliver unique, memorable virtual and physical events. Their platform enables companies — especially those with remote workforces — to easily find, customize, and manage appropriate events. Elevent offers experiences focused on food & drink, crafts, self-care, games, excursions, fitness, entertainment, and education.

name: Elion Health
description: Elion Health is a healthcare IT marketplace and research platform that simplifies the healthcare procurement process by providing unbiased insights and vendor analytics. Elion helps decision-makers navigate thousands of healthcare IT vendors, enabling smarter and more cost-effective technology procurement.

name: Ellevest
description: Ellevest is a transformative financial technology company created to help women achieve their financial potential. They use a method that encourages modern and low-cost investing, with a digital platform that is backed by a unique investing approach.

name: Ellipsis Health
description: Ellipsis Health provides early identification of stress, anxiety, and depression by using the human voice as a biomarker for mental health and wellbeing. It uses machine learning and AI to generate a clinical-grade assessment of the severity of anxiety and depression.

name: Embedded Financial
description:
Embedded is a Clearing & Custody API for broker dealers, RIAs, banks and fintech startups. "They are developing a modular, white-label platform that allows fintech companies and financial institutions to
offer securities trading services."

name: Emerald Cloud Lab
description: Emerald Cloud Lab is a single, comprehensive workspace designed to support biotech researchers’ entire scientific workflows. Emerald remotely conducts their experiments in a highly automated ECL facility, allowing scientists to easily organize data.

name: Emerge
description: Emerge is a consumer platform enabling the next level of human presence and connection, with a first product that leverages the human senses in digital communications. They aim to enable more meaningful, diverse, and engaging interactions in augmented, virtual, and mixed reality technologies.

name: Emissary
description: Emissary is a human intelligence network. Their platform, the Emissary Exchange, connects enterprise sales and marketing professionals directly to a community of over 12,000 talented senior and C-level executives who have recently worked at their most important accounts.

name: Emm
description: Emm is a healthtech company developing a smart wearable designed to discover and monitor menstrual cycles for users to better understand their reproductive health. The company's product syncs with a smartphone app and uses Bluetooth-sensing technology to monitor and provide data and insights into key metrics like volume, flow rate, cycle length,and regularity.

name: Emme
description: EMME (formerly Cadence) is a connected platform meant for women to manage their birth control. It alerts women when they’ve forgotten to take their pillvand helps them understand their pregnancy risk based on their own personal data.

name: Empirik
description: Empirik is an AI-powered infrastructure intelligence platform that helps engineering teams understand and predict the impact of changes across complex cloud, on-premise, and SaaS environments. The company’s autonomous infrastructure agent maps system dependencies and calculates the potential “blast radius” of proposed changes, enabling teams to prevent outages, resolve incidents faster, and safely automate infrastructure operations.

name: Empromptu
description: Empromptu is a no-code AI app builder that lets teams quickly create production-grade AI applications with built-in front-end and back-end capabilities. It also provides smart logic and continuous optimization, all without requiring teams to rewrite their infrastructure.

name: Emtech
description: EMTECH offers a cloud SaaS product that empowers central banks, financial institutions, and regulators to navigate the rapidly evolving landscape of financial services innovation and regulation. Built for multi-country exchange and with an initial focus on central banks in emerging markets, including West Africa, the platform provides currency exchange and digital compliance services.

name: Emulate
description: Emulate creates living platforms that mimic the complexities of human biology to enable unprecedented insights into human biology and health. Their breakthrough organ-on-a-chip technology recreates the natural physiology and mechanical forces experienced within the human body in order to deliver clinically relevant, decision-worthy insights.

name: Enable
description: Enable has developed an enterprise platform to help manage complex rebate agreements with suppliers and customers. Users can easily set up complex rebate deals, calculate rebate earnings for every transaction line, and manage allocations.

name: EnAct Systems
description: Enact is the developer of a cloud-based, solar energy project management system. It has developed an end-to-end system that helps utilities, system installers, and building owners develop, install, and manage solar panels.

name: Enboarder
description: Enboarder is an experience-driven people activation platform that transforms employee onboarding into an ongoing, rich, and consistent experience at scale. Enboarder has reimagined HR programs to create natural sequences that match employees’ journeys including onboarding, learning and development, change management, access to diversity and inclusion resources, and/or employee transitions.

name: EnCharge AI
description: Encharge AI is developing semiconductor hardware and software tools to dramatically improve the performance, energy, and cost efficiency of deploying AI at the edge. Its new chip provides speed and efficiency for AI applications such as self-driving cars, smart cities and factories, and healthcare.

name: Enclave
description: Enclave is redefining hybrid work by bringing high-quality, tech-enabled coworking spaces to the suburbs, offering a convenient alternative to commuting or working from home. For businesses seeking flexible, distributed workspace solutions, Enclave provides remote-managed spaces designed for productivity, community, and corporate partnerships.

name: Endless West
description: Endless West is redefining the art and science of great spirits. The company has used molecular analysis of the world’s best whiskeys to create a high-quality spirit using a fraction of the usual resources.

name: Endolith Mining
description: Endolith is transforming mining using engineered microbes and real-time data analytics to recover copper from existing mine waste, providing critical resources for the AI and electrification economies. Its “living heap” platform unlocks 30–90% more metal from the same ore, turning waste into new domestic supply without new mines or major capex, aligning miners, governments, and investors around cost, speed, and sustainability.

name: EnergySavvy
description: EnergySavvy is a customer engagement platform for the personalized management of utilities. The company’s software helps to generate customer insights, drive customer engagement, and streamline customer operations to enable utilities sectors to overcome data gaps.

name: Enfabrica
description: Enfabrica designs networking chips, systems, and software for AI computing workloads. The company’s chips enable up to a 50% reduction in AI cluster cost in addition to significant improvements in scalability, bandwidth, and data speeds.

name: Enko Chem
description: Enko Chem uses predictive analytics to develop products for farmers that protect their crops from pests and disease. Their proprietary technology platform represents a revolutionary approach to rapidly discover safe and economical solutions that are needed to ensure sustainable food production.

name: Enough Energy
description: Enough Energy is reinventing battery systems by eliminating traditional power converters and replacing them with software-defined solutions and low-cost electronics, cutting costs by up to 50%. Using Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) technology, it delivers flexible, resilient energy storage and EV charging for commercial and industrial applications in a $120B+ market.

name: Entendre Finance
description: Entendre is an enterprise-grade finance system tackling the problem of accounting for business cryptocurrency holdings and on-chain activity. Its platform will automate nuanced Web3 accounting required by CFOs, controllers, and auditors. By aggregating data across disparate sources, Entendre gives businesses a full treasury view of their balances and activities.

name: Epicore Biosystems
description: Epicore Biosystems is a digital health company developing advanced sweat-sensing wearables that provide real-time personalized health insights for hydration, stress, and wellness. Its clinically validated products are deployed globally and licensed by leading Fortune 500 companies, the Department of Defense, and the National Institute of Health in the sports and fitness, occupational safety, and clinical trials industries.

name: Equilibrium Energy
description: Equilibrium Energy is leveraging its unique combination of deep energy expertise, AI-centric technology, and power grid fundamentals to build a clean power company. Equilibrium’s first commercial efforts support the accelerated deployment of grid-scale batteries that balance an increasingly volatile power grid.

name: Equillium
description: Equillium develops first-in-class therapies to treat people with severe autoimmune disorders with unmet medical needs. They use a clinical-stage and first-in-class monoclonal antibody that selectively targets the novel immune checkpoint receptor CD6.

name: Eragon
description: Eragon is building an AI operating system that unifies a company’s SaaS stack into one plain-English workspace. It lets teams query, analyze, and act across tools like Salesforce and Mixpanel in one place — turning fragmented data into live, actionable insight.

name: Esper Technologies
description: Esper Technologies is empowering a new era of public administration with a platform that helps government evaluate and manage public policy. Its end-to-end platform provides a single source of truth that transforms government data into actionable insights and increases back-office efficiency.

name: Esports One
description: Esports One (E1) is the first all-in-one fantasy esports platform created for gamers, by gamers. Users can create a fantasy team to compete with others, as well as research players, read articles about the latest esports news, and watch live games.

name: Essential AI
description: Essential AI is a next-generation platform that integrates autonomous workflows to enhance efficiency in the field services sector, initially targeting the Fire & Life Safety industry. The platform automates key processes, such as paperwork generation and customer inquiries, with the aim of expanding into other industries with significant inspection demands.

name: Ethena
description: Ethena is a compliance training software platform aiming to reinvent how companies manage required employee training. Their evidence-based approach delivers personalized content in frequent, digestible doses via email and Slack nudges.

name: ETHSign
description: EthSign is a decentralized, versioned, and consensus-based electronic agreements-signing application built on Ethereum, IPFS, and Filecoin. EthSign provides basic functions such as private key signature, online drafting and decentralized storage of agreements, and process logs of agreement signing. All these features are provided in a decentralized, transparent, and privacy-protected manner.

name: EvaBot
description: Evabot is a unique corporate “gifting-as-a-service” platform that digitizes and personalizes the relationship management process. The company uses AI, big data, and machine learning to create a smarter, more personalized, and more effective product for its clients.

name: Even Platforms
description: Even Platforms builds a network of small, identical, automated machine shops to address the U.S. precision machining supply gap for defense and aerospace manufacturers. Its modular approach uses standardized facilities, robotics, and proprietary software to enable centralized programming and quality control across hundreds of locations, splitting large contracts among small shops while maintaining defense specifications.

name: Eventual Computing
description: Eventual is building an integrated development experience for data scientists and engineers to query, process, and build applications on Complex Data (non-tabular data such as images, video, audio, and 3D scans). Data warehouses don’t work well for imaging data, which make up 80% of the world’s data. Eventual is changing that by building a specialized, vision-ﬁrst data warehouse to power modern Machine Learning.

name: Ever Cars
description: Ever Cars has created a specialized marketplace for used electric vehicles (EVs) to address a growing market expected to exceed $100 billion by 2030 Its platform, featuring “Ever Certified” vehicles and private listings, integrates EV financing, insurance, and charging solutions to provide a comprehensive service for buyers and upselling opportunities for the company.

name: Evernow
description: Evernow is a science-first telehealth platform that provides comprehensive, personalized menopause care and treatment for women through their multi-year journey. More than 55 million women in the U.S. are experiencing menopause symptoms, but 75% of those who seek care don’t get it. Evernow closes this gap while elevating care with prescription delivery and unlimited communication with its health team.

name: EverQuote
description: EverQuote is an online auto, health, life, and home insurance marketplace. Using EverQuote’s team of top analysts and business representatives, users can compare insurance quotes from agents and insurance providers to find the right insurance for them.

name: EverSettled
description: EverSettled builds the operating system for estate settlement, automating the administrative burden placed on grieving families after a death and guiding executors through every legal, financial, and logistical step of the inheritance process. Its platform combines an AI guide, financial administration, and document handling into a single system of record, with distribution embedded directly through funeral and cremation providers at the moment families need it most.

name: Evident
description: Evident is a fully automated, fully digital insurance verification platform designed to make it easy for businesses to reduce their third-party risk and improve compliance rates. The API driven platform helps Evident customers collect and analyze both individual and business credentials so they can make fast, informed decisions about engaging new third-party partners, prospective employees, franchisees, and more, without compromising their privacy.

name: Evil Genius Games
description: Evil Genius Games is developing a digital-first platform for the tabletop role-gaming game industry with "Everyday Heroes," featuring AI-driven tools, online play, and a user-generated content marketplace. With immersive adventures in licensed movie settings like The Crow, Rambo, and Escape from New York, Evil Genius offers a premium experience without requiring existing customers to convert to a new system.

name: Evvy
description: Evvy is an AI-driven precision medicine platform that sequences the vaginal microbiome through a single at-home swab, delivering personalized diagnostics and treatment plans across a broad range of women's health conditions. Its compounding data platform grows more predictive with every patient, enabling Evvy to expand into new clinical indications—such as vaginal health, fertility, endometriosis, and gynecologic cancer—through the same provider network and patient base.

name: Excision Bio
description: Excision Bio is focused on developing advanced gene editing therapeutics to treat life-threatening viral infections. The company's CRISPR-based therapies eliminate viral genomes from infected individuals.

name: Exicure
description: Exicure is developing a new class of immunomodulatory and gene regulating drugs. Their proprietary spherical nucleic acid architecture is designed to unlock the potential of therapeutic oligonucleotides across a wide range of cells and tissues.

name: Exin Therapeutics
description: Exin Therapeutics is developing AI-driven precision genetic therapies to treat neurological disorders like epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, and Parkinson’s by correcting signal imbalances in targeted brain circuits. Exin’s circuit-level approach has the potential to benefit a broader range of patients than traditional gene therapies, while its AI platform accelerates drug discovery for more effective treatments.

name: Expectful
description: Expectful is a meditation and sleep app designed specifically for fertility, pregnancy, and motherhood. Their platform was created to make meditation and mindfulness practices easy for expectant and new moms.

name: Expo
description: Expo (formerly Pared) provides next-gen Restaurant Performance Management (RPM) software for national, multi-unit restaurant companies to better align their back offices with front lines. Expo’s no-code visualization, machine learning, and intuitive interface gives companies the data they need to plan, manage, and become more agile.

name: Exponent Beauty
description: Unlike anti-aging skin care products with pre-mixed ingredients that degrade rapidly, Exponent Beauty’s skincare line achieves peak results because its lets consumers custom mix ingredients at the time of application. A patented self-activator system dispenses a precise dose of active powder and a “Quadruple Hyaluronic Acid Hydrator” to create a freshly whipped serum with a light gel-cream texture.

name: EyeLevel
description: EyeLevel.ai is a native marketing platform designed for easy integration into chat and conversational experiences. Brands receive an ad ecosystem, allowing them to advertise on third party chatbots and identify the type of campaign they want to run.

name: Ezra
description: Ezra combines advanced Magnetic Resonance Imaging with proprietary AI algorithms to facilitate early cancer detection and treatment via affordable, accessible, and high-resolution full-body scans. Ezra’s proprietary AI enhances the quality of Magnetic Resonance Images and decreases the time needed to complete a high-quality scan — technology it will use to launch the world’s first 30-minute, full-body MRI scan with the principal aim of facilitating early cancer detection and treatment.

name: F0cal
description: F0cal is a web-based image analytics platform that enables enterprises to turn images and videos into business intelligence. Users can easily create an account and enable CircleCL integration and import a f0cal API key and export a SSH fingerprint.

name: F2 AI
description: F2 AI is an AI-native platform that automates the manual, back-office workflows of private market analysts — from auditing spreadsheets to drafting deal memos. Spun out from Arc, an AV portfolio company, F2 focuses on the analyst layer of the $15T private credit ecosystem, helping capital markets teams accelerate deal execution and reduce overhead.

name: Fabric
description: Fabric is a financial technology company that makes the purchase of life insurance simple and affordable. Users can easily apply for affordable life insurance, create their wills, and organize their family’s important legal and financial information.

name: Fabric Health
description: Fabric Health is turning laundromats into healthcare hubs by providing on-site health support targeting underserved families. Fabric partners with health plans to address growth and retention challenges by using tech-equipped staff to conduct Medicaid SDOH screenings, redeterminations, and benefits enrollments.

name: Fanstake
description: Fanstake is a fan-driven NIL (Name, Image, and Likeness) platform that lets supporters pledge money to recruit or retain college athletes, with funds returned if the athlete chooses another school. Replacing the chaos of unregulated third-party collectives, it brings athlete endorsement activity under school oversight with a compliant, transparent system that aligns fans, athletes, and athletic departments.

name: FanUp
description: FanUp is a social gaming company that allows fans to bet on sports, fantasy sports, and esports. Their app allows users and their friends to compete for cash and prizes, with challenge-based contests, influencers, and engaging, personalized content.

name: Farmhand
description: Farmhand (fka Tract) is an all-in-one farm management platform empowering specialty crop farmers with the tools and technology to streamline operations, increase revenue, and support resilient local food systems. The platform provides Community Supported Agriculture subscription management, digital storefronts, and communication tools, helping small farms increase revenue and connect with local consumers.

name: FarmWise
description: FarmWise develops farming robots to facilitate autonomous cultivation and organic farming with the mission of building sustainable farming at scale. They capture and analyze crop data, take optimal crop-specific interventions, and help farmers produce.

name: Fast Radius
description: Fast Radius develops comprehensive additive manufacturing solutions, from application discovery to product design and testing, to industrial-grade production and global fulfillment. Users can discover newer applications and ultimately launch products.

name: Fastbreak AI
description: Fastbreak is the leading scheduling platform in professional sports, now expanding into youth sports to modernize and unify event operations. It is building a comprehensive operating system that integrates scheduling, registration, ticketing, travel, payments, and sponsorship to power seamless league and tournament management.

name: Fauna
description: Fauna is a developer of a globally-distributed, serverless, cloud database management system built for modern applications. It offers a flexible, developer-friendly, transactional database delivered as a secure, web-native API.

name: FCF
description: Fan Controlled Football (FCF, formerly the Fan Controlled Football League) is building the future of sports entertainment. Their platform streams live games on an interactive video overlay where fans can participate in a draft, determine their team’s game roster, and call plays in real-time.

name: FeatureForm
description: Featureform accelerates the machine-learning (ML) process, untangling the mess of ad-hoc and discordant data pipelines, speeding the process to take days instead of weeks. Featureform does this by allowing data scientists to quickly define, manage, and serve ML features across their organization.

name: Feedcast
description: Feedcast is the provider of a mobile-first application that aims to help podcasters monetize their content. Their platform allows creators to make and sell audio courses, including organizing and publishing supplemental material.

name: FeltSense
description: FeltSense is an AI platform that acts like a digital founder, creating thousands of micro-SaaS startups that can research markets, build products, launch websites, and attract customers on their own. Instead of selling software, it makes money from the ventures its agents create, enabling fast testing across markets and building a valuable dataset to guide future successes.

name: Fernish
description: Fernish is a premium furniture and decor rental service that makes it effortless to decorate a home. Customers choose items from a curated selection, pay monthly, and decide later which items they want to keep or return.

name: Fetch
description: Fetch is a software-powered marketplace for on-demand truck and cargo van rentals. Their platform is augmented by a proprietary hardware device that locks or unlocks vehicles, tracks location with GPS, and collects telematic data, thereby automating fleet management at scale.

name: Fido
description: Fido is a rapidly growing digital-lending platform that serves clients in Ghana and soon other countries covering the ~560M Sub-Saharan Africans who can’t access basic financial services such as loans through traditional banks. Powered by machine learning, Fido makes small personal loans through instant credit decisions based solely on a user's cell phone data. Its technology is entirely automated, highly scalable, capable of detecting fraud — and results in remarkably low defaults.

name: Fifth Season
description: Fifth Season is positively disrupting the food industry by bringing advanced tech to farming. Their indoor farming system uses robotics and cutting-edge AI to streamline their vertical growing operation.

name: Final Round AI
description: Final Round AI is an innovative platform that enhances interview preparation with its AI-powered tool, Interview Copilot, offering real-time feedback during live or mock interviews. Aiming to become the go-to destination for the global collector community, the platform ensures a secure and engaging environment for buying, selling, and connecting with fellow enthusiasts.

name: Finix
description: Finix is a modern, full-stack payment processor tailored for mid-market businesses, offering a unified platform that seamlessly handles both in-store and online transactions through developer-friendly APIs, advanced reporting tools, and customizable payment solutions. With its scalable infrastructure, transaction-level fee transparency, and low-code integration options, Finix empowers software platforms, marketplaces, and merchants across the U.S. and Canada to optimize their payment operations, reduce costs, and drive revenue growth in ways traditional processors struggle to match.

name: Finli
description: Finli’s payment management system helps small-service businesses get paid in a timely and affordable way. Finli is ideal for freelancers, small business owners, professional coaches / trainers, home services providers, and more. Users can create and send invoices on desktop and mobile — for immediate payment or to schedule billing and payment in advance — for single events, packages, and subscription business needs. Users can also automate communications and digitize customer files online and access / modify anywhere anytime.

name: FinLocker
description: FinLocker is a consumer-enabled financial data platform that gives lenders access to critical borrower information. The platform allows users to easily streamline the origination and underwriting processes for mortgages and other financial products.

name: Finmo
description: Finmo is a fintech platform that revolutionizes online payment processing and gateway services, with a unique focus on providing a modern, API-driven Treasury Operating System (OS). The platform's capabilities enable businesses to expand into new markets swiftly and efficiently, while also providing rich, on-demand reporting and settlement capabilities for data-driven decision-making.

name: Finresi
description: Finresi (fka Yieldeasy) enables accredited investors to passively invest in real estate bridge loans, providing potentially attractive returns with managed risk and no property management responsibilities. By partnering with lending institutions, investors share in loan payments and receive monthly returns, offering a simpler, lower-risk alternative to traditional real estate ownership

name: FINsix
description: FINsix is a small, light power system for consumer electronics. It advertises itself as the world’s smallest laptop charger. It allows users to charge all devices from a single outlet and is 4x smaller and lighter than typical computer chargers.

name: Fintary
description: Fintary is an AI-powered accounts reconciliation platform for businesses that manage B2B payments in verticals such as insurance, manufacturing, and real estate. Fintary’s efficient, end-to-end financial operating system helps finance and accounting teams make better, faster, and more complex financial decisions.

name: Finwave
description: Finwave develops high-performance Gallium Nitride (GaN) power electronic chips to solve energy-efficiency challenges and enable the potential of 5G. Finwave's GaN power electronic chips shrink the volume of many power electronics systems by 10x, while reducing power inefficiencies by at least half.

name: Firestorm
description: Firestorm is transforming the defense industry with affordable, modular unmanned aerial systems (UAS) produced through advanced 3D printing. Firestorm drones, customizable for missions like surveillance and strikes, are built in just nine hours at a fraction of competitors’ costs, offering rapidly scalable, cost-effective solutions for battlefield demands.

name: Firmly
description: Firmly is building infrastructure for agentic commerce, enabling AI-native content, chats, ads, or live streams to support secure, real-time checkout without redirects or engineering lift. Its full-stack APIs connect platforms and merchants to thousands of sellers, turning any digital surface into a transaction-ready marketplace in the $900B+ e-commerce sector.

name: Five to Nine
description: Five to Nine is a B2B SaaS that helps organizers for mid-market and large-scale enterprises manage and evaluate company events — both virtually and in-person. From employee resource group events and programs to manager training and recruiting events, the company helps organizers streamline program management into one tool. Its platform automates organizers’ busy work while helping to scale multiple events, integrate workflows, and collect insightful event analytics and feedback.

name: Flagler Health
description: Flagler builds an AI-native orchestration system specifically designed for musculoskeletal clinics, managing the entire patient journey from referral intake through billing and outcome tracking. Its end-to-end platform automates administrative workflows while improving patient routing and revenue capture, enabling providers to spend more time on care delivery rather than paperwork.

name: Fleet
description: Fleet has developed an all-in-one software solution to power the next generation of fleet tracking by automating the work of entire transportation teams. Fleet’s plug-and-play solution makes it easy to monitor and manage mobile workforces, helping uncover hidden costs while revealing potential for greater productivity and efficiency.

name: Fleet Panda
description: FleetPanda is a full-stack platform designed to manage fleet operations in industries such as construction, HVAC, and travel. They refuel, maintain, and wash businesses’ fleets overnight, saving costs on labor, reducing fraud, and increasing revenue.

name: Fleet Space Technologies
description: Fleet Space Technologies delivers the world’s first satellite-enabled seismic sensors for critical mineral exploration. The company’s solutions enable non-invasive surveying 100x faster to meet the increasing need for critical minerals to supply global electrification.

name: Flex Index
description: Flex Index (launched by AV portco Scoop) is the leading authority on hybrid, remote, and full-time office policies, providing comprehensive data on workplace flexibility for thousands of companies globally. Covering 100 million employees across 10,123 companies, it offers a searchable database by city, state, industry, company size, and type of flexible policy.d type of flexible policy.

name: Flexe
description: Flexe is a technology platform that helps enterprises and digitally native brands find warehouses with excess capacity. Their cloud-based platform functions as the Airbnb of warehousing, helping cusomers connect to facilities with available capacity.

name: Flickplay
description: FlickPlay is a gamified social commerce platform. Users can create and activate limited edition AR experiences using the company’s interactive map game and camera.

name: Flo
description: Flo (formerly Flo Recruit) offers a modern software solution that makes the hiring process more efficient and effective for law firms and law students. The company's platform streamlines the entire recruitment process, from sourcing candidates and scheduling interviews to tracking applicants.

name: Flora
description: FLORA is an AI-native creative suite that lets teams design and automate workflows across text, image, and video on a real-time canvas similar to Figma, a popular collaborative tool for web/app design. With over 40 models and a modular system for building generative workflows, FLORA replaces fragmented tools with a unified platform built for speed, control, and professional collaboration.

name: Florence Healthcare
description: Florence Healthcare develops workflow automation software designed to make clinical trial documents compliant, accessible, and simple. It advances clinical trials through software, managing document and data flow between research sites and sponsors.

name: Flotive AI
description: Flotive AI offers an automated regulatory compliance platform for infrastructure project developers, integrating AI-powered rules parsing with geospatial intelligence to streamline complex, multi-jurisdictional compliance workflows. It provides real-time alerts on regulatory changes, maps compliance risks to project locations, and transforms burdensome compliance processes into streamlined digital workflows for utilities, developers, and regulators.

name: FLUIX Pro
description: FLUIX Pro develops AI-driven technologies to optimize critical infrastructures, combining sustainability with advanced tech to address the complexities of modern data centers and manufacturing facilities. By intelligently connecting and controlling facility systems — including HVAC, IT, water, and lighting — FLUIX achieves up to 40% savings in energy costs.

name: Flywheel
description: Flywheel has developed an informatics platform that accelerates biomedical research, discovery, and collaboration. Its platform significantly improves imaging research efficiency, analytical capabilities, and security by automating the scaling of big data and medical image capture, content management, and collaboration.

name: Focal Point Procurement
description: Focal Point Procurement is a B2B SaaS tool empowering enterprise procurement teams to fully modernize and optimize their operations. Focal Point’s software centralizes and streamlines the entire procurement process — from business intake to project collaboration and vendor relationship management. Focal Point enables users to efficiently source suppliers, track procurements, and analyze spend.

name: Focusmate
description: Focusmate is a virtual co-working software platform intended to empower people and organizations to achieve their goals by unlocking the power of psychology. Users are assigned virtual Focusmates in order to work in tandem and increase productivity.

name: Folio
description: Folio is a centralized eProcurement tool for hotel operators to save time and money with existing suppliers, while more easily discovering new ones. Folio replaces current manual, paper-based processes by delivering a higher-quality and more efficient procurement process for independent and brand hotels.

name: Fonzi
description: Fonzi (fka Kumospace) is an all-in-one AI recruiter that automates the entire hiring process, from job descriptions to sourcing, screening, and interviewing candidates. By delivering top-tier talent faster and more cost-effectively than traditional recruiters, Fonzi streamlines hiring for companies while also providing job seekers with personalized career support.

name: Forage
description: Forage (fka Clarity) is an AI assistant that streamlines inboxes by summarizing newsletters, organizing non-urgent emails, and delivering a daily digest of key points — while integrating with a user’s preferred email app. Committed to privacy and security, Forage never sells your data, avoids using it to train AI models, and is rigorously tested and Google Verified.

name: Forager Logistics
description: Forager has developed a cross-border freight solution that makes it easier to transport products to and from Mexico and Canada. Their digital platform, "Scout," allows users to to get quotes from carriers and then fully execute deliveries.

name: Forcemetrics
description: Forcemetrics uses data science to deliver actionable insights to improve the relationship between governments and citizens. The platform leverages machine learning to analyze police department data — such as dispatch incident reports and patrol car locations — and delivers actionable insights for agency and government leaders.

name: Formic Technologies
description: Formic Technologies addresses the growing manufacturing labor shortage by offering a “robotics as a service” model, enabling small and medium-sized factories to adopt custom robotic solutions with no upfront cost. Formic manages all robot service and maintenance, providing customers with a more affordable and reliable (96% uptime) alternative to manual labor without requiring in-house robotics skills.

name: Formlogic
description: Formlogic is a rapid manufacturer of precision parts. The company delivers mission-critical, high-quality, technically complicated, low-volume parts using intelligent automation systems.

name: Formulary
description: Formulary is an AI-powered fund administrator modernizing private market fund operations with automated workflows, transparent data, and intelligent tools for GPs, LPs, and fund managers. Backed by top design partners, the platform is launching with SPV management and expanding toward full-service fund administration.

name: Fort Health
description: Fort Health is a tech-enabled mental health platform that collaborates with pediatricians, parents, and the Child Mind Institute to improve access to evidence-based mental health care for children. With a family-centered approach, they integrate mental health services into pediatric practices, reduce wait times, and provide comprehensive support through both referral networks and collaborative care models—ensuring children and families receive timely and effective care.

name: Forta Health
description: Forta delivers personalized, in-home applied behavior analysis therapy for children on the autism spectrum. Its proprietary algorithm ingests medical records, video calls, and other data to select a personalized therapy plan. Its platform also encompasses parent training and telehealth services from registered behavior therapists and board-certified behavior analysts.

name: Fortera
description: Fortera has developed a patented process for producing a cement-like material with a significantly smaller carbon footprint by converting CO2 into a replacement for ordinary cement. This technology reduces CO2 emissions on cement production by ~60% and also offers cost savings in production compared to traditional cement.

name: Foundation Alloy
description: Foundation Alloy revolutionizes metal manufacturing with advanced materials science and a proprietary process that enables atomic-level control over metal structures. Combining computational design with scalable, energy-efficient production, they deliver stronger, more durable metals for aerospace, defense, power generation, and industrial applications.

name: Foundation EGI
description: Foundation EGI is building an AI platform that captures, applies, and scales engineering expertise by automating design and documentation workflows for physical products Trained on real-world CAD files and manuals, its foundation model is already helping customers accelerate development in the $40T global manufacturing market.

name: FourFront
description: FourFront is defining a new type of storytelling on TikTok with a network of individual actors performing scripted, short-form serialized stories that feel native to the platform. While building out its network of TikTok stars and their audiences, it’s looking to develop characters for tech products like conversational AI chatbots

name: Freebird
description: Freebird was a mobile re-booking tool that allowed disrupted travelers to instantly book a new ticket on any airline. Users could optimize their travel by getting a new ticket in the event of a flight cancellation, four-hour delay, or missed connection.

name: Freeing Returns
description: Freeing Returns develops SaaS products for retailers to shrink loss from fraudulent purchases, returns, and other sales-reducing activities. Unlike competitors who only track point-of-sale systems, the company’s AI-powered platform integrates inventory data for retailers to have a better grasp of their sales data and prevent loss.

name: FreeWire
description: FreeWire develops and manufactures mobile energy storage systems to transform energy delivery. Their products deliver clean and quiet mobile power wherever and whenever users need it without the added costs of construction or infrastructure upgrades.

name: FreightFlows
description: FreightFlows is a SaaS platform that offers predictive analytics for global maritime trade. Their platform allows customers to source, synthesize, and analyze current data to better understand the pricing and market conditions for bulk maritime transport.

name: Frens
description: Frens is a web 3.0 growth marketing platform that makes new marketing tactics available to any projector company looking to leverage web 3.0 incentive mechanisms to engage its audience. The Frens toolkit allows users to automatically connect wallets, manage social media channels like Discord or Twitter, establish audience pools, create action and reward parameters, etc., in a simple, web-based platform.

name: Freshcut
description: Freshcut has developed a mobile entertainment app that provides gaming videos and content focused on users’ favorite games, creators, and communities. Their platform offers a personalized playlist of videos that are curated by content experts and based on users’ favorite games. It keeps users updated on the latest clips and news from the creators they follow.

name: Freshly
description: Freshly delivers healthy, gourmet, ready-to-heat meals to your door. Users can choose from 4-12 meals per week. They select from a menu, the meals are cooked to-order, and they arrive ready to warm up and eat.

name: FriendliAI
description: FriendliAI builds high-performance infrastructure that revolutionizes how developers build and run custom AI agents — key to scaling the generative AI market, forecast to reach $1T by 2034. Its proprietary engine boosts GPU efficiency up to 90%, with 10× faster processing and 6× lower delays, helping teams deploy AI more effectively and affordably at scale.

name: Frore Systems
description: Frore Systems is a developer of breakthrough thermal technology for consumer devices. Its solid-state cooling chip delivers 2x improvement in device performance while operating in silence. Its compact size and unique capability enables faster, quieter, thinner, lighter, and dustproof devices.

name: FullFill
description: Fullfill is a B2B2C disease-management company focused on weight loss. The Fullfill program combines face-to-face virtual coaching with other digital content — such as meal plans, exercises, daily videos, and meditations — to meaningfully help employers and employees better manage weight loss and wellness.

name: Function Health
description: Function Health is a direct-to-consumer, membership-based health diagnostics platform that imparts individualized insights on personal health data by offering comprehensive consumer lab panels -- from standard blood work to specific tests for cardiometabolic markers and emerging disease signals. Members test biannually at any of over 2,000 diagnostic locations and receive clinician-reviewed results through a digital dashboard that tracks longitudinal health data—conferring an insight-rich time series of patient data—and delivers personalized reports and recommendations for proactive care.

name: Fundamental Research Labs
description: Fundamental Research Labs (fka Altera) is building socially intelligent, AI-powered agents that learn, collaborate, and interact like digital humans. Evolving from multi-agent experiments in games, these autonomous systems are now moving into everyday computing — with the long-term goal of creating AI companions that grow alongside us.

name: Funnel IQ
description: Funnel IQ (formerly Funl) is a revenue operations platform for SaaS and subscription businesses. Their go-to-market data platform and end-to-end, full funnel analytics keep marketing, sales and customer success teams aligned.

name: Futura
description: Futura Labs (fka Moons) is transforming dental practices in Mexico and Columbia with a digital-first approach, providing intraoral scanners and a clinical portal to dentist offices in order to streamline patient tracking, ordering, and treatment management. By integrating cutting-edge technology with lab services, Futura helps dental offices modernize their operations to reduce costs, accelerate treatment times, and enhance the patient experience.

name: Future
description: Future provides digital fitness and training services. Its subscription-based fitness platform connects users with personal trainers remotely and uses a smartwatch to track exercise metrics.

name: Future Family
description: Future Family is a financing and concierge care solution for couples looking to start or grow their families. Future Family offers affordable and flexible financing plans for IVF and egg freezing, as well as a centralized consumer, clinic, and care-team data platform.

name: Future/Proof
description: Future Proof is an alcoholic beverages brand offering three product lines in the fastest growing categories of the alcohol market. It produces single-serve packaged wine, hard seltzers, and high-ABV flavored beverages.

name: Gains
description: Gains (fka GamerGains) is a next-gen gaming company, democratizing earn-ability across the gaming ecosystem irrespective of skill level. Traditionally, earning as a gamer is reserved for streamers, influencers, and professionals. Gains is flipping the script by allowing gamers to earn $GAMER tokens simply for logging hours on the games they already love playing.

name: Gallant
description: Gallant is working to advance stem cell banking and regenerative medicine for pets. Working in tandem with dog owners and their veterinarians, Gallant collects and stores stem cells during spay/neuter procedures so they can be used down the road to alleviate the dogs’ health problems.

name: Galvanick
description: Galvanick’s platform enables companies to secure their industrial infrastructure and minimize cyber risk. Its scalable, cloud-native analysis platform helps industrial companies secure their operations and reduce the time to detection of anomalous behavior on their most sensitive assets.

name: Gametime
description: Gametime is a ticketing platform for mobile users, selling last-minute tickets to the most popular events in sports, music, and theater in cities across the U.S. and Canada. With a mobile-first platform, industry-leading NPS, and strong appeal and stickiness with the younger demographic, Gametime examines as many as 10,000 potential seats to present the 50 best values. After purchase, it delivers tickets directly to users’ phones. If plans change, users can sell their tickets with the push of a button.

name: Gatik.AI
description: Gatik.AI is an autonomous vehicle company focused on “middle-mile” B2B short-term logistics. It focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics, optimizing customers’ hub-and-spoke operations, enhancing service levels and product flow while reducing delivery time and labor costs.

name: GC Therapeutics
description: GC Therapeutics harnesses synthetic biology and AI to develop next-generation stem cell therapies, offering unmatched efficiency and scalability in regenerative medicine. Its platform reprograms patient-derived stem cells into any cell type with up to 10x greater efficiency, up to 100x faster speed, and superior scalability compared to current methods.

name: Gearflow
description: GearFlow is a B2B marketplace for heavy equipment parts. It gives fleet managers access to the suppliers, communication tools, and reporting insights needed to keep equipment running and jobs profitable. GearFlow also provides a comprehensive set of tools for customer/purchase management, analytics, and payment/invoice processing for both buyers and sellers.

name: geCKo Materials
description: geCKo Materials has created a bio-inspired, reusable, zero-energy dry adhesive that enables residue-free, ultra-strong attachment and detachment across a variety of surfaces. Its scalable technology transforms industries like aerospace, robotics, and semiconductors with high-performance, precision-driven solutions.

name: General Intuition
description: General Intuition develops world models that enable AI systems to see, reason, and act in dynamic environments by learning from visual data rather than text alone. The company trains its embodied intelligence models using over one billion gameplay clips annually captured through its subsidiary, creating vision-to-action systems that can transfer knowledge across different environments without additional training.

name: Generate Biomedicines
description: Generate Biomedicines brings together AI, automated experimentation, and cutting-edge science to replace the traditional trial-and-error approach to developing new medicines. Its platform — trained from the ground up across millions of protein sequences — can drastically reduce the time and cost of finding and engineering candidates for a range of therapies and diseases.

name: Genesis Therapeutics
description: Genesis Therapeutics is a biotechnology company deploying breakthrough AI techniques to discover / develop drugs that address severe unmet medical needs. It is initially focusing on severe disorders that have genetically validated targets but remain difficult to treat. This includes late-stage pancreatic, melanoma, and non-small cell lung cancers — all of which currently have very low survival rates due to the lack of effective treatment.

name: Genetesis
description: Genetesis provides a commercially deployed, MRI-like machine, called CardioFlux. It can rapidly diagnose the severity of chest pain symptoms without the need for more intrusive, costly, and time-consuming testing. Cardioflux is the only FDA-cleared, non-invasive, radiation-free cardiac diagnostic technique that can be completed in minutes with accuracy rivaling invasive testing such as a coronary angiography.

name: Genome Medical
description: Genome Medical is a services network and tech platform that integrates genomic medicine into everyday health care. Through its nationwide network of genetic specialists and an efficient Genome Care Delivery platform, Genome Medical provides expert virtual genetic care for individuals to improve health and well-being.

name: Geospiza
description: Geospiza is a SaaS company that helps predict natural disasters by integrating data from multiple sources and leveraging proprietary machine-learning algorithms. Their PATH Platform analyzes potential risks for climate-exposed businesses in order to improve decision-making.

name: Get Copper
description: Copper is a digital bank that teaches teens how to make smart financial decisions in a supervised app experience that connects parents and teens. The Copper app and debit card helps teens develop the knowledge, tools, and resources to take control of their financial futures by developing patterned behaviors.

name: Getaround
description: Getaround is a peer-to-peer, car-sharing marketplace that enables users to get around easily. Users can easily rent nearby cars from their phones for hourly or daily rentals, with instant access and insurance included without needing a membership.

name: GetMyHome
description: GetMyHome is an AI-powered real estate platform offering personalized home recommendations, market analyses, and on-demand services at a fraction of traditional agent costs. By providing flat-fee compensation and full rebates on seller-paid commissions, it empowers buyers to pay only for the services they need, eliminating excessive fees and overbidding incentives.

name: Ghost Robotics
description: Ghost Robotics designs and manufacturers legged, unmanned ground vehicles for defense, industrial, and academic markets. Their robots are designed with limited mechanical complexity to increase durability, agility, and battery life while lowering capital and operating costs.

name: Giant Leap
description: Giant Leap is a direct-to-consumer, personalized children’s supplement, and integrative nutrition brand. The company is developing a survey-based user experience to provide customized product plans based on age and developmentally specific needs.

name: Giblib
description: GIBLIB allows medical professionals to stream surgical procedures, medical courses, expert advice, one-on-one talks online, earn American Medical Association (AMA) PRA Category 1 Credits for certification GIBLIB subscribers receive instant, unlimited access to its entire library, including thousands of accredited medical lectures, surgical videos, and courses in every major language. Clinician-learners who complete an assessment test can download CME certificates instantly. GIBLIB’s content is also used by institutional customers for their faculty, residents, and students.

name: Gibran AI
description: Gibran AI is rearchitecting artificial intelligence with its Scale-Free Learning AI (SLAI), a dynamic multi-agent system that learns through social interaction instead of static scaling. This approach creates AI that acts as a thinking partner, offering real-time learning, user alignment, and explainable reasoning.

name: Giglabs
description: GigLabs provides two tools — a CMS platform and a 3D environment to experience digital art and collectibles — to help brands build successful NFT experiences. Their cloud-based CMS platform, NFT Bridge, enables brands to manage the creation, distribution, management, and tracking of NFTs. RareRooms provides an immersive 3D environment for collectors, artists, and admirers to experience digital art and NFT collectibles.

name: Gilded
description: Gilded is a complete back-office solution for crypto native businesses, enabling companies to scale by automating cryptocurrency payments, reporting, and transaction reconciliation. Gilded's invoicing, payment, and accounting software empowers businesses to leverage digital currency, enabling faster and more transparent payment, with dramatically lower fees.

name: Gilgamesh Pharmaceutical
