description: Gilgamesh is a drug discovery and development company creating a portfolio of novel compounds that capture the therapeutic benefits of psychedelics — and fundamentally reshape the treatment of mental illness. The company leverages a combination of medicinal chemistry, intellectual property strategy, neuroscience & neurobiology, and drug development expertise. Its AI-powered platform accelerates the design and discovery of psychedelic-related medicines that offer improved safety, tolerability, duration, and efficacy.

name: Glacier
description: Glacier uses AI-powered sorting robots and data analytics to modernize Material Recovery Facilities, addressing inefficiencies and labor shortages in recycling. The company’s cost-effective and easily integrated technology increases recycling rates, reduces landfill waste, and enhances profitability for facility operators.

name: Glean Analytics
description: Glean’s accounts-payable tool analyzes invoices to optimize and regulate vendor spending. Their AI-powered accounting software provides real-time visibility to highlight when vendors charge more than they should. It enables clients to simplify vendor budgeting and bill payment processes.

name: Global Predictions
description: Global Predictions combines AI and financial expertise to build a full-stack solution for investing insights and financial advice on top of its proprietary Economic Insights Engine. The company’s fintech applications include its flagship product, PortfolioPilot, an AI-driven financial advisor providing customized insights for individual investors, with over $30B assets on platform.

name: Gloqal
description: Gloqal is an advanced community infrastructure platform. Their solution replaces chatbots and static forums with a social community that can be embedded anywhere online, with built in data science and fintech tools to monetize that community conversationally.

name: Glow
description: Glow develops a suite of services that enables podcasters to directly monetize their listeners. Glow’s solution is platform-agnostic, allowing users to continue to listen to podcasts on their platform of choice and pay for premium content in only three taps.

name: Glydways
description: Glydways is developing a congestion-free transportation network for mass urban transit built around autonomous electric vehicles traveling on dedicated, narrow-footprint rights of way. With a customer experience likened to personalized ride hailing at public transit prices, Glydways provides comfort, privacy, and efficiency to the rider, while contributing net-negative greenhouse gas production to the environment.

name: GoGig
description: GoGig is an anonymous professional networking platform designed to help passive job seekers confidentially advance their careers. Users can sign up as a job seeker or a recruiter and are matched with others based on specific personality traits and career qualifications.

name: Goldelocks
description: Goldelocks is an early-stage skin-care, beauty discovery, and wellness platform run by serial beauty entrepreneur Michelle Phan. It’s building a friendly ecosystem where skin-care bloggers and vloggers blend seamlessly with a community eager for authentic content.

name: Good Goods
description: Good Goods is a marketplace solution that brings together producers and retailers to accelerate the adoption of reusable consumer products. Customers receive credit for returning empty wine bottles, which can be used towards future in-store purchases.

name: Gooder Foods
description: Gooder Foods offers veggie-boosted, protein-packed, mac & cheese under the brand name Goodles. Goodles includes protein, fiber, and prebiotics; is low glycemic; has 21 nutrients from plants; and contains fewer calories.

name: Goodpath
description: Goodpath delivers whole-person virtual care for chronic conditions for employers and payers. It improves outcomes and lowers total cost of care through personalized programs and health coaching.

name: GoodTrust
description: GoodTrust is a digital legacy management platform. Their solution protects and preserves digital assets, including accounts, photos, social media, financial data, and documents.

name: Gordy Health
description: Gordy Health is a healthcare technology company focused on heart disease, one of the leading causes of death in the U.S. and worldwide. The company uses telemedicine and remote patient blood pressure monitoring to prescribe and ship medication directly to patients.

name: Grafiti
description: Grafiti was a search engine that allowed users to easily find the best charts, insights, and graphs from top publishers. Their AI-powered search engine enabled users to cut through the hassle of traditional search methods, optimizing all graph research.

name: Graft
description: Graft offers a full AI infrastructure as a service, making it much easier for companies without highly skilled ML teams to leverage the transformational power of AI. Within minutes, teams can implement Graft’s end-to-end solutions around use cases like search and recommendations, customer analytics, content moderation, and more.

name: Granata Bio
description: Granata Bio is a biotech firm aiming to transform women’s health and infertility care by offering more treatment options, reducing costs, and improving access. Its strategy involves identifying and obtaining licenses for strategic IVF medications used outside the US, with the aim of developing and commercializing them in North America.

name: Graphite
description: Graphite is a platform that connects companies with independent consultants. Their solution performs data-driven matching of projects to consultants and features worker management and enterprise collaboration capabilities.

name: Grata
description: Grata is a developer of data intelligence and prospecting software to help BD professionals discover SMB companies. Their verticalized search engine uses machine learning and natural language processing to help BD professionals discover and target SMBs.

name: Gray.life
description: Gray is developing a first-of-its-kind health and wellness coach training program to cultivate future generations of coaches who concentrate on emotional well-being. Their 9-week course builds a strong foundation in evidence-based coaching competencies to enable coaches to help increase access to quality behavior healthcare services. Completion of the course provides eligibility to sit for the National Board for Health and Wellness Coaches Certificate Exam.

name: Grayce
description: Grayce is a global caregiving empowerment platform for family caregivers. In partnership with employers, Grayce helps families to navigate needs for aging, ill, and vulnerable loved ones with personalized guidance, support, and resources.

name: Green Check Verified
description: Green Check's automated compliance platform allows financial institutions to offer banking services to market categories that have historically been difficult to bank — starting with the legal cannabis industry. Its RegTech platform currently gives dispensaries access to transparent, verifiable, and compliant banking tools.

name: GreenPark Sports
description: GreenPark Sports develops and publishes mobile games and fan-forward digital experiences. Their flagship product is a native, free-to-play mobile game played over the top of sporting and eSports events, where fans battle to become the undisputed “best fans” of their league and season. A YouTube co-founder and the founder and former CEO of Zappos co-founded the company.

name: GridAero
description: Grid Aero builds uncrewed, long-range cargo aircraft—the “pickup trucks of the sky”—designed to move heavy payloads across thousands of miles with rugged simplicity. Its autonomous Lifter fleet forms a scalable, distributed network that delivers resilient, low-cost logistics where traditional aviation can’t.

name: GridMatrix
description: GridMatrix is an intelligent traffic solutions and technology company. Its products are built for cities to help them economically achieve their transportation objectives, including reductions in traffic congestion, accidents, and associated emissions. GridMatrix’s proprietary platform combines edge sensor data with cloud-based data sources. It delivers live data in under a second from sensor to screen, quantifying everything from traffic light performance to accident severity.

name: Gridwise
description: Gridwise is a mobile platform aggregating and analyzing datasets to help rideshare drivers maximize revenue. Drivers can find more rides in less time, save on taxes, avoid crowded airport lots, and know when the best time is to arrive at an airport.

name: Gritwell
description: GritWell is a virtual care platform that is using AI to understand each patient’s genetic, biochemical, and lifestyle factors, leveraging that data to deliver more precisely personalized care with better outcomes. The AI platform ingests vast amounts of health data from a patient to identify root causes of their chronic health issues. A patient is then paired with an MD who is a dedicated health coach and a care team that works with the patient to build a comprehensive health plan over 4-6 months.

name: GRO Biosciences
description: Provider of a protein therapeutics technology platform designed to develop improved protein therapeutics across multiple disease classes including diabetes, growth disorders and autoimmunity.

name: Groovetime
description: Groovetime’s platform offers a huge array of dance styles and routines by world-class dance creators from around the world, making dance accessible for everyone. The app’s innovative, motion-detecting technology provides a fun, effective way to learn the latest dance moves at home.

name: Groq
description: Groq’s single core chip, with its tensor streaming processor architecture, seeks to unleash the potential of AI by driving the cost of compute to zero. The Groq chip eliminates many barriers of traditional computing, and it is easier to program with 10x lower latency compared to leading competitors.

name: Groups Recover Together
description: Provider of recovery treatment services designed to improve recovery from opiate use

name: GrubMarket
description: GrubMarket is an affordable, farm-to-table food delivery service offering a variety of organic and locally sourced food and produce. Users can get farm-fresh food delivered to their door all across the U.S. from local sources in a quick, timely manner.

name: Gyde
description: Gyde builds an AI-native health insurance brokerage that combines strategic acquisitions with proprietary technology to transform how independent agencies operate and scale. Its platform automates renewal workflows, client service operations, and administrative tasks, enabling brokers to focus on growth while improving service consistency and economics across acquired agencies.

name: H3X Technologies
description: H3X Technologies makes high-performance electric propulsion systems to enable sustainable electric aircraft, along with other industrial, aerospace, marine, and defense applications. At over 10 kW/kg power density, its integrated motor drive overcomes a major obstacle to widespread adoption of electric aircraft and a range of other markets.

name: Haddy
description: Haddy is a micro-manufacturer of furniture produced through direct digital manufacturing using machine learning and 3D printing. The company uses 100% reusable materials, meaning that industrial recycling programs or Haddy itself can take entire pieces and recycle them into brand-new furniture.

name: Hadean Supercomputing
description: Hadean Supercomputing provides the essential computing infrastructure needed to power the scalable building and staging of Metaverse / Web3 applications. Hadean offers multiple deep-tech products, while its core platform provides needed infrastructure between cloud-native applications and developers. The infrastructure is helping power Metaverse adoption for clients in defense & security, gaming / entertainment, and commercial sectors.

name: Haiqu
description: Haiqu is accelerating the path to quantum computers delivering real economic value — not just increased R&D budgets -- by delivering software that lets today’s quantum chips run longer circuits than their raw coherence limits. It slices large algorithms into bite-size chunks that finish within the physical hardware’s coherence window, keeps the quantum state alive by encoding it in noise-resilient sub-spaces, and shuttles it to a fresh coherence time to resume computation.

name: Hallow
description: Hallow is a faithtech business creating software and media for Christian consumers, communities, and churches, offering a growing library of audiovisual content for emotional and spiritual growth. It’s now the #1 Catholic app globally, downloaded 14 million times and used for over 400 million prayers in 150-plus countries.

name: Halo
description: Halo is building a financial marketplace for assets that have traditionally been opaque, illiquid, and complicated. Their platform lets users transact financial instruments such as structured notes, buffered ETFs, and annuities from more than 27 different issuers.

name: Hammerspace
description: Hammerspace is reinventing unstructured data infrastructure with a Global Data Platform that unifies data across edge, on-prem, and cloud environments — eliminating silos and enabling instant access anywhere. By decoupling data from metadata and pre-orchestrating placement, it delivers high-speed, parallel performance for AI and GPU workloads — without the complexity of legacy file systems.

name: Happied
description: Happied is a B2B SaaS platform / marketplace that helps companies ideate, book, and manage events — all in a single platform and at a fraction of the normal cost. Happied uses data and machine learning to auto-plan in-person, metaverse, and hybrid events, with remote event planners providing personal touches.

name: HappyRobot
description: Happyrobot is an AI operating system for enterprise operations that deploys AI agents to automate workflows across sales, customer support, collections, and logistics — replacing manual work across phone calls, emails, and legacy systems. Its platform embeds deeply into enterprise infrastructure, expanding by every use case until it functions as the operational backbone of some of the world's largest companies.

name: Harbor
description: Harbor is the app that makes disaster preparedness easy and accessible. It enables users to build emergency plans, backed by advice from world leaders in disaster preparedness and community resilience.

name: Harbor MedTech
description: Harbor MedTech develops regenerative medical technology for wounds, orthopedics, and plastic surgery. Their BriDGE® platform creates a stabilized collagen matrix that prevents products from degrading and allows them to heal in a single application.

name: Hardline
description: Hardline converts everyday jobsite conversations into structured workflows for commercial construction teams, automatically generating daily logs, tasks, and notifications from walk-and-talks and phone calls. By fitting into how crews already communicate, Hardline closes the documentation gap that drives $180B in annual miscommunication costs.

name: Hark
description: Hark offers a video-based customer service channel to enhance customer experience and reduce costs for businesses. Users can easily record audio or video through customized workflows when clicking the 'contact us' button, helping CX teams swiftly address issues.

name: Harmonic
description: Harmonic tracks companies, professionals, and market activity with a new approach to business and personnel intelligence. The platform uses proprietary AI to uncover business activity data that helps growth teams and investors identify and act on important signals.

name: Hatch Apps
description: Developer of a cloud based application creation platform designed to empower people to build advanced software. The company's platform offers a robust content management system to update, manage and change an application's design and content, enabling businesses to drive efficiency and growth for a fraction of the time and cost of the existing technology.

name: Haven
description: Haven is an AI-powered financial platform replacing legacy accounting tools for startups and SMBs, automating over 70% of core functions like bookkeeping, taxes, and R&D credits. Blending advanced LLM automation with human insight, it aims to become the unified financial OS — streamlining everything from accounting to payments in one intelligent platform.

name: HavocAI
description: HavocAI builds low-cost, autonomous maritime drones — known as uncrewed surface vessels — designed for tasks like surveillance, defense, research, and cargo transport. Positioned to deploy thousands of these multi-mission vessels, Havoc delivers cost-effective, scalable solutions that meet the increasing global demand for faster and more adaptable maritime technologies.

name: Hawala
description: Hawala is a financial super app for the Middle East and North Africa that combines digital banking, remittances, investing, and financial management in one platform. The app offers borderless money transfers with $0 fees and lets users send, save, spend, and invest across multiple currencies through subscription tiers and transaction-based revenue.

name: HawkEye 360
description: HawkEye 360 is a Radio Frequency (RF) data analytics company operating a commercial satellite constellation to identify, process, and geolocate a broad set of RF signals. With the power to reveal hidden and previously uncharted activities across land, sea, and air, the company creates powerful analytical products that solve hard challenges for their global customers.

name: Hayden AI
description: Hayden AI is a smart cities platform working to improve safety, traffic flow, and urban mobility. Hayden generates real-time digital twins of cities by fusing mobile sensors with citizen-driven data for traffic enforcement and management.

name: Heading Health
description: Heading Health is building a network of mental health clinics that combine psychedelics, psychotherapy, and technology to provide better health outcomes for the 17 million Americans suffering from treatment-resistant depression and PTSD. The company pairs in-person delivery of psychedelic therapy with its proprietary software platform to maximize long-term impact. Its in-clinic therapies boast a 60% success rate vs. 17% for patients on their third antidepressant

name: Headroom
description: Headroom’s video conferencing and collaboration solution uses natural language processing, computer vision, and multi-modal real-time AI to increase engagement and reduce the estimated $37 billion wasted each year due to inefficient meetings. Its AI-first technology stack provides a multitude of real-time and post-meeting analytics to improve meeting efficiency and engagement.

name: Heal
description: Heal is a platform that links doctors with users’ homes or offices for a flat rate, or as an In-Network Provider from several insurance companies, as well as Medicare. Users can easily schedule a doctor’s house call from 8am-8pm for personalized care.

name: Health Hero
description: Health Hero is an online platform that offers smart patient and employee health engagement. Their digital platform enables organizations to manage complete health engagement in a scalable, yet empathetic way, focusing on the needs of the population.

name: Health Note
description: An intelligent pre-visit planning and workflow optimization platform using ML / DL to automate patient communication and interactions for health organizations

name: HealthMyne
description: HealthMyne is a healthcare IT software firm that uses a Multi-Specialty Quantitative Imaging Decision Support Platform to positively impact clinical productivity of radiologists. HealthMyne’s proprietary software algorithms, analytics, and clinically integrated workflow transforms unused data into useful clinical decision support data.

name: Heart Aerospace
description: Heart Aerospace develops next-generation electric aircraft designed to drastically reduce carbon emissions and operational costs, fostering a sustainable future in aviation. For shorter-distance regional flights — which now account for 40% of aviation emissions — Heart is developing its 30-seat, hybrid-electric ES-30 airliner as well as its 19-passenger ES-19.

name: Hearth Display
description: Hearth Display is an all-in-one digital family management system designed to simplify household organization and distribute responsibilities. Its 27-inch, wall-mounted touchscreen integrates calendars, task lists, and routines, reducing mental load by making planning and daily logistics a household collaboration.

name: Heaven's Door
description: Heaven’s Door Spirits is an American Whiskey brand endorsed by musician and pop culture icon Bob Dylan. The company marries small batches of premium aged whiskey with the music and artwork of Dylan. Products include Tennessee Bourbon and Rye Whiskey.

name: Hedron
description: Hedron (FKA Analytical Space) is building a network of data relay satellites designed to solve the connectivity problems faced by remote-sensing constellations, connecting space to Earth in real time. Hedron’s remote sensing satellites provide crucial weather data, help optimize industrial-scale agriculture, track vital industrial assets, aid in disaster response, and more.

name: Heidi Health
description: Heidi Health is an AI-powered clinical documentation platform that transforms clinician-patient conversations into clear, structured, and customizable medical notes in real time. Its intuitive, standalone design reduces administrative work and streamlines workflow automation, helping free up clinicians to focus more on patient care.

name: Heleo
description: Heleo’s Next Big Idea Club is a direct-to-consumer media company that curates the top non-fiction books into the most salient points for easier and quicker absorption. Each quarter, thought leaders including Malcolm Gladwell, Susan Cain, Daniel Pink, and Adam Grant curate a selection of books that are delivered to members’ doors, or via eBook along with original video e-courses.

name: Helios
description: Helios is building Proxi, an AI-native operating system that acts as an autonomous, 24/7 legislative analyst, writer, and relationship manager for public policy and government affairs teams. Its end-to-end platform replaces fragmented tools with real-time regulatory insights, auto-generated briefs, and a stakeholder-mapping AI CRM — all powered by 350+ verified government data feeds and a proprietary knowledge graph.

name: Helium
description: Helium’s disruptive approach combines wireless technology with blockchain. The result: A connectivity system that’s inexpensive to build, highly accessible, and quickly scalable. Helium’s open-source, distributed network of Hotspots is owned and operated by users who are incentivized with tokens. It provides public, long-range wireless coverage for Low-Power Wide-Area Networks Networks (LoRaWAN)-enabled IoT devices.

name: HelixNano
description: HelixNano is building next-generation mRNA technologies, vaccines, and therapies to augment the immune system’s power to fight disease. With a long-term focus on a cancer vaccine, HelixNano has developed the first known method for producing circular mRNA, aiming to enhance vaccine efficacy and affordability through this novel protein structure.

name: Hello Alfred
description: Alfred is on a mission to change the way we live in cities. Their on-demand concierge provides services like laundry, home cleaning, and pet care to apartment buildings throughout the U.S. and Europe.

name: Hello Alice
description: Hello Alice is a free online platform that helps businesses launch and grow by providing knowledge, funding, networks, and peer-to-peer connections. The company offers services such as a credit card, access to grant opportunities, and an accelerator program.

name: Hello Divorce
description: Hello Divorce is a legaltech platform that lets customers complete the divorce process online, using self-service tools and integrated expert help from financial advisors, mediators, and lawyers as needed. Through Hello Divorce, customers largely avoid the confusing court system, spend one-tenth the cost of the average divorce, and complete the process in a third of the time.

name: Hello Patient
description: Hello Patient is an AI-native platform that replaces the costly, inefficient front office in healthcare with a 24/7 voice and SMS assistant for scheduling, intake, follow-ups, and referrals. In a system burdened by $200B+ in structural inefficiencies, Hello Patient reduces labor costs, rescues lost appointments, and improves access to care.

name: Hepta Bio
description: Hepta Bio is developing a noninvasive liquid biopsy test for nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NAFLP), a more severe and progressive form of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Its novel diagnostic solution is enabled by next-generation sequencing combined with AI and begins with a simple blood draw shipped to and analyzed in Hepta’s central lab.

name: Hercules AI
description: Hercules offers a generative AI platform for data-stringent enterprises like law firms and financial institutions, automating workflows within strict compliance frameworks. Its modular LLMs — handling data extraction, transformation, and verification — ensure secure, on-server automation to streamline processes without data compromise.

name: Here
description: Here enables investors to acquire fractional ownership interests in vacation rental properties, providing passive income without management responsibilities. Here’s platform makes it easy for anyone to invest in vacation rentals. Investor can browse and select properties to invest in, and Here takes care of the marketing, day-to-day management, guest interactions, and other operational responsibilities. Investors receive quarterly distributions of pro-rata net rental income, plus potential tax benefits such as depreciation and expense write-offs.

name: HeronAI
description: Heron AI simplifies data-driven decisions with easy-to-use tools for dashboard generation, report creation, and seamless integration with third-party data sources like Salesforce and Google Analytics. Leveraging AI, Heron provides actionable insights and reduces complex reporting processes from weeks to minutes, giving businesses a 360-degree view of their operations.

name: Hexem Bio
description: Hexem Bio is pioneering a fast, minimally invasive therapy that rejuvenates aging blood stem cells to reverse immune decline and extend healthspan, starting with patients at high risk for bone marrow transplant complications. Hexem restores stem cell function in a process shown to reduce transplant failure tenfold in mice — offering a scalable path to treat age-related diseases and visible aging.

name: Hey Jane Health
description: Hey Jane is a digital women’s healthcare company tackling a host of important, underserved women’s healthcare issues such as abortion, postpartum depression, and miscarriage. Hey Jane provides medication for abortion on a digital platform that’s private, safe, supportive, accessible, and convenient. It also enables women to schedule online consultations with doctors and order prescription contraception drugs from the comfort of their homes.

name: Heyday
description: Heyday (formally Journal) is a productivity software provider. Their platform serves as a digital base where users can connect all their content from apps like Gmail, Google Calendar, Dropbox, Slack, etc., and can access all of their files, messages, and meetings.

name: HeyMilo
description: HeyMilo AI allows companies to automate the job screening process and engage candidates with an always-available, generative AI-powered voice agent . The platform employs AI for interactive candidate assessments, saving time, reducing bias, and informing hiring decisions with dynamic, two-way conversation.

name: HeyRosie
description: HeyRosie (fka Rally) delivers AI-powered answering services that seamlessly manage customer inquiries, appointments, and day-to-day communication so businesses never miss a critical call. By combining intelligent automation with a human-quality touch, the platform acts as a reliable extension of a company's team, elevating responsiveness.

name: Heywell
description: Heywell makes low-sugar, adaptogen-infused sparkling waters that support energy, focus, hydration, immunity, and stress relief using clean, plant-based ingredients. Designed for health-conscious Gen Z and millennial consumers, each can delivers daily wellness benefits through a blend of adaptogens, antioxidants, herbs, minerals, and organic caffeine.

name: Higgsfield
description: Higgsfield is an AI-powered video platform that turns simple ideas into studio-quality ads and cinematic content in minutes through an intuitive, Canva-like interface. It unifies proprietary and third-party models to create Hollywood-grade videos at a fraction of the cost, meeting demand for accessible, cinema-quality content.

name: High Brew Coffee
description: High Brew Coffee develops a convenient, shelf-stable, premium cold-brew experience made from 100% Fair Trade Certified Arabica beans. The cold brew coffee is brewed to be smooth, bold, and full of natural energy, with a lower sugar content than others.

name: Highlight
description: Highlight's (formerly known as Showcase) market research platform generates targeted, efficient, and agile consumer insights by connecting brands with a network of home product testers. Their in-home product-testing platform sends boxes of free products to members of its consumer community in exchange for feedback, enabling brands to get faster results to better innovate and design products.

name: Highly
description: Highly allowed users to highlight web content in order to share key items in articles. Users could highlight articles or items on apps and websites and sync the highlights to the cloud, enabling them to access and share them via texts or social media.

name: Highscore
description: Highscore (fka INcoggo, EXT) is a cloud gaming platform that offers access to over 100,000 titles, allowing users to stream games across various devices without the need for a gaming PC or console. It provides flexibility with a BYOG model and subscription options for enhanced features, promising better performance and cost savings compared to traditional gaming setups.

name: Higlobe
description: Higlobe is an international payment platform enabling instant, fee-free transactions, designed to support overseas freelancers, contractors, and independent workers with U.S. business clients. Higlobe generates revenue through value-added services like FX optimization, USD savings interest, and its Higlobe Pro Membership.

name: Hill Research
description: Hill Research streamlines one of the most painful bottlenecks in clinical trials by automating the biostatistics work that slows FDA submissions and depends on scarce expert labor. Its AI platform generates compliant code and submission-ready statistical outputs quickly, reducing human error and accelerating the path to new drugs.

name: Hillflint
description: Hillflint developed heirloom-quality inspired collegiate apparel for over 100 universities. They utilized luxury fabrics, classic color palettes, and old-school logos for a retro and classic product.

name: Hingeto
description: Hingeto is a SaaS platform that helps fashion brands crowdfund new designs while minimizing the amount of inventory that needs to be held. It allows small vendors to sell products unique to their customer base without inventory risk or bulk buying.

name: Hitch
description: Hitch is solving intercity transportation by offering an affordable, personal, and safe ride-sharing service to consumers Emphasizing safety, punctuality, and speed, the app matches riders and drivers headed to the same city, with no pre-booking required.

name: Holler
description: Holler is a media company that enriches conversations within apps. Their solution enables the creation and curation of stickers, GIFs, and other media to enhance exchanges.

name: Homepolish
description: HomePolish provided interior designing services to residential customers. Their platform connected consumers with interior designers.

name: Honcho
description: Honcho (formerly Whistler) is a digital communication monitoring platform that is designed to perform real-time compliance review. They help businesses monitor and analyze every incoming and outgoing communications channel with analytics and communication controls.

name: Honest Bank
description: Honest Bank is a financial services company leveraging cutting-edge technology to bring fair fintech and financial solutions to the underserved Southeast Asia market. Its first project is the launch credit services in Indonesia, where credit card penetration has historically been very low.

name: Honor
description: Honor is a software and tech-enabled services company that utilizes AI to improve in-home senior care. The company partners with local agencies and professional caregivers, to provide high-quality non-medical home care for the market of older adults.

name: Hopscotch Health
description: Hopscotch Health addresses healthcare shortages in rural communities — enhancing access, quality, and community well-being with its holistic care model, advanced technology, and clinics. Specializing in Medicare-focused primary care, Hopscotch offers team-based, comprehensive care complemented by technology and analytics that ensure personalized, proactive healthcare.

name: HopSkipDrive
description: HopSkipDrive is a web and mobile-based platform that offers alternative transportation for children and teens to assist with education. It develops safe, dependable transportation that schools and families can use to get kids where they need to go.

name: Horsepower Technologies
description: Horsepower Tech is an animal healthcare and biotech company that is intended to combat equine lameness and suffering. Their products and technologies are based on sound and proven science and have been rigorously tested in laboratories and on horses.

name: House Account
description: House Account’s personalized, predictive platform allows customers to effortlessly subscribe, schedule, and pay for all their home services in a click or two. The platform provides payments software for home services providers (e.g., pool cleaners, landscapers), facilitating AR/AP, invoicing, and CRM.

name: Human Interest
description: Human Interest provides low-cost, high-quality retirement benefits to small and medium businesses. Its affordable, full-service 401(k) syncs to legacy payroll solutions and automates compliance and recordkeeping.

name: Humanly
description: Humanly has developed a hiring platform that uses conversational AI to help recruiters surface the most qualified, diverse pool of applicants at scale. Its chatbot automates repetitive screening, scheduling, engagement, reference check tasks, and responses to candidate queries, while ensuring a fair candidate experience that minimizes bias.

name: Humans&
description: Humans& develops AI systems designed for social intelligence and human coordination, building technology that helps groups of people work together more effectively rather than replacing individual tasks with automation. The company uses a novel long-horizon reinforcement learning approach that simulates multi-user interactions over extended periods, enabling AI to understand relationships, maintain context about individuals and organizations, and support better collective decision-making.

name: Humatics
description: Humatics creates precise location and navigation data in places where those capabilities do not exist for use in manufacturing, transportation, robotics, surgical, and more. A combination of proprietary software / hardware, on-board sensors, and complex algorithms position everything that moves with unmatched precision and reliability in XYZ coordinates.

name: Humio
description: Humio’s time-series logging and aggregation platform is designed to facilitate real-time observability through log data management. It features data aggregation, exploration, reporting, and analysis from a range of sources for on-premises and cloud infrastructures.

name: Humming Homes
description: Humming Homes offers a single platform for homeowners to significantly reduce the time it takes to manage home maintenance, especially for first-time homebuyers and non-DIYers. Through Humming’s subscription service, users can have their homes assessed for preventative (or emergency) maintenance, find vetted home service providers, and manage projects and payments.

name: Humu
description: Humu’s behavioral action management platform makes it easy for organizations to improve their engagement, retention, and performance, all of which increases productivity. The company's software combines scientific studies, machine learning capabilities, and basic human characteristics to empower managers and employees towards positive behavioral change in a way that is targeted, research-backed, and complementary

name: Huskeys
description: Huskeys is rethinking web and API security with an AI-powered platform that works alongside existing tools to fix vulnerabilities and manage defenses automatically. Designed for today’s complex, cloud-based environments, it simplifies protection while paving the way to replace outdated security systems.

name: Hydrow
description: Hydrow is a fitness platform focused around a tech-enabled rowing machine. It provides an immersive screen experience and maximum muscle engagement for the user, as well as computer-controlled resistance.

name: Hyfé
description: Hyfé is reducing the cost of biomanufacturing by converting food-processing wastewater into low-cost fermentation feedstock. Hyfé’s technology processes food-processing wastewater, creating nutrient-rich and organic matter to be used in fermentation and clean water as a byproduct.

name: Hyper
description: Hyper is modernizing emergency response infrastructure through AI-powered automation, handling up to 75% of non-emergency 9-1-1 calls, enabling call-takers to focus on emergencies. Seamlessly integrating with existing call systems, Hyper ensures intelligent routing, instant escalation, and automated follow-ups to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and scalability.

name: Hyperbolic
description: Hyperbolic aims to lead in open-access AI cloud services, building a GPU marketplace with an automated interface that enables anyone to rent or supply GPUs in seconds. Its Hyper-dOS decentralized orchestration system fosters an open AI ecosystem with innovations like revenue-sharing for AI agents, developer reputation systems, AI-powered DAOs, and GPU restaking.

name: Hyperion Biosystems
description: Hyperion Biosystems (fka C2Sense) develops advanced optical detection devices that improve health and safety through AI-powered vision systems, physics-based algorithms, and proprietary molecular additives. Spun out of MIT, Hyperion delivers high-performance diagnostics at low cost through deep expertise in sensing hardware and scientific innovation.

name: Hypr
description: HYPR is a password-less, dual-authentication cybersecurity solution for enterprise employees and customers. It enables businesses to eliminate fraud, phishing, and credential reuse, while at the same time enhancing customer and employee experiences.

name: Hyprsense
description: Hyprsense develops facial tracking software and developer kits for virtual reality. The software uses eye, tongue, and dense face tracking to capture users’ likenesses and bring characters to life using real-time human expressions.

name: Iambic
description: Iambic (formerly Entos) is a biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics from its unique generative AI discovery platform. Its physics-based AI algorithms drive a high-throughput experimental platform, converting new molecular designs to tackle the most challenging design problems in drug discovery.

name: iAsk AI
description: iAsk.Ai is an advanced, free AI answer engine that allows users to ask questions in natural language and receive instant, accurate, and factual answers without storing user data. Its solution stands out by integrating a proprietary natural language processing (NLP) technology that allows for the delivery of precise responses on the first attempt.

name: IceGuard
description: IceGuard is an AI-ready enterprise security platform, replacing legacy log management and threat detection tools with a scalable, cost-efficient solution for hybrid and self-managed environments. Built for high-scale investigations, it enables analysts to process massive log volumes, resolve threats with AI, and reduce the total cost of managing and operating security infrastructure.

name: Icon Savings Plan
description: Icon is building a financial platform intended to offer an alternative and/or complement to 401(k) plans. It removes the complexity, administrative burden, and cost from employers and delivers a low-cost, easy-to-use, portable retirement plan for employees.

name: Illumix
description: Illumix is transforming the future of mixed reality with enviromentally-intelligent, world-scale augmented reality (AR) games. Their approach uses best-in-class AAA gaming practices with cutting-edge R&D in computer vision, deep learning, and mobile AR.

name: Impart Security
description: Impart Security is building the first programmable protection platform that defends apps, APIs, and LLMs with AI-assisted rules deployed directly in runtime environments. Its agent-based architecture blocks threats in real time — without alerts, latency, or code changes — giving security teams precise, autonomous control.

name: Impulse Space
description: Impulse Space creates orbital maneuvering vehicles for last-mile payload delivery that can transport multiple payloads to unique orbits from a single launch. With a near-term focus on low Earth orbit, Impulse will offer services for all classes of payloads to distant destinations such as Geostationary Equatorial Orbit (GEO), the Moon, and Mars.

name: Inchfab
description: Inchfab is developer of a microfabrication platform that offers quick manufacturing solutions for the semiconductor and micromechanical IoT chip industries. By streamlining the transition from prototype to production, Inchfab's solution is four times faster and 60% more cost-effective in the fabrication process.

name: Included
description: Included is a Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI) data platform that provides companies with real-time DEI analytics, insights, and actions. The platform allows businesses to connect candidate and employee data from across multiple platforms, sources, and databases into one single source of truth. The goal is to aid in recruiting diverse candidates, managing the employee's experience, and identifying and closing all equity gaps.

name: Indigov
description: Indigov is a service delivery and constituent engagement platform built for governments that enables elected officials at all levels to respond to the 5.1 billion messages they receive every year — in minutes, rather than months. Its constituent service platform integrates every channel of communication, including web, scanned mail, Facebook, Twitter, and phone calls, sorting messages into smart inboxes for easy management. Its tagging system allows staffers to identify trends and track information related to common constituent inquiries.

name: Infactory
description: Infactory offers an AI search platform designed to eliminate the risks of misleading or inaccurate GenAI outputs, ensuring precision in data management, query processing, and error prevention. By using advanced technologies like embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Infactory delivers clear, reliable, and cost-effective AI solutions that provide trustworthy results.

name: Influence
description: Influence is a public online platform designed to be the first vertical professional community to discover and connect influencers, brands, and agencies. Influencers can chat with peers, discover new brands, and be discovered by brands and agencies.

name: Infracost
description: Infracost gives engineering teams real-time visibility into cloud computing costs during development, enabling them to catch expensive infrastructure changes before code is deployed. Unlike legacy tools that only show cloud costs after deployment, Infracost brings cost awareness into the development process to save time and prevent overspending.

name: InGel Therapeutics
description: InGel Therapeutics develops stem-cell therapeutics and biodegradable polymers to treat eye diseases that cause retinal degeneration. Founded on Harvard research, InGel's lead product is a cell-based therapy that acts on neuroprotective pathways to rescue the dying cone photoreceptors in the retina.

name: Ingrediome
description: Ingrediome utilizes blue-green algae in a scalable precision fermentation process, using CO2 and sunlight to create protein-rich meat with higher Omega-3 levels. This sustainable method reduces CO2 emissions by 15 times, water usage by 8 times, and land usage by 30 times compared to traditional methods.

name: Inkbit
description: Inkbit is the developer of a multi-material 3D printing system for advanced additive manufacturing. The company's platform integrates machine vision systems and artificial intelligence to enhance reliability, throughput, precision, and material quality.

name: Innoblative
description: Innoblative is a medical device company that is developing specialized electrosurgical devices that innovate multiple surgical procedures. They develop advanced energy surgical solutions that improve the way surgeons achieve better care for patients.

name: Innoviti
description: Innoviti is the largest provider of payment solutions in India for non-cash transactions that are processed at brick-and-mortar stores. Through a point-of-sale terminal and their retail data platform, Innoviti can capture payments from credit, debit, UPI, QR codes, and 10 different digital wallets. It has also built rich data sets that are helpful for banks, brands, and merchants to partner together to upsell and simplify their operations.

name: Insiteflow
description: Insiteflow is an electronic health records (EHR) integration platform. Their solution integrates on top of existing EHR and healthcare analytics software applications to provide curated workflow automation and actionable recommendations.

name: Inspira Education Group
description: Inspira Education Group (formerly InspiraFutures) supports college and graduate school applicants with mentorship, counseling, and coaching. Using AI-enabled tools, the company pairs students with consultants from the world's largest network of admissions counselors based on the individual personality and learning needs.

name: Intangible AI
description: Intangible is an AI-native 3D creation platform that lets anyone—from filmmakers to marketers—build complex, high-quality scenes using natural language, no code required. Its browser-based system combines Pixar-level composition with Canva-like simplicity, dramatically reducing the time, complexity, and cost of 3D production.

name: Integrate
description: Integrate is a marketing automations and technology company, as well as a hub for managing and measuring demand generation programs. It develops integrated solutions for various platforms, including marketing, content, events, websites, and webinars.

name: Integry
description: Integry provides SaaS companies with embeddable integrations. Their platform enables users to build custom directories for apps and workflows across their enterprise.

name: Intelity
description: Intelity develops a friction-free, personalized guest experience while creating operational efficiencies and driving additional revenue. They offer an enterprise experience & management platform for the hotel, casino, cruise, and residential markets.

name: Intramotev
description: Intramotev specializes in pioneering zero-emission freight mobility solutions, such as its self-propelled battery-electric freightcars designed to seamlessly operate within standard railroad interchange services. With Intramotev's proprietary TugVolt kit, existing railcars are retrofitted to move independently--like a truck--for first- and last-mile deliveries at significantly reduced costs and considerably lower carbon emissions.

name: Intrinio
description: Intrinio is a marketplace built by developers designed to make financial data affordable and accessible. Users can subscribe to real-time financial data, visualize data with tools such as price charts and ticker tapes, and download bulk data.

name: Intus Care
description: Intus Care is a healthcare analytics platform that helps providers improve care for elderly patients. Their system synthesizes financial, clinical, and administrative data to identify trends and proactive care measures at long-term care facilities.

name: Inventive
description: Inventive is building a tailored data product platform to help product managers rapidly ship valuable new data products to customers. Inventive empowers non-technical domain experts to rapidly build high-value solutions that unlock smarter business operations and accelerate growth.

name: Iolyx Therapeutics
description: Iolyx Therapeutics is a precision therapeutics company focused on the intersection of immunology and ophthalmology. The company is leveraging the work of a highly successful drug with proven efficacy in dermatology to deliver a therapeutically novel application to treat dry eye and uveitis.

name: Ion Storage Systems
description: Ion is developing a breakthrough solid-state battery technology to fuel the global electrification of vehicles and energy, as well as the IoT. The benefits are lower costs, higher efficacy, and increased safety and adaptability. Applications of Ion’s patented lithium metal battery technology includes defense and aerospace, consumer electronics, electrified transportation, and renewable energy storage.

name: Ionobell
description: Ionobell works to improve the capacity of rechargable batteries through the development of a lithium-ion battery. They are working to migrate lithium-ion batteries to 70% Si anode designs, achieving 2X initial performance improvement with 8X potential capability improvement in the long term.

name: Iris
description: Iris is a telehealth platform to help chronically ill patients manage their advanced care planning. The platform offers specially trained facilitators, available anytime via phone or video, to take families through the advanced care planning process.

name: ISO.io
description: ISO is the first collaborative performance management solution for the supply chain industry. Their platform creates a centralized source of truth by reconciling data discrepancies between business partners in real time.

name: ISOThrive
description: ISOThrive develops and distributes prebiotic healthcare supplements. Their microFood is made of non-digestible soluble fiber, and it nourishes specific bacteria in the gut in order to resolve imbalances and health conditions, like digestion problems.

name: Italic Health
description: Italic Health builds a universal identity and data layer for patients across the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, enabling them to verify their identity once and reuse it seamlessly across labs, digital health apps, providers, and pharmacies. Its platform creates persistent, patient-permissioned health profiles that unlock AI-powered clinical insights while reducing patient drop-off and improving care coordination across fragmented healthcare systems.

name: Iterative Health
description: Iterative Health is applying powerful, proprietary AI tools to the practice of gastroenterology and drug development. The company uses computer vision, machine learning tech, and deep neural networks trained by leading GI specialists to help gastroenterologists detect and classify lesions in real-time — including those that often elude the human eye.

name: Jadu
description: Jadu’s platform combines augmented reality (AR), NFTs, and cryptocurrency for a revolutionary mobile gaming experience. Jadu’s Mirrorverse expands its gaming platform to attract new players and earn additional revenue. This kind of blockchain-native, open AR platform is a first of its kind.

name: Jasmine Energy
description: Jasmine Energy accelerates the net-zero transition with a decentralized marketplace for renewable energy, offering fast, transparent, and liquid trading of Renewable Energy Credits (RECs) on the blockchain. Jasmine makes it easy to claim, trade, and retire RECs, enhancing the efficiency and transparency of renewable energy markets.

name: Jawnt
description: Jawnt unifies transit and makes it the best way to move around cities, giving riders access to every bus, subway, bike, and scooter — all in one platform and subsidized by employers and transit providers. Jawnt directly integrates with a company's existing HR and payroll systems and determines benefit eligibility and compliance with IRS guidelines and local transit mandates.

name: Jebbit
description: Jebbit is a mobile marketing solution designed to collect and activate the most relevant consumer data through innovative mobile experiences. The company's Declared Data platform allows brands to build their own valuable sets off first party data through innovative consumer experiences, enabling advertisers to use collected data to personalize user experiences both inside and outside the platform.

name: Jeeves
description: Jeeves is building the first global business bank with payments, lending and treasury functions that work across countries and currencies. Jeeves provides startups and SMBs with innovative banking infrastructure, credit cards, and payment products to power their growth. It’s an “all-in-one,” cross-country, cross-currency, expense management platform.

name: Jericho Security
description: Jericho Security provides a cybersecurity platform designed to train employees on how to defend against generative AI cyberattacks. By simulating hyper-personalized attacks, Jericho trains employees to recognize and respond to threats, while building the largest dataset of generative attacks to enhance detection capabilities.

name: Jetty
description: Jetty is a financial services platform that makes renting a home more affordable by offering greater flexibility with how and when to pay rent, deposits and insurance. Its product also helps property managers increase lease conversions, improve resident retention, reduce bad debt, and boost net operating income.

name: Jirav
description: Jirav offers a cloud-based Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) platform purpose-built for accountants and small to medium-sized businesses that’s easy to use, collaborative, and comprehensive. The platform allows for collaborative, automated reporting; forecasting; and predictive analytics. It integrates seamlessly with popular applications such as Excel, NetSuite, HubSpot, and QuickBooks.

name: Jock Mkt
description: Jock MKT (”market”) is an app that allows users to buy and trade fantasy shares of sports players for cash. Users choose their event and game format, bid on shares of individual players, trade with others in real time during the sports event, and receive a payout based on their players’ final rankings.

name: Jodie
description: Jodie (fka 2045 Studio) is a manager development platform that blends AI coaching, structured programs, and executive mentorship to build better people managers. It helps companies create resilient, inclusive, high-performing teams with personalized prompts, guided practice, and continuous support.

name: Jona
description: Jona uses AI to generate personalized summaries of the vast body of microbiome research and connect all of this data to an individual’s microbiome. In its first market, Jona provides AI-powered analysis of the gut microbiota living in the human digestive-tract in order to detect chronic GI disorders that are otherwise hard to detect.

name: Jopwell
description: Jopwell has developed a career-services platform designed to increase Black, Latinx, Hispanic, and Native American students’ representation. Designed to facilitate a national dialogue about diversity in the workplace, Jopwell offers career advancement and recruiting for diverse hires.

name: Journey Meditation
description: Journey provides online and offline meditation services intended to strengthen focus and bring happiness in life. Their instructors teach live group wellbeing classes in a simple, approachable way to local communities, inside organizations around the world, and every day through the Journey LIVE app.

name: Joyne
description: Joyne automates the pre-construction materials takeoff and cost estimates process for general and subcontractors via Computer Vision and Machine Learning. Their solution uses computer vision and machine learning to convert blueprints into a digital Bill of Materials (BOM).

name: Judi Health
description: Judi Health (fka Capital Rx) is a full-service health benefits technology company helping employers design and manage transparent, affordable plans. Its unified, AI-powered platform pairs a transparent, flat-fee Pharmacy Benefits Managers model with medical, dental, and vision benefits on a single system

name: Jump
description: Jump intends to bring next-gen functionality to ticketing by building a Shopify for the $126B ticketing sector. Founded with the belief that ticketing is under-monetized and under-innovated, Jump is building an integrated solution that taps into other aspects of the fan journey – from sports betting to mobile ordering and merch, games, even NFTs.

name: Jumpcloud
description: JumpCloud has developed a directory-as-a-service platform that provides users secure, frictionless access from any device to any resource anywhere.

name: Juno College
description: Juno is an in-person technical college designed for students to learn the skills they need to get a tech job quickly. It builds a custom coding education learning journey and offers a bootcamp for immersive education in web development.

name: Juno Residential
description: Juno combines world-class design and a mass timber-building system to create elegant, innovative, and sustainable homes in cities. Juno is reimaging how multifamily housing is designed and built while delighting residents and reducing costs.

name: Juvena Therapeutics
description: Juvena Therapeutics unlocks the therapeutic potential of stem cell-secreted proteins and accelerates their development into life-saving therapeutics for chronic and age-related diseases. Juvena’s computational platform mines proteins secreted by regenerative stem cells. It then screens this rich pool of drug candidates across therapeutic areas to discover and engineer novel biologics.

name: Kabata
description: Powered by AI, Kabata is focused on bringing connected strength training into the home, starting with smart free weights and a connected app. The smart weights analyze a user’s real-time metrics and preferences to deliver strength training routines uniquely curated for their body.

name: Kalder
description: Kalder provides a platform that automates and enhances loyalty programs for brands, offering features like gamified rewards and integrated digital wallets to boost customer engagement and satisfaction. By enabling scalable reward exchanges and partnerships between brands, Kalder creates a unified loyalty ecosystem that increases customer spend and reduces churn, driving revenue growth.

name: Kalderos
description: Kalderos’ platform simplifies the complex coordination of drug discount programs. The platform uses proprietary machine learning engines and a robust dataset across different stakeholder groups — including government agencies (all 50 states' Medicare departments), leading drug manufacturers, and 3,000+ pharmacies.

name: Kangaroo
description: Kangaroo has developed simple and affordable home security systems. Their products are flexible, app-enabled, and ensure data is secure and privacy is protected.

name: Kanmon
description: Kanmon is an embedded lending solution that enables vertical software and marketplace platforms to offer bespoke, bank-level lending products to their business customers. Platforms use Kanmon to build multiple lending products such as net terms loans, business term loans, and line of credit.

name: Kano
description: Kano develops do-it-yourself computer kits designed to allow anyone, especially children, to build a computer and learn basic computer coding skills. Users can go from beginner to code master with simple engaging step-by-step challenges and stories.

name: Kanvas Biosciences
description: Kanvas Biosciences is a deep-tech therapeutics company that harnesses the microbiome with spatial AI to design and manufacture next-generation live biotherapeutics for greater efficacy and scalability. The company's platform combines proprietary spatial biology imaging with scalable anaerobic manufacturing to reveal microbe-immune cell interactions in tissue, enabling applications from cancer immunotherapy to drug discovery.

name: Kapital
description: Kapital is a digital banking and financial management solution that simplifies financial tasks for Latin American small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). With Kapital, SMEs can request credit, get paid faster, streamline payroll, and visualize and automate their finances in a modern, unified platform.

name: Kapow
description: Kapow enabled users to book restaurant dining, group corporate activities, and other experiences across the U.S. Users could discover ideas for corporate events, client events, business meetings, and company parties by browsing the curated marketplace.

name: KarmaCheck
description: KarmaCheck is revolutionizing the pre-employment background check. Its platform improves on speed, accuracy, and user experience for both candidates and employers.

name: Katalyze
description: Katalyze develops AI-powered automation software for pharmaceutical manufacturing that connects to existing systems and deploys always-on agents to investigate issues, analyze process data, and generate regulator-ready documentation. Its platform transforms manual manufacturing and quality workflows into continuous, executable processes that keep humans in control while dramatically reducing the time needed for deviation analysis and batch release decisions.

name: Kayhan Space
description: Kayhan Space provides scalable and cloud-based collision-avoidance services for operators of satellite constellations who need complete situational awareness of their fleet. Kayhan uses complex algorithms and advanced machine learning techniques to help commercial and governmental satellite operators avoid space debris and other potential risks.

name: Kea
description: Kea is an automated phone ordering system designed for high volume restaurants. Restaurants can take orders automatically when customers call, handling simultaneous phone orders with an artificially intelligent operator and full time availability.

name: Kenshō
description: Kenshō is a personalized, research-backed, and holistic health discovery platform. It pairs scientific research with personalization technology to take the guesswork out of the search for a trusted provider.

name: KetoNatural Pet Foods
description: KetoNatural is a healthy pet food delivery service. They offer specialty dog food and treats through their website via a subscription service.

name: Kettle
description: Kettle is a property reinsurer focused on wildfires and other climate risks. Kettle leverages deep learning to build more accurate climate-risk models that enable better predictions and reduce loss ratios.

name: Key
description: Key (formerly BlueprintX) is a a community-based event tool to organize and manage events via a simple workflow. Users can set up easy-to-set-up invite pages, customize automated reminders, and provide surveys and chats with guests.

name: Kidas
description: Kidas is a cybersecurity platform that analyzes all in-game communications on PCs and alerts parents about potentially dangerous activities in video games. Its ProtectMe tool monitors over 125 PC games to keep kids safe from threats such as cyberbullying, predators, privacy violation, financial fraud, and more.

name: Kindbody
description: Kindbody is a full-service women’s health and fertility platform. It provides egg-freezing and IVF treatments, fertility assessment, employer benefits, community events, and digital access for an easily accessible healthcare plan.

name: Kindbridge
description: Kindbridge Behavioral Health provides online therapy services, connecting individuals, families, and organizations to licensed counselors specializing in gaming, gambling, and other behavioral concerns. With fast, accessible telehealth services and support groups, Kindbridge combines clinical expertise, research, and technology to offer comprehensive care for behavioral addictions.

name: Kindest
description: Kindest is a social good platform that powers philanthropic giving to the 1.5 million non-profits in the U.S. Their free, elegantly designed, and technically lightweight platform drives regular donation behavior from its user base.

name: Kinsa
description: Kinsa offers a smart thermometer for tracking the temperature of children and monitoring health. The app records temperature data to offer personalized guidance, services, and information on possible diseases while also providing anonymous, aggregate information on illness trends to schools.

name: Kinside
description: Kinside helps connect working parents with optimal daycare and pre-school options for their children. Their marketplace app can be offered by employers to create more flexibility and cost savings in daycare through tax-friendly flexible spending accounts.

name: Kite AI
description: Kite AI is the purpose-built Layer 1 for the AI economy, enabling transparent, trustless collaboration across data, models, and agents through protocol-level attribution. Powered by Proof of Attributed Intelligence, it rewards contributions, enforces ownership, and scales decentralized AI development with modular tools, privacy-preserving memory, and customizable subnets.

name: Klasha
description: Klasha is a checkout platform for international retailers that serves African customers. Its solution integrates directly into e-commerce websites and accepts online payments in African currencies as well as through M-Pesa.

name: KLOwen Braces
description: KLOwen provides custom, in-office braces made using 3D printing. Their system uses 3D printed, modular brackets to straighten teeth faster, better, and more comfortably than conventional braces.

name: Knapsack
description: Knapsack is a design system platform that unites code and design, so developers, engineers, and designers can collaborate in real-time, with built-in tools and features they need to do their best work. With its flexible, end-to-end platform, paired with expert guidance, Knapsack enables enterprise teams to build better products in half the time.

name: Knit
description: Boasting the largest nationwide panel of Gen Z consumers, Knit empowers brands to make meaningful, customer-centric decisions. Its Quant + Qual studies can hyper-target to specific geos, attributes, and demographics. Knit’s platform automatically extracts structured insights from customer videos, virtual focus groups, and quantitative studies — quickly getting that information to product managers & business analysts.

name: Knix
description: Knix develops women’s seamless, comfortable, and chafe-free intimate apparel. Their garments include revolutionary leakproof protection, seamless and moisture-wicking underwear that doesn’t cause chafing, and wireless bras that mix comfort and style.

name: Knoq
description: Knoq (formerly Polis) is a neighborhood outreach platform that empowers users to educate their communities about products and services that can make their lives better. Their technology trains and guides neighborhood representatives (Knoqers) to help homeowners understand important home decisions.

name: Knowde
description: Knowde is the leading digital marketplace for the industrial chemical sector. For the first time, R&D teams and buyers can search, learn, engage, sample, quote, and purchase from every major producer. Knowde offers access to over 6,000 suppliers and 150,000 chemical products. Buyers are able to find and purchase products from myriad producers, while sellers enjoy a digital storefront that’s easy to navigate and conducive to engagement.

name: Koala
description: Koala Health is a mobile-first petcare solution that partners with veterinarians to supply direct-to-home pet prescriptions through a seamless, low-friction user experience. Using the vet’s prescription, the company pre-sorts and packages prescriptions labeled by day and time and delivered to customers’ doors. Vets can offload the burden of pharmacy operation without giving up all of their incremental margin from scripts.

name: Kodama
description: Kodama Systems is developing technology to improve climate resilience and carbon storage in forests across the western U.S. Kodama’s robotics-powered solution makes forest thinning more capital-efficient and climate-friendly.

name: Kodex
description: Kodex is building a Web3 domain name platform focused on the budding Ethereum Name Service (ENS) marketplace that’s analogous to Under construction - Awesome site in the making! internet domains. Kodex will allow users to leverage unregistered domain name listings with smart search filters, advanced appraisals, registration bundling, and value bots to track secondary market opportunities.

name: Kognition
description: Kognition combines real-time data streams and response, AI, and continuous machine learning to manage industrial and commercial properties. Users can reduce risk, raise performance, and drive ROI with an AI-powered, autonomous property system.

name: Kognitos
description: Kognitos is a pioneering GenAI automation platform that lets businesses automate even the most complex processes using plain English, with no coding required. Its platform transforms everyday instructions into self-maintaining AI agents, unlocking enterprise-wide efficiency and productivity while reducing reliance on traditional RPA tools.

name: Kolors
description: Kolors is a Mexico-based smart bus line using data and technology to help bus operators increase their load factors and revenue. Kolors partners own the buses and do the driving and maintenance while Kolors runs all other aspects of the operation through its platform and brand (sales, marketing, pricing, logistics, etc).

name: Komment
description: Komment offers an AI-driven software tool that securely automates code documentation, seamlessly integrating into current developer workflows. This tool allows engineering teams to concentrate on innovation rather than manual documentation, cutting documentation costs by over 95% and boosting developer productivity.

name: Kontain
description: Kontain is redefining containers — a standard unit of software that packages up code so applications run quickly and reliably in multiple computing environments. Their patented “unikernel” technology allows containers to run on their own kernel “operating system,” resulting in secure and efficient operations.

name: Kontigo
description: Kontigo is a USDC smart neobank in Latin America offering a decentralized platform for low-cost, cross-border remittance, and financial management without intermediaries. Kontigo uses DeFi technology to address the region’s high transaction fees and currency depreciation with a secure, inflation-resistant alternative that operates seamlessly through WhatsApp with AI-driven private banking support.

name: Korbit
description: Korbit uses machine learning, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning to provide interactive, personalized online learning. The company sells its solutions to employers seeking to upskill their employees. Korbit’s 50+ modules cover topics such as ML, AI, and neural networks — and will add modules in topics such as physics, biology, and chemistry.

name: Koru
description: Koru developed predictive hiring software for companies to better identify candidate fit. Every candidate completed an online pre-interview and Koru identified prospects with the candidate's fit score using predictive hiring to lead to better matches.

name: Koxa
description: Koxa’s one-to-many API gateway solution allows banks to extend the functionality of their online treasury portal directly into their corporate customers’ accounting software. Using Koxa’s secure API platform, bank controllers or treasurers can execute their work directly in their native application suite without moving between bank portals, accounting systems, and permissioning flows. The banks’ corporate customers can seamlessly consolidate activities from within their existing systems, reducing complexity, errors, and expenses.

name: Kriya Therapeutics
description: Kriya Therapeutics is a gene therapy company. Their fully-integrated platform, SIRVE™, enables rational vector design, analytical characterization, and scalable manufacturing to develop gene therapies for diseases with well-understood underlying biology.

name: Kryptomon
description: Kryptomon is using location-based technologies and digital genetics to create a crypto-gaming metaverse shaped and brought to life by players. The company is building an NFT blockchain-game with Play-and-Earn mechanics set in the Kryptomon metaverse, where players act as ‘trainers’ of customized Kryptomon monsters.

name: Kudos
description: Kudos is a direct-to-consumer retail company specializing in providing clean, non-toxic, and eco-friendly baby products. The company’s disposable diapers, lined with 100% doctor-recommended sustainable cotton and featuring two absorption layers, provide superior protection and care for a baby’s sensitive skin.

name: Kuvee
description: Kuvee was a patented wine dispenser system that prevents oxygen from touching the wine to enable by-the-glass consumption. The system prevented oxygen from touching the wine to enable by-the-glass consumption.

name: KwaKwa
description: KwaKwa (fka Piggy) is a creator monetization platform that turns expertise into income through mobile courses and micro-learning experiences. With a social media-like format of interactive stories and short-form reels, it helps creators connect with their audiences, grow communities, and unlock new revenue streams.

name: KYC Hospitality
description: KYC Hospitality offers software as a service for the hospitality industry. Their comprehensive platform brings simplicity, agility, and a customer-centric approach to the hospitality management sector by allowing enterprises to eliminate up to 25 legacy systems.

name: Kyte
description: Kyte offers fully flexible rental cars on demand delivered to a user's door without the hassle of queues or paperwork and with no refueling on return. Kyte allows consumers to bypass the inconveniences of car ownership, leasing, and traditional car rental for trips longer than an Uber ride.

name: Kyte Tech
description: Kyte Tech provides a lightweight, flexible interface that lets airlines present their full product suite — fares, ancillaries, and bundles — across all channels, from their own website to third-party travel sellers. By standardizing content and simplifying integration, Kyte reduces complexity and unlocks more personalized, scalable, and cost-effective retailing

name: Lacework
description: Lacework develops cloud security with automation and scale, so that security and DevOps teams can safely keep data and applications in the cloud. They support increased security visibility, cloud compliance, anomaly detection, and Kubernetes security.

name: Lambda
description: Lambda is a hybrid AI cloud infrastructure provider that offers on-site and cloud-based GPU computing infrastructure, along with a software stack for AI engineers and deep learning operations. Lambda Labs specializes in providing advanced AI infrastructure solutions that cater to a diverse range of sectors including technology, academia, healthcare, and government

name: Landed
description: Landed is a marketplace that helps businesses hire associates faster using candidate video clips. Candidates can record short videos of themselves answering interview questions and hiring managers can view candidates’ schedules to instantly book an interview.

name: LandIt
description: Landit develops personalized career pathing, using a turnkey “one size fits one” solution. They enable companies to effectively develop and retain diverse and underrepresented talent at scale. Users can easily track their accomplishments and talents.

name: Lang.ai
description: Lang.ai is the developer of a no-code platform for structuring free-text data for inquiry, analysis, and retrieval. Their language-understanding platform uses unsupervised AI to automate time-consuming manual tasks like tagging, prioritization, and routing.

name: LARQ
description: LARQ offers the world’s first portable digital water purification system. Their smartly designed water bottles self-clean every two hours, and the contents can be purified via UV light at the touch of a button.

name: Latent Technology
description: Latent Technology revolutionizes game animation by replacing handcrafted techniques with a physics-based foundation model that removes the biggest bottleneck in game development: bringing characters to life. With reinforcement learning and generative AI, its platform enables real-time character movement, letting developers create immersive experiences faster and more efficiently.

name: Layer
description: Layer is engineering a solution that allows companies to easily deploy and manage AI copilots — personal assistants for software platforms — at a fraction of current costs. Layer’s copilots seamlessly integrate with complex web platforms, enhancing user experiences and streamlining web interfaces.

name: Leadbay AI
description: Leadbay AI builds an artificial intelligence platform that uncovers and qualifies business prospects from the "invisible economy" of small and medium-sized businesses that traditional lead databases fail to detect. The platform uses machine learning models trained on sparse data sources to identify potential customers even when little structured digital data exists, automatically enriching and scoring these hidden prospects for sales teams.

name: LeadIQ
description: LeadIQ’s sales-enablement platform simplifies lead management and sales prospecting processes. Their platform helps sales teams research and find potential leads on LinkedIn Sales Navigator by capturing and sequencing contact information with one click — to eliminate busy work and save time for higher-value tasks.

name: LeafPress
description: Leafpress helps large property managers collect and report carbon emissions. By utilizing AI, the company seamlessly integrates with utility provider platforms and analyzes millions of data in order help real estate owners avoid substantial ESG fines and reduce energy expenses.

name: Leaftail Labs
