description: Leaftail Labs is a mobile, augmented reality gaming company that is developing a location-based immersive game titled “Chibis.” The game is designed to use location-based tech to easily recognize and adapt to your daily physical routines.

name: LeaseUp
description: LeaseUp equips commercial real estate brokers with a comprehensive suite of tools that streamline the entire transaction process, from site selection to signing, centralizing surveys, tours, and documents. Its platform enhances broker-client collaboration with a mobile-friendly interface and flexible data management, ensuring brokers can personalize their workflow and efficiently control how information is presented to clients.

name: Legacy
description: Legacy is a direct-to-consumer healthcare platform that is developing methods to enable at home collection, remote testing, and long-term cryogenic storage of sperm. It allows male users to test and freeze their best sperm without leaving their house.

name: LegalMate
description: LegalMate’s platform enables law firms to offer flexible payment options to their clients with its buy-now-pay-later solution for out-of-pocket legal expenses. LegalMate’s customers can pay off costs over months at very favorable terms — including competitive interest rates and no late fees — while law firms get paid up front. The company is selling through practice management software (PMS) companies to reach lawyers at scale.

name: Legion Health
description: Legion Health is a high-quality, AI-enabled psychiatry network where patients can receive care from a provider who takes their insurance. Legion uses LLMs and AI agents to improve care quality, streamline operations, enhance patient communications, and more.

name: Leigh & Siena
description: Leigh & Siena is building a body-inclusive fashion brand, starting with the wedding dress. They provide accessible, customizable, and easily-returnable clothing in pursuit of their mission to make women of all body types feel beautiful.

name: Lemon
description: Lemon is an AI-powered neobank and super app for Latin America that unifies everyday banking, instant payments, and crypto in one simple experienc By combining everyday payments with investing, Lemon is making crypto part of daily life across the region.

name: Lemurian Labs
description: Lemurian Labs is developing an affordable AI processor uniquely designed from foundational mathematical principles to deliver the next generation of AI workloads. Lemurian’s affordable, high-performance Spatial Processing Unit delivers better performance and consumes less power than legacy processors that have limited gains in AI capabilities.

name: Lentesplus
description: Lentesplus is the leading online contacts lens retailer in Latin America, operating in Colombia, Mexico, Chile, and Argentina. They offer competitive prices between 20% and 30% below market standards, as well as efficient delivery, in many cases on the same day as the order was placed.

name: LeoLabs
description: LeoLabs is a leading partner in Orbital Intelligence, helping military, government, and commercial operators detect, track, and respond to space-based threats through its global radar network and AI-powered analytics. With the largest commercial LEO object catalog and real-time monitoring, LeoLabs prevents collisions, safeguards assets, and ensures safe operations in an increasingly congested space.

name: Lessonly
description: Lessonly provides a new model for enterprise learning software. Their software helps even non-technical users create content, deliver trainings, assess performance, and improve performance of their employees.

name: Letter
description: Letter is a “Banking as a Service” platform that will make it possible for anyone to provision bank accounts and lend money to their customers. They provide an easy-to-use embeddable User Interface and API.

name: Levee
description: Levee’s AI-powered platform empowers organizations to quickly find, hire, and retain the best talent for service sector jobs. Its platform provides a single interface to manage all recruitment marketing channels and combines data with intelligence to help teams make better hiring decisions by pinpointing candidate skills and traits that genuinely enhance retention.

name: Levelfield
description: Levelfield’s mission is to be the first federally chartered, full-service bank and broker-dealer to integrate digital assets alongside USD. Its goal is to elevate digital asset investing to the same level of customer protections, customer service, and integrations with regulatory entities as traditional banking and brokerages.

name: Levels
description: Levels is a dashboard for your body’s metabolism. Their platform offers personalized insights into how different foods affect your body and health through a wearable metabolic device that monitors real time glucose levels.

name: LEX Markets
description: LEX Markets is a commercial real estate securities marketplace for accredited and non-accredited investors. Users are able to diversify into Commercial Real Estate properties with the potential to earn passive income and build wealth.

name: Lexi
description: Lexi provides real-time, HIPAA-compliant medical interpretation that integrates directly into clinical workflows, making language access seamless across the entire patient journey. By supporting underserved languages and replacing costly legacy vendors, Lexi improves care equity while dramatically reducing provider expenses.

name: Life House Hotels
description: Life House Hotels has developed a hotel software platform to manage its own properties and a white-label version for other hotel brands to increase their revenue and reduce operating costs. Their platform includes automated financial accounting and reporting tools, AI-driven pricing, and an employee-facing property management system.To date, Life House Hotels has opened four high-touch, locally rooted lifestyle boutique hotels designed to connect travelers with new places by celebrating neighborhood heritage.

name: Light Field Lab
description: Light Field’s high-resolution holographic display platform enables digital objects to accurately move, refract, and reflect in the physical world without the use of headgear. Light Field’s proprietary render engine provides real-time, interactive experiences. It offers a turn-key system solution for a range of next-generation experiences across entertainment and corporate applications.

name: Lightbeam
description: LightBeam enables privacy and compliance executives to maintain continuous compliance and ensure secure use and access of sensitive data. Its AI platform offers a comprehensive view of privacy data from unstructured, semi-structured, and structured sources, enabling identity-centric views and management of the entire data lifecycle.

name: Lighter
description: Lighter (fka Lunchclub) is a decentralized trading platform that uses advanced cryptography to ensure fast, low-cost, and fair order book trading on Ethereum. Its system guarantees transparent matching, secure transactions, and full user control over assets without relying on a middleman.

name: Lightfield
description: Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that automatically captures calls, emails, and meetings to create a living system of record that both revenue teams and AI agents can act on. Its natural-language interface lets users manage the full scope of go-to-market work — from prospecting and lead scoring to forecasting and follow-up — replacing the fragmented stack of legacy tools that modern sales teams have long relied on.

name: Lightship
description: Launched by Tesla alumni, Lightship is bringing the $26B RV industry into the electric age. The team is designing and producing an aerodynamic, battery-powered trailer that liberates travelers from the noise, emissions, and range anxiety of a gas RV. Lightship’s commercialization plan entails an initial rollout of a limited-run fleet for rental. The goal is to eventually transition to a for-sale model with service offerings such as storage and consignment for owners, seamless campsite booking, curated itineraries, and mobile on-demand service.

name: Lila Sciences
description: Lila Sciences is pioneering the world’s first AI Science Factories — modular, autonomous systems capable of running the entire scientific method with 46x faster workflows and 95% labor savings. Each experiment generates proprietary, high-quality data, creating a self-reinforcing intelligence that accelerates breakthroughs in human health, climate, and sustainability at unprecedented scale.

name: Lilo
description: Lilo (formerly Torpedo) is a one-stop B2B procurement marketplace for independent hotels — from sourcing to buying to financing. By applying innovative software and AI solutions, Lilo enables small and independent hotels to compete with larger chains in purchases of equipment and amenities across 16 categories.

name: Lily AI
description: Lily AI develops customer engagement AI for the fashion retail industry. Shoppers can easily find the right look for them, using semantic search, filters, and facets. Their image recognition technology automatically identifies every item of clothing.

name: Limitless
description: Limitless (fka Rewind AI) offers a discreet, wearable AI device designed to record and process audio data with the intention of enhancing memory and comprehension by transcribing and summarizing interpersonal interactions. Combined with its wearable pendant, the company's cross-platform app enhances human memory and efficiency by automating mundane tasks like meeting preparation, note-taking, and summaries.

name: Limitless Minds
description: Limitless Minds is a digital mental fitness platform providing transformational coaching aimed at increasing the productivity of corporate sales professionals and other employees. The company differentiates itself as a B2B performance solution and enhancer, rather than a health and wellness solution for individuals.

name: Lincode
description: Lincode has developed a unique computer vision-based solution that assists manufacturers with quality inspection, increasing both efficiency and profitability. Using proprietary AI and industrial IoT solutions, Lincode’s software quickly and accurately detects manufacturing defects, foresees machine downtime, and predicts the likelihood of future defects.

name: Lineaje
description: Lineaje provides solutions to manage software supply chain risks across enterprise software — including cloud applications, SaaS, and off-the-shelf software. Lineaje’s flagship product provides a comprehensive solution to manage and secure the software supply chains of enterprises, focusing on the management of open-source and third-party software risks.

name: Linear Labs
description: Linear Labs manufactures electric motors and generators intended to create more power while using less energy. Their new electrical motor design maximizes the physics of converting electricity to torque with higher efficiency.

name: LineLeap
description: The LineLeap venue platform empowers venue owners and managers to provide a better customer experience, improve marketing efforts, and create new revenue streams. LineLeap partners with venues across the country, helping them maximize revenue. Services include letting customers skip long lines, order drinks, pay the cover, access exclusive deals, get event tickets, and reserve special areas straight from their phones.

name: Lingohealth
description: LingoHealth provides a digital platform that helps immigrants and their loved ones navigate the U.S. healthcare system. LingoHealth connects English-nonfluent patients and their families to an inclusive primary care experience in their preferred language and cultural context.

name: Lish
description: Lish is an on-demand food catering and delivery platform specializing in workplace and corporate office catering. Users can sign up for one-time or subscription catering and receive family-style meals from a diverse array of chefs using custom menus.

name: Live Undiscovered Music
description: Live Undiscovered Music is transforming how emerging music artists engage with their fans. It has built the first-ever U.S. music streaming platform to allow for direct-to-artist payment via its own in-app currency: the “Note.”

name: Loadsmart
description: Loadsmart is an on-demand freight marketplace designed to help shippers move their freight and carriers keep their trucks and rail cars full. The company’s online platform enables users to get quotes, book trucks and rail, and track their freight from pickup to delivery.

name: Lobby
description: Lobby is a knowledge management platform enabling DAOs to go from idea to scale with tools built on Web3. Its platform enables teams to onboard contributors, share context, and maximize the potential of web3 native projects. The company’s Wiki is a database for DeFi and DAO knowledge owned by the crypto community. Lobby helps DAOs create their own token-gated wikis while providing community features to help them discover new partnerships and contributors.

name: Localwise
description: Localwise connects local jobs with the professional “uncollared” worker who currently lacks an online professional reputation. Users can upload a resume and join local businesses and receive help from professional recruiters through a talent network.

name: Loft Orbital
description: Loft Orbital operates microsatellites and flies customer payloads as a service. Their groundbreaking Payload Hub technology is a universal payload adapter that can fly any payload on a standard satellite bus.

name: LogCat
description: LogCat builds automated observability and debugging infrastructure for the system software layer that sits between physical hardware and applications, enabling device manufacturers to diagnose complex failures in a fraction of the time. Its proprietary parsing layer compresses massive hardware logs before AI ingestion, bypassing the context limits and cost constraints that make general AI tools unworkable in this environment.

name: Logistyx
description: Logistyx develops low-cost transportation management execution services. It is designed for high volume parcel shipping and allows manufacturers, retailers, and logistic providers to ship millions of parcels worldwide at the lowest possible cost.

name: Loliware
description: Loliware addresses a major environmental concern by developing durable, biodegradable, and elegant bioplastic products using seaweed-based pellets on existing plastic manufacturing machinery. Its single-use products, such as straws, are designed to disappear after use, either through composting or natural processes.

name: Long Game
description: Long Game is a personal finance app that is migrating toward a white label product in 2021. Users can win real money and crypto, save for their goals, earn coins, and play to win in a gamified version of the real world of personal finances.

name: Longéve Brands
description: Longève Brands provides shelf-stable, pea protein products for both in-home and commercial use. Their products are always completely clean and made with nothing but pure plant ingredients.

name: Looking Glass
description: Looking Glass Factory has developed holographic light field displays that enable enterprises and individuals to create and showcase 3D designs. Their two light field displays — desktop and portrait — combine custom electronics, advanced optics, and a software stack. Both a holographic creation tool and a viewing portal, the displays enable artists, developers, designers, filmmakers, photographers, and others to convert any image into a hologram at a reasonable price.

name: Loop AI
description: Loop AI offers a smart platform that helps boost profitability and customer experience for restaurants using third-party delivery services like DoorDash. The platform addresses key challenges for restaurants such as financial reconciliation, bookkeeping, sales tax and franchise fee management, and marketing optimization.

name: Loops AI
description: Loops AI builds an AI commerce platform that serves as the merchant-side intelligence and orchestration layer for brands navigating the shift to agentic commerce, where AI agents interpret intent and transact on behalf of shoppers. Its commerce knowledge graph separates deterministic decision-making from probabilistic reasoning, enabling brands to surface accurate, personalized product recommendations without sharing sensitive data with foundation models.

name: LoveLocal
description: LoveLocal’s e-commerce platform is digitizing India’s $1.1 trillion unorganized retail market, bridging the gap between tens of millions of potential digital consumers and India’s 60 million retail shops. The platform gives India’s local retailers an online presence and more than 750 million consumers the ability to conveniently buy products from favorite neighborhood shops on their phones.

name: LTSE
description: LTSE is developing a new stock exchange, with a vision to reduce the focus on short-term pressures and thinking. Its software tools transform public stock markets by helping companies hire and grow from startup, to initial public offering, and beyond.

name: Lucra Sports
description: Lucra Sports develops a B2B SaaS platform that enables brands to build customer loyalty through competitive tournaments and challenges rather than traditional, points-based programs. Its white-label solution integrates into partners' existing mobile and venue experiences, delivering measurable increases in customer visits, engagement time, and revenue per user across hospitality, entertainment, and media companies.

name: Ludis Analytics
description: Ludis Analytics is a no-code, cloud-based data platform that unifies messy datasets — whether from sports, web3, or new verticals — to accelerate analytics and drive better decisions. By automating ingestion, cleaning, and visualization, it empowers non-technical teams to harness AI and ML without needing engineering support.

name: Lula
description: Lula is the first all-in-one, ultra-fast delivery platform for convenience stores, transforming them into last-mile, micro-fulfillment centers to dispatch products to consumers via third-party partners. Lula’s middleware solution digitizes physical store inventories while providing a single point of contact with all major delivery solutions (i.e. Uber Eats, Postmates, Doordash, Seamless, Caviar, GrubHub). This helps stores manage inventory, gain customer insights, and leverage instant deliveries via an easy-to use subscription service.

name: Luma Health
description: Luma Health is an automation platform that helps clinics orchestrate the patient journey. Their engagement engine is simple for patients and flexible for clinics and health systems — transforming the process to a continuous and lasting relationship.

name: Lumafield
description: Lumafield provides the world’s first low-cost industrial CT scanner and AI software for analyzing physical products, accessible through the cloud. Lumafield’s detailed 3D reconstructions of scanned objects allows designers and engineers to look inside products, inspect invisible features, and pinpoint problems before they reach customers.

name: Lumanu
description: Lumanu streamlines payments and eases collaboration interactions to give creators more time to focus on building their brands and growing their businesses. Its media platform helps brands access first-party data and permissions from influencers, musicians, artists, streamers, and other creators.

name: Lumiata
description: Lumiata is a healthcare-focused artificial intelligence platform company optimizing healthcare delivery to individuals. It supports the prediction of patient-specific clinical trajectories, and drives easily affordable population healthcare management.

name: Luminous
description: Luminous is a developer of novel photonics chips. These chips leverage the physical characteristics of photons to process the exponentially increasing compute workloads in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.

name: Lunar Energy
description: Lunar Energy is designing and building products to facilitate the future of electrified homes, starting with solar, storage, and distributed energy generation. Its solar energy backup system provides modular battery units that can power an entire home while giving users control over the system in one app.

name: Lux Aeterna
description: Lux Aeterna is revolutionizing space logistics with reusable satellite platforms that separate the payload from the spacecraft bus, enabling satellite reuse and letting customers focus on their missions instead of rebuilding spacecraft. Its fleet-based model reduces failure rates, lowers costs, and unlocks new capabilities like in-space manufacturing, material testing, and rapid payload return.

name: Lōvu
description: Lōvu is a next-generation maternal health platform that enhances pregnancy outcomes through technology, real-time monitoring, and data-driven insights, supporting mothers, clinicians, and payers. With tools like fetal heart rate monitoring, evidence-based recommendations, and mental health support, Lōvu drives data-driven prevention, generating 1,000 times more clinical data per pregnancy than traditional care models.

name: M80
description: M80 is a gaming and esports company that sponsors professional teams competing in various global esports gaming competitions. M80 will build on its teams’ success to grow a scalable audience and cross-sell products such as content, games, CPG, and digital items.

name: Maad
description: An e-commerce marketplace between brands and retailers in Africa. Maad offers a smart distribution management system for order and delivery management between brands and retailers in Africa. They also offer a multichannel ordering platform for retailers and real-time monitoring and intelligence platform for brands.

name: Machina Labs
description: Machina Labs builds AI-enabled robotics to scan, cut, and shape sheet metal to millimeter precision, enabling the fabrication of custom precision parts that are uneconomical or impossible to manufacture by traditional means. Machina Labs uses real-time sensor data, coupled with AI software, to precisely control the incremental forming and trimming of sheet metal parts; as a result, their robotic systems are able to replicate the honed perception, dexterity, and agility of a master sheet metal craftsman, but with the repeatability and scalability of a modern factory.

name: Madison Reed
description: Madison Reed develops premium at-home hair color products. Users can choose from permanent hair dye, touch-ups, shampoo and conditioner, and various styling tools and products. The company offers a referral program and in-person services at ColorBar.

name: Magdrive
description: Magdrive develops compact plasma thrusters delivering 10x the thrust of electric propulsion systems while maintaining efficiency and maneuverability, addressing key limitations in satellite propulsion. Its technology unlocks new capabilities like frequent orbital maneuvers, satellite servicing, and untraceable defense satellites, driving innovation in the massive space economy.

name: Mage
description: Mage is a low-code artificial intelligence (AI) development tool for tech product developers. Their programming interface and infrastructure platform enables tech teams to leverage AI seamlessly with minimal engineering time.

name: Magic
description: Magic is a software platform that enables merchants of any size to easily and quickly build a co-branded, card-like loyalty program through closed-loop payments. Merchants pass on savings to shoppers — in the form of store credit — that would normally cover credit-card-processing fees, thereby leading to boosted LTVs, AOVs, and repeat purchase rates.

name: MagicX
description: MagicX (formerly Hero) is an artificial intelligence software company developing AI-powered assistants and productivity tools designed to help users automate tasks, take actions instantly, and manage everyday workflows more efficiently. The company’s products, including Hero Assistant and AI Autocomplete, combine conversational AI with action-oriented automation to help individuals and teams streamline daily activities, improve productivity, and interact with software more naturally.

name: Magna
description: Magna is building the "Carta of Web3," allowing companies to track fundraises, manage capitalization tables, and execute token unlocks for employees, investors, and contributors. Magna's automated platform replaces the long, manual hours required to manage a token-centric cap table with a full suite of products providing organizations with fast and secure token operations. With Magna, companies save time on token management, ensure compliance, and reduce security vulnerabilities.

name: Magnetic Insight
description: Magnetic Insight has developed real-time, ultrasensitive imaging technology that accelerates preclinical research with direct translation into the clinic. Its groundbreaking Magnetic Particle Imaging technology provides faster, safer, and more accurate detection of cells, blood perfusion, and other biological events

name: Mahmee
description: Mahmee is a prenatal and postpartum care management platform, designed to deliver personalized, ongoing education and live support to families. They are a HIPAA-secure care platform that makes it easy to coordinate prenatal and postpartum healthcare.

name: Mai
description: Mai (or Markable.ai) is a Video Search Engine Optimization company that makes visual content shoppable. They use the power of computer vision and deep learning AI to provide links to any fashion items (or similar items) in a video or picture in near real-time.

name: Mainline.gg
description: Mainline.GG is the provider of esports tournament software. The company provides customers with their own white-labled esports platform for hosting and assisting entities to manage, monetize, and market their esports programs.

name: Mainspring Energy
description: Mainspring Energy’s linear generators provide affordable, clean, onsite power. Their products’ breakthrough design and adaptive control software allow them to derive power from various biofuels with near-zero emissions in a space the size of a parking spot.

name: Mainstay
description: Mainstay is an AI-powered mobile chat platform that helps students engage with universities. Chatbots are available 24/7 for current and prospective students, answering over 80% of questions immediately with advanced Natural Language Processing.

name: MainStreet
description: MainStreet helps small businesses and startups discover, apply for, and receive government stimulus funds, hiring incentives, and tax credits. The platform automates the process by pulling key data from a company’s payroll platform. MainStreet then runs that information against a database of applicable programs and submits application materials on behalf of the company.

name: Maintouch
description: Maintouch is reinventing SEO through autonomous AI agents that replace traditional agencies with real-time, end-to-end content, technical, and backlink execution. Its results-driven engine—learning continuously from customer feedback—creates a performance and cost advantage so strong that profitability, retention, and measurable traffic gains become a built-in competitive moat.

name: Maisonette
description: Maisonette operates a marketplace that connects parents with a curated selection of high-quality children’s products sourced from a global network of independent brands and boutiques. Their marketplace offers a broad range of quality children’s products while serving as an essential go-to-market resource for more than 800 independent brands and boutiques.

name: Makelog
description: Makelog has developed software that makes it easier for companies to compile, curate, and share product updates with the right stakeholders at the right time using the right medium. Their software automates and centralizes product release communications so product teams can keep customers and internal teams up to date, ensuring that communication velocity keeps pace with shipping velocity.

name: Mammoth Cyber
description: Mammoth Cyber (formerly Appaegis) leverages an enterprise access browser to eliminate operational complexity, enhance security, and protect against malicious actors. Mammoth secures cloud infrastructure access by combining browser isolation, identity, and authorization.

name: Mammoth Media
description: Mammoth Media is a mobile-first media platform as a modern alternative to television. They bring original, interactive short-form content to Generation Z, revolutionizing the entertainment world and focusing on content for a tech-focused generation.

name: Mantel Capture
description: Mantel Capture is developing innovative molten-salt-based carbon capture technology that operates at high temperatures, making it suitable for industries like steel and chemical manufacturing. This approach greatly reduces energy loss by >60% and cuts costs in half, making carbon capture more efficient and cost-effective for hard-to-decarbonize sectors.

name: Mantle
description: Mantle makes precision metal 3D printers that help manufacturers automate their toolmaking processes, dramatically reducing lead times and costs. Mantle's TrueShape technology creates tools with the precision, surface quality, and durability necessary for demanding tooling tasks.

name: Mantra Health
description: Mantra Health is a digital mental health provider for university students. Mantra Health collaborates with schools to provide measurement-informed treatment and actionable lifestyle changes to students needing specialized care.

name: Manus Bio
description: Manus is a biotech/biosynthetics company that sustainably manufactures natural chemicals and plant oils via fermentation. Their technology provides a low-cost, sustainable, environmentally-friendly source for ingredients used in people’s daily lives.

name: Marble
description: Marble is a loyalty rewards platform for the insurance industry. Their data-driven engagement and retention solution allows members to organize, pay, and shop for home and auto insurance, while earning up to 5% back on their insurance premiums.

name: Marine Snow
description: Marine Snow is a vertical social network and music-streaming platform. Its platform prioritizes listening and is built on music discussion, game-like consumption, and lean-in personalization.

name: Maritime Fusion
description: Maritime Fusion is building the first nuclear fusion reactors for marine applications, using compact high-temperature superconducting technology to power shipping vessels. By avoiding radioactive fuels (e.g., from nuclear fission reactors) and leveraging a simpler regulatory pathway via a modular development model, the company is able to sidestep the cost and complexities facing other nuclear systems.

name: Market
description: Market (formerly Trust) is a retail media network that helps direct-to-consumer brands create new revenue streams and get in front of new customers. Market combines the best aspects of large platform ad systems with an open network that allows brands to make more money and access data that is usually locked behind walls and premium subscriptions.

name: Marveri
description: Marveri is a legal tech startup that uses AI to synthesize company documents for lawyers and investment bankers. Marveri has processed billions of dollars’ worth of venture financings and M&A deals.

name: Massless
description: Massless is a virtual reality enabled development platform designed for creative professionals. The Massless Pen — a VR input device — unlocks design potential, combines sophistication with intuitive design, and allows users to create in VR, 3D, or 2D.

name: Masterful AI
description: Masterful is an automated software platform to train deep learning computer vision models. Masterful enables any developer to build a production-grade ML model without days and weeks of experimentation or paying an army of human data labelers. The results are that developers get the highest-quality model in the shortest amount of time and at the lowest cost.

name: Matchwell
description: Matchwell is a cloud-based, online, clinician marketplace. Via cloud-based technology, their platform brings together clinicians seeking work and facilities looking for talent.

name: Matrix Wildfire
description: Matrix Wildfire (formerly Team Wildfire) is a wildfire resilience and risk management company that helps homeowners, businesses, and communities assess and reduce wildfire exposure through expert inspections and recommendations. The company combines deep wildfire prevention expertise with construction and mitigation experience to deliver defensible space assessments, home hardening guidance, and custom wildfire preparedness plans that improve property resilience and insurability.

name: Matterbeam
description: Designed to manage the complexity of today’s data stacks, Matterbeam gives customers control, visibility, transparency, and scalable access to data that was previously scattered and fragmented. Users access Matterbeam through a web UI that allows them to connect arbitrary data sources and destinations in order to create single data pipelines.

name: Max Space
description: Max Space is reshaping space exploration by creating large-scale, expandable habitats that are more affordable, efficient, and safer than traditional methods. The habitats provide 10x the volume of traditional ones, are more transportable due to reduced packed volume, and utilize advanced materials in multi-layered systems for enhanced space hazard protection.

name: Maxinsights
description: MaxInsights revolutionizes robotics data collection and AI model development with an autonomous platform that delivers a 10x efficiency improvement over traditional methods. Its proprietary technology enables a single operator to manage up to 100 robotic systems, optimizing large-scale data gathering for Tier 1 corporations, research institutions, and AI-driven robotics firms.

name: Mayan
description: Mayan is an end-to-end analytics and revenue optimization platform for Fufilled by Amazon businesses. Their software solution provides a centralized analytics tool suite that manages all aspects of a company's FBA business.

name: MD Ally
description: MD Ally provides patient navigation software and telemedicine solutions that integrate into 911 computer-aided dispatch systems. The company helps transfer non-emergency callers to telemedical care, provide virtual care to triaged members, coordinate follow-ups, and automate referrals.

name: Medallion
description: Medallion is the leading healthcare provider network management platform, uniting provider operations and enabling end-to-end automation for credentialing, enrollment, and compliance monitoring. By replacing outdated systems with AI-powered workflows, Medallion helps healthcare organizations reduce costs, accelerate revenue, and lets care teams focus on what matters most — patients.

name: MedCrypt
description: MedCrypt has developed a security platform that enables medical device OEMs to secure their devices from cybersecurity threads, patch vulnerabilities, and monitor device behavior. Their platform helps enterprises prevent unauthorized access or misuse of their medical devices — from imaging devices to implantables like pacemakers — by authenticating users, encrypting data, and monitoring for malicious behavior.

name: Meditrina
description: Meditrina is developing a medical device intended for the treatment of various intrauterine pathologies. The Aveta system is the first seamless hysteroscopy system for the office or operating room, removing the complexity of hysteroscopy procedures.

name: Medivis
description: Medivis is a medical technology company that uses augmented reality and artificial intelligence to facilitate advanced medical imaging and surgical visualization. Their FDA-Cleared Surgical AR integrates the latest computer vision advancements to decrease surgical complications and improve patient outcomes all while lowering costs.

name: MedScout
description: MedScout has launched the first revenue acceleration platform built for medium-sized medical technology companies. Seamlessly integrating into the client’s CRM, the platform enables sales and marketing teams to easily find best-fit prospects, learn more about them, and then organize sales activities.

name: MeliBio
description: MeliBio makes 100% plant-based honey without the environmental damage caused by commercial bees. With its proprietary blend of ingredients, MeliBio uses microbial fermentation and synthetic biology to make plant-based honey that has the same nutrient composition, sweetness, and viscosity of conventional honey.

name: Mend
description: Mend works with leading hospitals and universities to develop nutri-medicine products targeting appetite, blood sugar stabilization, energy, healthy aging, inflammation, and more. Mend is also building a digital health platform to align with existing healthcare billing codes, reducing friction and cost for care providers recommending a product and patients adopting it.

name: Mendel
description: Mendel is a decentralized expense reporting solution combined with a corporate credit card. Their platform combines expense management software with a smart corporate credit card, allowing companies to set up workflows and define parameters for employee spending.

name: Mending
description: Mending (fka Taro Health) offers a fresh take on health insurance, providing ACA-compliant concierge healthcare plans that combine major medical coverage with exclusive access to Direct Primary Care providers. By streamlining administration and emphasizing relationship-based care, Mending helps patients get better access to doctors while alleviating the many common friction points on both sides of the incumbent healthcare system.

name: Menten AI
description: Menten AI is a platform drug discovery company focused on designing peptide therapeutics for conditions with high unmet medical needs. The platform combines protein design, machine learning, and quantum computing to create and fast-track development of new therapeutic molecules from target selection to in vivo efficacy in record time.

name: Mentium
description: Mentium produces AI inference chips that are 100x faster and 50x more efficient than current solutions, enabling 10x larger neural networks to run on edge devices like satellites, robotics, and IoT devices. Mentium's approach facilitates the seamless integration of AI co-processors into existing hardware systems, eliminating the need for reconfiguration or redesign.

name: Mentra
description: Mentra launched AugmentOS, a first-of-its-kind open-source OS and super app that makes AI-powered smart glasses more accessible, functional, and developer-friendly than ever before. With built-in features, real-world AI assistants, and a universal dev platform, it enables cross-device apps and seamless daily support — paving the way for the next era of augmented reality.

name: Mercor
description: Mercor powers the human expertise layer of AI by connecting elite professionals—bankers, consultants, engineers, and doctors—to frontier model training programs. I ts tech-enabled marketplace supplies expert-level data to leading AI labs, capturing the fastest-growing and most profitable segment of the reinforcement learning economy.

name: MergeQueue
description: MergeQueue has developed a GitHub app that monitors PullRequests and automatically merges them after running all of the required validations. Their First-in-First-Out queue helps users manage merge workflow in GitbHub repositories and increase productivity by both automating merge workflows and improving code quality.

name: Merit
description: Merit provides a digital credentialing system for issuing, verifying, and tracking credentials issued by governments, companies and other public and private organizations. Merit’s digital credentialing system enables public- and private-sector organizations to easily issue verified licenses, certificates, and awards to their members and trainees. Individuals benefit by having all of their life’s achievements in one secure place and in their control. Agencies and industries benefit by having a common standard to check credentials without the need for a personal connection to create trust.

name: Mesa Cloud
description: Mesa Cloud is a student-progress tracking and graduation-management platform. Their centralized solution analyzes student data and automatically tracks each student’s achievements against their best graduation path.

name: Mesh Connect
description: Mesh Connect (formerly Front Financials) is the developer of a global crypto payments network. Combining a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app, it makes it easy to coordinate crypto payments across hundreds of exchanges, wallets, and providers.

name: Metabilia
description: Metabilia provides a white-label platform to professional sports teams and athletes that increases fan engagement and drives revenue through its unique marketplace for authentic physical and digital sports memorabilia. Focused on solutions with physical memorabilia and NFTs, Metabilia delivers to fans collectibles never before available in real time on an easy, user-friendly app/web experience.

name: MetaSight
description: MetaSight provides affordable liquid biopsy diagnostics for early detection of chronic and acute diseases using proprietary mass spectrometry technologies like metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics With the world’s largest serum molecular dataset linked to electronic health records, MetaSight aims to revolutionize healthcare through accessible, advanced diagnostics.

name: Method Financial
description: Method Financial makes it easy for developers to embed debt repayment into their apps.

name: Metrobi
description: Metrobi is a Boston-based delivery service that helps food and beverage makers and other businesses with wholesale deliveries to restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores. They have developed a mobile app that uses AI to provide shared B2B deliveries. It frees clients from the hassles of making local deliveries, giving them access to an on-demand delivery fleet and saving them money.

name: Mic
description: Mic is a media brand and news platform for the Millennial generation. They provide timely and relevant articles that speak on pop culture, recent events, trends in social media, and other topics which might interest people between the ages of 20 and 35.

name: Midgame
description: Midgame developed an intelligent voice assistant for gamers and esports teams. Their AI assistant allowed users to streamline their gameplay, expand their abilities, and bring them deeper into the game, all while reducing friction and expanding capabilities.

name: Miga Health
description: Miga Health is a digital health company building out medical and services products that unite key stakeholders (consumers, physicians, biopharma, employers) in the goal of preventing heart attacks and strokes. The company is focused on developing medical products and services (e.g., diagnostics, clinical visits, and prescriptions) for hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and other chronic conditions that lead to heart disease.

name: Mighty
description: Mighty is an all-in-one platform for legal funders to manage and grow their businesses — ultimately helping plaintiffs get fairer outcomes. It helps lienholders and law firms work better together in order to manage documents, case statuses, and liens.

name: Mighty Buildings
description: Mighty Buildings is using innovative material science, robotics, and automation to make carbon-neutral housing a reality for everyone. The company aims to disrupt the construction industry with 3D printing tech, robotics, and composite materials.

name: Mighty Health
description: Mighty Health develops solutions for cardiovascular care, with in-home treatment powered by digital therapeutics technology. They offer a cardiologist-designed treatment plan, heart health exercises, as well as nutrition plans personalized for users.

name: Mign
description: Mign Orthopedics is a medical supply company revolutionizing the way custom-made body braces are constructed by using digital scanners and 3D printers. Mign’s design engine synthesizes patients’ clinical requirements and body data for a personalized design of back, hand, wrist, and other medical wearables.

name: Mindset Health
description: Mindset is a digital therapeutics business, building a portfolio of apps which leverage hypnotherapy and cognitive behavioral therapy techniques to treat chronic health conditions. Its current portfolio of apps help relieve symptoms of IBS, menopause, and smoking cessation — and future products will address anxiety, depression, sleep disturbance, chronic pain, obesity/eating disorders, and more.

name: Mineral Forecast
description: Mineral Forecast is revolutionizing drilling accuracy for critical metals by leveraging AI and ML to enhance success rates, lower costs, and expedite target definition periods. Its software promises a threefold increase in accuracy compared to industry standards, empowering mid-market miners to thrive amidst rising global demand for essential metals.

name: Minicart
description: Minicart (formerly Neurox) is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that enables makers and small businesses to launch and operate online stores through a conversational, chat-based interface. The company’s platform builds branded storefronts from product photos; manages tasks such as marketing, payments, shipping, and customer support with AI agents; and helps merchants grow their businesses without technical expertise or marketplace listing fees.

name: Minoa
description: Minoa’s pricing and packaging platform enables B2B SaaS companies to customize quotes and streamline their sales process. Minoa’s modular platform will start with an interactive ROI Calculator and Product Catalog and CPQ, and then expand to include pricing insights, revenue analytics and upselling assistance.

name: MINTX
description: MINTX (formerly MintNFT) is a customer engagement platform to help global brands, celebs, creators, and IP build deeper engagement and advocacy with their consumers through a transparent membership model. The Web3-powered membership platform enables members to unlock unparalleled access to exclusive drops, events, benefits, voting rights, rewards, and much more.

name: miRecule
description: MiRecule is a pre-clinical biotechnology company that is focused on the development of microRNA therapeutics to treat cancer and other diseases. They utilize a genomic based drug development platform that is designed to treat drug-resistant cancers.

name: MirrorTab
description: MirrorTab is a cybersecurity company that protects browser-based applications by isolating users from underlying code, eliminating browser attack surfaces. MirrorTab converts web content into secure video pixels, safeguarding against threats like man-in-the-browser attacks, credential theft, and malicious extensions — without compromising users’ experience.

name: Mission Bio
description: Mission Bio developed tools for researchers and clinicians to unlock single-cell biology to enable discovery, development, and delivery of precision medicine. They combined single-cell resolution with comprehensive biology, from genotype to phenotype.

name: Mitra Biotech
description: Farcast Biosciences is an oncology solutions company personalizing cancer treatment with their patented "CANScript" diagnostic platform. Their unique approach to testing has the potential to deliver powerful predictions for personalized therapy selection and enhanced drug development.

name: Moby
description: Moby aims to surpass leading stock research sites like Motley Fool and Seeking Alpha by offering a trusted go-to source for retail investors that provides relevant, up-to-date insights in easily digestible formats. Moby’s platform includes a concise, readable, actionable newsletter; expert investment advice; and a user-friendly app interface.

name: ModBot
description: Modbot is a robot development platform that is designed to implement creative technologies across different industries. It introduces software defined robotics that are powered by flexible modular hardware and rapid integration development software.

name: Modicus Prime
description: Modicus Prime’s self-service AI product suite empowers scientists to perform product quality control of their drugs. The company's computer vision technologies provide intelligent image analysis to monitor biologics and drugs at any scale, helping scientists scale up and manufacture more drugs with greater safety.

name: Moises
description: Moises’ platform offers musicians and producers a suite of AI tools such as audio separation, pitch/beats/chord detection, metronome, tempo changer and mastering. Moises is building a suite of AI-enabled DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) apps. Its first app, available on mobile with a freemium model, uses AI to parse music files into their parts (drums, voice, etc.) to enable editing, modulation, and reproduction.

name: Mojave
description: Mojave is the developer of next-generation air conditioning units that reduce energy draw by 40-60% compared to today’s legacy air conditioners. Key to Mojave’s technology is a third-generation liquid desiccant dehumidification system plus a modern vapor compression system to control temperature.

name: Mona
description: Mona offers an AI-native financial operating system for small and medium-sized businesses, helping them discover, apply for, and secure capital across a fragmented landscape of loans, grants, government programs, and private funding sources. Its AI agents continuously scan funding opportunities, match businesses to the best fits, and automate the application processs—turning a time-consuming, manual workflow into a persistent capital access and management layer.

name: MoneyMade
description: MoneyMade is a discovery and investment platform for alternative asset marketplaces. Their solution gives users access to nearly 200 investment platforms in conventional and alternative asset classes, and connects them with a community of fellow investors.

name: Monterey
description: Monterey AI serves as a “co-pilot” for product development. It replaces documents with workflows that automatically generate product specs — including feature ideas, metrics, designs, and launch plans. Using Monterey, customers pick a product template based on their use case (e.g., “software as a service”) and configure the inputs. The platform then uncovers cross-team conflicts and dependencies while providing a bird’s-eye view of the portfolio to align features.

name: MontyCloud
description: MontyCloud is a multi-cloud management platform intended to simplify management and governance of modern cloud infrastructure, applications, and services. The company’s Intelligent Cloud Operations platform enables small to medium businesses and enterprises to become cloud powerhouses and reduce their total cost of cloud operations by 30% or more

name: Moons
description: Moons is improving access to orthodontics for Mexicans and Colombians with its invisible aligners at affordable prices. Moons uses 3D printing to create high-quality aligners, unique to each customer. With a treatment around half the price of its competitors, Moons is disrupting a market consisting of millions of customers.

name: Mootral
description: Mootral manufactures a natural feed supplement that improves animal health and reduces methane emissions by up to 38%. Their formula is based on a proprietary combination of active compounds from garlic and flavonoids derived from citrus.

name: Motif FoodWorks
description: Motif FoodWorks is an ingredient innovation company dedicated to reshaping the landscape of food through bio-science and technology. They strive to innovate new food ingredients that maintain taste while achieving better nutrition and sustainability.

name: MotorMia
description: MotorMia is launching a marketplace and social media platform that connects collector car enthusiasts who are looking to modify their vehicles with specialty equipment in the aftermarket. Founder and CEO Isaac Buahnik is a collector car enthusiast himself who has previously led sales and business development for several high growth technology startups.

name: Motorq
description: Motorq is a connected car data and analytics company, working with car fleet managers to provide a cloud-based middleware software solution. It allows businesses to leverage data and actionable insights from the emerging set of connected-car systems.

name: Motra
description: Motra (formerly Train Fitness) offers AI-driven workout tracking that uses motion data from your Apple Watch to automatically detect and count reps for over 470 unique strength exercises. Its patented Neural Kinetic Profiling technology logs workouts with no manual input, delivers personalized insights and AI-generated recommendations based on your goals and history, syncs progress with Apple Health, and adapts workouts using performance and recovery data.

name: Movandi
description: Movandi has developed an innovative technology for 5G mm wave deployments that removes many of the barriers to the adoption of 5G. Their chipset, coupled with software, goes into various repeaters/routers and wireless access points in order to boost and redirect network signals. Movandi is currently working with Verizon on their 5G rollout in the US.

name: Movemint
description: Movemint is a next-gen event management platform for endurance sports, streamlining registrations while embedding sponsorships, performance marketing, and participant engagement into the event experience. Movemint offers a modern alternative to legacy platforms like RunSignUp, providing organizers with a data-rich system for payments, race logistics, and seamless participant communication.

name: Movn Health
description: Movn Health (formerly Moving Analytics) is the leading national telehealth provider of virtual cardiac rehab and cardiovascular prevention programs. The company combines evidence-based guidelines, behavioral science, remote monitoring, and telehealth coaching to engage patients to adopt heart-healthy lifestyles.

name: Moxie
description: Moxie is a marketplace for group fitness coaching. Their platform offers 24/7 access to a range of live fitness and yoga classes powered by individual instructors.

name: Moxii
description: MOXii (formerly iiNDYVERSE) is an AI-powered conversational marketing platform that helps brands engage audiences through personalized, always-on interactions across messaging channels and digital touchpoints. The company’s agentic operating system combines strategy, content creation, campaign management, analytics, and automation into a single platform, enabling brands to scale customer engagement, marketing performance, and audience insights more efficiently.

name: Moxy
description: Moxy develops Cerlos, a groundbreaking carbon-neutral building material derived from the natural mineralization of plant fibers, with a focus on licensing its technology to global building material leaders. Addressing an initial $450+ billion market, Cerlos offers a sustainable, cost-effective alternative to plywood, delivering unmatched fire, water, mold, and termite resistance for applications in siding, roofing, decking, and beyond.

name: Mozza Foods
description: Mozza makes cheese from plants that’s indistinguishable from cheese that comes from animals. Their plant-based cheese offers the same characteristics of dairy cheese — such as melt, stretch and taste — to provide consumers an alternative to dairy cheese.

name: MUD / WTR
description: MUD\WTR produces and sells an organic coffee-alternative beverage that offers health and performance benefits. Thei MUD\WTR beverage consists of masala chai, cacao, adaptogenic mushrooms, and other organic ingredients that help support health and well-being. It also provides the same focus and energy boosts as coffee but with much less caffeine (one-seventh).

name: Multiplayer
description: Multiplayer is building a collaborative, visual tool for managing complex and multi-layered system architectures that support a company’s operations. Multiplayer’s solution enables engineering teams to visualize their system architecture comprehensively and in granular detail to better handle backend software services.

name: Multiple
description: Multiple (formerly Parallel) is a developer-centric load test platform designed to help increase uptime and reliability, prevent outages, and improve end-user experience. The platform enables users to test any stack, any scenario, and capture any metric in 10 minutes.

name: MultiScale
description: Multiscale’s software optimizes exploration of materials & manufacturing processes, significantly speeding up product introduction. Its AI platform overcomes the complex fragmentation of data required to produce high-fidelity models by connecting experiments, simulations, and materials domain expertise through data-driven fusion.

name: Multitude Insights
description: Multitude Insights is developing an AI-powered platform to enhance police efficiency and inter-agency collaboration by providing a bulletin format for real-time information sharing and coordination. The platform serves as a document intelligence tool, enabling law enforcement to parse unstructured data, issue alerts, and foster community safety through collaboration across departments and stakeholders.

name: Mureni
description: Mureni is a dental services provider in Latin America. Their offerings include 3D scans and printing technologies to provide customers with an effective treatment without the need to visit an orthodontist.

name: Mycocycle
description: By training mushrooms to eat trash, Mycocycle is sustainably diverting industrial waste such as asphalt shingles and rubber from landfills and turning it into usable, recycled products. Leveraging its proprietary process and trained mycelium mixture, Mycocycle delivers products that can be used in building materials, packaging, and other industrial applications. The result is not only environmental benefits but costs savings for customers of millions of dollars annually in service fees and penalties.

name: Mylance
description: Mylance is a business-in-a-box solution to help skilled freelancers reduce their administrative burden. Mylance’s immersive bootcamp teaches new freelancers key skills, and its monthly subscription service helps manage finances and tax preparation.

name: Mysten Labs
description: Mysten Labs provides developers with a scalable, secure, low-cost, and high-performance Layer 1 blockchain — the foundational “operating system” for Web3. Mysten’s Sui is a permissionless Layer 1 blockchain with high throughput, instant settlement, and rich on-chain assets, providing user-friendly experiences and scalable web 3 solutions.

name: Mythic
description: Mythic is an AI computational platform. Their solution delivers the power of desktop GPUs in a single chip, allowing AI models to be run on edge devices (smart cameras, gaming systems, intelligent appliances, etc.).

name: Mythical Games
description: Mythical is a game-technology platform for the buying, trading, and selling of in-game digital assets. Major games like Fortnite, League of Legends, and Counterstrike can leverage this platform to control in-game customization, earn value from player-made digital assets, and empower player-owned economies that enhance the gaming experience.

name: n3xt
description: n3xt is redefining financial transactions by combining the regulatory rigor of a bank with the speed and efficiency of blockchain technology. Its platform eliminates intermediaries, enabling instant, secure, and programmable payments that cut costs, enhance liquidity, and reduce settlement times from days to seconds.

name: NALA
description: NALA provides reliable, affordable, and efficient international payments, enabling users in the EU, U.K., and U.S. to send money across 249 banks and 26 mobile money services in 11 African markets. The service also provides a leading cross-border payment API to harness exceptional FX capabilities, streamline financial processes, and drive revenue growth.

name: Nanochon
description: Nanochon has created a novel orthopedic implant that encourages the growth of new cartilage, specially designed for patients who want to avoid surgeries like total knee replacements. Its proprietary, 3D-printed nanomaterial implant is minimally invasive and has potential to deliver faster and more successful recoveries while reducing costs to health providers, payers, and patients.

name: Nanopath
description: Targeting women’s health initially and eyeing broader use cases, Nanopath has built a sensor-based tool providing granular and actionable information within a single office visit. Its diagnostic approach harnesses advances in bioengineering and nanotechnology to detect viral, bacterial, and fungal pathogens without the need for nucleic acid amplification testing.

name: Napster
description: Napster uses blockchain and token-based economics to bring the current Web2 music streaming economy into the Web3 era. Napster is leveraging its existing assets — including 15M users in 35 countries and 8M+ artists — to deliver compelling and exclusive benefits for artists, fans, and licensees. Napster earns subscription and ad fees, token sales, and a percentage of NFT sales & resales.

name: Nava Benefits
description: Nava Benefits is a modern benefits brokerage using AI and automation to streamline renewals, lower costs, and provide 24/7 employee support, all without changing existing insurance carriers. It integrates with HR and payroll systems to become the “operating system” for benefits. This helps growing businesses manage healthcare more easily and affordably.

name: NavTrac
description: NavTrac uses advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to track containers at shipping ports and truck yards. Their platform uses computer vision to increase data quality, detect damaged loads, improve inventory management, and eliminate guard costs.

name: Nectero Medical
description: Nectero Medical is innovating a novel treatment for mid-sized abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA), aiming to reduce the roughly 10,000 AAA-related deaths in the U.S. each year. Its system administers a proprietary molecule directly to the aneurysm to strengthen the aortic vessel wall, offering an earlier and less invasive option for the one million+ Americans living with AAA.

name: NeighborSchools
description: NeighborSchools is a childcare and educational program intended to provide parents with experienced, verified educators and childcare providers. It offers individualized care and quality in-home childcare support that's easily accessible to users.

name: Nen Labs
description: Nen Labs (fka Lasso) is engineering the next generation of Web3 and Web2 internet products using AI. The company powers sales with advanced AI agents that find prospects, research companies, and help create personalized outreach — all in one platform.

name: Neo Financial
description: Neo Financial is a leading Canadian neobank leveraging a digital-first approach to disrupt the traditional banking industry dominated by legacy banks. With over 1.3 million customers, Neo offers intuitive financial tools and products — ranging from rewards cards to mortgages — while offering users lower fees and competitive rates.

name: Neptune
description: Neptune (fka Bedelia) is an AI-powered assistant that specializes in prenuptial agreements, offering emotionally intelligent guidance and simplifying complex legal processes. Neptune aims to extend into broader legal–financial planning for couples, such as marriage immigration, and trust & estate planning.

name: Nerd Apply
description: Nerd Apply transforms messy student application files into a unified, de-identified dataset that helps colleges understand where students apply and why they enroll. This admissions data layer gives schools new visibility into recruitment dynamics and powers a scalable platform that grows from counselors to institutions.

name: Nest Genomics
description: Nest Genomics is a Y Combinator W22 company whose tech platform aims to integrate genetic data into patient care. Nest ingests genetic data to generate personalized care plans, which are fed into health systems’ EMRs and existing patient workflows.

name: Nest Health
description: Nest Health offers a comprehensive, value-based healthcare model for parents and children, delivering primary care via house visits and telehealth, along with a suite of medical, behavioral, and social support services. Starting in the greater New Orleans area, Nest Health’s services are accessible at no additional cost to thousands of families covered by Medicaid.

name: Netris
description: Netris provides a cloud networking platform that streamlines AI workloads on private and on-premises clouds by abstracting hardware and networking configuration, offering a user experience similar to public clouds like AWS. Its software automates the configuration of network infrastructure, simplifying on-prem and private cloud management to minimize human error and offer a seamless, cloud-like experience.

name: NeuraLight
description: NeuraLight is on a mission to transform the lives of millions of people impacted by neurological disorders. Its AI-driven platform accelerates and improves drug development, monitoring, and care for patients with disorders such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's Disease, and Multiple Sclerosis. The platform’s proprietary deep-learning algorithms extract and integrate a host of digital eye-movement markers from facial videos taken with a smartphone or webcam.

name: NeuReality
description: NeuReality designs semiconductor chips specifically for the needs of AI computations. It addresses the challenges posed by the growing deployment of AI in the cloud, edge, and fog systems.

name: NeuroFlow
description: NeuroFlow has developed an integrated platform to address behavioral health in all care settings. Their software enables healthcare professionals to deliver collaborative, measurement-based care to patients through personalized tools and resources.

name: Neuron Mobility
description: Neuron Mobility (Formerly Beam Mobility) is an e-scooter and e-bike sharing company that operates in many cities and countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand. The megacities in these regions are ideal for scooters where car-based congestion is intense and the populations dense.

name: Neurophos
description: Neurophos is developing optical AI inference accelerators that use light to perform the core matrix operations behind large language models. The company is targeting two orders of magnitude improvements in speed and power efficiency over today’s GPUs, making AI cheaper and relieving the growing power bottleneck limiting AI datacenter growth.

name: NeuSpera Medical
description: Neuspera is a clinical-stage bioelectronic medicine (electroceuticals) company developing miniature implantable devices that can be used to treat chronic and debilitating diseases. They deliver targeted, bioelectronic medicine for various conditions.

name: New Aera
description: New Aera is a medical device company that manufactures innovative products for people suffering from acute respiratory conditions. They offer respiratory therapy that increases exercise endurance, reduces breathlessness, and enables greater activity.

name: New Culture
description: New Culture is a food and beverage company that focuses on revolutionizing how cheese is made. They sustainably produce dairy proteins, known as casein proteins, in the lab.

name: New Era ADR
description: New Era ADR has developed a fully virtual arbitration and mediation platform. Their platform enables businesses and individuals to quickly and efficiently resolve disputes with the assistance of an experienced neutral professional.

name: NewFound
description: Newfound (formerly Houwzer) is a next-generation provider of residential real estate brokerage and associated services. Houwzer changed its name to Newfound when it completed a merger with a peer company, Trelora.

name: NewLeaf Symbiotics
description: NewLeaf is an agricultural biotechnology company that is aimed at developing sustainable agriculture. They develop and research Pink Pigmented Facultative Methylotrophs (PPFMs), which are symbiotic bacteria aiding in plant germination and crop yield.

name: Newmetrix
description: Smartvid.io is an AI-based risk identification platform for construction sites. Their Safety Suite enables users to observe, monitor, and predict jobsite risks in areas of project safety, productivity, and quality.

name: NewTrul
description: newtrul provides freight carriers with a search engine to easily search, find, and book their customers’ freight. Their platform integrates with existing shipping and brokerage technology, allowing carriers to seamlessly arrange shipments.

name: Nexa AI
description: Nexa AI's on-device technology delivers faster, more energy-efficient processing for edge devices, ensuring both privacy and accuracy while managing data flow between networks. Nexa’s efficient AI models run directly on devices, handling tasks like language processing and image recognition without the cloud to ensure faster performance, better privacy, and lower energy use.

name: Next Droid
description: NextDroid is an intelligent machine company. Their NxD-Sled is a ‘bolt-on’ intelligent agent (comprised of hardware and software) that autonomously assesses faults of autonomous driving features.

name: Nextiles
description: Nextiles blends traditional sewing techniques with innovative circuit boards. By stitching sensors within fabrics such as everyday sportswear, it can capture a broad new range of biometric and biomechanics data. Nextiles’ patented sewing technology applies circuitry directly into fabric with basic threads such as cotton, polyester, spandex, and nylon. It thereby creates a cohesive hardware / software solution to transform sensor data into actionable insights that clients can use to better train and quantify human performance.

name: Niche
description: Niche is a mobile-first, consumer infrastructure layer for DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations). Its fully native blockchain protocol enables users to build, organize, and maintain their communities. The Niche app pairs users’ interests with a variety of decentralized communities built around favorite Web3 artists, operators, and thinkers. Niche takes care of all the transactions and tokenomics, while users can conduct private discussions or enter more curated spaces for proposals or the NFTs they collectively own.

name: Nimble Collective
description: Nimble Collective was a cloud-based animation platform that contained full end-to-end production capabilities. Its goal was to simplify and improve the often archaic, complex, and costly process of creating animation to change the way animation works.

name: Nimble Science
description: Nimble Science is a medical device company developing a small ingestible capsule used for in-vivo sampling of small intestine fluid, leading to advances in personalized medicine and nutrition. The capsule can provide a novel solution for basic research of the gut microbiota, disease etiology, therapeutic intervention, oral drug development, and new biomarker identification.

name: Niobium Microsystems
description: Niobium develops specialized semiconductors that enable enterprises to run AI workloads on sensitive data 2,500–10,000x faster while keeping it fully encrypted. Its hardware accelerates Fully Homomorphic Encryption, allowing industries like defense, healthcare, and finance to process data securely without violating privacy laws such as HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA.

name: Nirvana Health
description: Nirvana Health’s platform aims to simplify healthcare payments in the therapy space while connecting mental health professionals with new clients. The company aims to maximize therapists’ focus on patients by relieving providers of the necessary filing, managing, and follow-up of insurance claims.

name: Nitricity
description: Nitricity is an energy company that is developing a system to produce carbon-free fertilizer. Its environmentally friendly process uses only air, water, and renewable electricity.

name: Noble.AI
description: Noble.AI combines fusion physics and deep learning to accelerate discovery in enterprise research and development. The platform uses the core physics inherent in a particular use case —at molecular, quantum, or real-world scales — to give customers unparalleled speed (more than 100x) and accuracy for their product simulations

name: NoCodeOps
description: NoCodeOps (formerly Switchboard) is an error-monitoring and incident-response platform for the two most widely adopted no-code integration tools: Zapier and Make (formerly Integromat). When an error occurs in Zapier or Make, the platform sends alerts to the right people, in the right channels, via the right escalation paths. Armed with alerts, documentation, ownership, and accountability, non-technical users can resolve issues with the speed and accuracy of their technical counterparts.

name: Noda AI
description: Noda Intelligence builds the orchestration layer for autonomous warfare, providing a battle management AI that enables unmanned systems to coordinate across air, maritime, and ground domains. Its vendor-agnostic software acts as a real-time decision engine, allowing heterogeneous robotic fleets to adapt and maintain mission continuity in contested, communications-degraded environments.

name: NoMad Data
description: NoMad Data is the provider of a multi-sided data management platform. Their solution connects users with data providers and automates data search by learning from previous user queries.

name: NomNomNow
description: Nom Nom delivers premium, fresh, custom-made meals for dogs and cats directly to the doorstep of subscribers. They use made-to-order, personalized, and healthy meals for customers who want to give their pets the freshest and most nutritious food.

name: Northwood Space
description: Northwood builds and operates secure ground station infrastructure that allows government and defense satellite missions to move data to and from space faster and at lower cost. Its modular, multi-tenant network removes a major bottleneck in space operations by deploying classified-ready infrastructure in weeks, not years.

name: Notable Labs
description: Notable Labs is a drug development platform that is built to rapidly identify and advance new cancer therapeutics at a fraction of traditional costs. They enhance clinical trials with their proprietary predictive power, enabling better cancer treatments.

name: Notifi
description: Notifi simplifies communication across all Web3 messaging channels, empowering developers to better engage with their users via multichannel communications. The Notifi platform is designed with simple APIs for easy integration. It also features customizable, advanced features for dApps and Web3 applications on all blockchain platforms.

name: Novella
description: Novella builds an AI-native wholesale brokerage that modernizes the distribution layer of the Excess & Surplus insurance market, using AI agents to automate risk review, carrier matching, and quote processing for complex commercial accounts. Its platform compresses quote delivery from weeks to under 24 hours while operating invisibly within existing broker workflows, eliminating the need for industry participants to change how they work.

name: Nox Metals
description: Nox Metals operates an AI-driven factory that transforms raw metal into ready-to-use components for defense, aerospace, and advanced manufacturing customers including Anduril and SpaceX. Its proprietary optimization engine and autonomous cutting systems compress traditional multi-week processes into days while achieving superior material utilization and dramatically reduced lead times.

name: NPM
description: Npm hosted the world’s largest JavaScript software registry. More than 150,000 companies relied on npm’s products and services to reduce developer friction and build amazing things.

name: Nuanced
description: Nuanced helps preserve the integrity and authenticity of online services by verifying whether images are authentic or machine-generated. Its solution provides a privacy-first easy-to-use API integration into the workflows of financial services (to prevent fraud), social media (to combat deep fakes), dating applications (to mitigate "catfishing" and other scams), as well as a host of other applications where the ever-increasing sophistication of Generative AI poses a threat.

name: NuCurrent
description: NuCurrent is a developer of high-efficiency antennas for wireless power applications. They offer development platforms for new products, customization for existing products, and optimize their technology for power systems, modules, software, & more.

name: Numerade
description: Numerade is a fully free online education platform that seeks to democratize access to extraordinary educators and content. Their platform enables teachers to easily create videos on any topic, create a playlist from the more than 250,000 existing lesson videos, track student engagement, and create weekly class recaps.

name: Nuon
description: Nuon provides a platform for software vendors to run their apps in their customers’ cloud accounts, creating greater flexibility, control, and opportunity. Via the platform, software vendors can provide all the benefits of SaaS while their customers get to control their own data.

name: Nurx
description: Nurx is a telemedicine prescription and delivery platform granting users the ability to request and receive medications. Users can have medications delivered to their door without visiting medical professionals, making healthcare easy and accessible.

name: Oak9
description: Oak9 is a cybersecurity platform providing seamless cloud infrastructure security for developers. Oak9 allows DevOps teams to catch security issues before deployment of applications, cutting code review time by 50%. It also provides continuous monitoring of large cloud workloads.

name: Obligo
description: Obligo has developed a platform that relieves both landlords and renters of the security deposit burden, enabling renters to pay only if their landlord has a claim. Their platform replaces security deposits while keeping landlords secure and renters accountable. A qualified renter can create a Billing Authorization, which gives Obligo a secure, limited connection to their bank account. The tenant keeps their deposit funds, and their landlord can file a claim to charge the tenant up to the deposit amount when warranted.

name: Observe
description: Observe provides a cloud platform that swiftly pinpoints technical issues in applications used by businesses, speeding up incident resolution and slashing cloud expenses. Once Observe detects a technical issue, it offers in-depth diagnostics and prioritization tools, aiding engineers in rapid root cause analysis and focused remediation efforts.

name: Obvious
