It uses its proprietary drug and target discovery platform, ResCu, to identify resistance target networks and resistance biomarkers that aid pharma companies in developing cancer treatments.

name: Resolve
description: Resolve offers an online point of sale credit API for B2B payment terms. They allow businesses to increase their customers’ buying power via credit lines and Net Payment Terms, with the ultimate goal of increasing their total purchases and net profits.

name: Respiratory Motion
description: Respiratory Motion’s ExSpiron device monitors breathing in non-intubated patients — like an EKG for lungs. Non-invasive ventilation monitoring and analysis provide early detection of respiratory problems via a device that is comfortable for patients and connects to existing hospital systems.

name: Restore The Day
description: Restore the Day (formerly LYLA, formerly Errand Solutions) is a dedicated support system for employees designed to reduce stress by offering concierge support to get real-life tasks done. Its app offers employees support in their day-to-day lives while increasing workplace productivity and reducing turnover.

name: Revel
description: Revel is a Web3 personal media collecting-and-trading platform where communities are formed around shared assets and people. Revel’s social NFT marketplace leverages tokenomics to reward creators and followers, alike.

name: Revelio Labs
description: Revelio Labs has created the world’s first universal HR database, based on hundreds of millions of public employment records. It delivers valuable workforce analytics to customers that include investors, corporate strategists, HR teams, academics, and governments.

name: RevivBio
description: RevivBio uses advanced AI and streamlined bioengineering to create affordable, eco-friendly solutions safeguarding plants and animals against resistant pests and pathogens. Its robotic bio-foundry develops billions of bioactive biomolecule variants, like its broad-spectrum biofungicide designed to tackle the $400B crop loss from fungal pathogens

name: Revmo
description: Revmo is an enterprise platform that facilitates professional introductions and connections. Their AI platform searches across CRM systems, contact lists, social and professional input sources to make meaningful connections through a secure system that keeps users’ information and networks private.

name: RevUp
description: Numero (formerly RevUp Software) develops tools that help academic institutions, non-profits, and political organizations leverage data analytics and social media. This allows these organizations to exceed their fundraising goals while avoiding spam and broken events.

name: RGo Robotics
description: RGo Robotics is pioneering an artificial perception technology that makes wheeled robots truly smart. Its full-stack solution enables mobile robots to understand complex surroundings and operate autonomously. By providing an affordable, outsourced solution to visual perception, RGo allows a wide range (e.g. logistics, delivery, service, floor care, etc.) of robotics segments and manufacturers to compete and evolve.

name: Rhone
description: Rhone designs and develops high-performance activewear. They engineer clothing for men and women in technical fabrics and styles that are also office-appropriate, letting them transition smoothly from work to workout.

name: Ridepanda
description: Ridepanda is a one-stop micromobility marketplace. Their platform offers the best e-bikes, e-scooters, and e-mopeds with maintenance support and theft protection.

name: Rigetti
description: Rigetti is a full-stack quantum computing startup. They are focused on designing and manufacturing superconducting quantum integrated circuits and building software to enable quantum computing, and integrating their systems into a cloud infrastructure.

name: Rime
description: Rime’s text-to-speech (TTS) platform lets users choose from hundreds of unique voices covering a range of demographic categories, with tools to manipulate nuanced details such as punctuation, pauses, and pronunciations. Designed particularly for large contact centers, the platform gives enterprise customers much faster than real-time generation, with sub-300 millisecond response times.

name: Rinse
description: Rinse is a delivery service for laundry and dry cleaning. Users schedule for pickup ahead of time via text, website, or app, select what service they need, and have their clothes cleaned and delivered within days. A subscription service is available.

name: RIOS
description: RIOS has developed a technology platform intended to serve tactile sensors and AI for robots. They have significantly improved the software and hardware of robotic arms, allowing them to do a variety of complex physical tasks not previously achievable.

name: Ripple Match
description: RippleMatch is a SaaS recruitment platform designed to help early career candidates such as college students find jobs and internships. The company’s software automates entry-level recruiting and career coaching to make the process easier and more efficient for both employers and candidates.

name: Rise Egypt
description: Rise Egypt is building Egypt’s first private, fully digital bank to bring simple mobile banking to the 85% of adults who are unbanked. With first-mover regulatory momentum and an experienced team, Rise aims to scale from payments and deposits into credit, insurance, and savings to become the region’s breakout fintech.

name: Rise Gardens
description: Rise Gardens is a smart indoor hydroponic gardening system. Their app-connected modular gardens come in multiple sizes and require minimal care to produce professional-grade produce from the seeds the company sells.

name: Risilience
description: Risilience develops pioneering risk-management software that enables companies to gain valuable insights into their risk exposure. The Risilience platform provides detailed, quantified results to support strategic decision-making and business planning while balancing investment requirements driven by future scenarios.

name: Risotto
description: Risotto is an AI help desk for IT teams with cross-department functionality, IAM automations, Slack ticketing, and automatic knowledge management. Positioning itself as the AI-native system of record for enterprise operations, Risotto embeds across daily workflows to drive end-to-end automation and measurable efficiency gains.

name: Riven Systems
description: Riven Systems offers an AI-driven "Separation Intelligence" platform that enables Western miners, refiners, and defense customers to process rare earth elements domestically, breaking their dependence on Chinese separation infrastructure. Its system combines a computational chemistry engine, a high-throughput self-driving laboratory, and modular processing nodes that together drastically reduce development time and the cost and physical footprint of rare earth separation.

name: Rize
description: Rize enables fintechs, financial institutions and brands to build across multiple account types with one API. Their service allows banks to securely and compliantly build user experiences that match their customers’ needs.

name: Robyn
description: Robyn is a maternal wellness platform that’s reimagining the journey of pregnancy for expectant mothers and families. It connects aspiring, expecting and new parents with specialists and a multitude of services, from accupuncture and chiropractic to lactation consulting and nutrition.

name: RocketCart
description: RocketCart is developing an online, ethnic grocery delivery platform. They’re currently operating in stealth mode, but the founders — who also started three well-known deacorn and unicorn e-commerce companies — expect to go live in the near future.

name: Rodeo
description: Rodeo is building Calendly for social planning among friends, turning an idea (e.g., “Dinner next week somewhere lively in West Village”) into a structured, shareable invite. With Rodeo, users can collaborate without an app or account, commenting on others’ suggestions — all while seamlessly integrating plans with personal calendars.

name: Rollick
description: Rollick is the developer of a suite of sales and marketing software for the outdoor recreation industry. Its integrated online platform offers a transparent and connected retail experience for outdoor recreation products, such as RVs, boats, motorcycles, snowmobiles, and ATVs.

name: Rollup
description: Rollup is developer of a software platform to help engineering teams build the next generation of complex hardware and systems. Rollup integrates with existing tools to easily weave engineering analysis, designs, and documentation, thus enabling teams to avoid specially trained engineers and expensive tools and software.

name: Roofer
description: Roofer is a digital national roofing contractor platform using drones and AI to provide roofing on-demand. The gathered AI / drone data is used to reduce costs of completing a home or commercial roof inspection and avoid risk of future property damage.

name: Rook
description: ROOK is a B2B SaaS company that accesses health data across the fragmented wearables market so that businesses can more effectively obtain valuable user insights. ROOK’s API integrates and embeds health metrics from wearables into existing apps and software in order to generate data-driven analysis and insights for its customers.

name: Rosie
description: Rosie (fka Rowsie) is an AI assistant designed to streamline business analysis in Excel by comprehensively automating modeling and business logic. It integrates directly into Excel as a plug-in, offering features such as debugging formulas, understanding sheets, constructing workflows, and an intuitive chat function to automate bespoke workflows.

name: Rosy Soil
description: Rosy Soil makes biochar-based potting soils that replace peat and are carbon-negative, offering high performance with a much smaller footprint. Proven in 1,000+ plant trials, its mixes grow stronger roots and richer microbes while using less water — giving consumers and growers a better, sustainable alternative.

name: Row64
description: Row64 delivers real-time analytics at massive scale with a GPU-powered dashboard that can process over a billion records — compared to legacy tools like Power BI and Tableau, which struggle to scale beyond 1 million. By combining backend data engineering with intuitive front-end visualization, it offers a faster, more interactive, and cost-effective alternative for enterprise analytics.

name: Rownd
description: Rownd’s B2B SaaS privacy platform helps companies register and retain more users through frictionless sign-ins across all of their websites or apps, with one simple code snippet. Its passwordless authentication helps companies increase user sign-ups by eliminating the traditional registration / sign-up / sign-in page and converting 25% more visitors into account holders.

name: Rubedo Life Sciences
description: Rubedo Life Sciences uses a proprietary drug discovery platform to develop therapies targeting cells that drive age-related diseases like cancer, heart disease, diabetes, and dementia. The platform develops molecules that target and replace harmful senescent cells (aging cells that have stopped dividing but have not died), with a focus on both therapeutic and cosmetic applications.

name: RubiconMD
description: RubiconMD is an innovative eConsult service that connects Primary Care Physicians to same-day insights from a network of Specialists across the country. They enable primary care clinicians to effectively discuss their eConsults with top specialists.

name: Ruby Bio
description: Ruby Bio manufactures complex molecules into biodegradable and non-toxic chemicals through biotechnology. Ruby’s proprietary biosynthesis platform converts low-cost sugar into high-value products for sustainable personal care, home care, food, and beverage items.

name: Runwise
description: Runwise is a customer-focused, climate-tech startup that controls and runs key energy systems (heating, water, etc.) in 3500+ buildings throughout the U.S. Runwise’s unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output.

name: Rwazi
description: Rwazi’s rich, reliable market data is sought by Global 1000 companies to help expand their businesses in Africa’s fast-growing consumer market. Rwazi’s platform includes an on-the-ground network of 20,000 consumers in 40+ countries and answers critical questions such as who is buying what, for how much, from where, when, and why.

name: Rylo
description: Rylo is a consumer electronics company that developed a photography app and a stabilized, high-resolution, 360-degree camera for active use. They focus on helping users capture and share shake-free, horizon-leveled, cinematic videos.

name: Rypplzz
description: Rypplzz has developed a patented software platform that uses geospatial mapping technology to enable users to place and track digital assets in 3D space for industries like entertainment, advertising, and venue management. Its Interlife platform unlocks new AR, VR, and MR applications, offering both operational efficiencies and new revenue opportunities through interactive ads and navigation tools.

name: Ryvn
description: Ryvn simplifies software deployment for SaaS vendors, enabling secure, seamless application management across customer clouds and on-premises environments. With multi-cloud support, real-time monitoring, and centralized control, it reduces deployment costs while ensuring data security and operational efficiency.

name: Ryze
description: Ryze is a crypto neobank that makes the process of investing in Bitcoin easier, enabling users to buy, sell, save, and earn The company helps users operate between Bitcoin and fiat through a proprietary savings platform, debit card, and other financial services.

name: SafeBase
description: SafeBase helps B2B SaaS companies close enterprise deals faster by streamlining the security assessment process. Security and sales teams can share and automate access to security, compliance, and privacy information so organizations can avoid redundant questionnaires, build customer trust, and more quickly close deals.

name: Sage
description: Sage offers an AI-powered operating system that transforms how senior care is delivered across living facilities, skilled nursing homes, and the home environment. Its platform combines proprietary edge devices with workflow software to enable real-time care orchestration, turning reactive, fragmented care into continuous, data-driven delivery.

name: Sagence AI
description: Sagence AI (fka Analog Inference) designs energy-efficient analog chips and systems for running AI models, addressing the growing energy demands of traditional GPUs in data centers. By leveraging in-memory computing and innovative multi-level memory technology, Sagence achieves 100x power savings, enabling sustainable, high-performance AI inference for real-world applications.

name: Sahara AI
description: Sahara AI (fka Quest Labs) is pioneering a decentralized AI network that empowers individuals and businesses to freely and securely deploy autonomous, personalized AI. Sahara AI uses the privacy, security, and incentive mechanisms of Web3 combined with its proprietary technological framework to offer a high-performance, privacy-first network with fair rewards based on contributions and provenance.

name: Sail Internet
description: Sail Internet is an ISP that provides fiber-based high-speed internet service in attractive standalone plans. The company serves residential and commercial customers in several California markets.

name: Salido
description: Salido is a B2B SaaS company providing a point-of-sale platform for the restaurant and hospitality industry. The company provides restaurant operators with CRM, reporting, labor management, and kitchen supply management tools.

name: Salus
description: Salus is an underwriting platform that enables lenders to identify creditworthy borrowers that may be overlooked by traditional underwriting. The Salus platform ingests and analyzes raw data from various sources, scoring it via proprietary models to return a faster and more fair and accurate risk score than traditional methods.

name: Salvo Health
description: Salvo Health enables local providers to provide wraparound care for chronic GI and metabolic liver conditions in a hybrid patient-centered approach accessible on mobile devices. Salvo’s integrated backend and frontend platforms benefit patients and GI practices, generating new revenue streams, enhancing outcomes, revealing insights, and reducing administrative burdens.

name: Samaya
description: Samaya AI offers an expert intelligence platform for financial services, using specialized AI agents to power high-stakes workflows like investment research and client advisory. Designed for precision, traceability, and real-world reasoning, Samaya aims to become the foundational intelligence layer for global capital markets.

name: Sami
description: Sami is a Brazil-based, technology-driven health insurance provider that’s transforming the world’s second-largest private healthcare market. Performing the majority of initial patient interactions in a virtual setting, Sami has implemented a primary-care gatekeeper system and emphasizes long-term preventative care.

name: Sana.IO
description: Sana offers a mask-and-headphones device that uses audio visual stimulation to promote relaxation. App-controlled sessions use light and sound to guide users into a meditative state to clear a busy mind and improve sleep management.

name: Sapho
description: Sapho is an enterprise workforce portal designed for employee communication. It contains micro-applications that consolidate tasks and tools in simple workfeeds, improving employee productivity by replacing complicated systems with modern workflows.

name: Satellite Bio
description: Satellite Bio is a life science company engineering cell therapies to eradicate complex disease. Through minimally invasive surgery, bioengineered sacks called “Satellites” are implanted as living therapeutic solutions for serious diseases. The proprietary technology provides a transformative option for patients with serious disease.

name: Savvy
description: Savvy streamlines the process for getting health benefits for a startup or small business. Their platform allows small businesses to offer health insurance to their employees at a fixed cost they choose.

name: Savvy Wealth
description: Savvy Wealth is a digital-first platform that modernizes human financial advice, enabling financial advisors to leverage integrated technology for enhanced growth. Advisors using Savvy's proprietary technology can scale revenue faster and focus more on client growth through improved software and sales and marketing automation.

name: Sawmills
description: Sawmills offers an AI-powered solution that enriches and transforms data before it is delivered from storage, improving data quality and reducing costs. Its Machine Data Management Platform sits between data storage and observability platforms, enhancing data governance and observability while analyzing and correcting data errors in real time.

name: ScanTrust
description: ScanTrust develops a non-forgeable digital fingerprint that can identify and locate products anywhere in the supply chain with a smartphone. Brands benefit from their anti-counterfeiting, supply chain traceability, and consumer engagement solutions.

name: Schemata
description: Schemata (fka Traverse3D) uses AI-powered 3D simulation technology to create immersive, photorealistic training environments in days instead of months. Its platform enhances virtual training across defense, energy, and infrastructure sectors, reducing costs while improving operational efficiency and engagement.

name: SCiFi Foods
description: SciFi Foods is on a mission to build a sustainable future through development of the next generation of meat alternatives It combines cultivated fat and muscle cells with plant-based meat to develop an option that tastes more like meat than other plant-based competitors.

name: SCIO
description: Consumer Physics has developed SCiO, the first sensor that hovers over and determines the quality and content of foods and substances on iPhones. It uses a micro-spectrometer, absorbing light reflected off an object to determine the object’s chemical makeup.

name: Scipher Medicine Corp
description: Scipher is a precision immunology company commercializing blood tests to detect whether a medication will be effective in a particular patient. They use a simple blood test to interpret a patient’s RNA data and determine which drugs will work best.

name: ScopeAI
description: ScopeAI uses natural language processing to connect trends from customer conversations to business metrics. They can then be used to make strategic product and operational decisions, centralizing product feedback and exploring customer conversations.

name: Scorenomics
description: Scorenomics (formerly Revolution Credit) is a behavioral analytics and consumer engagement platform. The company helps financial institutions engage their customers, improving revenues and profits.

name: Scratch Financial
description: Scratch Financial is a fintech that provides financing services across dental, optometry, and other healthcare verticals, including veterinary care. The app makes it easy to apply for a payment plan, select the appropriate financing, and pay bills.

name: Scription
description: Scription replaces the pay-per-repair model with fixed-fee subscription maintenance plans for commercial and industrial equipment, bundling preventive and reactive services to maximize uptime and reduce costs. Leveraging AI and historical data, Scription’s platform ensures 3x less downtime, predictable expenses, extended equipment life, and seamless integration with existing systems.

name: Scythe Robotics
description: Scythe Robotics builds autonomous robotic solutions for the commercial landscaping industry. It offers electric, fully autonomous mowers using a Robots-as-a-Service busness model.

name: Seaspire Skincare
description: Seaspire is launching a line of organic, natural skincare products using their novel, curated Xanthochrome ingredient. Inspired by a unique molecule produced by crustaceans, Xanthochrome’s proprietary formulations provide superior protection from UV rays and also function as a high-performance antioxidant.

name: Secure
description: Secure has developed a fintech platform that helps employees build up emergency savings with contributions from their employers. Their SecureSave emergency savings program makes it easy and affordable for employers to offer employees the ability to set up savings accounts to navigate unexpected life events. By adding this service to their benefits package, employers can help their employees achieve financial wellness and avoid financial stress, which has knock-on effects for employers.

name: Secure3
description: Secure3 provides an alternative to the existing centralized model in order to make web3.0 security audits more scalable and transparent. The company’s platform consists of 1) a marketplace to connect customers with auditors; 2) a streamlined, semi-automatic auditing SaaS; and 3) a DAO to establish data records, audit SOP, and certify auditors.

name: SecureFrame
description: Secureframe is building a compliance and security platform that automates the compliance certification process end to end for software companies — making it much less costly and time consuming. Secureframe’s platform streamlines the process for SOC 2, ISO 27001 (international SOC 2), and HIPAA certification. This helps boost revenue for fast-growing SaaS startups looking to sell software to large customers.

name: Securrency
description: Securrency is a financial trading platform that’s intended to facilitate the trading of all illiquid asset classes. They create interoperability among blockchains and legacy systems along with associated Distributed Investment Banking Services (DIBS).

name: Seed
description: Seed develops technologies that improve microbiome health. Their team, including scientists, doctors, innovators, and entrepreneurs, has developed products including a daily Synbiotic which is used for systemic benefits beyond digestive health.

name: SendaRide
description: SendaRide is a mobile application and cloud-based ridesharing platform providing transportation services for non-emergency medical patients and children. Users can log into a personalized web portal and schedule patients’ transportation in real time.

name: SendOwl
description: SendOwl’s ecommerce platform enables creators and businesses to sell and deliver digital goods such as e-books, podcasts, online courses, memberships, coaching services, live remote events, and more. Customers can use their existing website or blog via SendOwl’s payment links, integrations with Stripe and Shopify, or by using SendOwl’s API.

name: Senra Systems
description: Senra Systems develops software-integrated wire harness manufacturing systems that serve aerospace, defense, and electrified vehicle markets with dramatically improved speed, quality, and reliability compared to legacy suppliers. Its proprietary Amp platform digitalizes every stage of the harness lifecycle, enabling four-week technician training cycles and sub-1% defect rates while building toward 80% factory automation.

name: Sense Photonics
description: Sense Photonics is a lidar (light detection and ranging) company utilizing a proprietary photographic 3D mapping technology. This technology is more accurate and significantly cheaper than the scanning technologies currently available in the market.

name: Sentenai
description: Sentenai is a data cloud infrastructure that delivers automated data engineering for data science and machine learning applications. It enables agile decision-making by quantifying risks, uncovering anomalies, and identifying any threats within data.

name: Sepion Technologies
description: Sepion Technologies combines the latest in nanoscience, polymer chemistry, and cell engineering to deliver lithium-metal batteries with performance and economic benefits compared to incumbent lithium-ion technology. Sepion delivers membranes that enable manufacturers to produce batteries with increased energy density at a lower cost.

name: Sequel
description: Sequel is an integrated SaaS platform that enables organizations to host their internal and external audiences natively within their own websites. Its flawless streaming technology empowers brands of all sizes to create meaningful live event series, conferences, community platforms, and employee engagement tools.

name: Serif
description: Serif is a global members club for LGBTQ+ leaders and creators with an NFT membership. Membership includes rights to purchase membership to its flagship physical location; access to the Serif network; access to IRL and digital events; partnership perks; and a private Discord.

name: Sesame
description: Sesame is a direct-pay healthcare marketplace that makes it easier and more affordable for American patients to get access to high-quality healthcare. They put patients first, providing upfront affordable pricing for doctors, dentists, and specialists.

name: Seventh Ave
description: Seventh Ave is a developer of an interactive platform that connects and mobilizes Black communities through shared experiences and transformative conversations. The platform allows small businesses and creators to sell products and NFTs and will allow digital goods, digital services, and physical products to be sold throughout the community.

name: Shakudo
description: Shakudo's (Formally DevSentient) powerful platform accelerates and empowers AI teams by providing a streamlined workflow for AI and data-intensive products from ideation to production. Their Hyperplane platform helps AI scientists design, develop, deploy, and maintain their own work in production. Top features include easy scaling, fast deployment, powerful debugging, and integration with popular tools.

name: ShapeScale
description: ShapeScale is a personal scanner that digitizes and measures your body in photorealistic 3D, transforming the way we track health by visualizing changes in fat and muscle. Combining computer vision and deep learning, ShapeScale provides fast, visual, and gamified feedback to keep users motivated and informed about their fitness progress.

name: Shift
description: Shift is an online auto marketplace that facilitates the buying and selling of used cars. Users can shop for the best deals online, test drive cars at home or at a Shift location, and buy, finance, or trade in to purchase the used car of their choice.

name: SHINE Technologies
description: SHINE Technologies (formerly SHINE Medical) deploys its safe, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly fusion technology to develop medical isotopes for heart disease and cancer treatment. In the future, SHINE will apply its technology to recycle nuclear waste on the way to achieving its ultimate goal: producing fusion energy.

name: Shoulder Innovations
description: Shoulder Innovations offers a proven, breakthrough product portfolio for shoulder implant surgeries. Their Total Shoulder Replacement System is informed by more than ten years of clinical studies and provides excellent implant stability, addressing the leading cause of revision surgery.

name: Showrunnr
description: Showrunnr is a production planning and management platform that improves media and entertainment industries’ currently fragmented supply chains and accelerates deals flows. Content creators are able to budget, plan, and track their projects by accessing freelance crews, equipment, and services.

name: Sidecar Interactive
description: Sidecar helps retailers deliver powerful performance marketing campaigns to consumers on the channels they use most. They combine advanced artificial intelligence and retail-focused datasets for holistic cross-channel marketing programs.

name: SiFly
description: SiFly is an aerial robotics company that delivers helicopter-like endurance and range at a fraction of traditional aviation costs, serving public safety agencies, utilities, and enterprise operators that need persistent, affordable eyes in the sky. Its patented rotorcraft architecture enables hours of continuous flight on a single charge, unlocking long-duration missions that conventional short-range drones and costly crewed aircraft cannot practically serve.

name: Sighten
description: Sighten is a solar industry software solution designed for solar installers, channel managers, and financiers. They support the entire sales workflow and offer such key features as contracts, intuitive solar system designs, lead management, and pipelines.

name: Signoz
description: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform that helps developers monitor applications and troubleshoot problems in their deployed applications. SigNoz is building its platform on top of another open-source project, OpenTelemetry, to provide an alternative for companies that can't use SaaS products due to security and privacy concerns.

name: Silver Tree
description: Silvertree Labs is a consumer business that enables America’s growing population of 55 million seniors to age in-place with confidence. The company’s first product is a wrist-wearable connected device designed to promote independent living. Features include fall detection, real-time location, an SOS button, and a 30-day battery life.

name: Simple Machines
description: SimpleMachines is developing the world’s first easily programmable high-performance silicon chip. Their design offers full customization, patented architecture, and increased security.

name: SimpliSafe
description: SimpliSafe develops do-it-yourself home security products designed to help people live safely without introducing complexity, hassle, or annoyance into their lives. They offer protection against intruders, water damage, medical emergencies, and more.

name: Singuli
description: Singuli is creating a decision platform, beginning with inventory forecasting, to optimize modern commerce.

name: Sinn Studio
description: Sinn Studio is a virtual reality gaming studio utilizing proprietary game development software and AI tools to deliver innovative and immersive extended reality (XR) combat games. Its flagship title, Swordsman VR, is a best-selling virtual reality game that has garnered significant acclaim and users.

name: SiPhox
description: SiPhox makes an at-home blood-testing device to track biomarkers used to diagnose and manage chronic diseases and for general health and wellness monitoring. Using silicon photonics and microfluidics, SiPhox has miniaturized lab equipment to a handheld format that performs a subset of blood tests in just 5 minutes.

name: SIQ Basketball
description: SIQ Basketball integrates advanced sensor technology into basketballs to provide detailed shooting analytics, revolutionizing training with immediate feedback for improvement. The SIQ Smart Basketball uses patented ML technology, paired with a smartphone, with the potential to be applied to other popular sports such as soccer, volleyball, and football.

name: Siris Medical
description: Siris Medical is a decision-support system for radiation oncology therapy. The platform uses AI to leverage patient data and improve radiation treatment planning.

name: Sitch
description: Sitch is redefining online dating with an AI matchmaker powered by LLMs and trained on real-life introductions to deliver curated, chat-based matchmaking It combines the high-touch feel of human matchmaking with the scale of AI, replacing subscriptions with pay-per-introduction pricing for real, intentional connections.

name: Sizzle
description: Sizzle’s Deep AI Engine analyzes video, audio, and chat of live streams across sports or gaming broadcasts to create hyper-personalized highlights for its viewers. Sizzle works with sports and esports leagues and broadcasters to deliver highlights from their full-length streams on YouTube, Twitch, or any video backend. Its AI personalization technology provides each fan with the dynamic, funny, and exciting moments they want to see.

name: Skill-Lync
description: Skill-Lync is a rapidly growing edtech company that provides a project-based learning curriculum for mechanical, electrical, civil, and computer engineers to become more employable. Each course is designed and overseen by an industry expert with at least 15 years of experience. Students graduate with a portfolio of projects to share with potential employers, plus guidance on preparing their portfolios, resumes, interview skills, and prospective employer pipeline.

name: Skip Scooters
description: Skip is a ridesharing company focused on electric scooters. The company is making smarter scooters with novel battery technology and a sleeker design for better user experience.

name: Skyline Robotics
description: Skyline Robotics develops automated solutions for previously costly, dangerous maintenance tasks on high-rise building exteriors. It operates a Robotics-as-a-Service revenue model by selling to building manufacturers and maintenance companies. Skyline’s flagship product, Ozmo, automates skyscraper window cleaning using robotics, AI, and computer vision. Cleaning 3x faster than human counterparts,Ozmo can be implemented into existing building maintenance units without adding infrastructure.

name: Skysafe
description: SkySafe is the developer of a security system designed to protect airspace from drone attacks or surveillance. Using advanced radio tech, reverse engineering, and deep threat analysis, SkySafe enables clients to maintain airspace security by detecting and controlling malicious and reckless drones. It also provides tools to safely and effectively operate authorized drones.

name: Slate
description: Slate is a social media content creation platform for brands that allows social media, marketing, and design teams within organizations to easily create, manage, and publish on-brand content across every channel. Its solution enables companies to quickly overlay content with their own branded fonts, colors, filters, graphics, and animations from a custom mobile app — and then post directly to social media platforms.

name: Sleeper
description: Sleeper is a fantasy sports software application. Users can create their own fantasy leagues and play with family, friends, or coworkers.

name: SleepSpace
description: SleepSpace (formerly Sonic Sleep) has developed an app that senses sound and motion patterns to accurately measure and improve the user’s sleep score. Their smart sleep assistant suggests tips and content to improve sleep quality and facilitate deeper, more regenerative sleep.

name: Slingshot Aerospace
description: Slingshot Aerospace’s simulation and analytics solutions apply advanced analytics, machine learning, computer vision, and collaborative tools to data from earth and space to provide situational clarity. Their situational-intelligence platform fuses together data from satellites, drones, ground sensors, and other sources to provide a full, dynamic picture of real-time conditions. The service helps governments and commercial space organizations make rapid, data-driven, mission-critical decisions in the complex, high-risk environment of space.

name: Slope
description: Slope provides a clinical trial execution platform that provides data-driven oversight into complex, sample-intensive clinical trials for pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and other trial sponsors. The platform enhances collaboration, real-time visibility, and traceable chain of custody, resulting in reduced supply waste and better adherence to study protocols, timelines, and budgets.

name: Small Door Veterinary
description: Small Door provides customer-centric veterinary services. Its membership model delivers priority access to the best board-certified veterinarians and specialists.

name: Smart Wires
description: SmartWires is a smart grid technology company that helps electric utilities transform the way electric grids operate. It manufacturers power flow devices that turn existing transmission lines into dynamic, controllable and observable “smart wires.”

name: SmartHop
description: The goal of Smarthop is to reduce operational burdens for the nation’s three million small-fleet truck drivers. The company has a tech-enabled platform offering easy load booking; end-to-end, back-office support; and business-in-a box solutions. The platform optimizes routing to minimize dead hauls and maximize pay per mile driven. An additional suite of financial products pools the purchasing power of small fleets to obtain and offer fuel, leasing, and insurance rates usually reserved for larger fleets.

name: Smartrr
description: Smartrr is a recurring revenue platform that helps Shopify brands maximize customer lifetime value. Smartrr creates a seamless checkout and account management experience for subscription customers, and also helps brands easily manage and analyze their customers.

name: Smitten
description: Smitten Ice Cream develops unprocessed and freshly made ice cream for brick-and-mortar retail stores. They use proprietary technology to create made-to-order ice cream with natural and organic ingredients, as well as flavors customers can customize.

name: Snappr
description: Snappr is a platform that connects pre-vetted pro photographers with consumers and businesses. Users are matched with the best photographers in real-time and edited photos are guaranteed to be delivered in 48 hours.

name: SnapShyft
description: SnapShyft is a digital, two-sided labor marketplace. It connects understaffed food-and-beverage and hospitality businesses with experienced and prescreened workers.

name: Social Bicycles
description: JUMP Bikes (formerly Social Bicycles) offers affordable and scalable bikeshare technology. Users sign up on the app to enjoy bikes specifically designed for sharing, equipped with new state-of-the-art technologies, as well as easily accessible.

name: Socrates AI
description: Socrates AI’s platform helps companies to make their existing digital channels and infrastructure more user friendly for employees. Its platform gives easy-to-understand responses to anything employees want to ask or do — such as updating records, requesting vacation, finding answers to critical benefits or IT — and from any digital channel (MS Teams, Slack, intranets, texts, etc.).

name: Solarcore
description: Solarcare (FKA OROS Labs) offers an aerogel-based material inspired by NASA technology that is up to 10 times more effective than traditional thermal insulation, without the bulk. This innovation reduces energy consumption, enhances operational efficiency, and is versatile enough for use in a range of products, from apparel to military equipment.

name: Soldera
description: Soldera (fka Solid World) creates a marketplace for carbon credits, enabling carbon reduction projects to secure funding by selling credits in advance of certification. The software-based solution also helps renewable energy producers automate the sale of certificates that verify their electricity’s green source, streamlining operations and maximizing income.

name: SoLo Funds
description: SoLo Funds is a peer-to-peer lending platform that relies on a user base of borrowers and lenders. SoLo Funds caters to people who aren’t eligible for traditional lending, such as personal loans. Instead of relying on expensive alternatives like payday loans, prospective borrowers can borrow money through SoLo Funds with no interest.

name: SolOr
description: SolOr develops advanced photovoltaic paints that convert sunlight into electricity, potentially turning any sun-exposed product into a zero-carbon solar energy producer. Using ultralight nano photovoltaic fluids, SolOr’s ultrasonic spray-coating technology is designed for application on vehicles, buildings, and various surfaces.

name: Solsten
description: Solsten is a developer of an SaaS customer engagement platform. Rooted in the gaming industry, they use neuropsychological data to better understand audiences, as well as to locate, retain, and monetize users.

name: Solvo
description: Solvo is a dynamic pricing software engine for the logistics and freight shipping industry. Using machine learning, game-theory decision analysis, and access to historical pricing data, it automates the pricing discovery process, predicting the optimal price a specific customer will pay for a given shipment.

name: Somna Therapeutics
description: Somna Therapeutics has developed the Reflux Band, a nonsurgical medical device designed to reduce symptoms from laryngopharyngeal reflux (LPR) without medication. It helps alleviate symptoms of LPR, including the burn of acid reflux into the throat and lungs.

name: Sond
description: SOND is a consumer sleep technology company developing the first AI-powered, non-contact wearable that actively improves sleep in real time. Its lightweight forehead sensor uses clinical-grade biosignals and adaptive audio interventions to extend deep sleep, reduce latency, and optimize circadian alignment.

name: SonderMind
description: SonderMind is a behavioral health network that addresses the three-sided marketplace between consumers, private practitioners, and partners or enterprises. Their platform helps users find a licensed therapist and comes with built-in customer support, as well as integrations with medical billing systems.

name: Songclip
description: Songclip is a digital media platform that makes it easy for consumers to integrate licensed music clips into their text messages and social media posts. The Songclip API enables users and platforms to make music a part of the content that is being shared or sent.

name: Sonoro
description: Sonoro is building a platform agnostic, Spanish-language digital audio company. They are developing a portfolio of audiofirst digital media products (e.g. podcasts) using a unique “make in Mexico, monetize globally” operating strategy.

name: Sorcero
description: Sorcero's Language Intelligence Platform allows employees to access their company’s knowledge more efficiently and effectively. Their NLP suite enables the immediate deployment of solutions, automating the building of advanced knowledge bases to future-proof team members’ expertise.

name: SoSo Value
description: SoSO Value is an AI-driven investment research platform that integrates traditional financial analytics with the dynamic world of Web3. Combining on-chain data with off-chain data, the platform provides Bitcoin Spot ETF dashboard, an AI-powered news aggregator, and Crypto Sector Index for real-time analytics and a collaborative community for investors.

name: Sotira
description: Sotira addresses the $163 billion surplus inventory problem with automated workflow and compliance software that connects suppliers, including major brands, with U.S. buyers of discounted goods. Sotira accelerates transactions from weeks to days, reduces compliance time, and delivers significantly higher financial returns compared to traditional liquidators, enabling suppliers to quickly offload surplus and unlock working capital.

name: SourceDay
description: SourceDay is the developer of a purchase order management platform. Their solution automates the process of fulfilling purchase order requests via cloud software alternatives.

name: South 8 Technologies
description: South 8 Technologies has developed a liquefied-gas electrolyte that boosts lithium-ion battery safety, energy density, and performance from –60 °C to +60 °C. Its drop-in, fast-charging, low-fire-risk chemistry delivers step-change gains without retooling for next-gen EV, aerospace, defense, and grid-storage applications.

name: SoWork
description: SoWork has developed the world’s first massively multiplayer online workplace, applying gaming principles to create a virtual office that empowers companies to embrace hybrid work without compromising on culture. Their platform helps solve communication, teamwork, culture-building, productivity, and collaboration problems inherent in remote and distributed work. It enables companies to help employees form communities, socialize, and feel good about their work.

name: Space and Time
description: Space and Time is creating the Web3 data foundation with a decentralized, community-operated data warehouse, using novel cryptography to integrate on- and off-chain data, delivering enterprise solutions to smart contracts and LLMs. Using Space and Time, developers can connect analytics to smart contracts for use cases in financial services, gaming, DeFi, and other fields requiring verifiable data across enterprise, blockchain, and AI.

name: Spaceium
description: Spaceium is building the first fully automated, in-space refueling and repair stations — addressing critical bottlenecks in the space economy such as restricted fuel capacity and single-use spacecraft. By leveraging patented technologies like robotic arms and cryogenic fuel transfer systems, it enables reusable, scalable missions while reducing costs and unlocking new possibilities for interplanetary exploration.

name: SparkFund
description: Sparkfund is an online energy subscription platform that gives organizations access to energy technologies without the constraints of ownership. It provides financing alternatives for organizations looking for outsourced solutions and service models to implement new energy technology.

name: Spartan
description: Spartan is an automotive radar system solutions provider. Its biomimetic radar system emulates human perception so automated vehicles can detect obstacles faster with better range and resolution.

name: Spectrum Security
description: Spectrum Security automates threat detection engineering for enterprise security operations centers, reducing the time to detect new threats from months to minutes by replacing manual detection rule creation with continuous, AI-driven automation. Its platform sits above existing security infrastructure to automatically map emerging threats against a specific environment, author detection logic, and maintain detection health without requiring teams to replace their current tools.

name: Spekter Games
description: Spekter Games is a next-gen publisher building high-retention, high-monetization games that blend proven Web2 mobile mechanics with seamless Web3 features. Its flagship title, Spekter Agency, is a survivor-style action game built natively for Telegram, tapping into its 950M users and growing Web3 ecosystem.

name: Spero Foods
description: Spero Foods is an innovative, plant-based, dairy-alternative company specializing in creating tasty eggs and cheeses. They use sunflower seeds as their primary ingredient, which provides many advantages over nuts, including both cost savings and time to harvest.

name: SpexAI
description: SpexAI employs state-of-the-art imaging technology and multispectral sensors to deliver in-depth, precise insights for cultivators, with an initial focus on the cannabis industry. SpexAI’s AI-powered imaging technology converts spectral data into actionable, real-time insights that foster improved cultivation outcomes.

name: Sphere Semi
description: Sphere Semi employs AI to accelerate the design of widely used analog semiconductors that enhance “real-world” functionalities like temperature, sound, and electrical current. Sphere’s AI-driven approach expedites and refines the complex analog design process for quicker, more adaptable semiconductor production.

name: Spice AI
description: Spice AI is data and AI infrastructure for web3. Similar to the Snowflake data cloud for web2, Spice provides Web3 data APIs for applications and machine learning using simple SQL query for fast data access.

name: Spintly
description: Spintly offers advanced IoT solutions for access management in commercial and residential buildings, delivering a seamless, cost-effective method to bolster security and efficiency. Spintly's Smart Access App leverages Bluetooth Low Energy, WiFi, LTE, and location services to enable smooth, smartphone-based building access.

name: Spiral Technologies
description: Spiral builds solutions for customer feedback using AI. Their platform scans and analyzes a company’s customer feedback across all voice and text channels to detect emerging problems within a product or service before they become serious issues.

name: Spiras Health
description: Spiras Health pioneers a care-at-home model with a special focus on chronic conditions like COPD and CHF, employing predictive analytics and nurse-led teams to improve outcomes and lower healthcare costs. Spiras proactively identifies at-risk patients, providing personalized at-home care plans, reducing unnecessary hospital visits, and collaborating with health providers for a holistic treatment that enhances patient quality of life.

name: Split Pay
description: Split Pay (formerly Rent App) is a fintech platform that helps consumers manage cash flow by splitting large recurring bills, including rent, mortgage, and car payments, into two smaller payments. The company pays the full bill to the landlord or lender on time while allowing users to repay Split Pay in installments approximately two weeks apart, reducing the financial strain caused by mismatches between bill due dates and pay cycles.

name: SportsVisio
description: SportsVisio is an AI-powered software company transforming sports analytics with automated stat tracking and video highlight generation via a mobile app. As a multi-sport software company, SportsVisio applies advanced computer-vision research to generate stats, analytics, and highlights for teams, coaches, parents, leagues, and players.

name: Spot Insurance
description: Spot Insurance is a technology startup making it easier for people to access affordable on-demand injury insurance. The company is currently focused on the active lifestyle industry (e.g., Alterra's ski resorts, USA Cycling, etc.) where Spot's fully digital product allows its partners to offer customers injury insurance online at the point of sale.

name: Springbok Analytics
description: Springbok Analytics is an AI-powered muscle analytics platform that transforms 2D MRI data into 3D models of individual muscles for use in precision medicine, elite performance, and life sciences research. With recent FDA clearance and a commercial partnership with GE, Springbok is positioned to address healthcare sectors such as orthopedic surgery, degenerative disease monitoring, and women’s health.

name: Sprouts
description: Sprouts is an AI-powered martech platform that provides a single solution for B2B prospecting, data enrichment, and outreach, enhancing personalization and data insights to drive higher conversion rates and cost savings. By addressing challenges like fragmented tools and undefined ideal customer profiles, the platform streamlines go-to-market efforts, improves lead quality, and reduces tool management complexity.

name: Spry
description: Spry is a comprehensive platform designed to simplify and centralize the management of athletic departments’ operations, compliance, and communication. Its cloud-based and mobile-friendly platform provides integrated tools for recruiting, scheduling, and NIL (name, image, and likeness) management.

name: Sqrrl
description: Sqrrl is a Big Data analytics company that lets organizations pinpoint and react to unusual activity by automatically uncovering hidden connections in their data. Sqrrl’s linked data analysis platform gives analysts a way to visually investigate these connections, allowing them to rapidly understand their surrounding contexts and take action.

name: SQZ Biotechnologies
description: SQZ Biotech designs cellular delivery systems for oncology and therapeutics development. Their cell-based therapies target patients with a wide range of conditions, including cancer and autoimmune diseases.

name: Stable
description: For over 90% of the $14T global commodities market (such as agri-food businesses), hedges are not available. Stable is changing that by offering a risk management platform for businesses of all sizes to hedge commodities. By creating simple insurance contracts that act like futures contracts, Stable simplifies hedging for goods that are difficult to commoditize due to variance in quality, shapes, and sizes.

name: StackHawk
description: StackHawk helps developers implement security testing before applications are pushed into production. StackHawk empowers software engineering teams to take ownership of their applications’ security. Its security testing software — built for automation in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) — makes it simple for developers to find, triage, and fix application security bugs.

name: Stadium Live Studios
description: Stadium Live Studios is a consumer social company building an authentic, unique metaverse for the next generation of sports fans to create, connect, and play with others around the world. Its app is primarily focused on sports but the company plans to expand into music, esports, and fashion. It also expects to include blockchain technology through the use of avatars and in-game items that are now non-NFT virtual goods on the app.

name: Standard Kernel
description: Standard Kernel automates the creation and optimization of low-level software that makes AI systems run faster and more efficiently on modern hardware. By removing an engineering bottleneck, the company enables AI builders to unlock more performance from existing compute without rewriting code by hand.

name: Starfish Space
description: Starfish Space is a pioneering company focused on developing autonomous satellite-servicing vehicles that will significantly extend the life of commercial and government satellites. Its compact, cost-effective service spacecraft docks with satellites to maximize satellite capabilities through life extension servicing and as well as performing debris removal missions.

name: Stark
description: Stark is an integrated and intelligent SaaS software compliance tool built for mid-market and enterprise companies. Their integrated suite of tools makes software products more accessible and compliant at scale.

name: Stashpad
description: Stashpad (formerly Bytebase) offers a fast, easy way for individuals — primarily engineers — to create, organize, and search their notes as they work. Stashpad allows developers to pull once-fragmented snippets, thoughts, and notes directly from Slack SMS, Notepad, etc., into a scratchpad that’s instantly searchable, automatically organized, and easy to share.

name: StatusPRO
description: StatusPRO creates sports video games featuring 3D player simulations experienced through a VR headset. The company has partnered with top pro sports leagues to develop VR simulations that use real-time player data and extended reality technology to create authentic, immersive gaming experiences.

name: Stavvy
description: Stavvy is a digital mortgage vendor platform. Their solution enables title agents, lawyers, notaries, and other professionals in the real estate industry to conduct virtual closings and meetings in real time.

name: StayTuned Digital
description: Under a single software platform, StayTuned builds, acquires and grows Shopify apps that enable merchants to expand their businesses faster and more efficiently. Staytuned's suite of software tools reduce ecommerce brands' reliance on paid media and help businesses grow sustainably. The company both builds and acquires an interconnected suite of Shopify apps that provide direct ROI to merchants.

name: Stella Connect
description: Stella Connect measures and boosts performance of customer facing employees through real-time customer feedback, recognition and engagement functionality. They redefine how front line teams work by driving more efficient and more engaged workforces.

name: StemoniX
description: StemoniX develops tools meant to discover new drugs that can treat diseases. They create ready-to-use, preclinical plates of biologically relevant human mico-organs, reducing the need for animal testing and transforming traditional drug development.

name: Steno
description: Steno is bringing a revolutionary and reliable approach to court reporting. Their platform provides legal-support services with a deferred payment approach, all seamlessly tracked, delivered, and automated through tech.

name: Stockpress
description: Stockpress is a highly effective file management platform for SMB businesses teams who find their existing file management platforms hard to navigate and lacking in features. Stockpress allows its SMB customers a simple way to easily manage/share their files than the traditional folder storage format of platforms such as Box and Dropbox. Its lightweight platform also allows version control, which increases collaboration among teams.

name: Storecash
description: StoreCash is a neobanking solution built to provide young and underbanked populations with the tools and education to build their credit through the use of a debit card — without the typical financial risk that comes with credit. The StoreCash platform provides a physical and digital debit card, parent/guardian supervision of an account, and full credit building capabilities — along with educational resources. Users enjoy zero deposit, no interest or hidden fees, and instant cash-back features.

name: StoryFit
description: Storyfit delivers insights and solutions for the book publishing, movie, and television-production industries. It uses proprietary technologies to quickly analyze manuscripts and screenplays, enabling publishers to monitor how a story is developing.

name: Stratagen Bio
description: Stratagen Bio transforms standard MRI scanners into objective, quantitative platforms that measure tissue biology, reducing reliance on subjective image interpretation. Initially focused on prostate cancer, Stratagen’s end-to-end solution aims to reduce unnecessary biopsies and improve diagnostic accuracy by providing clinicians with precise, biologically driven insights.

name: Strategikon Pharma
description: Strategikon Pharma is the creator of a SaaS tool to plan, source, and manage clinical-trial operations for pharmaceutical companies. Their tool enables users to manage clinical portfolios through integrated workflows and facilitating better communication between pharma companies and their outsourcing partners.

name: Strateos
description: Strateos is a robotic cloud lab platform designed to accelerate drug discovery and synthetic biology research. The Strateos Common Lab Environment coordinates scientific processes, instruments, and robotics to create a programmatically addressable lab environment.

name: Strike Graph
description: Strike Graph is a security-compliance solution. They strive to make complex cybersecurity standards simple and provide insights via automated verification.

name: STRIVR
description: STRIVR is a virtual reality software platform that allows organizations to run simulated-training programs for its employees, covering situations they may encounter on the job. Their platform powers the creation, management, and experience of immersive training.

name: StrongestLayer
description: StrongestLayer builds an AI-native email security platform that protects enterprises from phishing and business email compromise attacks that bypass traditional defenses. Its multi-agent reasoning system analyzes the intent behind every email from first principles, delivering high detection accuracy with minimal false positives while providing pre-investigated alerts that dramatically reduce response times.

name: Strongsuit
description: Strongsuit is a work-life management platform. Its task management platform offers employers a new way to retain talent by providing their staff with a deep-thinking, home–life management partner.

name: Structural
description: Structural is a dynamic people directory and internal-opportunity marketplace. Using data-rich profiles, intelligent search and real-time insight, their SaaS solution gets the right people working together at the right time.

name: Style Genome
description: Style Genome (formerly Spruce Up) is a personalized e-commerce solution for home and design. The platform creates a unique online shopping experience for each individual customer in real time and with infinite scale.

name: Subspace
description: Subspace is building a high-performance platform to help developers overcome latency and network issues. The Subspace platform helps real-time application developers deliver improved network quality while protecting their applications’ availability.

name: Sully
description: Sully AI is a full-stack, AI-native healthcare platform that automates administrative tasks such as scheduling and follow-ups and empowers busy clinicians to deliver superior patient care. Sully’s AI platform integrates directly into Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to handle documentation, scheduling, and medical coding, enabling doctors to focus on patient care instead of paperwork.

name: Summer
description: Summer enables second-home ownership. It removes the friction from buying and owning a vacation or investment home, creating “a home that pays for itself” through rental income. Summer helps its customers identify, design/furnish, finance, and yield on these second homes.

name: Sunbird Bio
description: Sunbird Bio (formerly Glympse Bio) develops proprietary protein-based technologies to improve diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders and early-stage cancer. It is the first company to overcome the challenge of accurately detecting and differentiating the specific proteins that aggregate and signal the presence of Alzheimer’s disease with a simple blood draw.

name: Sunbit
description: Sunbit is a financing and payment platform that is intended to split up purchases into smaller, more achievable payments. Businesses can use Sunbit’s personalized payment plans to enable their customers to pay gradually over time for larger purchases.

name: Sunflower
description: Sunflower offers an AI-powered sobriety companion that combines personalized guidance, therapy access, and community support to help people manage addiction. Its approachable, affordable platform delivers meaningful behavior change at scale, making high-quality support accessible to anyone seeking recovery.

name: Sunfolding
description: Sunfolding's proprietary solar tracker reduces installation time, lowers maintenance cost, and improves land utilization for solar plants. Their technology replaces motors, gears, dampers, batteries, and bearings with a single component.

name: SuperCritical
description: SuperCritical has developed the world’s first high-pressure, membraneless electrolyzer to produce green hydrogen at a 40% lower cost per kilogram. By delivering hydrogen in a natively pressurized state, it eliminates costly compression processes, tackling key industry challenges and advancing a zero-emission future.

name: Superhuman
description: Superhuman (fka Coda, acquired by Grammarly) is an AI-powered productivity platform that helps professionals manage email and communication faster. It combines automation, collaboration, and intelligent workflows to turn everyday messages into streamlined, high-impact work.

name: SuperPhone
description: SuperPhone is a full-featured, scalable CRM for managing all volumes of SMS, text, or Messenger conversations. SuperPhone allows people with hundreds of thousands of followers and fans to manage direct interaction with their fans on a scalable basis.

name: SupplyHound
description: SupplyHound has developed an on-demand delivery app for building supplies that enables contractors to buy materials from their favorite local suppliers and have them delivered on-site quickly. Their app improves construction and supplier productivity by managing material order flow and providing on-demand delivery. SupplyHound eases the burden of procuring materials for contractors, keeps skilled labor on the job, and helps vendors reduce sales costs while boosting customer satisfaction.

name: Surge Therapeutics
description: SURGE Therapeutics (formerly STIMIT) seeks to dramatically improve cancer patient survival by disrupting how, when, and where cancer immunotherapy is deployed. The company is developing an injectable biodegradable hydrogel that enables extended, localized release of cancer immunotherapy at the site of surgical tumor resection to improve patient survival outcomes.

name: SurrealDB
description: SurrealDB is a scalable, multi-model cloud database that allows developers to focus on building their applications rather than architecting and managing their infrastructure. Its serverless database is equipped with an SQL-style query language for real-time, efficient data operations and advanced security permissions for multi-tenant access.

name: Sustainment
description: Sustainment is a SaaS platform connecting manufacturing vendors and U.S. machine shops with their enterprise customers. Their platform incorporates algorithm-based matching and optimization, encrypted transfer protocols, and semi-autonomous sourcing techniques to provide an intuitive customer experience for sourcing teams and manufacturing vendors.

name: Swaplanet
description: Swaplanet offers a “recommerce” marketplace that allows parents to resell gently used children’s clothing, earning them money while giving usable items an extended life and buyers a bargain. Swaplanet intends to grow by focusing exclusively on children’s goods, including books, toys, and other items that generally have a short useful life.

name: Swarm Aero
description: Swarm Aero is building AI-powered autonomous systems and software that can control large swarms of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) with a limited number of operators.

name: Swarmbotics AI
description: Swarmbotics AI designs affordable swarm robotics for defense and industry, using off-the-shelf components and cutting-edge autonomy to create scalable and sophisticated robotic systems. Its flagship product — the Attritable, Networked, Tactical Swarm (ANTS) features autonomous robots that work together seamlessly for advanced and coordinated operations in complex battlefield environments.

name: Swiftmile
description: Swiftmile provides fixed, standalone parking and charging stations for light electric vehicles (LEVs). Working directly with municipalities and private micromobility providers, their stations are compatible with a wide variety of LEVs, keeping them charged and organized throughout a city.

name: Swing Therapeutics
description: Swing Therapeutics builds digital solutions for chronic diseases with an evidence-backed approach, starting with fibromyalgia, a widespread musculoskeletal disorder. Its team is focused on increasing access to therapies for more people through the power of software-based treatments. Swing received an FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021 for Tempo, their 12-week smartphone-assisted fibromyalgia management program. Tempo is designed to reduce symptoms and improve physical functioning and emotional wellbeing.

name: Sygaldry
description: Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers that slash the cost and energy needed to train and run large-scale models. Its hybrid architecture combines multiple approaches to quantum computing that leverage best of breed quantum technologies, targeting hyperscalers, labs, and researchers grappling with soaring compute and power demands.

name: Synchron
description: Synchron has built a first in class minimally invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) via a stent implanted in the brain’s blood vessels. Its device interprets signals from the brain, enabling treatment of brain pathologies such as paralysis and epilepsy. Patients are now able to perform various tasks via a smartphone connected to the bluetooth neuroprosthetic BCI interface.

name: Synteny
description: Syntney decodes the signals of immune repertoires to help biotech research and pharma companies with disease discoveries. Its AI-based bioinformatic platform enables identification of novel immune targets, isolating responders from non-responders for immunotherapies and early disease detection.

name: Synthesis AI
description: Synthesis AI is pioneering the use of synthetic data to build a more capable computer vision model. Applications include teleconferencing, identity verification, driver monitoring, and digital humans. Through a proprietary combination of generative neural networks and cinematic CGI pipelines, its platform creates perfectly labeled image data at vastly increased speed and reduced cost compared to current approaches.

name: Synthesis School
description: Synthesis is an innovative learning experience created by the founder of a school for Elon Musk’s children. Their learning experience is designed to cultivate student voice, strategic thinking, and collaborative problem solving for kids, ages 8 to 14.

name: Syntiant
description: Syntiant has developed a completely digital Neural Decision Processor and AI compute solution for low-power, always-on devices. Their solution works for everything from smartphones to laptops, autos, earbuds, and virtual assistants such as Alexa. Syntiant’s technology brings powerful machine learning from the cloud into even the tiniest devices. The result is greatly increased battery life, privacy, and responsiveness — along with decreased infrastructure costs.

name: Syntra
description: Syntra is an AI-powered healthcare operating system that automates administrative workflows, driving greater efficiency, accuracy, and financial performance for medical providers. By consolidating tasks like patient check-in, data capture, billing, and inventory management, Syntra minimizes software dependency and optimizes operations.

name: Tabs
description: Tabs is the first AI-powered revenue platform that helps B2B businesses automate the management of customer contracts, billing, revenue recognition, renewal, and audits. Businesses use Tabs to eliminate manual work, accelerate cash collection, enhance operational efficiency, and increase business model flexibility.

name: Tamr
description: Tamr is an enterprise software company designed to tackle large-scale data management challenges in organizations with extreme data volume and variety. They help to replace labor and time-intensive data preparation with the power of machine learning.

name: Tangibly
description: Tangibly delivers an end-to-end solution for effective administration and protection of trade secrets. Tangibly’s software supports every type of trade secret, including technology know-how, proprietary code, business methods, financial models, and customer lists.

name: Tango
description: Tango’s workflow intelligence software is designed to help train remote operations teams. Their platform enables users to accelerate new hire ramp time, multiply top performers, and celebrate how work gets done.

name: Tango Technology
description: Tango’s workflow intelligence software is designed to help train remote operations teams. Their platform enables users to accelerate new hire ramp time, multiply top performers, and celebrate how work gets done.

name: Tara Intelligence
description: Tara is a smart product management platform that is designed to scope software projects, build teams, and monitor performance. Their platform leverages machine learning in order to help teams scope, resource, and build cutting-edge software products.

name: Tari Tickets
description: Tari is an open source and decentralized protocol enabling the management, use, and transfer of many kinds of digital assets. The digital assets it covers include tickets, loyalty points, and virtual goods, transforming the future of digital assets.

name: Tau Systems
description: TAU Systems is developing compact, high-energy particle accelerators, reducing them from kilometer-scale infrastructure to tabletop systems for atomic-scale chip fabrication. Its proprietary free electron laser technology delivers large-scale accelerator performance in a smaller, more accessible form, enabling advances in semiconductor manufacturing, biotech, and energy.

name: Taya
description: Taya is redefining wearables as luxury fashion with an AI-powered pendant that captures and transcribes conversations through on-device intelligence. Its design-led approach—jewelry first, technology second—creates emotional comfort and cultural acceptance, giving Taya a durable brand moat where aesthetics and trust drive adoption.

name: Teach Me To
description: Teach Me To is an in-person leisure learning marketplace that connects students with skilled professionals for private lessons. From surfing to pickleball, pros are matched with children and adult beginners for individuals or group lessons.

name: Teal Drones
description: Teal develops drones that are designed to improve augmented reality, security, and inspections. Their sports drones reach speeds of 80 mph, and their First-Person-View feature allows these drones to transmit a live feed to the user’s goggles.

name: Teal HQ
description: Teal HQ is a career management platform that guides workers through their ideal long-term career path. They provide a digital tool set to ensure long term professional development, individual coaching, job matching, and compensation negotiation.

name: Teampay
description: Teampay has developed a user-friendly platform that gives organizations greater control and visibility over spending, helping them focus on resources and growth rather than on overhead. Their platform aligns spenders and finance, integrates with legacy systems, and collects critical data. This enables employees to request, approve, and track company spending in real time, helping reduce policy misalignment, lack of transparency, and unpredictable spending.

name: TeamShares
description: Teamshares develops small business purchasing services designed for employee ownership. Users can get a screening decision for their business with the click of a button, and they can sell their small business without needing a financing contingency.

name: Tellus App
description: Tellus was founded in 2016 as a real estate and property management app and has evolved into an app at the intersection of fintech and proptech. Its platform provides high-yield (3% APY) savings accounts with zero lockup and daily compounding interest. The cash deposited into savings accounts is subsequently lent to landlords at 8%-12% interest. Tellus also still supports its property management app, with access for the landlords that they lend to.

name: Tembo Health
description: Tembo Health’s telemedicine practice provides caregivers, payers, and healthcare organizations with care for nursing home patients in hard-to-access specialties, such as psychiatry and cardiology. Its platform delivers superior data and stakeholder engagement, enabling its flagship 24/7 emergency medicine product to improve patient outcomes and reduce ER visits.

name: Tembo IO
description: Tembo IO is revolutionizing the deployment of Postgres — ranked by developers as the most popular open-source database engine — by consolidating database sprawl into a unified, high-performance managed service. With Tembo, developers can quickly create and deploy specialized data services using Stacks, pre-built Postgres configurations, without complex builds or additional data teams.

name: Tempest
description: Tempest develops virtual services to address alcohol use, mis-use, and addiction. They offer an online sobriety school and aftercare program that enable users to receive the education, tools, and community they need to build a life free from alcohol.

name: Tempo
description: Tempo (Formerly RedoxBlox) develops energy storage modules for power generation and industrial heat applications, replacing natural gas/fossil fuel with electrification and thermochemical energy. Using a patented material that can store and emit electric energy, Tempo’s solution drastically reduces carbon and nitrogen oxide emissions while enhancing grid resiliency and safety.

name: Tempo Automation
description: Tempo develops fast, low cost, precise printed circuit board design and fabrication for low volume applications. Their software-driven smart factory merges data, analytics, and automation, to deliver results that are essential for rapid prototyping.

name: TenLittle
description: TenLittle is rethinking children’s footwear from the ground up. Their shoes are designed with pediatricians and podiatrists to support natural growth in little feet.

name: TensorMesh
description: TensorMesh builds critical middleware that optimizes AI inference by solving the "memory wall" bottleneck, enabling enterprises to more efficiently and cost effectively run LLMs with massive context windows. Led by leading AI researchers behind LMCache Lab, TensorMesh decouples the key-value cache from the compute layer and delivers immediate efficiency gains as a hardware-agnostic layer compatible with NVIDIA, AMD, and other accelerators.

name: Teradar
description: Teradar is building a new category of automotive sensors and perception using the terahertz frequency – enabling the next generation of ADAS (advanced driver assistance systems) sensors.
