Tedradar’s powerful sensors use terahertz waves instead of light to see through rain, fog, or snow better than lower-wavelength lidar lasers. The sensors also have 33% higher resolution in clear conditions.

name: Teraki
description: Teraki is an AI and IoT company that develops and produces intelligent edge processing software for the automotive industry. Their software is embedded within devices and/or sensors to efficiently condense and transmit data to the cloud.

name: Teramount
description: Teramount makes fiber-to-chip connectivity solutions that enable the high-volume manufacturing of co-packaged optics for AI workloads. Teramount is rearchitecting the future of data centers by making mass manufacturing scalable, delivering on the co-packaged optics promise of 10x bandwidth and 8x power efficiency.

name: Terradepth
description: Terradepth is a data-as-a-service company that collects high-resolution undersea information and makes it accessible to industries, researchers, and others. The company has developed an unmanned submersible vehicle system that captures detailed underwater data, which — paired with big data analytics and machine learning— delivers insights into the oceans.

name: Testbox
description: Testbox is a self-serve evaluation platform that allows companies to avoid the frustrating experience of choosing SaaS vendors. Users can experience and test software products side by side in live, fully-configured environments.

name: Tethr
description: Tethr is a communications intelligence platform designed to surface insights from large volumes of customer phone conversations, in order to help guide businesses’ decisions. It automatically detects sources of Customer Effort and loyalty indicators.

name: TFC Therapeutics
description: TFC Therapeutics is developing novel immunotherapeutic approaches with enormous potential to address the earliest indicators of new and repapses of cancer. By focusing on tumor-immune hybrid cells, TFC aims to target cancer at its earliest stages and significantly improve patient outcomes.

name: The Arrive Platform
description: The Arrive Platform enables brands and retailers to manage their non-salable returns by identifying, refurbishing, grading, and managing order fulfillment. The software is integrated with the retailer’s website and provides consumers an opportunity to purchase less-than-perfect items at 20% to 60% below regular retail prices.

name: The Bland Company
description: The Bland Company creates plant-based proteins that mimic egg whites using low-cost byproducts like rice bran, cutting costs by ~50% while maintaining performance in baking, sauces, and more Its proprietary protein restructuring platform unlocks clean-label, scalable ingredients for the $120B processed egg market and beyond.

name: The Helper Bees
description: The Helper Bees (THB) is an insurtech company transforming the home care experience by helping people stay at home longer through their data-driven aging-in-place platform for both service providers and long-term care recipients. HB’s platform allows for aging-in-place service providers to bill insurance carriers and health plans directly. The platform collects data-driven insights to provide comprehensive, in-home, care management programs — while reducing claims costs and improving operational efficiencies.

name: The Mentor Method
description: Mentor Method is an enterprise SaaS platform that helps companies match diverse talent with effective mentorship. Their solution uses a double-blind algorithm to match employees with mentors in their organization, tracks mentorship progress, and provides data analytics.

name: The Mighty
description: The Mighty is the world’s leading social health platform, with over 3 million members creating conversations across 1,500 medical conditions. The Mighty’s unique quantitative and qualitative research capabilities serve a variety of purposes for its healthcare partners and community members

name: The Players Lounge
description: The Players’ Lounge is a Web 3.0 platform built to empower relationships within the collegiate sports community. The platform provides opportunities for current and former student-athletes to connect with their respective fan bases while also monetizing their individual brands.

name: The Post
description: The Post is a networking membership community for athletes transitioning to the business world. Membership includes exclusive benefits like networking, leadership training, mentorship, and access to physical and virtual events such as an annual summit.

name: The Realest
description: The Realest is an authentication platform and marketplace that sources items directly from artists and athletes, enabling collectors and fans to own the most trusted entertainment memorabilia. Its authentication platform uses witness-based verification, hologram stickers, and hidden markings to essentially give an item a fingerprint to protect its value.

name: The Recount
description: The Recount is a new digital media company. Their streaming video channel delivers daily, on-demand, 5-minute video news to consumers on mobile platforms.

name: The Routing Company
description: The Routing Company is working to solve major operational gaps in the demand responsive transportation (DRT) market. It dynamically routes shared rides in real time through a fleet management dashboard, a rider app, and a driver app, all powered by MIT-born technology.

name: The Snow League
description: The Snow League is building the first global, professional winter sports league, founded by three-time Olympic gold medalist Shaun White, the world’s most recognizable winter sports athlete. The company aims to unify the fragmented winter sports industry through a premium, season-long competition featuring the world's best athletes, high-stakes head-to-head events, and best-in-class production.

name: The Third Place
description: The Third Place (TTP) helps local businesses launch and grow subscription programs. Their solution includes a robust customer CRM, recurring payment systems, event management capabilites, and event-driven triggers and automation.

name: Thea Energy
description: Thea Energy leverages proprietary breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster, simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. Thea has redesigned the stellarator (a device for producing controlled nuclear fusion), creating a simpler, scalable system for long-term use aimed at producing unlimited, zero-emission energy.

name: ThinkVerse
description: Thinkverse provides personalized, interactive artificial intelligence math tutoring at a fraction of the cost to K-12 schools. The AI tutor assesses students’ understanding, answers questions, provides targeted instructions, and tracks achievements.

name: Thirty Madison
description: Thirty Madison is a healthcare company focused on improving how people manage their chronic conditions. It provides expert diagnosis, specialized treatment plans, and ongoing support via a scalable platform, reducing specialist shortages, wait times, and expenses.

name: Thistle
description: Thistle offers healthy, plant-based prepared meals, juices, and sides to consumers as a subscription service. Customers can select from a rotating weekly menu of gluten- and dairy-free options, and adjust their plan at any time.

name: Thousand Fell
description: Thousand Fell is a sustainably sourced line of sneakers that are recyclable and biodegradable

name: ThreatKey
description: ThreatKey provides organizations automated tools to find and eliminate malware and other cybersecurity threats, so they don’t need to hire a security team. Their solution enables users to remove security threats with a single click or opt to allow ThreatKey handle the entire process. The solution is agentless, integrates with cloud services, does not require software installation, and provides robust compliance controls.

name: ThreatWarrior
description: ThreatWarrior is the provider of a cloud-native, network-threat-intelligence platform. Their SaaS solution identifies and analyzes threats to digital networks and supply chains, and it offers protection in real time.

name: Thynk
description: Thynk (formerly Mentis Minds, ATENTIV) uses a special EEG headset that teaches children personalized cognitive skills while playing an immersive adventure game on the computer. With regular use, children can enhance their ability to focus and self-control / manage, leading to success in school, home, and social settings.

name: Tibles
description: Tibles is a NFT studio and marketplace focused on digital collectibles from pop culture and entertainment brands, which users can collect and own. The company creates digital objects called ‘tibles,’ with links to pop culture brands and entertainment properties, which users can collect and own.

name: Tienda Pago
description: Tienda Pago’s digital platform provides small merchants in Lat-Am emerging markets with short-term credit lines to finance their weekly inventory of consumer packaged goods. Using their cell phones, merchants can buy high-turnover inventory with credit — increasing sales and reducing inefficiencies and costs for both the small merchants and leading brands.

name: Tilled
description: Tilled provides payment facilitation (PayFac) services intended to support the financial backend of marketplaces, SAAS companies, and integrated software vendors. The freemium solution also helps teams organize and prioritize to improve work relationships with colleagues, customers, and prospects.

name: Tobler
description: Tobler (fka UserHub) is a commercial real estate valuation firm combining MAI-certified expertise with AI-powered tools to deliver faster, lower-cost, and decision-ready reports. Designed for modern lenders, Tobler’s platform streamlines everything from evaluations to full appraisals — without compromising quality or compliance.

name: Tofu
description: Tofu offers an AI-powered platform that enables B2B marketing teams to create hyper-personalized, omnichannel campaigns at scale using their brand guidelines and segmentation. Tofu automates approximately 80% of campaign workflows and repurposes content across channels, increasing conversion rates and helping teams scale efficiently while reducing sales cycles.

name: Together AI
description: Together AI is an open-source AI company building a full-stack cloud platform for training, fine-tuning, and deploying a wide range of generative AI models. Supporting over 200 models with 2–3x faster inference than current solutions, its AI Acceleration Cloud and private deployment options make state-of-the-art AI more accessible, scalable, and secure.

name: Toggle Robotics
description: Toggle Robotics provides automation focused on rebar pre-assembly for reinforced concrete construction. By using their robotics technology to pre-assemble rebar on customer job sites, Toggle reduces onsite costs, complexity, and hazards, while speeding up the construction process.

name: Toma
description: Toma offers advanced AI agents designed to streamline and automate phone-based customer interactions for car dealerships. Its technology seamlessly integrates with existing business software, enhancing AI agents’ ability to provide real-time data and contextually relevant responses for a more personalized customer experience.

name: Torch Technology
description: Torch Technology offers a dental supplies procurement platform that provides price transparency and digital transactions, saving dentists’ time while securing the best prices. Torch also provides dental suppliers with real-time order analytics and increased volume, negating the need for sales teams by sending orders straight to warehouses and offering predictive inventory optimization.

name: Torus
description: Torus is transforming grid reliability with hybrid flywheel-battery systems that deliver instant, long-duration energy storage for utilities and commercial users. Its patented technology responds faster than traditional batteries, reduces wear, and offers a durable, U.S.-made solution for stabilizing the grid amid rising demand from EVs and data centers.

name: Trajektory
description: Trajektory is a global sponsorship analytics platform that uses AI-driven valuation to measure performance across social, broadcast, in venue, and digital assets. It helps teams, leagues, and brands save time and optimize ROI with real-time, transparent data.

name: Transcend Therapeutics
description: Transcend Therapeutics discovers, develops, and delivers next-generation psychoactive compounds to treat some of the most pressing mental illnesses. The compounds provide therapeutic effects without the inebriating, mentally challenging “trip” associated with these compounds. They are designed to be compatible for use with other antidepressants and PTSD medication.

name: TransCrypts
description: TransCrypts’ blockchain-powered platform enables customers to safely own, store, and verify their important records. Users can automate record and credential issuance through over 500 supported API integrations and share files instantaneously with anyone in the world. Customers have complete data ownership and can off-ramp from TransCrypts’ platform by minting their data as an NFT.

name: Trashie
description: Trashie (fka For Days) helps people recycle clothing, shoes, accessories, linens, and more in almost any condition to keep waste out of landfills. Customers earn TrashieCash™ for each bag, redeemable for rewards across a wide range of retailers in clothing, home goods, beauty, wellness, and experiences.

name: TravelBank
description: TravelBank is an all-in-one business expense management and travel booking platform. Companies can create and deploy custom travel policies with ease and create a baseline for travel spend, with access to TravelBank’s in-house customer success team for 24/7 concierge-level support.

name: TRAXyL
description: TRAXyL is the developer of a smart optical fiber distribution system that allows for high-speed fiber to be installed (“painted”) on-demand directly onto paved surfaces. The company’s system alleviates the need to trench cables underground. This eliminates much of the cost and time associated with conventional ways of laying fiber optic cables

name: Treehouse
description: Treehouse is simplifying the complex, $200B home-electrification industry to better meet consumers’ everyday needs. Rising energy costs, declining renewable expenses, heightened climate change awareness, and government incentives are all driving demand for this company's consumer-centric SaaS tool.

name: Trendsi
description: Trendsi (formerly Shobby) is a simple social selling platform that makes it easy for anyone to become a reseller. Users can shop genuine quality brands at low prices and share merchandise with people, earning money when someone purchases a shared item.

name: Trestle
description: Trestle provides a dashboard for construction contractors, engineers, and architects to easily review and choose the right vendor partners for upcoming projects. By using bid integration, automation, and AI, the platform speeds up contract closure to 15 times faster than the usual industry pace.

name: Trifacta
description: Trifacta is a cloud data platform that is designed to improve the efficiency of curating and preparing data. This enables clients to reduce end-to-end reporting time and accelerate customer on-boarding, ensuring increased success of their analytics.

name: Trilobio
description: Trilobio is revolutionizing biology research with fully automated lab solutions designed to improve reproducibility and efficiency. Its platform — built by biologists for biologists — integrates robotics and software to simplify research workflows, enabling scientists to design experiments in minutes and ensure consistent results across labs.

name: TripleBlind
description: TripleBlind provides digital privacy as a service. Their suite of tools enables companies to safely provide and consume extremely sensitive data and algorithms in encrypted space.

name: TRM Labs
description: TRM Labs provides blockchain intelligence to help government agencies, financial institutions, and cryptocurrency businesses detect, investigate, and mitigate crypto-related fraud and financial crime. TRM's risk management platform includes solutions for cryptocurrency anti-money laundering, transaction monitoring and wallet screening, investigative tracing, and entity risk scoring.

name: Trocafone
description: Trocafone is a South American e-commerce marketplace that is designed for customers to buy and sell used electronics. Users can exchange their phones through the service and will then receive vouchers that can be used at a trade-in electronics store.

name: True Link Financial
description: True Link develops payment cards, investment management, and other financial services for older adults, people with disabilities, and people who are recovering from addictions. Their offerings include Visa prepaid cards and Investment Advisory plans.

name: Truleo
description: Truleo offers an AI-driven platform that utilizes body camera footage to improve law enforcement practices, automatically creating highlight reels that support officer training and showcase exemplary conduct. By analyzing video content, Truleo helps police departments reinforce professionalism, provides valuable coaching, and assists in the development of best practices.

name: Trunk Tools
description: Applying “gig economy” attributes, Trunk Tools incentivizes, analyzes, and provides instruction and up-skilling to construction workers. The platform allows small businesses and creators to sell products and NFTs and will allow digital goods, digital services, and physical products to be sold throughout the community.

name: Trusstor
description: Trusstor is a cloud-based, integrated platform that helps construction managers improve site efficiency, safety, and profit margins. With a click of a button, managers can fully digitize their construction site. Trusstor’s platform combines IoT with construction management to provide valuable insights much more quickly.

name: Trustible
description: Trustible is a leading AI governance platform enabling organizations to manage AI risk, ensure compliance, and build trust across the entire AI lifecycle. As regulatory pressure and stakeholder demands grow, Trustible offers real-time risk analysis, regulatory mapping, and built-in workflows to support scalable, accountable AI adoption.

name: Tulip
description: Tulip developed and distributed premium oral care products. Users could order toothpaste that contained an FDA-approved formula and toothbrushes that included twice the usual number of bristles and an activated charcoal strip for affordable dental care.

name: TuMeke
description: TuMeke provides AI-powered ergonomic assessments. Their app uses computer vision to measure and automatically track the safety of employees without stopping production.

name: Tundra
description: Tundra is an online marketplace created to buy products instantly and directly from suppliers. Users have access to wholesale products without fees and with free shipping, complete with tags to follow to gain knowledge of the current market.

name: Tunnel
description: Tunnel is a developer too that supercharges product team workflows by enabling real-time collaboration and feedback to accelerate software development. Instead of waiting for deployment to get feedback, teams using Tunnel’s live app previews can leave comments, start a video chat, and visualize changes in real time.

name: Turing
description: Turing is a talent platform intended to deploy the acquisition of engineers with a touch of a button. The platform uses artificial intelligence to analyze data from various sources, build developer profiles, and match them with companies looking for engineers.

name: Twenty20
description: Twenty20 is a marketplace for crowdsourced imagery, using stock photos to enhance and authenticate a brand’s image. The company connects brands and creative agencies with authentic, real-world imagery that is crowdsourced from users around the world.

name: Twentyeight Health
description: Twentyeight Health is a mission-driven womxn’s health organization with the goal of increasing access to reproductive and sexual healthcare. The company sells and delivers birth control pills, patches, rings, shots and emergency contraception prescriptions at a low cost — or covered by insurance, including Medicaid.

name: Twin Prime
description: Twin Prime (fomerly Stream AI) is a frontier artificial intelligence company developing specialized AI models for defense and national security applications. The company’s multimodal AI platform processes and reasons across diverse sensor data to improve situational awareness, accelerate decision-making, and enhance mission-critical operations for defense organizations and critical infrastructure.

name: Two
description: Two is a purchase management software that provides Buy Now, Pay Later capabilities, helping B2B enterprises increase sales conversions and order sizes. Two has developed propriety machine learning algorithms to derisk customer profiles as well as offer various payment options for merchants. This enables their B2B clients to optimize business and process efficiency.

name: Ubicept
description: Ubicept redefines computer vision by transforming raw photon data into crystal-clear images—eliminating motion blur, overexposure, and low-light noise in milliseconds. As the $90B imaging market shifts to next-gen sensors, Ubicept’s Photon Fusion software is the critical layer unlocking precision vision across autonomy, robotics, and beyond.

name: UENI
description: UENI provides small businesses with all-in-one solutions for building their online presence — including website design, SEO, Google verified listings, hosting, custom domain, and 1-1 coaching services. UENI combines a full suite of technology with human support to provide an agency-level solution at the price of a DIY platform.

name: Ummino
description: Ummino creates novel food categories using rare, animal-free proteins that enhance taste and nutrition, allowing clients to turn basic ingredients into high-value foods. The company reproduces naturally occurring beef proteins that clinically repair and restore a depleted gut microbiome and can be added to foods and beverages.

name: Undock
description: Undock is a software company that helps people instantly schedule, host, and document meetings. Their SaaS platform uses a predictive AI model to instantly discover the ideal meeting time for participants by comparing availability, preferences, and behavior.

name: Unfabled
description: Unfabled is a women's health platform that uses data to help women find curated products for needs often overlooked by mainstream healthcare, including menstrual, pregnancy, and menopausal care. Its market intelligence platform also delivers crucial insights into consumer behavior, helping healthcare businesses in advancing women’s health.

name: Unicorn Biotechnologies
description: Unicorn’s technology is designed to work with cultured meat producers aiming to create beef, salmon, chicken, and other products. Its fully automated and modular bioreactors enable rapidly scalable and affordable cultured meat production while significantly reducing manufacturing footprint and labor costs.

name: UnifAI
description: UnifAI Network (formerly AiVengers) is building AI-native infrastructure that lets autonomous agents navigate and execute in decentralized finance. Its modular, security-first framework unifies tools and APIs, enabling anyone to deploy intelligent DeFi agents and strategies with ease.

name: Unified API
description: Unified provides a decentralized platform for AI applications that accelerates launch speeds and ensures secure, seamless data management and integration, saving businesses time and resources. Unified’s real-time platform enables developers to perform a single integration that grants access to hundreds of pre-built integrations with various SaaS tools.

name: United Dwelling
description: United Dwelling transforms garages and backyards into affordable, high-quality homes through its technology platform. The platform handles every aspect of the home-building process for property owners, including design, permitting, construction, and finding qualified tenants, as well property management and maintenance.

name: Unity Biotechnology
description: UNITY Biotechnology develops small molecule medicines that potentially halt, slow, or reverse age-associated diseases, while restoring human health. They target the root causes of these diseases, such as arthritis, vision loss, and cognitive decline.

name: UNIXi
description: UNIXi is a cybersecurity company that provides next-generation identity security solutions to protect businesses' online accounts and data. The company’s primary product enhances login security for work-related websites and apps through Universal Single Sign-On (SSO) and multi-factor authentication, eliminating the need for passwords.

name: Unlearn AI
description: Unlearn.AI is a computational science company that builds machine learning platforms to create biological digital twins for the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries. By leveraging historical datasets and disease-specific machine-learning models, Unlearn generates virtual placebo patients, created from actual patient baseline data in clinical studies.

name: Unspun
description: UnSpun has developed a 3D-weaving technology that is versatile and fast. The company has created the 3D printer of textiles that can weave clothing at more than four times the rate of current methods, and it works with a variety of material inputs.

name: Unstructured
description: Unstructured converts data from multiple sources into a large, secure, central repository that is “AI ready.” The company's software uses open-source libraries and APIs to build custom preprocessing ML pipelines for labeling, training, or production, enabling clients to turn simple data into natural language data.

name: Untapped
description: Untapped has developed a diversity recruitment platform that creates a collaborative talent marketplace aimed at increasing workplace diversity. Its platform helps companies hire diverse teams by gaining visibility into their applicant pool. Candidates self-report demographic information, enabling employers to filter according to the priority groups and talent they are focusing on.

name: UpEquity
description: UpEquity’s platform makes the application and approval process for home loans more efficient while also enabling customers to make cash offers to home sellers. Its tech-enabled platform enables home buyers to close offers faster by offering them a combination of free cash offers, automated underwriting, and low mortgage rates.

name: Upland
description: Upland is a virtual property strategy game that’s mapped to the real world, where uses have fun while earning real world value. The game uses blockchain to ensure true ownership for players, who can build dream homes, start virtual businesses, and earn in-game currency or U.S. dollars by selling their NFT properties in a free and open marketplace.

name: Upside Health
description: Upside Health empowers clinicians to deliver cutting-edge chronic pain care through remote patient monitoring and engagement tools without increased burden on physicians and office staff. Its turnkey, reimbursable solution also allows registered nurses to review and deliver all the data into the clinician’s electronic health record.

name: Upstart
description: Upstart is a marketplace lending platform bringing together lenders and borrowers more directly. It uses superior data modeling to go beyond FICO scores, providing a more accurate sense of creditworthiness, and helping borrowers receive better rates.

name: Upstock Equity System
description: Upstock is an equity compensation management platform. It allows businesses to implement and manage an equity structure using fixed and dynamic restricted stock units (RSUs).

name: Uptime Industries
description: Uptime Industries, doing business as Lemony AI, is a secure, on-premise generative AI platform that delivers enterprise-grade AI performance while ensuring data privacy, compliance, and full ownership. Designed for scalability and ease of use, it enables organizations to deploy AI securely without reliance on cloud-based solutions, reducing costs and regulatory risks.

name: Ursa Major Technologies
description: Ursa Major is a space company focused solely on building turnkey rocket engines that can be used for a variety of applications and space markets. Ursa Major builds oxygen-rich, staged combustion engines — preferred by the world’s advanced space programs — at the engine assembly level, delivering better engine performance.

name: User Interviews
description: User Interviews develops a platform for recruiting, vetting, scheduling, and managing participants for any type of user research. This allows companies to easily, efficiently gather feedback from target users in order to make better product decisions.

name: Usermind
description: Usermind is a customer engagement hub platform that is designed to transform customer engagement from end to end. It helps enterprises to deliver personalized customer journeys that make customers happier, more loyal, and more likely to buy products.

name: Utmost
description: Utmost is a Workday-native alternative to legacy vendor management systems. The platform allows users to source, engage, and pay every category of non-employee from a single entry point.

name: Vahan
description: Vahan uses AI to match job seekers with potential employers within messaging apps. Users can text the service on the messaging app of their choice, take a short quiz, schedule an interview, and get hired quickly and efficiently.

name: Valar Atomics
description: Valar Atomics is building small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) to provide on-site, low-cost power for data centers, heavy industry, and hydrogen production. Built with standard industrial tools and existing supply chains, its helium-cooled reactors can be assembled in weeks instead of years and deliver reliable, scalable energy at costs below fossil fuels.

name: Valence Security
description: Valence Security manages and secures the mesh of interconnected enterprise SaaS applications, workflows, and business processes. With Valence, companies can secure critical SaaS applications (e.g., Microsoft 365, Google, Salesforce) — without impeding business productivity or SaaS adoption and in compliance with both internal policies and industry standards / regulations.

name: Valerie Health
description: Valerie Health is automating the front office of independent medical practices with an AI-native, agentic platform that handles scheduling, referrals, and document workflows end to end. By embedding directly into operations, Valerie replaces administrative overhead with intelligent execution, delivering strong ROI and net revenue retention.

name: Vamana AI
description: Vamana AI is reimagining video infrastructure with a new file format that makes video instantly searchable, streamable, and ready for AI analysis. By storing visual data in a form that AI systems can read directly, it removes costly processing steps and boosts performance for security, streaming, and enterprise workflows.

name: Vanilla
description: Vanilla is the first estate advisory platform designed to help wealth management firms deliver a scalable and simplified estate planning experience, deepening client relationships and driving new business. Combining AI tools, visuals, and expert support, the platform offers client and advisor education, plan visualization and optimization, scenario simulations, tax optimization, and document creation.

name: Vantage Robotics
description: Vantage Robotics offers high-end drones that are designed to make flying HD cameras safe, fun, and easy to use. They are approved for flight over people and controllable by smartphone, and they automatically know to follow and orbit around their user.

name: Varda Space
description: Varda Space is a pioneer in space-based manufacturing and hypersonic reentry logistics, offering the first commercial system for producing materials in microgravity and returning them to Earth. Focused on pharmaceuticals and defense, Varda’s end-to-end solution enables the creation of high-purity products and rapid testing, accelerating innovation in space infrastructure.

name: Vayu Robotics
description: Vayu Robotics is building a scalable, mobile imaging platform intended for autonomous solutions. Its solution combines low-cost sensors with modern computational imaging and AI/ML techniques to enable perception technology that outperforms LiDAR at 1/50th the cost.

name: Vectara
description: Vectara is an end-to-end, trusted generative AI platform that enables product builders to embed powerful gen-AI features into their applications through an API-first, developer-friendly interface. By simplifying the ML operations pipeline, Vectara allows companies with limited AI experience to securely and efficiently implement use cases like conversational AI, semantic search, and research & analysis.

name: Vector
description: Vector is a next-generation defense tech company founded by former special forces operators to address gaps left by traditional contractors in drone and electronic warfare. By embedding with frontline units and rapidly deploying integrated hardware, software, and threat intelligence, Vector delivers modern battlefield solutions at the speed of combat.

name: Vector Space Systems
description: Vector Launch is a developer of cost-efficient and flexible launch options to get hardware into orbit. They connects space startups with affordable launches and platforms to enable space capabilities at a speed and price point never before possible.

name: Veda
description: Veda provides the core infrastructure for building yield-generating DeFi products, powering structured vaults for protocols, fintechs, and custodians across chains. With over $3B deposited by 100K+ users, its modular BoringVault — now adopted by leaders like ether.fi and Mantle — enables secure, customizable strategy deployment at scale.

name: Veem
description: Veem develops cheap and fast cross-border B2B vendor payments for small- and medium-sized businesses. Their platform routes transactions using the lowest-cost transfer method, such as banks, SWIFT and blockchain, enabling businesses to save money.

name: Velostics
description: Velostics a logistics software company that reduces congestion and increases loading/unloading at industrial facilities. The company’s platform increases trucking throughput by automating communication and scheduling among carriers, facilities systems, and logistics teams.

name: Vend Park
description: Vend is an end-to-end SaaS management and payments parking solution that transforms how real estate owners, tenants, and visitors interact with parking. Vend replaces onsite administration and legacy technology with a fully digital solution. Its platform allows garage managers to see all parking sessions in a single place, view detailed reporting and metrics, manage flexible passes, adjust pricing in real time, and more.

name: Vendelux
description: Vendelux offers an AI-powered platform that provides proprietary insights to help companies find the highest-impact ROI events, conferences, and trade shows to attend or sponsor. Vendelux analyzes over 60 million data points to predict event attendance and alert customers of potential leads, using data from event organizers, scraping engines, and enrichment providers.

name: VENN
description: VENN is a premium esports and gaming content platform that seeks to become the gaming generation’s MTV equivalent. Broadcasting live from studios in New York and Los Angeles, their original programming will be distributed across a broad range of media platforms.

name: VenoStent
description: VenoStent is clinical-stage medical device and tissue engineering company that’s developed a new device to vastly improve vascular surgery outcomes. VenoStent’s novel, 3D-printable, shape memory polymer could be useful in various vascular surgery applications, the first of which is addressing access failures in dialysis patients.

name: Venus Aerospace
description: Venus Aerospace focuses hypersonic technology to improve global travel, enabling passengers to travel more quickly and efficiently. The company’s primary aim is to build a plane that can travel across the globe in just an hour. The main complication with traditional hypersonics is the amount of heat put off by engines — causing the device to melt. Venus uses a hypersonic technology that cools the engine.

name: Veralox Therapeutics
description: Veralox is developing first-in-class therapeutics that treat thrombosis, type 1 diabetes, and other immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases. Its novel treatment paradigms are focused on small molecule therapeutics that address the underlying pathologies of these diseases.

name: Verge Labs
description: Verge Labs (formerly Verge Genomics) is an applied artificial intelligence and machine learning company that helps organizations build practical, high-impact AI solutions to improve business performance and decision-making. The company develops custom data products, algorithms, and AI-powered software tailored to specific business challenges, enabling enterprises to unlock insights, automate processes, and generate measurable value from their data.

name: Verishop
description: Verishop is a luxury e-commerce platform that sells a curated selection of men’s and women’s fashion, home goods, and beauty products. They offer category experts and selective shops so users can focus on the style or items that they want to purchase.

name: Veritonic
description: Veritonic's audio intelligence platform enables enterprises to understand, quantify, and optimize the best way to use sound. Its expanding audio intelligence platform measures the impact of audio to discover qualitative and quantitative marketing responses for brands, agencies, and publishers.

name: Verity Studios
description: Verity is a platform designed to enable safe use of large numbers of drones indoors and above people for verticals including entertainment and industry. The company’s Synthetic Swarm drone show combines its proprietary software with its LucieTM micro drones.

name: VeroSkills
description: VeroSkills is an EdTech platform that offers training and mentoring opportunities for underprivileged students, specifically focused on coding and software development. Partnering with nonprofits, the company offers a six-month, self-paced course funded by the nonprofit, leading to placement in a talent pool where corporations hire, paying VeroSkills for its services.

name: Vertical Mass
description: Vertical Mass is a data management platform designed for music, entertainment, and sports data. They are a data solutions company for identifying, understanding, and reaching passionate consumers, and provide businesses with unique consumer insights.

name: Vertiq
description: Vertiq makes smart electric motors, using proprietary hardware designs and advanced control software that enables superior operating performance and substantial cost benefits. Vertiq’s motor solutions offer a clear value proposition to drone and robotics providers. Compared to current modules with similar torque and speed ratings, its motors are 65% less expensive; 55% more compact; and offer 10% increase in flight time, 4x faster response times, and reduced noise.

name: Verto Education
description: Verto Education is an innovative education program that allows students to participate in study abroad programs before entering college. Users spend the first semester of college discovering the world in a space where academics and adventure collide.

name: Vesper Technologies
description: Vesper develops piezoelectric micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) microphones for consumer applications. The company’s microphone design brings studio quality acoustics into handheld devices, and they can withstand water or particle contaminants.

name: Vestmark
description: Vestmark is a wealth management and investment advisory SaaS platform. They provide outsourced services, including model trading and back office services, and help broker dealers and investment managers to provide better outcomes for their investors.

name: Vetted Pet Care
description: Vetted linked veterinary services to the accessibility and comfort of consumers’ homes. These house calls were meant to allow for more relaxed, comfortable pets and more convenient services for consumers, as all they needed to do was book an appointment.

name: Vincere Biosciences
description: Vincere Biosciences is a JLABS incubator company whose mission is to develop drugs to halt the progression of Parkinson’s disease. Their team of CNS drug discovery experts has built a pipeline, leveraging proprietary simulation for rapid advancement.

name: Vincere Health
description: Vincere Health is an application developer that helps lower-income Americans access free or low-cost healthcare. Their first solution, a digital platform to help individuals quit smoking, combines financial incentives with a biofeedback handheld device to help monitor user behavior, and it provides access to remote virtual coaches.

name: Violet
description: Violet is a unified ecommerce API. Their solution provides a centralized conduit between the online shopping experience and a merchants’ ecommerce engine.

name: Virdee
description: Virdee is a SaaS company providing virtual reception and customer engagement software that helps building owners manage and simplify access and authentication experiences for residents, visitors, and property staff. Virdee saves staff time and reduces friction by automating front-of-house workflows and connecting disparate platforms via its mobile application and in-lobby experiences.

name: Vital Plan
description: Vital Plan formulates unique custom-blended supplements. They use the best ingredients and manufacturing partners, as well as a Health Advisory Board to provide users with the most scientifically accurate, effective and safe products and information.

name: Vitrina
description: Vitrina helps entertainment companies in their worldwide vendor and partner selections through the use of its powerful supply-chain search and vendor intel. Its hub covers 50+ countries and 90k+ companies that provide 1000+ specialist services and solutions within the entertainment ecosystem.

name: Vivere Oncotherapies
description: Vivere Oncotherapies is developing a new kind of cancer treatment using a proprietary CRISPR-guided, directed evolution system to engineer viruses that safely target, infect, and kill hard-to-treat solid tumors. These custom-built delivery vehicles recognize multiple tumor markers and carry immune-boosting cargo, offering hope for patients who don’t respond to existing therapies.

name: Voro
description: Voro is a consumer healthcare social network. Users can find doctors, book appointments, and share health advice, navigating their healthcare needs in a trusted environment.

name: Vorticity
description: Vorticity has created a unique cloud accessible scientific computing platform through custom silicon accelerators for tackling some of the world’s hardest computational problems. Designed to make computers fast for fluid dynamics modeling, the company’s chips enable clients to speed up critical computing. The solution is tailored for industries such as aerospace, life sciences, and nuclear energy.

name: Vouch
description: Vouch is a new kind of digital insurer that protects startups from mistakes, litigation, and attacks. Their technology-first approach enables entrepreneurs to protect their business assets with tailored next-day coverage and expert guidance, all on a centralized platform.

name: VOW
description: Vow is a vertical SaaS platform built for sports, media, and entertainment professionals, transforming the fragmented $1.6T global events market. It streamlines event and guest management by integrating seating, ticketing, communications, and stakeholder coordination into one seamless solution.

name: Vultron
description: Vultron is transforming federal contracting with an AI-driven platform that streamlines government proposal development, cutting timelines from 28 days to just 8 while delivering a 92% efficiency boost. The scalable platform automates compliance checks, data synthesis, and content creation, ensuring full adherence to complex government regulations with unparalleled speed and accuracy.

name: Vyrill
description: Vyrill develops an artificial intelligence tool designed to focus on video insights, licensing, and content marketing. They use user-generated video to enable social commerce and content marketing, helping businesses monitor competitors and results.

name: Waivr
description: Waivr is building the payments infrastructure for the subscription economy. Waivr brings the Real-Time Payments network to the subscription economy (ex: (e.g., AT&T, Verizon, Netflix, Hulu, Spotify) by eliminating bounced payments and reducing chargeback. This enables merchants to get paid instantly and eliminates high-cost processing intermediaries.

name: Wander
description: Wander is verticalizing the 100B+ short-term rental industry. It owns 100% of its homes to consistently deliver high-quality smart technology and inspiring locations for guests. Wander’s fully verticalized STR platform is oriented to the top of the market. It owns the homes, property management, and technology. Wander’s guest data enables it to iterate the guest experience toward perfection and to fully realize adjacent branding and other market opportunities.

name: Wasabi
description: Wasabi provides simple, predictable and affordable hot cloud storage for businesses all over the world. It enables organizations to store and instantly access an unlimited amount of data at one-fifth the price of its competition — with no complex tiers or unpredictable egress fees.

name: Wave
description: Wave is developing a first-of-its-kind health and wellness coach training program to cultivate future generations of coaches who concentrate on emotional well-being. Their 9-week course builds a strong foundation in evidence-based coaching competencies to enable coaches to help increase access to quality behavior healthcare services. Completion of the course provides eligibility to sit for the National Board for Health and Wellness Coaches Certificate Exam.

name: WaveOne
description: WaveOne is leveraging the latest advancements in machine learning and deep learning to reinvent the way video is compressed, transported, stored, and analyzed. Their AI-native compression can be optimized for specific types of video, dramatically improving coding efficiency.

name: Wealth
description: Wealth is a comprehensive platform that makes estate planning estate that offers easy planning, accessibility, and secure storage. Wealth enables members to create, manage, and visualize their estate plans through an integrated ecosystem of proprietary legal documents, third-party APIs, and a bank-level-encrypted digital vault.

name: Wearlinq
description: WearLinq delivers AI-powered cardiac diagnostics through eWave™, the first FDA-cleared, 6-lead wireless ECG patch for continuous outpatient heart monitoring. By uniting proprietary multimodal hardware, an integrated clinical platform, and automated reporting, WearLinq offers a scalable, cost-effective alternative to traditional monitoring systems in the growing U.S. ambulatory cardiac care market.

name: WeatherXM
description: WeatherXM offers advanced weather forecasting and analytics, operating a decentralized network of over 8,000 weather stations worldwide to enhance data accuracy. The company provides precise forecasts and real-time, hyper-local weather data to reduce economic losses in sectors like agriculture, insurance, and energy.

name: Weekend
description: Weekend (formerly Volley) is an audio entertainment company redefining game night through voice AI games. With family-favorites like Jeopardy! and Wheel of Fortune, plus cutting-edge generative AI games. Weekend builds, purchases, and licenses audio games and other forms of voice-controlled interactive content. It then distributes this content through Amazon’s Alexa-enabled products, Google’s Google Home products, smart TVs, and other channels.

name: WelbeHealth
description: Physician-led WelbeHealth offers comprehensive person care services to keep the most vulnerable seniors living safely in their own homes. Its care team coordinates senior care, including all medical and dental care, physical and occupational therapy, transportation to medical appointments, meals, and personal care services.

name: Welcome
description: Welcome is a closing and total rewards platform for Human Resource teams. Their digital offer experience uses proprietary, real-time compensation and equity data to help users make better offers and manage pay equity.

name: Welcome Homes
description: Welcome Homes is an online platform that allows home buyers, financing, contractors, and landowners to coordinate the design and building of custom homes. Customers can customize the design of their home to their liking with full transparency on the pricing before the purchase.

name: Wendi
description: Wendi is an intelligent “front desk” automation platform for small and midsize businesses, starting with healthcare providers. Wendi automates the entire patient intake process, including communications, screening, insurance verification, and scheduling. The platform’s omnichannel capabilities across webchat, text, messaging, and phone system is HIPPA-compliant.

name: What3Words
description: What3words enables each three-meter square in the world to have a reliable three-word address. This makes any place or address more accessible, so users can find their tents at festivals, navigate to B&Bs, and direct emergency services to the right place.

name: Wheels
description: Wheels provides safe, sustainable, comfortable, and reliable micro transportation. They provide customers helmets and scooters and are working closely with cities to provide green, efficient transportation.

name: Wheels Up
description: Wheels Up is a private jet charter company that allows members to book short- and medium-range private charter flights. They offer private aviation services that reduce the cost to fly privately, enabling individual, family, and corporate members to book flights, manage their accounts, and participate in ride-shares through the mobile-based app.

name: When
description: When is an AI-driven tech platform and healthcare severance solution that supports employees through offboarding, life changes, and navigating the health insurance market, while saving companies time and money. When provides an alternative to COBRA subsidies, offering fixed-dollar reimbursements for healthcare premiums after an involuntary job loss, saving companies significant costs and mitigating risks.

name: Whistle Labs
description: Whistle develops GPS-based activity trackers for pets. These trackers monitor pets’ health and locations, analyze activity levels of potentially problematic behaviors, and help owners track events of their pets’ day, with real-time notifications.

name: Willow
description: Willow Innovations is the developer of a hands-free, wearable breast pump that has 100% spill-proof, 360-degree mobility. The Willow Pump features an all-in-one, in-bra design with no external cords, tubes, or bottles — to give moms unprecedented freedom.

name: Wind
description: Wind is a non-custodial crypto wallet on the Solana blockchain simplifying DeFi investing (“PayPal for Web3”). Wind simplifies DeFi investing, enabling investors to achieve higher interest rates and send cross-border remittance payments instantly with zero fees.

name: Windup Minds
description: Windup Minds aims to revolutionize digital entertainment by creating immersive experiences by combining AI and virtual reality. Its flagship product lets users interact with a lifelike virtual reality pet in a fully immersive VR environment.

name: Winn
description: Winn is a real-time AI sales assistant that guides reps through live calls, ensures key questions are covered, and automatically updates CRM systems. y eliminating manual note-taking and enforcing consistent execution, Winn helps large sales teams improve data quality and deal outcomes without adding admin burden.

name: Wispr AI
description: Wispr has developed an innovative brain-computer interface (BCI) that enhances productivity by allowing users to complete tasks through articulated thoughts, facilitated by a Bluetooth-like headset. To use the device, a user simply has to put the headset on and “lip-sync” words (i.e., talk completely silently), a process that is 5-6x quicker than typing.

name: Woebot
description: Woebot develops digital therapeutics for the mental health space. Their AI-enabled chatbot platform acts as a relational agent that can establish a therapeutic bond with users and provide therapeutic support.

name: Womaness
description: Womaness offers innovative menopause products with accessible, safe, and chic solutions in skin and body care, feminine care, sexual health, and supplements. Its products are formulated alongside a panel of menopausal experts who specialize in menopause, women’s health, nutrition, and skincare

name: Wootric
description: Wootric is a customer feedback management platform that combines insights from customer and employee feedback with machine learning. Its software analyzes qualitative data in real-time, allowing companies to increase customer retention or engagement.

name: Work&
description: Work& (fka Work & Mother) creates turnkey wellness suites that support both new mothers and all employees with private, well-equipped spaces for pumping, telehealth, meditation, and more. Through its offerings, the company helps landlords and employers meet legal requirements, achieve ESG goals, and promote a healthier, more inclusive workplace.

name: Workbrew
description: Workbrew (fka Raise.dev) simplifies deploying, securing, and managing open-source tools from Homebrew, a developer's ‘Appstore’ for macOS and Linux with over 35 million users. Workbrew enables companies using Homebrew to have faster onboarding, quickly mitigated security vulnerabilities, and consistency in Homebrew usage across teams and projects.

name: Worksphere
description: Worksphere is an integrated software platform that supports a safe return to the office post-pandemic and prepares employers for future workplace needs. The solution helps both employers and employees comply with coronavirus regulations through automated wellness surveys and contact tracing, as well as adapt to flexible work arrangements via a desk reservation and scheduling interface.

name: WorldCover
description: WorldCover develops crop insurance for smallholder farmers who live in Africa and around the world. They use satellites to monitor the rainfall and trigger payouts automatically, so farmers can analyze data, and invest in their most productive crops.

name: Wrench
description: Wrench is an online platform designed to book appointments for on-site car repair services. Users can easily find auto repair that works around their own schedule, work with full-time trusted mechanics who come to them, and enjoy a one-year warranty.

name: Wylei
description: Wylei uses adaptive cloud-based Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to help businesses create dynamic digital direct marketing content. Their Predictive AI enables the delivery of real-time, personalized content for an engaging user experience.

name: X-Energy
description: X-energy develops commercial nuclear reactors, giving users access to zero-emission energy that is safe, reliable, secure, and affordable. Its high-temperature, gas-cooled nuclear reactors are smaller, simpler, and melt-down proof compared to conventional nuclear designs.

name: Xanadu
description: Xanadu is one of the world's leading quantum computing hardware and software companies, offering a cloud-accessible, state-of-the-art computing platform. Taking a full-stack approach, the company builds photonics-based quantum computer hardware, as well as its own multi-platform software, that can be easily scaled for large and complex scientific and industrial computing applications.

name: Xaptum
description: Xaptum develops patented hardware security that is designed for the Internet of Things (IoT). They simplify the orchestration of secure data exchange between users’ Things and Clouds by utilizing a software-defined, multi-tenant IPv6-overlay network.

name: Xcelerium
description: Xcelerium develops high-performance, reconfigurable semiconductors that power AI-driven edge devices in robotics, aerospace, and defense with unmatched speed and efficiency. Its next-generation chip technology enhances real-time sensor fusion, wireless communications, radar, and computer vision, delivering 100x more processing power and 30x better energy efficiency across critical applications.

name: Xplore
description: Xplore is a Space-as-a-Service company that provides hosted payloads, communication relay services, and exclusive datasets to its customers via the Xcraft, the company’s multi-mission spacecraft. Xplore gathers data by organizing and combining multiple sensors on the same spacecraft. This provides unique data fusion capabilities and results in dramatic cost advantages versus single-sensor satellites.

name: Yaqumo
description: Yaqumo develops fault-tolerant quantum computers using a proprietary neutral-atom architecture, targeting research institutions, governments, and data centers globally. Its dual-isotope system enables local readout without atom transport, eliminating key scaling bottlenecks that limit quantum computing approaches and supporting large-scale quantum error correction.

name: YASSIR
description: YASSIR is building the "Super App" for French-speaking Africa. Their platform will provide an ecosystem of services – such as Uber, Doordash, Instacart, and digital banking–all delivered in a single app.

name: Yield
description: Yield (Formerly Bridge Money) is a rewards and engagement platform that helps financial institutions and fintech companies increase customer retention through personalized cashback, rewards, and earning experiences. The company’s software enables banks, credit unions, and financial apps to launch branded rewards programs that drive user engagement, encourage spending, and create new monetization opportunities.

name: Yoneda Labs
description: Yoneda Labs is pioneering an AI-driven foundation model that accelerates drug development and enhances chemical manufacturing efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Its platform helps chemists optimize reactions in days instead of weeks while reducing the overall costs of drug synthesis.

name: You.com
description: You.com is an AI search assistant that delivers accurate, traceable, and real-time information for consumers and enterprises. By integrating the latest large language models with real-time data sourcing, You.com ensures reliable, up-to-date results, enabling users to perform advanced, multi-step searches with ease.

name: yours
description: Yours is a personalization platform and holistic brand for skincare and related self-care products. On Yours’ platform, users answer questions about their environment and lifestyle, then upload a selfie analyzed by computer vision and machine learning. On the basis of their data analysis, Yours recommends personalized formulations and routines powered by its patented ingredients at a fraction of the luxury skincare price.

name: Yuhu
description: Yuhu is an end-to-end property management system for multifamily, residential, and commercial property owners. Their modular platform provides robust, day-to-day operations functionality for leasing, payments, maintenance, and resident experience.

name: Yumi
description: Yumi is a science-based early childhood meal delivery program. They offer over 50 flavors of freshly made organic baby food that can be delivered right to consumers’ doorsteps on a weekly basis.

name: Zaam
description: Zaam is an end-to-end workflow for business onboarding in the financial services sector. Their solution offers a white-label interface for data collection, customized checks on individuals and businesses, and intuitive case management tools.

name: Zagster
description: Zagster was a mobile-based platform that helped connect users with sustainable types of transportation, including scooters and electric bikes. The company operated bike-sharing programs for cities and universities in search of a micro-mobility program.

name: Zapata AI
description: Zapata AI’s solutions are tailored to enterprises’ domain-specific, industrial-scale business problems to drive growth, savings, and unprecedented insight. Zapata AI’s solutions are tailored to enterprises’ domain-specific, industrial-scale business problems to drive growth, savings and unprecedented insight.

name: Zen Business
description: ZenBusiness empowers the next generation of entrepreneurs, small business owners, and freelancers by making it easier to start, run, and grow a successful business. Their technology and automated processes provide a fast and low-cost business formation service that holds down costs and offers the most customized business formation experience online.

name: Zendar
description: Zendar is developing high-resolution imaging radar for autonomous vehicles and other applications. Their imaging system combines the benefits of radar, such as long-range and all-weather operation, with the precision of lidar, helping make autonomous driving safe and accessible for everyone.

name: Zeno
description: Zeno is developing an efficient electric motorbike that utilizes swappable batteries ("Battery-as-a-Service") to get riders back on the road faster, particularly for high-mileage commercial use applications. Swappable batteries provide a solution to range limitations since drivers can simply stop at a Zeno battery-charging station and swap out their battery for a new one, eliminating the down time from waiting for a full charge-up.

name: Zeno Power
description: Zeno Power is pioneering radioisotope power systems (RPS) that convert nuclear waste into long-lasting, carbon-free energy for space, maritime, and remote applications. With contracts from NASA, the U.S. Navy, and the Space Force, Zeno is scaling nuclear battery technology to power autonomous systems, satellites, and lunar missions for years.

name: Zenpli
description: Zenpli partners with fintechs in LatAm by providing an API platform that can quickly, easily, and cost-effectively streamline all customer identification decisions. The company’s no-code platform runs accurate identity decisions such as onboarding, KYC, compliance, and fraud management, enabling clients to run accurate end-to-end identity decisions.

name: Zenskar
description: Zenskar builds software to help SaaS companies automate their billing workflows. Zenskar allows SaaS companies to generate bills, no matter the basis for their complex pricing plans. Its flexible platform accommodates everything from usage-based pricing, subscriptions, nuanced discounts, credits, custom currencies, prepaid, and ramp deals.

name: Zephyr Fusion
description: Zephyr Fusion is developing compact fusion power systems designed specifically for use in space, where power is the limiting factor for many emerging applications. By rethinking fusion around the unique conditions of orbit, the company aims to make abundant, high-power energy available for the next generation of space infrastructure.

name: Zero
description: Zero Grocery is the first zero-waste, online grocery solution for consumers and manufacturers. Customers can access 900+ quality goods without plastic waste, at discounted cost and have them delivered right to their front door.

name: ZeroAvia
description: ZeroAvia is the developer of electric powertrains for aviation. The company uses hydrogen fuel cells to lower fuel and maintenance costs, resulting in up to 50% total trip cost reduction compared to traditional jet powertrains.

name: ZeroCater
description: Zero Cater sources meals from restaurants, caterers, and food trucks, in order to offer a wide variety of catered meals and snacks for business customers. They match users’ office with the right restaurant and snack partners, and create custom menus.

name: ZeroEyes
description: ZeroEyes is a security company specializing in AI-powered gun detection, designed to provide real-time alerts and actionable intelligence to prevent gun violence. By integrating its technology with existing security cameras, ZeroEyes enables rapid response times and enhances situational awareness for first responders.

name: Zeus
description: Zeus develops expertly appointed, inspected, full-service corporate housing units for today’s global professional. Users can enjoy smartly furnished neighborhood homes for extended stays in areas such as the Bay Area, Washington, D.C., and New York City.

name: Zevvy
description: Zevvy (formerly Flux EV) is building a platform to accelerate affordable and equitable financing of electric vehicles for all drivers. Its flexible-lease platform eliminates the traditional barriers of leases and loans — like mileage caps, three-year terms, and sky-high upfront payments. Zevvy also offers dedicated support to ease customers’ transition to electric.

name: Zight
description: Zight (formerly CloudApp) is an asynchronous communication platform enabling better communications through instantly shareable videos, screenshots, and screen recordings. Its website provides an intuitive experience and enhanced search capabilities that allows users to share information with clarity, flexibility, and efficiency.

name: Zippity
description: Zippity is a mobile car maintenance service that is migrating toward a software only solution for 2021. Its software helps with scheduling and other customer experience tools like online payment and digital service reports.

name: Zone7
description: Zone7 is a human performance optimization system. The platform uses AI to predict injuries, burnout, and fatigue in high performance athletes.

name: Zoo
description: Zoo (fka KittyCAD) is the developer of infrastructure and CAD software for hardware design. The platform brings generative AI and ML to hardware design, enabling developers for industries like robotics and aerospace to design parts with natural language.

name: Zoog
description: Zoog leverages technology to provide a simple, immersive way for people (often parents and grandparents) to virtually connect with their children through storytelling and interactive videos. As an example, grandparents can record themselves reading a story, while the app adds animations, filters, sound effects, and music to create engaging, interactive content and a deeper connection with the children.

name: Zordi
description: Zordi is developing a modular, autonomous greenhouse platform operated by AI and robots to grow high-quality produce. They are committed to feeding the world with sustainably grown fresh fruits and vegetables. To create short and efficient supply chains, they envision Zordi greenhouses operating near major cities, ensuring that fresh produce is readily available anywhere.

name: Zycada Networks
description: Zycada enables faster online shopping experiences by leveraging the power and scale of bot technology. Their platform has been proven to improve page load times for dynamic content by 10x and boost load performance for even the most optimized e-commerce sites.

name: ZZ Driggs
description: ZZ Driggs offers exceptionally crafted and sustainable furniture on demand, designed by independent studios and easy for consumers and businesses to rent, buy, or both. The company offers a marketplace where consumers and businesses can rent high-end furniture directly from the furniture craftsmen, and ZZ Driggs handles all of the delivery, logistics, and customer interactions. All furniture can be rented with an option to buy any time.

name: Stateful Robotics
description: Stateful Robotics is an embodied AI company developing decision intelligence technology for mobile robots operating in unpredictable, real-world environments. Its platform builds a persistent model of tasks, environments and past behaviour, enabling robots to plan over longer time horizons, adapt to disruption, and perform more reliably in the field. Already live with pilot customers in sectors such as infrastructure and logistics, Stateful is bringing an essential intelligence layer to robotics deployments where tightly scripted approaches break down. Spun out from the University of Oxford, the company is focused on helping autonomous systems scale more effectively across complex industrial environments.

name: OKAPI:Orbits
description: OKAPI:Orbits is a German software-as-a-service start-up making space operations safer and more sustainable through collision avoidance and space traffic management. As experts in Space Situational Awareness and Space Surveillance & Tracking, the company provides continuous monitoring, conjunction prediction, and alerting services, and recommends evasive manoeuvres to protect valuable space assets and reduce debris creation. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: UniSieve
description: UniSieve enables the scalable fabrication of mechanically flexible molecular-sieving membranes that separate hydrocarbons and CO₂ via a size-exclusion mechanism—replacing energy-intensive thermal distillation. By adopting UniSieve’s separation solutions, customers cut energy use, reduce emissions, improve their carbon footprint, and increase product recovery. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: ATMOS Space Cargo
description: ATMOS Space Cargo delivers a scalable, cost-efficient solution to bring cargo back from space. Its Inflatable Atmospheric Decelerators (IADs) act first as a heat shield and then as a high-velocity parachute, protecting payloads during re-entry. The approach is tailored to each object—from shoebox-sized experiments to the largest rocket stages—enabling safe, repeatable recovery at low cost. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: Vertus Energy
description: Vertus Energy develops ground-breaking technology that uses electricity to stimulate bacteria in anaerobic digestion (AD), dramatically increasing biogas output. Its product, BRIO, enables AD plants to process 3× more waste in the same tank while delivering biogas with 60% higher energy potential. BRIO can be retrofitted to existing facilities as well as deployed in new builds, allowing seamless testing and integration without interrupting ongoing digestion processes. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: Gemesys
description: GEMESYS is developing the architecture for a fully analogue AI chip inspired by the human brain, delivering step-change resource efficiency to overcome today’s compute bottlenecks and enable truly efficient edge AI. The design mirrors key brain-like information-processing mechanisms, allowing AI hardware vendors to offer a novel chip that supports both on-device inference and training—cutting latency and energy use while improving privacy. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: HyperHeat
description: HyperHeat develops ultra-efficient electric heaters to decarbonise heavy industry by replacing fossil fuels in high-temperature process heat, which accounts for 20% of global CO₂ emissions. Its breakthrough hot-air system reaches up to 2,000 °C with 95–98% efficiency and is designed for rapid integration, scalability, and low degradation—enabling megatonne-scale CO₂ reductions across sectors such as steel, cement, and chemicals. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund.

name: enaDyne
description: enaDyne is a Leipzig-based climate tech company developing modular, fully electric, non-thermal plasma reactors that convert CO₂ and other process gases into valuable chemicals and abate hard-to-treat emissions such as CF₄ and PFAS. With a patented electrode and catalyst platform, enaDyne combines high energy efficiency, operational flexibility, and scalable, containerised deployment—enabling customers to produce sustainable chemicals at or below fossil prices. Backed by the Amadeus APEX Technology Fund, the company operates as a technology OEM with recurring revenues from proprietary consumables.

name: Periphery
description: Periphery (formerly Qomodo) is a UK-based cybersecurity company securing the edge of critical systems—from drones and autonomous vehicles to industrial sensors and battlefield technologies. Designed for the embedded and extended Internet of Things (XIoT), Periphery’s platform defends the world’s most resource-constrained and security-critical devices against modern threats. Founded by former NATO and BAE Systems engineers, Periphery provides lightweight, AI-driven software agents that embed directly onto devices—enabling real-time threat detection, anomaly monitoring, and lifecycle protection without compromising performance. Its zero-trust architecture and in-device observability ensure compliance with global cybersecurity standards, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and IEC 62443. Periphery’s solutions are deployed globally, including in active conflict zones, where its technology helps protect drone fleets and autonomous systems in hostile environments.

name: Recurvia
description: Recurvia (previously known as Inephany) is a London-based deep-tech start-up, founded in July 2024, that pioneers foundation models designed to automate and optimise how other AI systems are trained, tuned and deployed. Its real-time, AI-driven optimisation platform intelligently controls the training process, boosting sample efficiency, accelerating convergence and raising final model performance while slashing compute costs and energy use — an order-of-magnitude leap over traditional trial-and-error methods. The company was founded by Dr John Torr (ex-Apple Siri) and Maurice von Sturm (co-founders of conversational-AI start-up Wluper) and is chaired by AI pioneer Professor Steve Young. Together this team of engineers, research scientists and entrepreneurs is rethinking AI at a system level to make cutting-edge models faster, greener and more affordable across domains ranging from large language models to computer vision and time-series forecasting.

name: Ciphergen Biosystems
description: Ciphergen Biosystems developed a unique technology, using a patented protein chip to detect proteins within biological samples. The technology proved efficient and cost-effective. Ciphergen customers included many of the largest pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide, as well as government agencies, research institutions and universities. Working with customers to develop new products and applications, Ciphergen became a leader in biomarker discovery, assay development and characterisation. Amadeus invested in Ciphergen in its $29 million pre-IPO financing round in March 2000. The company successfully floated on NASDAQ.

name: Oxford Nanopore Technologies
description: Oxford Nanopore Technologies, founded in 2005, developed a novel generation of DNA/RNA sequencing technology that delivers rich data, is fast, accessible, and easy to use. The company aims to disrupt conventional biological analysis and enable new applications with a profound, positive impact on society. Its sequencing technology is used across a wide range of biological research areas—including human genetics, cancer, agriculture, food science, environmental monitoring, and pathogen analysis. Oxford Nanopore’s platform has been deployed in over 70 countries to sequence SARS-CoV-2, the virus responsible for COVID-19.

name: V7 Labs
description: V7 is building the foundation for Trustworthy AI—unleashing the true power of artificial intelligence by combining machine efficiency with human insight. The company draws inspiration from the human visual cortex—specifically the six areas, V1 through V6, that enable the brain to interpret shape, colour, motion, and meaning. Just as the Cambrian explosion 540 million years ago gave rise to the sense of sight and an explosion of diversity, V7 aims to spark a new era of “living software”—granting machines the power of vision and multiplying the tasks they can perform.

name: Altana AI
description: Altana AI is a US-based technology company on a mission to improve global commerce through AI-powered value chain intelligence. Founded by leaders in supply chain artificial intelligence, the company helps governments, enterprises, and financial institutions build safe, lawful, inclusive, and resilient supply chains. Altana’s platform—the world’s first value chain management system—provides deep visibility and real-time risk intelligence across global supply networks, without requiring users to share sensitive data. By mapping and understanding complex, dynamic trade relationships, Altana enables smarter decision-making at the speed of commerce. The company works with customs authorities and multinational enterprises across North America, Europe, and Asia to drive more secure, compliant, and transparent global trade.

name: Pimloc
description: Founded in 2016, Pimloc builds deep learning systems to protect and manage sensitive visual data in video and image collections. Its proprietary AI platform, Secure Redact, enables private and public organisations to automate video redaction, protect personal data by default, and meet data privacy compliance—280x faster than manual processes. Trained on real-world, low-quality footage from sources like CCTV, body cams, and smartphones, Secure Redact can intelligently remove faces, number plates, or other identifiers. Pimloc’s technology is trusted across mobility, insurance, broadcasting, law enforcement, and more—unlocking the value of video while ensuring privacy is preserved.

name: Quibim
description: Quibim is a leader in imaging biomarkers for life sciences, pioneering advanced algorithms that transform medical imaging data into actionable predictions in oncology, immunology, and neurology. Headquartered in Valencia, the company employs more than 90 people and has built a diverse team of AI specialists from over 10 nationalities. Quibim has also expanded globally, with offices in Madrid, Barcelona, New York, and Cambridge (UK).

name: Xampla
description: Xampla has created the world’s first plant protein material for commercial use. A spin-out from the University of Cambridge, Xampla’s mission is to replace everyday single-use plastics, like bags, sachets and flexible packing film, and microplastics within liquids and lotions. Existing natural, primarily polysaccharide materials typically cannot match the performance of plastic without chemical additions. Xampla’s plant protein material does not require linking with harmful solvents to make it a viable alternative to synthetic polymers.

name: XYZ Reality
description: XYZ Reality is a construction technology company revolutionising the industry with the XYZ Atom™, the world’s first Engineering Grade Augmented Reality (AR) headset.
