name: Agtonomy
description: Agtonomy is pioneering physical AI solutions to transform agriculture and off-road industries, enabling autonomous operations for equipment like tractors to address labor shortages, boost efficiency, and promote sustainable practices in orchards, vineyards, and beyond.

name: Airspace
description: Airspace is a growth-stage technology-enabled logistics company focused on making the most urgent time-critical shipments cheaper, more reliable, and more cost-effective. Airspace addresses the challenges of time-critical shipping with its novel technology stack consisting of AI/ML models that process quadrillions of possible routes to provide the optimal combination of shipping routes by factoring in speed, cost, and environmental impact.

name: Andela
description: In the next ten years, there will be 1.3M software development jobs created and only 400,000 domestic computer science graduates to fill them. Africa, meanwhile, is home to the largest untapped talent pool and seven of the 10 fastest growing internet populations in the world. Andela is building a network of technology leaders on the African continent and bridging the divide between the U.S and African tech sectors. Leveraging a proven, data-driven approach, the company builds high-performing engineering teams with Africa’s top developers to help companies overcome the tech talent shortage and build better products, faster.

name: Apeel Sciences
description: Apeel Sciences is a company that’s fighting the global food waste crisis by utilizing nature’s tools to prevent waste in the first place — a sustainable approach to the world’s growing food demands. The company’s plant-derived products help USDA Organic Certified and conventional fresh food growers, suppliers, and retailers maintain produce quality and slow spoilage, which minimizes food waste from the farm to the kitchen. Apeel Sciences was founded in 2012 with a grant from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation to help reduce postharvest food loss in developing countries that lack access to refrigeration. Today, Apeel formulations have been proven effective at reducing the rate of spoilage for dozens of USDA Organic Certified and conventional produce categories, and the company works with partners ranging from smallholder farmers and local organic growers to the world’s largest food brands and retailers.

name: Bellwether Coffee
description: Bellwether is making coffee roasting more accessible, and more sustainable for the environment and our communities. With the most consistent and controllable roaster available, Bellwether’s customers—from large brands to small neighborhood cafes—are in complete control of their coffee offerings using Bellwether’s electric, ventless, zero-emissions coffee roaster and intuitive roasting software.

name: BrightSource Energy
description: Brightsource Energy, Inc. (formerly Luz II) is a builder and operator of renewable power plants for industrial and utility customers in the United States. The company’s energy generation approach is based on solar-thermal created steam supplemented with gas, providing more stable and more profitable power generation for utilities than other types of renewable energy like wind, hydro and photovoltaic. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include VantagePoint Venture Partners, Draper Fisher Jurvetson and Morgan Stanley.

name: BurnBot
description: BurnBot is revolutionizing wildfire prevention through mechanized vegetation management and prescribed fire technologies, using remote-operated vehicles to efficiently reduce fuel loads, dramatically increase the pace and scale of forest and landscape management, minimize smoke, and restore ecosystems while addressing escalating property and climate risks.

name: Chestnut Carbon
description: Chestnut Carbon develops high-quality, nature-based carbon removal projects in the United States, including both afforestation and improved forest management. Chestnut’s afforestation work restores marginal and degraded ag lands by planting native, biodiverse forests that benefit local communities and ecosystems and are subsequently monitored with proprietary technology. The company also works with individual landowners to develop a portfolio of high-quality, long-duration improved forest management projects.

name: eLoan
description: E-LOAN is a leading online provider of mortgages, offering consumers the ability to obtain the most suitable mortgages from a wide array of lenders at substantial savings. E-LOAN’s easy-to-use website enables borrowers to search through over 50,000 products provided by over 70 lending sources to find the most competitively priced loans that match the borrowers’ criteria.

name: eMeter
description: eMeter provides energy efficiency software and integration services that allows utilities to manage and utilize the data collected from automated utility meters. eMeter’s software platform enables applications such as enhanced billing, outage restoration, load monitoring and demand response. eMeter’s software provides utilities with detailed dynamic electricity usage information which can be used to identify unaccountable energy use and losses, as well as to support innovative programs that reduce the need to build power plants used for peak demand days only. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Foundation Capital and Sequoia Capital. eMeter was acquired by Siemens in December of 2011.

name: Farmers Business Network
description: Farmers Business Network (FBN) is an independent and unbiased℠, farmer-to-farmer agronomic information network. FBN’s services organize and seamlessly integrate farmers’ data with FBN analytics. Members can benchmark fields across multiple dimensions, access FBN Intelligence℠ insights derived from the community’s billions of data points, and explore the FBN Seed Finder℠ with real world seed performance on hundreds of seeds across a dozen crops.

name: Fiber Global
description: Fiber Global is a climate technology company focused on advancing building materials. Their mission is to reclaim abundant global waste streams to create sustainable, high performing building materials. Their flagship product, Forged Fiber Board (FFB) reclaims corrugated cardboard to manufacture panels that are used in the furniture and construction industries.

name: Five Prime Therapeutics
description: FivePrime is discovering and developing novel therapeutic proteins and antibodies by systematically screening all relevant proteins in the human body to find the best protein for treatment of a given clinical indication. FivePrime’s ProScreen Engine enables the rapid production and screening of all therapeutically relevant proteins in medically-focused assays at the highest quality standards in the industry. This powerful approach is the polar opposite of the industry’s traditional “one protein at a time”. The ProScreen Engine comprises the definitive protein collection and screening process for biologics discovery and is unprecedented in its efficiency, quality and scale. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Domain Associates, Versant Ventures, Kleiner Perkins Caufield and Byers, Texas Pacific Group, HealthCap and Advanced Technology Ventures.

name: Kateeva
description: Kateeva has developed an innovative manufacturing process for Organic Light Emitting Diode (OLED) displays to enable the transition of the flat panel display market to this technology. In addition to DBL Partners , investors include: Madrone Capital Partners, Sigma Partners, Spark Capital, Musea Ventures.

name: Labcyte
description: Labcyte Inc. is a laboratory instrumentation company with a novel approach to dispensing small volumes of liquids for life sciences applications. Labcyte’s acoustic dispensing technology uses a focused beam of acoustic energy to eject nanoliter-scale droplets of fluid from one plate to another, with high accuracy at low volumes and reduced consumables costs. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Alloy Ventures, Abingworth, New Leaf Venture Partners and Cross Atlantic Partners.

name: Mapbox
description: Mapbox is the location data platform for mobile and web applications. We provide building blocks to add location features like maps, search, and navigation into any experience you create. We’re changing the way people move around cities and explore our world. Through the apps Mapbox powers, we reach more than 300 million people each month. Location is built into the fabric of our daily experiences. Whether you’re exploring a city with Lonely Planet, sharing with friends on Snapchat, seeing if it’s going to rain on Weather.com, tracking breaking news on Bloomberg, or checking your ETA in Lyft — location is essential to every one of these applications, and they’re powered by Mapbox. We craft beautiful maps and developer-friendly location data, APIs, and SDKs so that you’re free to focus on designing, building, and developing your application. Our open-source tools let analytics companies understand big geo data, drone companies publish flyovers, real estate sites visualize properties, satellite companies process cloud-free imagery, and insurance companies track assets. Mapbox proudly embraces our open-source roots. We work in the open and release as much code as possible. We believe it’s the right thing for people, technology, and business.

name: Mast
description: Mast Reforestation is building a one-stop solution for reforestation that includes seed collection, tree replanting, and carbon offset generation. As climate change continues to drive more frequent and severe wildfires, Mast Reforestation’s approach accelerates the timeline to begin fire-scarred ecosystem restoration from years to months. Mast Reforestation’s acquisition of SilvaSeed, a 130-year-old leader in seed and seedling production, makes it the largest seed bank West of the Mississippi. The company is leveraging this seed supply and its FAA-approved drone technology to scale reforestation efforts across the West. In the process, the company generates high-quality, forward-looking carbon offsets that incentivize landowners of all kinds to restore forests and the vital ecosystem services they provide.

name: Menlo Micro
description: Menlo Micro is an Irvine, California-based technology company focused on bringing innovations in semiconductor manufacturing to electronic switches to create a more energy efficient and sustainable world. Menlo Micro’s advanced microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) switch, the Ideal Switch, has significant size, power consumption, and performance benefits relative to legacy switches used across a wide range industries including medical, aerospace, automotive, telecom, and home electronics. The Ideal Switch is tiny, fast, reliable, withstands extreme temperatures, is ultra-low loss, and can handle 1,000s of Watts.

name: NEXTracker
description: NEXTracker designs, develops, and manufactures industry-leading silicon PV products. NexTracker’s unique cell multiplication technology maximizes the energy yield of silicon PV, accelerating the cost savings that will make solar energy competitive in the world market. Using a proprietary singulation and packaging process, NexTracker delivers the high-efficiency performance of crystalline silicon with the standard module format, but brings the cost down by using less silicon. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include CMEA, NGEN Partners and Sigma Partners.

name: OPX Biotechnologies
description: OPXBIO uses its proprietary, leading EDGE™ (Efficiency Directed Genome Engineering) technology to manufacture renewable bio-based chemicals and fuels that are lower cost, higher return and more sustainable than existing petroleum-based products. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include:X/Seed Capital, USRG, Mohr Davidow, Braemar Energy Ventures and Wolfensohn & Co.

name: Pallet
description: Pallet is a social purpose company that manufactures rapid-response shelter products in Everett, Washington. Pallet’s prefabricated shelters can be utilized for homeless housing, disaster response housing, or temporary workforce housing. Pallet’s shelter villages are designed to be extremely low-cost, easily shipped, and rapidly assembled in a matter of hours. Pallet is a purpose driven company that includes formerly incarcerated or homeless individuals in its employee base.

name: Pandora
description: Pandora’s mission is to define what radio is in a connected world. Pandora is an online unicast radio station which instantly creates personalized streaming stations tailored specifically for each user. Users can influence the station by giving songs “thumbs-up” or “thumbs-down”. Users can create up to 100 different stations. The company began in 2000 when founder, Tim Westergren, launched The Music Genome Project to create the most comprehensive analysis of music ever. Pandora is bringing its extraordinary catalog of music analysis to the masses, using it to drive effective personalized music discovery and a unique on-line listening experience in a $30 billion radio market, capitalizing on an industry-wide transition from broadcast to internet and from radios to PCs and mobile devices. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Walden VC, Crosslink Capital, Labrador Venutres, King Street and Greylock Partners. Pandora went public on June 14th, 2011.

name: Peninsula Pharmaceuticals
description: Peninsula is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of antibiotics to treat life-threatening infections. The Company’s mission is to develop optimal anti-infective therapies that offer improved efficacy, dosing and safety characteristics over existing therapies. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Canaan Partners and Domain Associates. Peninsula was acquired by Johnson & Johnson on June 30th, 2005.

name: Planet Labs
description: Planet (formerly Planet Labs) is a space imaging and analytics company that assembles low-cost, off-the-shelf electronics into advanced microsatellites using agile aerospace technologies. The company launches fleets of low-earth orbit imaging satellites called Doves that map the entire Earth on a monthly, and eventually on a weekly and then daily basis to better understand our changing planet and ecosystems. Planet’s global, whole Earth cov­er­age and rapid cadence of imag­ing allow cus­tomers to understand and respond to change at a local and global scale, and also open up new mar­kets for satel­lite imag­ing and data analy­sis services. Planet works closely with a range of partners in environmental, social, and humanitarian sectors, including the Packard and Rockefeller Foundations, USAID, and Humanity United to make its Earth imagery data available for impact-oriented applications such as food security, environmental monitoring, urban planning, disaster response, public health and climate resilience.

name: PowerLight
description: PowerLight Corporation is one of the world’s largest integrator/installers of large photovoltaic (PV) solar electric projects. PowerLight designs, manufactures, installs and maintains commercial-grade, large-scale, grid-connected solar power systems. The company was founded in 1991 and has over 75 US and international patents issued or pending covering its technologies, including lightweight non-invasive PV roof systems and single-axis ground-based tracking arrays. PowerLight was acquired by SunPower on January 10th, 2007.

name: Primus Power
description: Primus Power is a developer of a low cost, versatile and power dense battery system that economically addresses a wide range of energy storage applications. The Primus Power battery system is designed to significantly improve the cost, reliability, environmental footprint & security of the electric grid, and to help accelerate adoption of renewable wind and solar energy. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include: Kleiner Perkins, Chrysalix Energy Venture Capital and I2BF.

name: R-Zero
description: The world’s first company dedicated to making the spaces we all work, rest, learn and play safer. R-Zero suite of hospital-grade technologies and protocols is designed to fit seamlessly into businesses of all shapes and sizes.

name: Rain
description: Rain Industries launched in 2019 to prevent catastrophic wildfires using a distributed network of autonomous aircraft located in high-wildfire-risk regions, which respond to ignitions within seconds and contain them within minutes. The company is headquartered in Alameda, CA.

name: RallyPoint
description: RallyPoint is a professional social network platform for active military and veterans to meet the unique networking and career placement needs of military professionals. With RallyPoint, military professionals can build out a network, connect with other members of the military in a safe environment, and explore career opportunities both within the military and in the private sector. RallyPoint was founded in 2012 by two military veterans to help veterans create a more connected and supported life. RallyPoint is based out of the Harvard University Innovation Lab in Boston, MA.

name: Revolution Foods
description: Revolution Foods transforms school food service by providing healthy food, nutrition education, and operational support for schools in California. The mission of Revolution Foods is to dramatically improve the food and food service experience in schools, by being the first company to provide the combination of tasty, quality food, nutrition education, and operational support to schools at a price that fits the requirements of the National School Lunch Program. The impact of Revolution Foods in communities it serves is to reduce the prevalence of childhood obesity, to improve overall health among children, and to enhance the educational experience for all students. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Oak, Catamount Ventures, New Schools Venture Fund, The Westly Group and Physic Ventures.

name: SolarCity
description: SolarCity is the leading provider of solar energy systems that deliver reliable power to homes and businesses. SolarCity’s growth is driven by its standardized approach to installation, innovative regional marketing initiatives, increasing homeowner and business owner demand for clean power, rising electricity rates and favorable solar energy system incentives. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Elon Musk, Draper Fisher Jurvetson, Generation and Mayfield.

name: SpaceX
description: Founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, SpaceX designs, manufactures, and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. SpaceX has gained worldwide attention for a series of historic milestones, including being the only private company to return a spacecraft from low-Earth orbit. SpaceX continues to work toward one of its key goals of developing reusable rockets – a feat that will transform space exploration by delivering highly reliable vehicles at radically reduced costs.

name: Spatial
description: Spatial is an audio technology company focused on improving immersive experiences through more realistic, interactive, and flexible audio environments.

name: Terram Lab
description: Terram Lab is building a waste-free world by eliminating plastic and harmful chemicals from packaging. Their plant-based food packaging is fully compostable, recyclable, and compliant with the highest EU and US regulatory standards. Partnering with Quick Service Restaurants and Consumer Packaged Goods brands, Terram provides cost-effective, high-performance packaging that is better for the planet and people.

name: Tesla
description: Tesla Motors designs and sells electric cars that break the compromise between performance and efficiency, combining world-class automotive design and Silicon Valley technology with an innovative sales and support strategy. The company’s first car is an all-electric roadster with exceptional performance, mileage, and range, and with zero emissions. Tesla’s patented and proprietary technologies change the automotive energy equation. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Vantage Point Venture Partners, Technology Partners, Valor Equity Partners, Draper Fisher Jurvetson, Daimler and Elon Musk. Tesla Motors went public on June 29th, 2010.

name: The Boring Company
description: The Boring Company constructs safe, fast-to-dig, and low-cost tunnels to revolutionize urban transportation and eliminate traffic congestion. Using advanced tunnel boring machines, it creates high-speed underground networks for autonomous electric vehicles, offering sustainable and efficient point-to-point transit. Its mission is to transform cities by enabling rapid, affordable, and eco-friendly transportation infrastructure.

name: The Muse
description: The Muse is a career platform used by people in the first fifteen years of their career to explore interesting companies and career paths, find jobs, and get the advice they need to succeed in their career. The Muse targets a highly diverse, millennial population with career advice and how-to’s, open job opportunities, and behind-the-scenes photo and video profiles of what it is actually like to work in hundreds of hiring companies and career paths.

name: The RealReal
description: The RealReal is a high-growth marketplace for luxury goods, replacing the traditional consignment sales with an ecommerce platform of authenticated, pre-owned high-end designer goods. By re-purposing unused items, The RealReal promotes sustainability by extending the lifespan of upscale goods. In addition to DBL Partners, other investors include: Canaan Partners, e.ventures, Expansion Venture Capital, Greycroft Partners, InterWest Partners, Novel TMT Ventures, and Panarea Capital.

name: Trove (formerly Yerdle)
description: Founded in 2012 as a Yerdle, a California Benefit Corporation, and later rebranded as Trove, Trove provides logistics and technology that makes it easy for brands to buy back and resell their items. By taking advantage of resale, brands take control of the growing secondary retail market – increasing profits, deepening customer engagement, and lowering the environmental and social cost of the stuff we buy. Trove began as a used goods marketplace, helping 950,000 members share more than 1.2 million items, from jackets to tents. Today, Trove Recommerce is proud to support iconic brands such as Patagonia, REI, and Eileen Fisher in their efforts to develop new business models that deepen customer engagement.

name: UrbanSitter
description: Founded by four busy parents, UrbanSitter is an online resource where parents go to find and book babysitters recommended by people they know. UrbanSitter’s platform connects parents and babysitters and enables online booking and payment for babysitting and nanny services. The company is based in San Francisco, CA.

name: View
description: View is a developer of next-generation green building solutions designed to improve energy efficiency. The company’s highly energy-efficient Dynamic Glass switches from clear to tinted on demand, resulting in significant cost savings, environmental benefits, and quality of life enhancements. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include: Khosla Ventures, Sigma Partners, The Westly Group, GE, Nanodimension and Navitas Capital.

name: Wynd
description: Wynd makes proprietary AI-powered indoor air monitoring and purification technologies. Wynd’s technology creates healthier spaces and helps customers, employees, and communities feel safe in an age of pandemics and serious public health challenges from wildfire smoke. Wynd’s powerful, economical air purification and monitoring technology helps users take the guesswork out of understanding if they’re breathing healthy air and serves as a key ally in the movement for climate justice.

name: xAI
description: xAI develops advanced artificial intelligence to accelerate human scientific discovery and advance our collective understanding of the universe. Grok, xAI’s AI companion, provides timely and accurate responses to diverse questions. Leveraging xAI’s robust computing infrastructure, vast access to real-time data from X (formerly Twitter), and advanced AI models, Grok supports tasks like research, problem-solving, and exploring complex topics, empowering users to drive progress in science, technology, and beyond.

name: XDx
description: XDx is a novel molecular diagnostics company whose mission is to improve patient care by developing molecular diagnostics that translate an individual’s immune status into clinically actionable information. The Company has developed an accurate blood-based diagnostic test to detect rejection in heart transplant patients. The test measures the level of gene expression for the set of genes most closely involved in the immune response of heart transplant tissue rejection. The test will partially replace biopsies, which are more costly, painful, invasive/risky, subjective, non-quantitative and slower to detect organ rejection. XDx is developing similar tests for other organ transplants such as lung transplants, as well as tests for autoimmune disorders. In addition to DBL Partners, investors include Kleiner Perkins Caufield and Byers, Texas Pacific Group, New Leaf Venture Partners, Burrill and Company, Integral Capital Partners, Intel Capital Partners and Duff Ackerman and Goodrich.

name: ZincFive
description: Headquartered in Tualatin, Oregon, ZincFive develops and manufactures nickel-zinc batteries. The company’s technology leverages the safety and sustainability of nickel-zinc chemistry to provide unparalleled high-power density and performance for mission critical applications, including battery backup for data centers. ZincFive batteries contain no heavy metals, are fully recyclable, are non-flammable, and use a non-toxic, aqueous (water-based) electrolyte. ZincFive is the only company in the world to have successfully commercialized this rechargeable battery chemistry.

name: ZOLA (formerly Off Grid Electric)
description: ZOLA Electric designs renewable energy solutions based on the latest in solar, battery and power electronics technology. ZOLA’s customer solution combines small solar PV panels, battery storage, LED lighting, and low-power appliances to create off-grid solutions that provide reliable, convenient, and affordable pre-paid electricity and lighting in the rural and peri-urban markets in Africa. ZOLA provides a fully integrated electric power solution for homes at cost-parity to what “base of the pyramid” customers are already paying on a monthly basis for kerosene (for lighting) and cell phone charging. Adaptable to energy need and income, ZOLA Electric’s solar systems can be bought over time using PAYGo micro-finance leasing and mobile money payments. ZOLA Electric powers more than 180,000 homes and businesses across Tanzania, Rwanda, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, and Nigeria.

description: Vinci’s foundation model for physics combines AI acceleration with deterministic, FEA solver-accurate simulation to deliver full manufacturing-resolution results.

name: 120Water
description: 120Water is the only data management platform purpose-built for water quality and asset compliance. We connect utilities and state agencies in real-time, ensuring data integrity and simplifying workflows. Our platform unifies water data and simplifies everything from sampling to community communication and public transparency. 120Water’s platform is used by more than 7,000 utilities across 48 states. Water systems partnering with 120Water to protect public health and make water work for their communities include the City of Newark, the City of Providence, the City of Buffalo, and Chicago Public Schools.

name: 15Five
description: 15Five is a human-centered performance management platform that creates effective managers, highly engaged employees, and top-performing organizations. From engagement surveys and 1-on-1 tools to performance reviews and OKRs, 15Five is the most complete solution that combines software, education, and community to develop successful managers and unlock peak employee performance. Built using the Positive Product Design™ method, 15Five is the only platform that offers software aligned to the latest positive psychology research.

name: Acorns
description: Acorns is how everyday consumers save & invest for the long term. By putting the tools of wealth-making in everyone's hands, Acorns is a leader in U.S. consumer finance, serving over 4.5 million everyday Americans. Customers get automated investing in diversified portfolios, a simple retirement product, a bank account that helps people spend less to invest more, bonus investments from brands while they shop, an easy way to invest in their kids, and a foundation of financial education. From acorns, mighty oaks do grow! Acorns recently acquired Edison portfolio company GoHenry to launch GoHenry by Acorns.

name: All Traffic Solutions
description: The leading traffic management solutions provider of portable radar speed and variable message signs that collect traffic data and can be managed remotely.

name: Anonos
description: Anonos is a global software company that provides the only technology capable of protecting data in use with 100% accuracy, even in untrusted environments, making otherwise restricted assets accessible to expand and expedite data-driven initiatives. Its patented Data Embassy platform transforms source data into Variant Twins: non-identifiable yet 100% accurate data assets for specific use cases. Because multi-level data privacy and security controls are embedded into the data and technologically enforced, Variant Twins can travel anywhere – across departments, outside the enterprise, or around the globe. Therefore, projects for capturing valuable insights can advance without compromising privacy, security, accuracy or speed.

name: Bindplane
description: Bindplane's mission, formerly ObservIQ, is to build the best open-source observability solutions for DevOps and IT Ops. Built by engineers for engineers, Bindplane has a specific focus on developing the latest next-generation agent technologies as part of its modern observability platform. Bindplane delivers scalable observability and intelligent control.

name: CleanDesign
description: CleanDesign develops and deploys cutting-edge Hybrid Energy Management Systems (hEMS) that combine intelligent software and AI-driven optimization with advanced battery storage. Designed as a plug-and-play solution, hEMS enhances power management, reduces reliance on traditional fuel-based generators, and delivers measurable results—such as reduced emissions, engine automation, blackout reduction, and seamless generator and grid support.

name: ClearJet
description: ClearJet is an AI-enabled logistics platform building a “SuperCarrier Network”, a software orchestrated delivery network that leverages narrow-body commercial airline capacity to perform Air Zone Skipping and optimize parcel cost and speed domestically across 50 States. The company sits between shippers and traditional carriers, aggregating volume from ecommerce platforms, large brands, 3PLs, and marketplaces, routing package shipments via air across shipping zones, and injecting them into last-mile networks closer to the end customer.

name: Comply
description: Comply is the champion for compliance professionals. Merging technology, consulting and education, Comply help clients navigate the ever-changing regulatory environment. Comply's portfolio of solutions includes ComplySci, RIA in a Box, National Regulatory Services (NRS) and illumis, whose more than 7,000 clients include some of the world's largest financial institutions. Clients throughout the portfolio of firms enjoy access to our full suite of industry-leading governance, risk and compliance (GRC) consulting, technology, managed services, analytics and outsourcing solutions.

name: Dash Solutions
description: Dash Solutions provides forward-thinking organizations with everything they need to make payments and rewards more meaningful to their business and the people they pay. The company has a proven track record of handling over $50 billion in payments volume across multiple industries—from healthcare and government to construction and utilities—building technology solutions that solve each sector’s unique requirements.

name: DemandScience
description: DemandScience is the premier B2B demand generation company accelerating global growth for clients. The DemandScience intelligence platform empowers B2B organizations to swiftly identify the right accounts and target in-market buyers with precision. By combining groundbreaking technologies, machine learning, and data science innovation, the company ensures timely delivery of accurate data, intelligence, and insights, adding value to the end-to-end journey from initial engagement to conversion. Founded in 2012, DemandScience provides 1,500 global customers with superior marketing solutions, B2B data, and leads. With a team of 500+ employees across operations in seven countries, DemandScience is one of only 107 companies in history to be named to the Inc. 5000 for 11 consecutive years.

name: Elligint Health
description: Elligint Health is on a mission to transform operations for risk-bearing healthcare entities to reduce the cost of care and lower administrative burden—accelerated by innovative technology and expert services. Helios® by Elligint Health is the clinical operating system for modern value-based care—engineered for transformation, built for change, and ready for what’s next. We deliver a purpose-built ecosystem designed to help payers and providers move faster, scale smarter, and lead with confidence — even as networks, models, and mandates evolve.

name: eSentire
description: eSentire, Inc. is the Authority in Managed Detection and Response, protecting the critical data and applications of 2000+ organizations in 80+ countries, representing 35 industries from known and unknown cyber threats. Founded in 2001, the company’s mission is to hunt, investigate and stop cyber threats before they become business disrupting events. Combining cutting-edge machine learning XDR technology, 24/7 Threat Hunting, and proven security operations leadership, eSentire mitigates business risk, and enables security at scale. The Team eSentire difference means enterprises are protected by the best in the business with a named Cyber Risk Advisor, 24/7 access to SOC Cyber Analysts, Elite Threat Hunters, and industry-leading threat intelligence research from eSentire’s Threat Response Unit (TRU). eSentire provides Managed Risk, Managed Detection and Response and Incident Response services.

name: Field Effect
description: Field Effect Software is a global cybersecurity company delivering managed detection and response (MDR) to help organizations detect, prevent and respond to cyber threats. Through a combination of advanced technology, expert-led threat intelligence, and human-centered security delivery, Field Effect enables partners and customers to reduce risk and strengthen cyber resilience.

name: Fingercheck
description: Fingercheck is an all-in-one payroll and workforce management platform built for deskless workers in SMBs across construction, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing. The mobile-first platform brings payroll, time & attendance, scheduling, taxes, compliance, and people management under one roof, covering the full employment lifecycle from onboarding through offboarding. Fingercheck solves a real pain point for SMBs stuck juggling multiple vendors (most of which weren't designed for hourly, shift-based teams) to manage their deskless workforce.

name: GAN Integrity
description: GAN Integrity helps global organizations elevate business ethics everywhere. We work with the world’s smartest companies to help them manage risk, impact behavior and deliver long term strategic value. GAN empowers enterprises to embed ethics in and around their business, by engaging everyone, from front line workers to third parties, and shareholders on their journey towards ethical business transformation. The Integrity Platform has built-in flexibility to quickly adapt to changing regulatory requirements combined with the ever-demanding ethical expectations of their employees. GAN enables companies like Google, Danone, Bombardier, Clarios, Tesla and Sandvik to act with integrity.

name: Giant Oak
description: Giant Oak is a data analytics software company led by behavioral scientists and software engineers who are experts in search technologies, people screening and national security. Giant Oak offers its customers unique threat protection using artificial intelligence and machine learning to support data analysis.

name: Grandstand
description: Grandstand (formerly Gambling.com Group) is the intelligence layer of sports, gaming and entertainment, powering informed decisions by building the brands consumers trust, the data partners act on, and the technology the industry runs on.

name: Havenly
description: is an online interior design and home decorating company that connects clients with professional interior designers to create personalized spaces that reflect individual styles and needs.

name: Health Recovery Solutions
description: Health Recovery Solutions (HRS) supplies leading health systems with the most advanced remote monitoring platform and technology-enabled management services focused on changing patient behavior to reduce readmissions and improve clinical outcomes. HRS' disease-specific engagement kits are customized with educational video, care plans, medication reminders while integrated with Bluetooth peripherals to engage clients. For clinicians, HRS' software allows for the management of high-risk clients and provides seamless communication with them through video chat, wound imaging, and text messaging. For family members and caregivers, HRS' software gives them the ability to be fully involved in their family member's care and well-being.

name: Houwzer
description: Newfound is a national proptech firm and real estate brokerage dedicated to making property transactions more rewarding—and cost-effective—for consumers and institutions. By pairing top-tier, salaried agents with a fully integrated service model, the company delivers a scalable, premium experience at radically transparent prices. The Newfound® portfolio includes Houwzer® and Trelora® (brokerages), HomeRise (DIY Flat Fee listings), Newfound Enterprise (institutional partnerships), and Newfound Title. Powering this ecosystem is HomeLister, a proprietary AI transaction platform that maximizes efficiency and profitability across all brands.

name: Judi Health
description: Judi Health™ is a health technology company providing benefit administration solutions to employers, unions, health plans, and government entities. Judi Health replaces fragmented, outdated systems with the industry’s first Unified Claims Processing™ architecture, seamlessly consolidating pharmacy and medical benefit administration on a single, secure platform. By delivering true price transparency, eliminating unnecessary middleman fees, and leveraging advanced AI-powered care delivery, Judi Health helps clients achieve unprecedented operational efficiency and service levels.

name: K1x
description: K1x is the patented, AI-powered tax data operations platform for private markets. Unlike tools that extract data into spreadsheets, force teams into closed ecosystems, or slowly drift into “maintenance mode,” K1x digitizes, decodes, and distributes tax data from K-1s, 1099s, W-2s, and IRS-certified 990 filings as structured, decision-ready data—while working seamlessly with your existing tax stack.

name: Kaiyo
description: Kaiyo is a full-service online marketplace for pre-loved furniture committed to great design, exceptional customer care, and a more sustainable planet. From pickup to storage, inspection, cleaning, and delivery, Kaiyo does all the heavy lifting, so that good furniture doesn’t go to waste.

name: Kinetiq
description: Kinetiq is taking a bold new approach to TV data and analytics. Through the union of iQ Media and Teletrax, Kinetiq’s intelligent monitoring, measurement and signaling solutions offer the most comprehensive view of TV performance across global, national and local markets. Kinetiq delivers valuable insights on audiences and engagement across all paid, earned and sponsorship investments.

name: KnowledgeLake
description: KnowledgeLake delivers an AI-enabled, cloud-native Document Management Operating System (DocumentOS) that helps organizations unlock value from unstructured information. Trusted by more than two million users worldwide, KnowledgeLake empowers enterprises and IT service providers to automate document-centric processes, improve compliance, and drive efficiency. Customers and IT service providers alike rely on KnowledgeLake to increase straight-through processing, improve margins, and modernize critical business operations. Let the work flow.™

name: LawnStarter
description: LawnStarter is a leading online marketplace connecting homeowners with local lawn care and outdoor service professionals. Through its website and mobile app, customers receive instant quotes and can schedule lawn mowing, landscaping, tree care, gutter cleaning, pest control, and more. LawnStarter’s network of vetted, insured pros serves thousands of communities nationwide, making it easy to book reliable outdoor services on demand.

name: Lokavant
description: Lokavant is a clinical intelligence platform that improves the time, cost, and quality of trial planning and execution through data-driven analytics applications. Lokavant's platform aggregates and integrates real-time data from disparate trial data sources, and powers advanced analytics enabled by its compendium of proprietary trial data. The suite of applications built on the platform allows study teams to proactively plan and manage their studies and surface insights, driving efficiencies in all scientific and operational use cases.

name: MacroFab
description: MacroFab is a digital platform for electronics manufacturing, which allows customers to consume manufacturing via a cloud interface with instant price quotes, material sourcing, version control, supply chain tools and access to a network of 75 factories across North America.

name: Mappedin
description: Mappedin is a global leader in indoor mapping and spatial data management. Our solutions power billions of square feet of indoor space and guide millions of people visiting malls, stadiums, airports, offices, healthcare facilities, warehouses, universities, and more. We’re making maps as powerful indoors as they are outdoors. With custom enterprise solutions, easy-to-use developer tools, and a revolutionary self-service mapmaking platform, we enable our customers to enhance indoor experiences, optimize spaces, track assets, and ensure public safety with AI-powered mapping technology.

name: Mediafly
description: Mediafly is an end-to-end sales enablement and content management platform that gives sellers and marketers a simple and effective way to access, create, and deliver engaging sales content from a single application. Mediafly’s online presentation software and sales apps allow marketers and sales representatives to create and present interactive content anywhere. Using the Mediafly platform, marketing and sales teams at companies like PepsiCo, GE Healthcare, Sealed Air and NBCUniversal, are able to manage, share, and present custom, dynamic sales content quickly and efficiently while engaging customers with insights that are relevant to them.

name: momoGood
description: momoGood is redefining modern giving. The AI-native platform brings fundraising, workplace giving, and individual generosity into a unified system designed to amplify impact at scale. Built to help enterprises, nonprofit and political organizations strengthen participation, deepen relationships, and drive measurable outcomes, momoGood connects intelligent data, text messaging, and event and auction fundraising to power mobile-first engagement. Collectively, the technologies behind momoGood have already contributed to more than $2B in global impact. Additional information is available at

Through its innovative marketplace platform, NPHub supports nurse practitioners throughout their education and career journeys, allowing them to graduate on time, secure jobs aligned with their specific areas of training and interest, and effectively contribute to the healthcare sector.

name: Overhaul
description: Overhaul is a supply chain platform that gives global brands real-time monitoring and control over their goods in motion. Enterprises are forced to stitch together their visibility, risk, and compliance tools — none of which provide unified, real-time control over in-transit goods. Existing systems stop short, leaving companies exposed to delays and disruptions they can’t act on in time. Overhaul offers dynamic SKU-level control over goods in motion. The intelligence-driven platform combines SKU- and part-level visibility, predictive risk intelligence, and compliance monitoring — protecting high-consequence cargo in industries like automotive, healthcare, life sciences, and high tech.

Leveraging its proprietary technology platform and data, Pixability makes every video impression more meaningful by identifying contextually relevant, brand suitable creators and channels and maximizing cost efficient outcomes. description: In the construction industry, it can take anywhere from 60 to 90 days on average for contractors to be paid. name: Arcee AI
description: Arcee AI provides a developer platform to pre-train, align, and continuously adapt domain-specific small language models (SLMs). Arcee AI has made training and deploying SLMs into a straightforward process using two techniques they have developed, Model Merging and Spectrum. Their technology offers vast improvements on performance at a staggering level of efficiency, in a secure end-to-end platform where the customer maintains full ownership of their models. Arcee AI's Model Merging approach allows customers to train an open source LLM on their data, then blend or “merge” that model with another open source LLM. The merged model has the brains of both input LLMs, including the domain-specific customer data, but the size and inference cost of just one input model. The merge doesn’t require any additional training, which means no GPU usage. Yet the performance of the merged model is superior to that of the two input models. Model Merge is truly a technology where 1+1 equals 3. The other approach Arcee has developed is called Spectrum, which allows for efficient training of LLMs by targeting specific layer modules that are useful, and freezing the rest. Spectrum optimizes training by 42% and addresses problems of LLMs “forgetting” previous knowledge, with no hit to performance. The Small Language Models (SLMs) resulting from these training methods greatly outperform closed source models in the enterprise. One financial services customer saw a 23% boost in benchmarks and a 96% reduction in costs. Another insurance customer boosted performance by 83% and cut costs by 89%. Arcee AI has also developed a SaaS interface, Arcee Coud, which makes Model Merging and Spectrum SLM training available with just a few clicks. This means even less technical users can build and deploy SLMs, supporting our conviction that specialized software will win in AI. CEO Mark McQuade and CRO Brian Benedict were both early commercial hires at Hugging Face and have brought with them a deep understanding of the state of AI research and the importance of developing solutions that are production-ready for the enterprise. Their third Co-Founder, CTO Jacob Solawetz, comes from YC company Roboflow (where he also worked with Mark), which has been working on computer vision problems, a subset of AI that also requires custom models for maximum performance. We are proud to partner with Arcee AI as they work to increase the utility, accessibility and performance of generative AI, so that businesses of all sizes can better serve their customers and achieve their goals.
