description: Blis (UK) is the global leader in advanced location data technology. Its proprietary platform provides businesses with accurate location data and in-depth behavioural insights to serve digital content to audiences that are on the go. The company has offices in 8 countries with regional headquarters in London, New York and Singapore. Blis was founded in 2008 by Greg Isbister.

name: Cevinio
description: Cevinio (NL) was founded in 2013 by Jeroen Volk, Vilayat William and Vincent Prooij as InvoiceSharing and is active on the global invoice-to-pay software market. Cevinio’s smart algorithms remove redundant steps from the invoice handling processes, significantly increasing productivity and reducing compliance risk. The system is compatible with all large ERP’s such as SAP and Oracle, enabling finance departments to process invoices and payments faster. Cevinio currently handles invoices in over 90 countries worldwide. The company’s platform is implemented internationally by Accenture, EY, KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

name: Contorion
description: Contorion (DE) is an online specialist dealer for hardware and industrial supplies. Its extensive range includes a variety of product categories from all the major producers such as screws, electric and service tools, as well as work clothing by well-known manufacturers. Contorion is known for its user friendliness, professional customer service and fast delivery times. The company was founded in 2014 by Frederick Roehder, Richard Schwenke and Tobias Tschötsch.

name: Deftpower
description: Deftpower (NL) is a fast-growing European provider of AI-powered EV charging solutions, serving over 40 clients across 10 countries. Its white-label platform helps eMobility providers deliver cheaper, cleaner, and smarter charging while easing pressure on Europe’s congested power grids. By shifting charging to off-peak hours and aligning demand with renewable energy, Deftpower cuts costs, lowers emissions, and improves grid stability. Scalable to handle millions of transactions, the platform is designed for seamless smart charging today and vehicle-to-grid integration tomorrow.

name: Eir
description: Eir is a full-stack embedded insurance carrier enabling digital platforms, MGAs, and e-commerce businesses to distribute non-life insurance products seamlessly across Europe. Through its proprietary API-driven platform, the company provides a unified infrastructure for underwriting, claims, and compliance—allowing partners to launch white-label insurance products in half the time compared to legacy carriers. Headquartered in Sweden, Eir operates under its own EU insurance license with 11 cross-border authorisations and partners with more than 60 distributors across eight active markets, spanning mobility, health, travel, property, and payment protection.

name: Eyeworks
description: Founded by Reinout Oerlemans in 2001, Eyeworks (NL) toils in scripted and non-scripted TV content across a range of genres which air in more than 150 countries. Its credits include Celebrity Splash!, Extreme Weight Loss and Test The Nation.

name: Finst
description: Finst is a fully regulated European digital asset investment platform founded by members of the early DEGIRO team, enabling retail and institutional clients to trade and manage digital assets transparently and at ultra low cost. Built on proprietary, in-house infrastructure, the platform provides access to over 340 digital assets in EUR at a flat 0.15% trading fee with no hidden spreads. Headquartered in Amsterdam, Finst operates under a MiCAR license from the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM). Since launching in 2023, Finst has grown into a large, fast-growing platform with a broad base of verified users and annual trading volume of several billion euros, while remaining operationally profitable.

name: Floryn
description: Floryn (NL) is a fintech company that offers small and medium-sized businesses with business loans up to € 2 million. The company was founded in 2016 by Sven van der Biezen (CEO), Marijn van Aerle (CTO) and Gion van den Bogaert (CFRO). Floryn - named after the Dutch currency used from the Middle Ages to 2002- is located in the Jheronimus Academy of Data Science (JADS) in 's-Hertogenbosch. Through the intelligent co-working of humans with AI and Machine learning (Intelligent Empowerment), Floryn stands out in customer experience and service

name: General Intuition
description: General Intuition is a frontier AI research lab, spun out from Medal.tv, developing next-generation foundation models designed for real-world intelligence. By combining their own multimodal data with large-scale model training, the company is building AI with advanced spatial and temporal reasoning capabilities that can perceive, reason, anticipate, and act across both digital and physical environments. Truly intelligent machines must move beyond language and understand the real world ("from words to worlds") enabling agentic systems that can perceive, anticipate, and improvise. Their foundation models aim to power the next generation of enterprise AI, robotics, and autonomous systems.

name: Grape
description: Grape Health is Switzerland's first carrier-backed group health MGA, combining fully digital group insurance with health analytics that proactively reduce employer absence costs. Founded in 2021 by ETH Zurich alumni Gregory Inauen and Fabian Mächler, the company has built a fully integrated insurance operating system that connects into 50+ HRIS and payroll platforms—automating claims handling, absence management, and payroll reporting. Beyond coverage, Grape's health analytics layer detects absence patterns and triggers proactive interventions, reducing claims frequency and duration. Headquartered in Zurich, Grape employs 70 FTE.

name: Happeo
description: Happeo (FI)was founded in 2017 in Helsinki, Finland by Perttu Ojansu and Antero Hanhirova. Happeo’s mission is to help solve knowledge intensive companies their information chaos. They’ve built a better intranet, truly connecting employees and making information readily available across all parts of the organisation.

name: Hyves
description: Hyves (NL) was a social networking site in the Netherlands with mainly Dutch visitors and members, where it competed with sites such as Facebook. Hyves was founded in 2004 by Floris Rost van Tonningen, Koen Kam and Raymond Spanjar . Hyves had more than 10.3 million accounts. These correspond to two thirds of the size of the Dutch population. Co-investment with Leendert van Driel, one of the founding fathers of the Dutch Venture Capital Industry.

name: Improve Digital
description: Founded in 2008 by Joelle Frijters and Janneke Niessen, Improve Digital is Europe’s leading independent publisher monetisation technology provider. Committed to increasing revenue for media owners, Improve Digital provides an innovative platform to automate and improve the monetisation of advertising and audience, across all screens, and through all public and private sales channels.

name: Infraspeak
description: Infraspeak (PT) is an Intelligent Maintenance Management Platform, trusted by over 60,000 front-line technicians worldwide working on over 240,000 buildings. Infraspeak has developed a platform solution connecting every key player involved in the operation of a building, from facility managers, frontline maintenance teams, to service providers. Endeit led a €18m Series B in Sept 2024.

name: IP Rally
description: The IP Rally (FI) team have built a Patent Search engine and Patent classifier driven by their proprietary Graph AI technology. The Helsinki based company was founded in 2018 by former Patent Lawyer Sakari Arvela and CTO Juho Kallio. IPRally is on a mission to disrupt the traditional Patent Search market and already had significant traction on an early version of their product when Endeit invested in 2023.

name: Klara
description: Klara (formerly Mooveo) is a Paris-based SaaS platform focused on employee development and skills tracking. The product is a platform that enables organizations to structure and monitor both soft and hard skills, automate feedback cycles, and align individual growth with business objectives. Its users range from individual employees and managers to HR leaders, who rely on it for self-assessment, performance reviews, and development planning. Its enterprise clients include major French and European corporations such as Carrefour, Safran, CDC, Arkema, and Banque Populaire. Klara positions itself as a core engine for talent management and continuous learning across organizations.

name: Leadfeeder
description: Leadfeeder (FI) automates lead generation for B2B sales teams from website visits, pushing qualified named company leads to CRMs. This allows Leadfeeder clients to bridge the gap between inbound interest and cold calling, generally the largest potential revenue bucket for sales teams. Leadfeeder was founded in 2012 by serial entrepreneur Pekka Koskinen.

name: Lepaya
description: Lepaya (NL) is founded by René Janssen and Peter Kuperus and enables the practical upskilling of employees on soft skills that are relevant to their jobs. The company provides training with a hybrid learning model combining bite-sized online content with group sessions led by experienced trainers. Lepaya’s curriculum centres around the idea of developing ‘power skills’ (i.e. resilience) across 60 modules (“hiring for success, presenting with confidence, or fostering diversity and inclusion”), with the focus on practical application so the skill is deeply embedded.

name: MetrixLab
description: MetrixLab is a global provider of analytics and consumer insights. The company turns data from surveys, social media and enterprise systems into actionable insights that help leading brands drive innovation, as well as brand and customer engagement. Headquartered in Rotterdam and San Francisco with 15 offices across the US, Europe and Asia, MetrixLab provides analytics and insights services in more than 50 countries. Endeit Capital co-invested with well known angel investor and entrepreneur Bodo Douqué.

name: Navan
description: Navan (US) provides thousands of global customers with travel, expense & corporate card management to automate manual processes & drive spend visibility. In 2015, after years of experiencing firsthand the pitfalls of legacy travel and expense solutions, Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig created a technology-first corporate travel platform made with the end user at the center of the experience.

name: NOAH
description: Noah (UK) is an API-first payments infrastructure provider that lets businesses move money across borders using stablecoins instead of slow and costly correspondent banking. Through a single integration, remittance providers, fintechs, marketplaces, payroll platforms, and global enterprises can collect funds through dedicated virtual accounts and pay out in local currency via bank transfers, mobile wallets, and other local payment methods. Funds enter as fiat, cross borders as stablecoins and settle locally in minutes, cutting costs, delays and the need to prefund accounts in every market. With compliance, licensing and banking relationships built into the platform, clients can launch in new markets without building that stack themselves. Headquartered in London, Noah was founded by Shah Ramezani, formerly head of Asia at The Hut Group, and co-founded by Thijn Lamers, former EVP at Adyen.

name: Nomupay
description: Nomupay (IE) is an online payments platform that provides orchestration, acquiring, and payout solutions across Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia and the Pacific. With a unified API, the company enables mid-market merchants, ISOs, ISVs, and platforms to efficiently manage pay-in and pay-out operations across multiple geographies. By offering locally licensed acquiring and multi-currency settlement services, Nomupay simplifies cross-border payments and improves conversion rates. Headquartered in Dublin, the company employs c. 200 people across several offices globally.

name: parcelLab
description: parcelLab (DE) is the leading Operations Experience Management platform globally. The company brings end-consumers and brands closer together by closing the experience gap post-sales and beyond. Being integrated with 150+ carriers worldwide, parcelLab helps 500+ brands globally, like IKEA, Bose, Puma, Farfetch and Nespresso, to enhance operations and communication with their clients post-purchase leading to increased customer satisfaction and engagement. With offices in Munich, London, Paris and New York, parcelLab has been highlighted by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in 2020.

name: Roamler
description: Roamler offers, via its proprietary crowdsourcing platform, a well-trained local mobile workforce to corporates with a focus on both near-time insights in execution on retail floors as well as technical home installations. The company employs over 55 people with headquarters in Amsterdam and regional offices in amongst others Germany, France and Belgium. Roamler was founded in 2011 by Martijn Nijhuis and Wiggert de Haan.

name: Sastrify
description: Sastrify (DE) is the leading European digital procurement platform for Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) products, helping companies to manage and reduce cost of their existing SaaS stack, as well as purchase additional 3rd party SaaS solutions via Sastrify’s marketplace. Founded by Sven Lackinger and Maximilian Messing in 2020, Sastrify’s platform automatically monitors cost, usage, GDPR compliance, renewals and other related parameters, helping companies to improve the overall software negotiation process.

name: Sharpist
description: Sharpist (DE), founded in 2018 in Berlin, DE, is a results-oriented, digital coaching provider with the mission to drive the growth of organizations and their people through 1:1 digital coaching and personalized learning journeys. Learners in organizations from more than 30 countries worldwide meet their personal business coach from an international network of certified coaches via the Sharpist’s mobile or web app. For ideal learning success, the coaching is supplemented with personalized learning content. Founded by Hendrik Schriefer and Fabian Niedballa, Sharpist now employs close to 100 people in its Berlin and Munich offices.

name: Stravito
description: Stravito (SE) is a knowledge management solution that democratizes access to market research and insights, making it fast and easy to use research to make better decisions. Global leaders such as Carlsberg, Comcast, Danone and Electrolux use Stravito’s intuitive, highly automated cloud service to centralize internal and external data sources, organize research and data, and quickly generate the findings that organizations need to power growth. Stravito was founded in Sweden in 2017 by a team of entrepreneurs with decades of technology and research industry experience. Today it is represented in Boston and in several European countries.

name: TourRadar
description: TourRadar (AT) is the world's largest and most-trusted online marketplace for multi-day tours. With more than 20,000 tours in over 200 countries, TourRadar helps millions of travellers each year find, compare and book the tour of their dreams. Based in Vienna (Austria) with offices in Brisbane (Australia) and Toronto (Canada), TourRadar has a vision of connecting people to life-enriching travel experiences. Tourradar was founded in 2010 by brothers Travis and Shawn Pittman.

name: Treefera
description: Treefera (UK) was founded in 2022 by Jonathan Horn and Caroline Grey to help companies enhance visibility and control over the first mile of their nature-based supply chains. Its AI-driven platform synthesizes multiple data sources, including satellite and ground truth data, into a single source of truth, providing timely and actionable insights that promote responsible sourcing and sustainability. By enabling businesses to identify risks, meet compliance requirements, and advance decarbonization, Treefera drives stronger, more transparent supply chains worldwide.

name: Unamic/HCN
description: From its offices in the Benelux, or offshore locations in Turkey and Suriname, Unamic/HCN supported companies active in the business-to-consumer as well as the business-to-business markets in increasing their turnover and profits from customer processes. Unamic became one of Europe’s larger care providers for both inbound and outbound sales activities.

name: Unruly
description: Unruly (UK) is the advertising technology company that gets videos watched, tracked and shared across the Open Web. The company is positioned at the intersect of video, social, native & mobile. Unruly uses emotional audience data and user-friendly video formats to massively increase viewer engagement, brand performance & publisher revenues. Co-investment with Amadeus Capital Partners and Business Growth Fund.

name: Virtuagym
description: Virtuagym (NL) provides a leading cloud based fitness software platform for member engagement, coaching and club management. Virtuagym supports more than 4,500 health clubs and 25,000 trainers in over 80 countries, including the United States and key European markets. The company has over 200 employees and offices in Amsterdam, The Netherlands and Medellín, Colombia. Virtuagym was founded in 2008 by brothers Paul and Hugo Braam.

name: AltiusHub
description: Altius Hub is a comprehensive pharmaceutical supply chain visibility platform offering serialization, post production track and trace, warehouse management and regulatory compliance solutions. The platform detects and prevents entry of counterfeit medications into the supply chain, helps pharmaceutical companies and other supply chain participants gain better control remain compliant with evolving regulations across various geographies.

name: AquaExchange
description: AquaExchange leverages edge devices, farm management systems, scientific farming, and direct market linkages to empower farmers with round-the-clock farm monitoring and control, seamless market access, and efficient procurement. The company’s integrated tech platform helps farmers reduce receivables risk, access formal financing, and receive real-time insights on crop quality and management, driving increased productivity, profitability, and sustainability.

name: BluJ Aero
description: BluJ Aerospace is attempting to make aviation 'simpler & sustainable'. The company is bringing together intelligent, green mobility and best-in-class VTOL technology to enable point-to-point travel for cargo and passengers. BluJ is especially focused on enhancing connectivity in developing and remote regions.

name: Cult.fit
description: Cult.fit is a comprehensive fitness and wellness platform designed to tackle chronic lifestyle diseases through health promotion and prevention. Combining both digital and offline experiences, the platform focuses on fitness, nutrition, and mental wellbeing to foster a holistic approach to health. With its integrated approach, Cult.fit aims to empower individuals to take charge of their overall wellness and lead healthier, and more balanced lives.

name: Cygni
description: Cygni Energy is a market leader in energy storage technology, specializing in electric vehicles and telecom. Their product portfolio includes cutting-edge Li-ion batteries and chargers for 2W / 3W EVs, as well as advanced energy storage solutions for telecom and industrials.

name: Darwinbox
description: Darwinbox is an HR platform designed for large enterprises to attract, engage, and nurture talent. This mobile-first HCM solution streamlines HR process across the employee life cycle covering recruitment, onboarding, leave, attendance, payroll, engagement, rewards, and recognition, learning etc. Darwinbox’ s platform seamlessly integrates with the existing digital enterprise ecosystem, ensuring smooth adoption at all organizational levels and enhancing HR efficiency.

name: EKincare
description: Ekincare is an integrated health benefits platform designed to provide preventive and personalized healthcare services, aimed at enhancing employee well-being and reducing healthcare costs. The platform offers AI-based health assistance and a closed network of healthcare service providers, ensuring comprehensive and streamlined care for the workforce.

name: Expertia AI
description: Expertia is an AI-powered recruitment automation platform that makes hiring faster, smarter, and more efficient. Expertia streamlines recruitment process from Job description creation, recruitment marketing, passive candidate sourcing, profile screening, interview scheduling, candidate assessment among others. Expertia's proprietary self learning technology makes it the ultimate hiring destination.

name: Eyestem
description: Eyestem is a trailblazing cell therapy company. Its lead candidate, Eyecyte-RPE targeting age-related macular degeneration is undergoing clinical trials in humans and aiming for CDCSO and FDA approval. With a vision of democratizing access to cell therapy, Eyestem aims to develop a scalable platform capable of treating incurable diseases and transforming the global healthcare landscape.

name: Gigforce
description: Gigforce is India’s leading EV and renewable energy infrastructure execution partner, ensuring reliable and scalable deployment across EV and solar networks. With a nationwide network of certified technicians, the company provides end-to-end services including infra development, installation, maintenance, and rapid repairs. Operating on a pay-as-you-scale model, Gigforce helps OEMs and energy providers expand efficiently while reducing downtime, delivering dependable and cost-effective infrastructure across India.

name: Grip
description: Grip is on a mission to transform the way Indians invest and create wealth. By providing access to multiple novel asset classes, Grip empowers investors with unique opportunities for financial growth. The platform enables participation in lease and inventory financing transactions, demonstrating its commitment towards democratizing alternate investing.

name: Karkinos
description: Karkinos is a technology first, oncology-focused healthcare platform committed to ensuring equal access to quality care for all. With a focus on early detection and diagnosis of cancer, Karkinos leverages the power of technology and data to revolutionize treatment pathways and alleviate the burden of cancer. By bridging the gap between patients and cancer treatment, Karkinos Healthcare aims to create a transformative impact on the global fight against cancer.

name: Kissht
description: Kissht is India's premier technology first consumer lender, dedicated to financing new-to-credit and underserved consumers through purchase financing, personal loans, and credit lines. Kissht employs a proprietary algorithmic credit decision model with self-learning capabilities, ensuring efficient and reliable credit assessments. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, Kissht empowers consumers with financial solutions tailored to their unique needs and circumstances.

name: Knit
description: Knit is an integrations platform focussed streamlining the process of building and maintaining native third-party integrations. By offering a 1 x many API portfolio, Knit enables seamless integration with multiple platforms within a category through its universal API. This powerful solution simplifies integration management through a no-code agentic approach, allowing businesses to focus on growth and customer satisfaction while effortlessly maintaining diverse integrations.

name: Maieutic
description: Maieutic is transforming the semiconductor industry by automating monotonous & repetitive tasks in design while freeing up time for creative work, ensuring faster design cycles and higher efficiency. The company’s designer-assist is powered by a contextual agentic flow for designers in the analog, mixed signal, and RF domains to achieve faster, smarter workflows.

name: Matters
description: Matters.AI is building an AI Security Engineer for Data—designed to protect sensitive information wherever it resides or moves across SaaS, cloud, endpoints, and AI tools. The platform combines deep contextual understanding of data, user behavior, and risk to prevent leaks in real time. By unifying DLP, DSPM, DDR, and both insider and external risk management into a single intelligent system, Matters. AI streamlines investigations and strengthens enterprise data security at scale.

name: Monetize360
description: Monetize360 is a next-gen billing and monetization platform built for event- and usage-based business models, offering unmatched flexibility and speed. It enables enterprises to rapidly deploy and scale complex billing scenarios, while its modular components seamlessly integrate with legacy systems.

name: Myelin Foundry
description: Myelin is a cutting-edge startup dedicated to transforming human experiences and industry outcomes by deploying edge AI for multi-modal data. Its offerings include specialized solutions for M&E, and automotive. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, Myelin aims to revolutionize the way data is processed and utilized in these industries.

name: Mylo
description: Mylo is a comprehensive platform dedicated to baby care and women's health. This platform provides it subscribers access to a large community of parents, high-quality mother and baby care products and seamless access to digital health solutions. With its tailored approach and wealth of resources, Mylo aims to empower women through every stage of their motherhood journey.

name: Nivaan
description: Nivaan Care focuses on chronic pain management by offering comprehensive, personalized care. They employ a multidisciplinary team of specialists, including pain management physicians, physical therapists, psychologists, and nutritionists, to address the multifaceted nature of chronic pain. This allows them to create individualized treatment plans that may include minimally invasive procedures, alongside therapies targeting the psychological and lifestyle factors contributing to a patient's pain. Nivaan Care is bringing the gold standard of care for chronic pain to Indian patients. Their holistic approach aims to improve the overall well-being and quality of life for those living with chronic pain.

name: Nkure Therapeutics
description: Nkure Therapeutics is a pioneering biotech platform for development of Natural Killer (NK) cell therapies for cancer treatment. Their mission is to make cutting-edge and affordable immunotherapies accessible, with a focus on improving patient outcomes and extending Indian innovation globally.

name: NWO Commute
description: NWO Commute is addressing urban mobility challenges by developing electromagnetically levitating, pod-based autonomous transportation systems. These systems aim to reduce travel times, energy consumption, and carbon emissions, while providing affordable last-mile connectivity.

name: OpenCFO
description: OpenCFO is an AI-native finance operations platform designed to help manage cash, payments, and financial workflows in one unified system. ‍ By combining intelligent automation with AI-powered workflows, the platform unifies accounts receivable (AR), accounts payable (AP), and treasury workflows to give CFOs and finance leaders real-time visibility into their company’s financial health.

name: Perceptyne
description: Perceptyne is an AI-first robotics company addressing the need for a drop-in industrial automation solution. The company is building dual arm robots with articulate manipulators and multi-modal sensing which are no-code and learn through AI-led tele-operation. They are currently focused on developing automation solutions for electronics and auto-component manufacturing.

name: Pulse
description: Pulse is an Agentic AI platform built for product managers, enabling them to automate feature extraction, centralize insights, and make precise, data-driven decisions. By integrating diverse data sources, Pulse provides real-time, actionable intelligence, driving outcome-based actions and directly linking product operations to business impact, ensuring customer satisfaction and sustainable growth.

name: Qapita
description: Qapita is an equity management platform tailored for private companies, especially startups. The platform streamlines the process of captable management, ESOP management, and digital ESOP issuance. Qapita envisions creating a network of stakeholders that digitally enables private investments and transactions, driving the future of private equity.

name: Scrut Automation
description: Scrut is a cutting-edge compliance and infosec platform for small and mid-sized companies. By leveraging advanced technology, Scrut streamlines the compliance process, helping companies comply with 30+ frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIsT 800, PCI DSS, etc. Scrut also helps companies surface and prioritize risks in their environment and significantly reduce manual effort.

name: Shieldsquare
description: Shieldsquare offers a robust solution to differentiate between human and non-human (bot) traffic on websites and mobile applications through a non-intrusive API approach. By providing real-time protection, Shieldsquare enables businesses to defend themselves against content theft, price scraping, form spam, skewed analytics, and other forms of bot abuse. Trusted by major brands across 68 countries, Shieldsquare has established itself as a reliable partner in securing digital properties and maintaining the integrity of online experiences.

name: SigTuple
description: SigTuple is on a mission to transform pathology using AI and Robotics. The company develops intelligent microscopy solutions that assist in diagnosis through AI-powered analysis of visual data. Their full stack platform which includes both devices and diagnostic software, has shown significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency compared to manual microscopy.

name: SteradianSemi
description: Steradian Semi is a fabless semiconductor company focused on developing CMOS ultra-high resolution and low power 4D imaging radar chips. These cutting-edge chips are designed to enhance navigation applications in the rapidly expanding markets of autonomous vehicles (AV / ADAS), traffic monitoring, industrial automation, security / surveillance, and gesture recognition.

name: Sugar.Fit
description: Sugar.fit is a tech enabled consumer centric chronic disease management platform focused on managing, reversing and preventing Diabetes and Pre Diabetes. By seamlessly integrating clinical expertise, personalized human coaching and technology, Sugar.fit transforms the lives of individuals living with diabetes. Its innovative approach empowers consumers to take control of their health, creating lasting, positive change.

name: ThirdAI Automation
description: ThirdAI is building a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) copilot for high-complexity manufacturing. The platform combines causal graph reasoning, multi-modal data intelligence, and agentic RCA automation to cut diagnostic time by 80%.The company is poised to address $ 1.5 T+ annual downtime across semiconductorfabs, utilities, and advanced manufacturing.

name: Track3D
description: Track3D offers a comprehensive solution for end-to-end construction monitoring built on a fully automated, data agnostic, AI-first stack, to help realize significant value through just-in-time and accurate visual documentation, progress tracking, deviation analysis & insights.

name: Verifaix
description: VerifAIX is building an AI-native verification platform for semiconductor design, combining advanced AI reasoning with mathematically rigorous formal verification. Its platform creates a grounded understanding of design specifications and intended behavior, reasons across specifications, RTL, and verification assets, and helps engineering teams automate and accelerate test planning, formal verification, simulation, coverage, debug, and verification closure.

name: WATER®
description: WATER® is a BiophysicalIntelligence research company. It builds physical systems that close the loopbetween sensing, modeling, and actuation: machines that read the body’ssignals, learn how each individual responds, and continuously adapt thephysical world around them. Its first two products bring this to the surfacespeople spend most of their lives on. CAMA™, an adaptive bed, and FLOW™, anadaptive chair, sense posture and physiological signals and respond withfine-grained physical adjustment, personalizing to each body over time. CAMA™debuted at CES 2026. Behind the products, WATER® runs research across threecenters: machine learning and mathematics, bio research, and materials andelectronics. Its long-range outcomes are human longevity and human experience,in service of one mission: make every human being superhuman.

name: Zluri
description: Zluri is a next-gen Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform that enables IT and security teams to discover identities and applications, streamline access management, and automate access reviews - all from a single, intuitive interface. Zluri helps organizations automate critical access controls mandated by SOX, HIPAA, SOC 2, and more ensuring the right people have the right access to the right applications at the right time, with minimal time and manual effort.

name: Ares Materials
description: Ares Materials is developing novel transparent polymer materials for the next generation of truly flexible mobile, wearable, and embedded electronics.

name: Biomakers
description: Biomakers innovates in Precision Medicine, specializing in genetic and molecular testing services for cancer and other complex diseases.

name: BioSolutions
description: BioSolutions transforms cellulose fibers like agave, barley, and other by-products into bioplastics.

name: Bioz
description: Bioz is the world’s most comprehensive AI search engine for scientific experimentation.

name: Cascade Bio
description: Cascade Bio is transforming chemical manufacturing using cascades of enzymes to make any molecule using nature’s catalysts.

name: Clip
description: PayClip provides simple and secure payment solutions that liberate merchants from the complexities and hassle of traditional card acceptance terminals.

name: Combinati
description: Combinati was acquired by Thermofisher Scientific in 2021.

name: Compound Foods
description: Compound Foods produces the best tasting and most sustainable coffee by leveraging synthetic biology to create coffee without the coffee bean.

name: Correlia Biosystems
description: Correlia Biosystems develops streamlined assay platforms to reduce the time and cost for quantifying proteins for proteomic and pharmaceutical applications.

name: Cubbo
description: Cubbo is a tech-driven fulfillment solution that leverages empty buildings, malls and parking lots, enabling urban distribution centers.

name: DProtein
description: DProtein is a synthetic biology startup developing sustainable and nutritionally efficient proteins for biopharma and food industries.

name: Equator Therapeutics
description: Equator Therapeutics is developing the first drug to burn fat safely through natural heat production.

name: Fiado
description: Fiado is a Miami-based fintech that provides geo-diverse families a simpler way to handle money, securely access their local banks and merchants, and optimize their family finances for a better life.

name: Finless Foods
description: Finless is producing sustainable, delicious seafood out of stem cells.

name: Gen1e Lifesciences
description: GEn1E Lifesciences is developing cures for inflammatory and age-related diseases.

name: Gira
description: Gira is building LatAm’s largest B2B trade platform, connecting manufacturers and wholesalers to SMB retailers, starting with Brazil.

name: Holoclara
description: Holoclara is developing first-in-class drugs for allergic and autoimmune diseases co-founded by Caltech and Cornell scientists.

name: Justo
description: Jüsto is an online supermarket serving the Latin America region, offering fresh, affordable, and high-quality products to your doorstep.

name: Merce do bairro
description: Mercê is building the largest virtual retail chain by strengthening mom & pop corner stores through digital procurement solutions, financing, inventory management, branding and store makeover.

name: Micro Meat
description: Micro Meat develops technologies that allow cultivated meat producers to scale.

name: Nebia
description: Nebia is a showerhead that is better in every way. A superior experience, iconic design, and 70% water savings.

name: Prixz
description: Prixz is an online marketplace and logistics software company that delivers prescription, health, and wellness products.

name: SkyAlert
description: SkyAlert is the only company in the world that detects, measures, and reports seismic activity directly to end users through multiple platforms.

name: Verdigris
description: Verdigris is the world’s most sophisticated AI for buildings to optimize efficiency, predict equipment failure, and automate cost savings.

name: Welbe
description: Welbe is a healthcare platform developer that uses data collecting and artificial intelligence to track and monitor employees health more effectively.

name: Amperon
description: Data analytics platform for forecasting the energy transition

name: Archive
description: Technology solution for brands to launch and scale profitable resale businesses

name: Aurora Solar
description: Cloud-based software transforming solar design, sales and delivery

name: Avathon
description: Enterprise-scale artificial intelligence solutions

name: Awake Security
description: Cybersecurity threat detection and response solution using advanced traffic network analysis

name: Axle Energy

name: Odyssey
description: At Equal, we believe that the clean energy transition will leapfrog the centralized grid in emerging markets. The IEA expects demand for power in emerging markets to grow 3x faster than in the US. Renewables will meet the majority of this demand, and should have 6–7x capacity in emerging markets compared to the US in the next 10 years. The WEF expects over $1T in investments to flow into emerging markets in the next 7 years to support this influx of new clean energy infrastructure projects. These projects have also already demonstrated the ability to achieve significantly higher IRRs than their OECD counterparts. Despite this rapidly growing demand, institutional investors have struggled to tap into these projects given lack of access to local developers and lack of data integrity of the underlying projects. Underwriting and investing in a solar project in New Jersey is different from doing the same in Nigeria. This is amplified by the struggles developers face in accessing capital outside their immediate localities, making it even more difficult to afford the IT infrastructure necessary to have robust data supporting these projects (which is ultimately necessary for them to access capital). This dynamic has inhibited the growth of the market for decades. Fortunately, it seems that Odyssey Energy Solutions has cracked the code.

description: Fergus is a New Zealand based job management platform focused on trades businesses. Customers use Fergus to manage all aspects of their operations, including quoting, scheduling, time sheets, communications, ordering, invoicing, payments and resource planning.

name: Foodbomb (Exited)
description: Foodbomb is an online marketplace connecting food service businesses with wholesale suppliers. Restaurants and cafes use Foodbomb to search for product, compare pricing and order supplies. In 2023, Foodbomb was acquired by Ordermentum. EVP maintains a position on the board.

name: Funding.com.au
description: Funding is the first Australian peer to peer platform for retail investors that is fully licensed for consumer credit. Via it's origination engine and investor dashboard, consumers access short term, secured credit in a trusted environment funded by private investors building a portfolio of private credit.

name: Hotel Club (Exited)
description: HotelClub was a global online hotel booking and loyalty platform. Following its sale to Cendant Corporation in 2004, HotelClub became part of Orbitz Worldwide Inc. (NSYE:OWW). In September 2015, Orbitz was acquired by Expedia Inc. and HotelClub was merged with Hotels.com, Expedia’s leading global online hotel booking brand.

name: Ignition
description: Ignition provides a client management platform for professional services firms, with a focus on the accounting sector. Customers use the platform to generate proposals, on-board clients, manage the scope of engagements, automate invoicing and process payments.

name: Insite AI
description: Insite AI provides an AI based decision engine to help global Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies optimise category level decisions relating to pricing, assortment and allocation of products across their retail distribution networks.

name: Intellischool
description: Intellischool is a SaaS solution targeting the global primary and secondary schools market. The product integrates rich data across the disparate software solutions used in a school environment to surface analytics for teachers, administrators, students and parents to drive student performance and wellbeing.

name: Investor Hub
description: InvestorHub is an investor marketing platform that simplifies the way public companies connect with shareholders. Founded in 2022, InvestorHub works with public companies ranging in value from $2m to $6bn, empowering them to increase investor demand through streamlined investor communications, intelligent investor insights, and optimised capital raise outcomes.

name: Kea
description: Kea provides a voice AI solution for restaurants that seeks to replicate and replace in-store cashiers and servers with an automated phone offering, helping venues increase order quantity while enabling cost efficiencies.

name: Lumary
description: Lumary is a SaaS company focused on the disability and aged care sectors. Lumary delivers a comprehensive CRM and business management platform, helping service providers manage all aspects of their operations whilst ensuring compliance with NDIS and Aged Care regulatory and funding frameworks.

name: Mad Paws (Exited)
description: Mad Paws is Australia’s largest online peer-to-peer marketplace for pet services. The platform connects pet owners with accredited pet sitters and facilitates introductions, bookings and payments. Mad Paws completed an IPO on the ASX in March 2021.

name: Mooven
description: Mooven is a SaaS platform used by government entities, engineering firms and construction companies to plan, manage and report on road traffic disruption. It is predominantly used in the construction and capital works sectors as a means of tracking traffic impacts in real time.

name: Mutinex
description: Mutinex is a marketing mix modelling platform that ingests large amounts of marketing performance data across all media channels to provide analytics and projections to inform marketing strategy and budget allocation decisions for large marketing teams.

name: Nexl
description: Nexl is a relationship intelligence platform for legal firms. The product passively maps interactions between lawyers, prospects and clients and helps business development managers and lawyers collaborate on projects, manage client relationships and optimise revenue opportunities.

name: Oneflare (Exited)
description: Oneflare is an online marketplace connecting consumers to local businesses. The platform operates nationally across c.150 industry categories. Participating business pay Oneflare based on monthly or quarterly subscription plans for access to relevant local jobs.

name: Outfit (Exited)
description: Outfit is an enterprise level brand automation platform. The Outfit product empowers marketing teams to produce customised marketing content at speed, on brand, and at scale. EVP exited the investment in January 2020 when Five Elms Capital acquired a controlling stake in the company.

name: Particular Audience
description: Particular Audience is an AI-driven product recommendation engine. It provides e-commerce businesses with a no-code personalisation engine that can be embedded within their customer-facing website.

name: Pendula (Exited)
description: Pendula is a two-way customer communication platform that helps businesses leverage multiple communications channels (SMS, Email, Social) to automate online interactions with their customers.

name: Practifi
description: Practifi is a practice management platform for financial advisors. Built on Salesforce, Practifi provides best in class CRM capability. The product integrates with wealth-specific and general applications, creating a central platform from which wealth professionals manage all aspects of their practice.

name: Programa
description: Programa provides workflow software for interior designers and brands. Its software-enabled marketplace brings together designers and brands with a single, fully integrated platform that helps them manage projects, workflows, products and procurement.

name: Rezdy (Exited)
description: Rezdy is an online booking platform for tour and activity operators. Tour operators around the world use Rezdy to take bookings through their own websites and through a range of third-party distribution channels.

name: Servicely
description: Servicely is an enterprise service management software platform providing large corporates with the tools to manage service requests across their employee and customer bases. Clients use Servicely across IT, HR and other helpdesks to manage requests, tickets and incidents, and execute resolutions.

name: Shippit
description: Shippit provides a logistics platform for online retailers. The Shippit technology enables merchants to book across multiple carriers, minimise shipping costs and deliver a superior post-purchase experience for their customers.

name: SiteMinder
description: SiteMinder is a global leader in the online distribution of hotel room inventory, servicing over 35,000 hotels around the world.

name: Smartabase
description: Smartabase (previously Fusion Sport) is a global leader in human performance software. The platform is used by professional and semi-professional sporting teams, national sporting associations, and the military for assessing and optimising performance across athletes or personnel. In 2021, Smartabase was acquired by Teamworks. EVP maintains a position on the board.

name: Snaprevise
description: Snaprevise is a subscription based video platform for high school students (in the UK) and university students (in Australia) to improve their education outcomes. Snaprevise recruits top graduates to create concise and engaging video tutorials covering all key concepts of a specific curriculum. Students use the video tutorials to prepare for exams and to enhance their learning outcomes

name: Snooper (Exited)
description: Snooper manages a crowd-sourced community of shoppers who collect in-store data and share consumer insights in real time. The data helps enterprise customers improve marketing execution and drive compliance across distributed physical outlets.

name: Splose
description: Splose is an AI-powered practice management software designed for allied health professionals, including physiotherapists and chiropractors. The platform uses AI to streamline critical practice management tasks such as appointment scheduling, invoicing, and payment processing.

name: SprintSuite
description: The All-In-One Solution for Mining & Engineering Contractors

name: Termina
description: Termina is a comprehensive energy management platform that allows businesses to optimise their energy costs, reduce emissions, and seamlessly integrate and manage their energy products within a centralised platform providing real-time visibility and savings.

name: Uptick (Exited)
description: Uptick is a cloud-based platform accessed by both facility managers and field service operators to specify, manage, track and audit the delivery of regulated compliance services in the property sector. EVP exited its investment when Accel-KKR acquired a controlling stake in July 2021.

name: Urban You (Exited)
description: UrbanYou is Australia’s largest marketplace for on-demand household services, with a growing presence in all capital cities. Homeowners and property managers use the platform to book, manage and pay for a range of household services, which are fulfilled on-demand by UrbanYou’s growing network of accredited professionals. Urban You was acquired by Oneflare in June 2018

name: VendorPanel (Exited)
description: VendorPanel is a SaaS platform helping government and corporates to manage decentralised, operational procurement. The platform connects buying organisations with suppliers and helps them manage sourcing, workflow processes, reporting and collaboration. Customers typically subscribe to multi-year contracts paid annually in advance.

name: Veridooh
description: Veridooh is an always-on content verification platform, that independently tracks, measures and verifies the performance of digital OOH advertising campaigns. The company’s proprietary technology aims to drive trust, transparency and confidence in the OOH advertising industry.

name: Zipline
description: Zipline provides a platform for aged care and healthcare facilities to manage their visitor experience. The platform incorporates online bookings, check-in, visitor management and post-visit sentiment analysis, and ensures appropriate record keeping, compliance and reporting for facility operators. The software is also used outside of healthcare (primarily in retail environments) under the RateIt brand.

description: AI driven travel platform

name: 3D Bio
description: 3DBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company and leader in regenerative medicine using novel 3D-bioprinting and materials technologies to deliver safe, functional and personalized living tissues and organs, engineered on-demand for patients. 3DBio’s pioneering approach develops living tissue implants with structural and functional integrity with a four-part technology platform, including: novel and proprietary 3D-bioprinter (GMPrint™), bio-ink (ColVivo™), specialized cell culture system, and implantable protective shell (Overshell Technology). Today, 3DBio is breaking new ground with a clinical trial underway to treat Microtia, three additional programs nearing the clinic, and multiple life-changing treatment approaches in development. 3DBio is committed to providing healthcare professionals with safe and functional implant solutions delivering optimal patient outcomes.

name: ATC
description: ATC is real estate data company bringing transparency and efficiency to the zoning approval and land entitlement process. By aggregating data and documents from prior projects, ATC provides real estate and land use professionals access to the information they need to make better decisions faster and with greater confidence. ATC is led by Natanael von Euler and Ruari Trueger with headquarters in NYC.

name: Aero
description: Aero is building the next generation of air travel. Built on the vision that flying is something that should be savored and enjoyed, Aero is more than just simply a way to get from A to B. Aero is a premium jet service that provides the time-saving convenience and world-class service of private air travel, booked by the seat with no membership required.

name: Airly
description: Airly provides governments, businesses, and citizens with access to accurate, hyper-local data about air pollution. Airly is based in Krakow, Poland and was founded by Wiktor Warchalowski, Michal Misiek, and Aleksander Konior.

name: Airwork
description: Airwork makes it easy for Canadian workers to pick up shifts at local businesses and get paid the same day. Airwork is led by Gary Lin and based in Toronto, Canada.

name: Alcove
description: Alcove enables co-living in any rental property, helping people find community in shared living. Alcove matches tenants to beautiful homes through a simple, intelligent process, and through flexible, per-room leases so that tenants never have to worry about splitting a bill. Alcove is led by CEO Mitchel Gorecki, and is based in Durham, North Carolina.

name: Allosense
description: Allosense designs and manufactures military-grade IoT sensors and asset trackers for electric vehicle manufacturing, defense, medical, and commercial applications. Allosense's proprietary software allows businesses to track an asset's location and view analytics in real-time, improving decision-making and operational efficiency. Based in San Antonio, Texas, the company was founded by Roman Sandoval and is led by Roman, Chris Benner, and Nico Gallardo.

name: Atro
description: Atro is breaking down the complex and expensive world of cybersecurity. Most businesses today don't have tools in place to protect themselves against the most basic cyberattacks. That's because existing solutions are too technical, only solve some problems, are hard to set up, and are almost always crazy expensive. These are barriers for all of the companies out there that don't have the budget, time, or expertise to focus on security. Atro solves cybersecurity from a different angle. A centralized, simple self-guided platform that walks teams through security step-by-step, requires no technical expertise, and offered at an affordable price. Atro is based in Austin, TX and founded by Kasey Batterman.

name: Aument
description: Aument is building the next generation marketing automation platform to help SMBs ecommerce stores acquire and retain customers. By collecting user touchpoints across multiple channels, Aument provides pre-built automations based on actionable insights and AI based customer segmentation tactics to deliver better customer experiences through every communication channel like SMS, email, paid median among others.

name: Beacon
description: Beacon makes logistics simpler, more transparent, and reliable. Founded by Fraser Robinson and Dmitri Izmailov, Beacon solves key issues in shipping and logistics, by allowing businesses to get paid sooner and more transparently, and offering purchase order financing. Beacon is based in London.

name: BlueCargo
description: BlueCargo solves the "first mile" of transportation. Nearly everything that happens after a container is dropped off at a port and before it arrives at a warehouse is broken, so they built a SaaS platform that optimizes container transportation through maritime ports to fix this multi-billion-dollar problem. BlueCargo's vision is to enable all logistics businesses to get the data they need to access and transport their shipping containers efficiently. Operators at 700+ trucking companies, freight brokers, and importers use BlueCargo to move containers faster, more reliably, and cost-effectively. BlueCargo is based in Los Angeles and New York and was founded by Alexandra Griffon and Laura Theveniau.

name: Bondaval
description: For credit managers, securing their receivables gives them the certainty to extend more credit and support more sales. Some security products, such as bank guarantees, offer perfect protection, but they come with a negative balance sheet impact for customers. Others, like trade credit insurance, shift risk to insurer balance sheets, but don’t offer full indemnity and can be cancelled without notice. In either case, getting cover can be an opaque, time-consuming process. Bondaval MicroBonds, however, offer 100% non-cancellable protection against default, backed by A+ rated insurers. Easily purchased and managed online via the Bondaval platform, MicroBonds are the perfect instrument, on the perfect balance sheet.

name: Cascade
description: Cascade is the first cloud-based, drag and drop data workflow builder built for the modern data stack, allowing teams to operationalize data without needing to write code. Cascade's collaborative platform allows teams to import large datasets, build repeatable transformation logic, publish their results, and set their process on autopilot. Cascade is based in San Francisco and is led by serial entrepreneurs Jake Fuentes and Jon Brelig.

name: Certification
description: Certifaction has developed the first electronic signature solution with zero document knowledge based on client-side processing and end-to-end encryption. Many organizations are rightfully concerned about the security and privacy aspects of their digitization efforts. Certifaction arms organizations with an easy-to-integrate privacy-preserving eSigning solution. Certification is based in Switzerland and is led by Benoit Henry (CEO), Emeka Mosanya (CTO), Fabian Mösli (CPO), Lukas Kart (Head of Security), and Manuel Gall (CBDO).

name: Charlie
description: Charlie is building the future of banking for the coming wave of millions of tech-confident retirees who deserve a bank built from the ground up for their unique needs, a bank they don’t have to get in line for, a bank that comes to them. Charlie is based in Los Angeles, CA and was co-founded by Kevin Nazemi and Ibrahim El Tatawy.

name: Chill Pill
description: Chill Pill is a peer support mental health platform for Gen Z womxn, which gamifies coping skill practice and matches young womxn struggling with similar issues in small, peer-run support groups. Chill Pill is led by Hayley Caddes and based in New York City.

name: Circus
description: Circus is the most advanced remote onboarding platform for the entertainment industry. Creators can customize and automate their onboarding workflows, collect crucial tax credit and payroll docs, capture custom-built digital contracts, approve, countersign or dispute start packs, and organize their team in one secure cloud. Circus is based in Vancouver and was founded by Nigel Fish and Daniel Domachowski.

name: Clau
description: Clau (formerly Flat.mx) is the property tech startup in Mexico focused on simplifying the home transaction experience by connecting buyers and sellers with top real estate agents. Combined with financial services and a data business they are creating the complete ecosystem for residential real estate transactions. The company was founded by Bernardo Cordero and Victor Noguera.

name: Clyde
description: Clyde is an extended warranty and accident protection platform for businesses. By integrating directly into the purchasing flow, Clyde helps businesses drive revenue through product protection, build LTV through loyalty and learn meaningful sales insights through analytics. Clyde is based in New York, and is led by CEO Brandon Gell.

name: Cmd
description: Cmd is a cybersecurity platform based out of Vancouver, BC, and Boston, MA. Cmd fills the need for a proactive Linux security solution by helping companies protect their cloud-based data by giving organizations visibility into online activity, protection, and authorization to keep data secure.

name: Collective
description: Collective is an online, back-office platform for the self-employed. Collective offers assistance with company formation, taxes, accounting, compliance and more, helping solopreneurs take advantage of the substantial tax savings associated with S corps. Collective is led by CEO and co-founder Hooman Radfar.

name: Commons
description: Commons empowers people to see the environmental impact behind their dollars and provides insights on how to reduce their carbon footprint. Commons allows users to turn small changes in their lifestyle into sustainable, environmentally friendly habits. Commons is based in San Francisco and is founded by Sanchali Pal.

name: Consider
description: Consider is an AI-powered tool to help teams and recruiters find the perfect talent effortlessly. Integrated with Slack and a range of applicant tracking software, Consider is a simpler, better way to hire. Consider is led by CEO Arnab Bhattacharjee, and is based in San Francisco.

name: Convoy
description: Convoy leverages machine learning and automation to save shippers money by connecting with carriers, increasing earnings for drivers, and eliminating carbon waste for our planet. Convoy is based in Seattle, and is led by CEO Dan Lewis.

name: Current
description: Current is one of the top neo-banks operating in the US. Current is an entirely new type of mobile-first bank, focused on improving financial outcomes for people and their unique lives. Having their own banking core means they can offer perks that other banks can’t — like early access to direct deposits, instant gas hold credits, and data-driven, automated savings and much more. Current was built within the Expa ecosystem, with hands-on support from Garrett Camp and Naveen Selvadurai. Current is led by CEO Stuart Sopp, and based in New York.

name: Dadi
description: Dadi offers sperm storage, a male fertility report, and an at-home collection kit. By utilizing better technology, Dadi ensures more sperm stored for when you need it. Dadi is based in Brooklyn, and was founded by Tom Smith.

name: Detect
description: Detect is developing a fast, accurate, and affordable molecular Covid-19 test to give everyone access to PCR lab-accuracy whenever and wherever they need it. Detect is based in Guilford, CT and was founded by Dr. Jonathan Rothberg, Owen Kaye-Kauderer, Spencer Glantz, and Eric Kauderer-Abrams.

name: Dovetale
description: Dovetale is a platform that makes it easy for e-retailers to recruit, manage and grow sales with creators and influencers. With Dovetale, brands can search for and connect with influencers to partner with, easily manage tasks and statuses in an all-in-one dashboard, and build powerful social reports. Dovetale is based in New York, and was founded by Navied Shoushtarian and Mike Schmidt.

name: Drip
description: Drip was created in 2012 by record label Ghostly International to support musicians through subscriptions. Drip was acquired by Kickstarter in 2017, and is a platform for artists and creators to fund and build community around an ongoing creative practice.

name: Eco
description: Eco isn’t a bank. It’s something better — a digital wallet that rewards its users every time they save, spend or send money. All at the same time.

name: Ember
description: Ember makes business easier for business owners. By automating the tax and accounting admin burden, Ember gives power back to those running the show without any need for an old-school, overpriced accountant, making managing a business simpler, smarter and way cheaper. Ember is based in London and was founded by Dan Hogan and Aaron Shaw.

name: Every.org
description: Every.org's mission is to connect givers and nonprofits through a joyful donation experience. Every.org is increasing the global giving rate by helping high-impact nonprofits get the unrestricted, recurring funding needed to focus on their work. Every.org allows donors to explore, share, and donate to over one million registered charities on their platform. Like the organizations they support, Every.org is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit funded by philanthropy. Every.org is based out of San Francisco.

name: Fabric
description: Fabric is the headless commerce platform built by and for commerce operators to deliver brand experiences shoppers want without having to hire an army of engineers. Customers like BuildDirect, GNC and abc carpet & home trust Fabric for its open and modular design that allows it to be live in six weeks without having to replatform. Fabric is a force multiplier on their existing technology investments proven to grow digital revenues by up to 3X. Fabric was cofounded and continues to be led by Faisal Masud and Ryan Bartley.

name: Farm
description: Farm is a climate investment platform focused on land restoration. We work with land operators & investors to find and acquire land for projects with a positive impact on the environment such as regenerative agriculture, carbon sequestration, and renewable energy.

name: Felux
description: Felux is a digital marketplace and community for the metals industry. The platform allows users to connect, transact, and manage their metals business, leading to increased efficiency, transparency, and communication throughout the buying and selling process. Felux is based in Cleveland, Ohio and was founded by Dallas Hogensen and Chris Day.

name: Fin.com
description: Fin is building the operating system for cross-border payments. Through a single API, companies can collect, convert, hold, and pay out money around the world—using stablecoins for settlement and local payment rails at the edges.

name: Findigs
description: Findigs a technology company making life easier for property managers and renters alike. Findigs enables applicants to easily apply for any apartment or home in minutes and ensure full transparency in the screening process by instantly and accurately verifying income, rental history, identity and way more - from prospect to tenant in under an hour with zero fraud - the way leasing should be.

name: First
description: First is building the next-gen legal ally for consumers. First provides seamless and cost effective legal agreements on its platform, created in collaboration with top family law attorneys. Today, prenups are created by finding a lawyer, your partner finding a different lawyer, and then paying your lawyers between $5,000 and $20,000 each. First believes there is a better way: that a prenup can be dramatically more affordable, created in hours and days (not weeks and months), and that aligning now means less misaligning later.

name: Forward
description: Forward is a comprehensive and personalized preventative healthcare membership. Using tech-powered tools, like remote biometrics monitoring and predictive risk scoring, as well as access to doctors, Forward offers an innovative approach to healthcare. Forward was founded by Adrian Aoun.

name: Gather AI
description: Gather AI is building the world’s first software-only autonomous inventory platform for modern warehouses. By using a proprietary autonomy engine, drones are able to map environments, collect inventory data, count cases, measure temperature, read barcodes, and more. Gather AI’s technology allows the software to work in warehouses that aren’t traditionally considered robot-friendly. Gather AI was co-founded by Sankalp Arora, Daniel Maturana, and Geetesh Dubey.

name: Genie
description: Genie is on a mission to help organizations unlock the power of their data. Our low/no-code tools help data scientists and researchers quickly turn machine learning models and simulations into interactive web applications that enable data exploration and smarter decision-making. Genie is co-founded by Adrian Salceanu and Cinzia Palumbo and based in Barcelona, Spain.

name: Gitalytics
description: Gitalytics was built to empower teams to learn more about their code, improve their process, and ultimately optimize their workflow. Gitalytics was founded by Milun Tesovic to create an analytics platform that helps engineering teams visualize meaningful workflow data.

name: Hallo
description: Hallo gives students access to top brands through live Q&As, increasing student job placement and university visibility. For companies, Hallo enables them to discover new talent before anyone else, through hiring events with moderation and analytics tools. Hallo was co-founded by Vern Howard and Phil Bauman, and is based in Los Angeles.

name: Haus
description: Haus was originally founded by Garrett Camp to create a more transparent way to sell a home based on real pain points he experienced. Under the leadership of CEO Jonathan McNulty, Haus has since evolved its products and now focuses on offering a new way to own or refinance a home that's more affordable, flexible, and transparent. The team is building an entirely new way to own a home that rethinks the traditional mortgage model — giving homeowners a way to access their equity and save significantly on their monthly payments.

name: IMU Biosciences
description: IMU Biosciences is a pioneering biotech company coupling deep, population-level immune profiling with a proprietary ML & AI platform to build an immune atlas spanning the breadth of human health and disease. Its discovery platform is fuelling a new understanding of the immune system to power the future of translational research and clinical practice, from diagnostics to drug development and treatment response.

name: Iconic
description: Iconic makes selling your business smooth, efficient, and certain by providing a transparent and professional process. Our team of experts help you sell your business faster, more efficiently, and to higher-quality buyers. Powered by our technology platform, we integrate essential deal-closing processes with AI and automation to improve buyer matching, data-driven valuations, real-time tracking, and secure collaboration. Our vision is to help small and midsize business owners realize meaningful exit value and create a new generation of business owners through our end-to-end M&A service platform.

name: Interseller
description: Interseller is a platform to optimize candidate outreach. A powerful hiring platform, users can quickly source and compile lists of candidates and outreach through targeted, automated emails. Interseller was founded and is led by Steven Lu.

name: Katoo
description: Katoo is making it easier for restaurants and suppliers to operate their businesses collaboratively. Through Katoo, restaurants can order produce and ingredients from their suppliers in an efficient way, track all deliveries, and visualize their expenses. Katoo also allows suppliers to manage all their orders in one place, create and import product catalogues, and track their clients purchase behavior to better optimize sales and promotions. Katoo has over 5,000 restaurant and supplier customers and operates in Southern Europe.

name: Kickoff
description: Kickoff is a powerful platform that pairs users with online certified personal trainers. Through text, video and the Kickoff app, users access a daily personal workout plan and strategy sessions, all designed to boost accountability and create real results. Kickoff was founded by John Gardner.

name: Kit
description: Kit was a New York-based startup building a platform for product recommendations. Kit was acquired by Patreon in 2018.

name: Kit Health
description: Kit was built to make easy, preventative health testing available to every industry. Through at-home testing kits, Kit allows organizations to deliver a safe, reliable, and secure alternative to in-person testing. Kit is led by CEO Phil Fung.

name: Knock
description: Knock is a flexible, reliable notifications infrastructure that's built to scale with you. Knock uses APIs to engage users, power cross-channel workflows, and manage notification preferences. The company is based in New York City and was founded by Sam Seely and Chris Bell.

name: Kolors
description: Kolors is reimagining what it's like to travel by bus in Mexico and LATAM. Kolors provides thousands of passengers with a high-quality, comfortable, and reliable coach bus experience for inter-city travel across Mexico. Kolors is completely digital, allowing travelers to find routes, book tickets, and pay directly through their platform. Kolors is based in Mexico City and was founded by Rodrigo Martinez and Anca Gardea.

name: Layer
description: Layer is an innovative digital art platform that delivers curated fine art from leading artists, presented on their museum-grade Layer Canvas display system. The company has pioneered a unique royalty engine called ViewTime that tracks art engagement and rewards artists when their work is viewed and appreciated. Founded by Angelo Sotira, Layer bridges the gap between traditional fine art collection and digital art consumption, creating a sophisticated ecosystem where artists can monetize their digital creations while collectors can enjoy museum-quality digital art in their homes and spaces. The platform represents a significant evolution in how digital art is experienced, valued, and integrated into everyday life.

name: Loop
description: Loop is a logistics payments platform that helps companies reduce costs and control working capital. Loop automates the invoice to payment cycle by digitizing all freight documents, simplifying invoice audits and carrier payments. Loop is headquartered in Chicago and was founded by Matt McKinney and Shaosu Liu.

name: M-XR
description: M-XR is a 3D technology start-up focused on developing a new age proprietary 3D scanning solution that is able to automatically measure and convert real-world materials, enabling production stakeholders to generate truly realistic 3D models and material libraries without the hindrance of time and cost. M-XR’s mission is to democratize the creation of realistic 3D assets, allowing brands, studios, and creators to build infinite 3D experiences and worlds at scale. M-XR is based in London and founded by Ryan Howell and Elliott Round.

name: MainVest
description: Mainvest connects communities with small business owners through investment. It’s investment platform unlocks new funding opportunities for neighborhood brick-and-mortar stores while providing local investors with an opportunity to share in their success. MainVest is based in Salem, Massachusetts, and was founded by Nicholas Mathews, Ben Blieden, Felix Le Dem.

name: Merlin Guides
description: Merlin Guides is a solution for companies to onboard new staff, new processes and ensure better offshoring. We use a browser extension which allows companies to create their own onboarding flow inside of any web application (guiding users through the software without them having to switch tabs, watch videos or bug their neighbor). Recording a workflow simply requires someone to perform the task once and then it can be shared with their team or company (no complex LMS systems or blotted help centers).

description: Learn More Breezy Breezy is the AI workspace built specifically for real estate agents, designed to run the operational side of their business in one intelligent system. Today’s agents are expected to do the work of an entire team—strategist, marketer, negotiator, analyst, administrator, and relationship manager—often while running their business from a car. For years, the industry’s solution has been to pile on more software: another CRM, another dashboard, another workflow to manage. The result is a fragmented system that slows agents down and buries critical information across tools. Breezy resets that system by replacing fragmented workflows with a single connected platform that works the way agents actually do—between meetings, on the move, and in real time. By combining deep industry expertise with modern AI infrastructure, Breezy is redefining how real estate gets done—giving agents the time, clarity, and competitive edge the industry never built for them. Founded by top-producing agent James Harris alongside Afterpay co-founder Nick Molnar, Breezy automatically captures conversations, organizes notes and follow-ups, generates client-ready comps in minutes, keeps pipelines updated in real time, and surfaces insights like hidden development and build potential that most agents would never uncover on their own. Early users report Breezy reduces administrative work by up to 80%, saving agents 15–25 hours per week while helping them move faster, advise clients with greater authority, and close more business.

It also drives significant efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and user satisfaction benefits. Historically there hasn't been an easy way for CFOs, Treasurers, and Controllers to make this seemingly simple connection. Koxa fixes that. Remember the last time you searched for a flat to rent, wanted to lease a car or applied for a loan? At some point during your search you were asked to share your last three months of payslips. name: 10x Genomics
description: 10x Genomics has pioneered commercialization of single cell sequencing. We made our first investment in 10x Genomics in the Series A financing in November of 2013. At that time, the company had proof of concept, what we believed was a world-class leadership team, and a clear path to product launch. Throughout the course of a year the 10x Genomics management team continuously executed each milestone. In December of 2014 Foresite Capital lead the $55 million Series B financing to further support the company’s product launch and further development. 10x Genomics launched the GemCode platform in February of 2015 at the Advances in Genome Biology and Technology (AGBT) meeting. AGBT is recognized as the cornerstone for the genomics community and the 10x Genomics launch was highly anticipated and enthusiastically received by industry and the financial community. Since its launch 10x has introduced several additional products and started to rapidly grow sales over the last year. We expect 10x to continue to be a leading innovator in the field of cell sequencing over the next decade.

description: Abdera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company leveraging antibody engineering to design and develop new precision radiopharmaceuticals for cancer. Abdera’s R adio O ptimized V ector E nginee r ing (ROVEr™) proprietary platform enables the company to engineer potential best-in-class therapies for both clinically validated and novel targets that deliver potent radioisotopes capable of emitting alpha or beta particles to selectively destroy cancer cells. Abdera’s lead program, ABD-147, is a next-generation precision radiopharmaceutical biologic therapy designed to deliver Actinium-225 ( 225 Ac) to solid tumors expressing delta-like ligand 3 (DLL3) for the treatment of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC). Headquartered in South San Francisco, CA, Abdera also has offices in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

name: Acceleron Pharma
description: Acceleron Pharma is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing protein therapeutics for unmet medical needs, particularly in the areas of cancer and rare diseases. The y are known for their work with growth and differentiation factors and have several drug candidates in development, including Sotatercept for pulmonary arterial hypertension. The company was founded in 2003 and acquired by Merk i n 2021.

name: Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc.
description: Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a pipeline of novel drug candidates to address the needs of patients with immuno-inflammatory diseases who lack satisfactory treatment options. The company has a multi-stage portfolio of drug candidates powered by a robust R&D engine exploring protein kinase regulation.

name: Adaptimmune Therapeutics PLC
description: Adaptimmune is a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on the development of T cell therapies to treat cancer. The company aims to utilize the body’s own immune system to target and destroy cancer by using engineered, increased affinity T cell receptors (TCRs) as a means of strengthening natural patient T cell responses. It has one clinical stage asset and two preclinical stage assets all for the treatment of various forms of cancer. Its lead program is an engineered higher-affinity TCR targeting the NY-ESO-1 cancer testis antigen.
