description: Confluent Surgical markets synthetic, polymer-based, sprayable adhesion barriers and surgical sealants. These materials have potential applications across minimally invasive surgery in adhesion prevention, as sealants and hemostats, and in interventional procedures. Confluent was sold to the U.S. Surgical division of Tyco International in August 2006

name: CorSolutions
description: CorSolutions is the nation’s leading provider of customer-centric health intelligence and solutions that help individuals improve their health and avoid complications associated with chronic diseases. CorSolutions merged with Matria Healthcare in January 2006

name: Covetrus
description: Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services company dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. The Company brings together products, services and technology into a single platform that connects its customers to the solutions and insights they need to work best. Founded through the merger of two industry leaders, Vets First Choice and Henry Schein Animal Health, Covetrus leverages and integrates its combined technology, services, analytics and experience to serve veterinaries and their patients.

name: Diameter Health
description: Diameter Health upcycles raw clinical data into a standards-based, interoperable asset using their FHIR-enabled technology engine, Fusion. Diameter Health’s comprehensive, automated data integration, normalization and enrichment technology delivers high-quality data to streamline workflows, inform decisions and accelerate interoperability, at scale.​

name: Elligint Health
description: Elligint Health (formerly HealthEC), established in 2024, is leading the charge of innovating healthcare by aligning all stakeholders, delivering intelligent healthcare solutions, and empowering pro-active, whole-person care across the healthcare continuum. Elligint Health integrates vast amounts of data from across the healthcare continuum, delivering intelligence that informs decision-making, enhances care coordination, and improves outcomes. Focused on enabling actionable intervention and whole-person care, Elligint Health helps healthcare organizations navigate complexity, turning insights into strategies that benefit providers, payers, and members/patients alike. With Elligint Health, the future of healthcare is simpler, smarter, and more effective.

name: Fuze Health
description: Fuze Health, is a technology-powered healthcare solutions company committed to transforming patient experiences and advancing personalized care. The company is focused on enabling healthcare partners – including care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies – to excel in an outcomes-focused system and empowering patients to more comprehensively manage their health at home.

name: Harmonycares
description: Harmonycares Medical Group (formerly U.S. Medical Management “USMM”) offers comprehensive, home-based healthcare services. We care for elderly individuals and those with complex medical issues. Our innovative model provides patients and payers with overall lower costs, better outcomes and higher patient satisfaction.

name: Hazel Health
description: Hazel partners with school nurses, counselors, parents, and local providers to bring high-quality whole child health care to every student.

name: Healtheon
description: Healtheon (NASDAQ:HLTH) provides connectivity and a full suite of services to the health care industry that improve administrative efficiencies and clinical effectiveness enabling patient care. Healtheon merged with WebMD in 1999.

name: InnovaCare
description: InnovaCare is one of the largest integrated, value-based payor and provider service organizations in the United States and Puerto Rico.

name: Interlace Medical
description: Interlace Medical designs and develops devices for the Interventional Gynecologist to perform office-based procedures to treat diseases and conditions traditionally requiring surgery in the operating room.

name: Leon
description: Leon is one of the largest independent integrated delivery systems in Florida with over 40,000 Medicare Advantage and dual-eligible members and a 5-star rating from CMS.

name: Linkwell Health
description: Linkwell Health is the premier member experience and content marketing company serving health plans, providers, and health services organizations. Our award-winning health and wellness journalists, content strategists, digital marketing mavens, and social media experts help healthcare brands to connect with consumers and empower them to take practical steps to improve their health. By engaging members, consumers, and patients in a deep, credible, authentic way, Linkwell’s clients build trust with their audience and earn the right to ask for something in return: an action that helps the client achieve their business goals, such as creating an account, making an appointment, calling a nurse line, closing a gap in care, and the like.

name: Main Street Health
description: Main Street Health is the nation’s largest provider of value-based care focused exclusively on serving rural America.

name: MedVentive
description: MedVentive offers health care providers and payer organizations solutions to measure and manage quality at the point of care. The company’s products identify opportunities for care improvement, provide interventions including alerts and patient communications that fit easily into the physician’s workflow and also measure the results.

name: mPulse Mobile
description: mPulse Mobile, the leader in Conversational AI solutions for the healthcare industry, drives improved health outcomes and business efficiencies by engaging individuals with tailored and meaningful dialogue. mPulse Mobile combines behavioral science, analytics and industry expertise that helps healthcare organizations activate their consumers to adopt healthy behaviors. With over a decade of experience, 100+ healthcare customers and more than 300 million conversations annually, mPulse Mobile has the data, expertise and solutions to drive healthy behavior change.

name: MyTown Health Partners
description: MyTown Health Partners expands access to primary care services for underserved patient populations.

name: NeuroFlow
description: NeuroFlow streamlines the collection of behavioral health insights at scale and empowers care teams with the decision support they need to avoid costly and dangerous outcomes.

name: Nordic Consulting
description: Nordic Consulting is a leading Epic EMR consulting firm. Ranked #1 by KLAS for Epic staffing and implementation support, Nordic consultants average ten years of experience and four Epic certifications and have worked with nearly 85% of Epic clients through a variety of healthcare settings. Nordic works with the country’s leading hospitals and offers a variety of services including software implementation, optimization, remote support, and affiliate extension projects.

name: Oceans Healthcare
description: Oceans Healthcare is a nationally recognized behavioral health provider of gero-pyschiatric treatment services to patients age 55 and older suffering from dementia-related or other progressive mental illness.

name: PayMedix
description: PayMedix is transforming how people access, use, and pay for healthcare by simplifying and consolidating healthcare information and payments for consumers and providers. Through guaranteed payments to providers, the SuperEOB®, and complete interest-free financing for consumers, PayMedix is the only platform that unifies all stakeholders through a single system. Built on 20 years of experience via the HPS Network, PayMedix has processed over $7 billion in medical payments for hospital systems and physician practices. The acquisition of TempoPay in 2024 expanded the company’s interest-free financing platform to include pharmacy, dental, and vision expenses.

name: Payspan
description: Payspan is a complete claim settlement, reimbursement, and payment solution delivering savings and efficiencies to payers, providers, financial institutions, and consumers. The Company focuses on connecting these various constituencies on a single automated SaaS platform.

name: Persivia
description: Persivia, formerly IHM Services Company, is a chronic care management company that helps providers better manage their clinical and financial risk through one robust platform. Persivia incorporates all patient data including both clinical and claims information to enable earlier clinical interventions and manage costs. Persivia’s advanced analytics and real-time clinical decision support addresses the growing need of managing complex patient populations and providing valuable insights into improving care quality.

name: Phreesia
description: Phreesia automates patient check-in, delivers fully interactive content direct to patients, and enables real-time, point of care collection of patient co-pays and deductibles. The proprietary platform is designed to drive efficiency and profitability to the providers through seamless, automated check-ins with reduced time and workflow complexities for the administrative staff. PhreesiaPad significantly improves the patient experience while collecting full patient history, signatures for consent forms and insurance information, relevant clinical assessments, and enabling an outstanding credit card transaction processing experience for the patient.

name: RedBrick
description: RedBrick Health is a technology and services company that drives sustained engagement in health improvement programs through constant innovation and deep consumer insight. The company’s health engagement platform blends a fresh, personalized consumer experience, impactful social networking tools and rewards that link individual financing to healthy behaviors. Redbrick’s comprehensive solution allows the employer to deploy singly, in combination, or as an entire system, but with an open hub, clients are also able to integrate their own components and programs

name: Rubicon
description: Launched in 2013, RubiconMD, a healthcare technology service, connects primary care providers to top specialists, enabling quick remote opinions that eliminate unnecessary visits, reduce patient wait time and alleviate travel burden.

name: Shiftkey
description: Shiftkey (formerly OnShift) distributes a cloud, SaaS-based staff scheduling solution for senior care facilities and the post-acute environment. Shiftkey’s software helps prevent both overtime and understaffing while dramatically reducing time spent on scheduling and managing open shifts. Fully integrated with time-keeping, HR, clinical and payroll systems, Shiftkey provides a unified view into staffing levels and labor costs across buildings. Thousands of customers choose Shiftkey because it’s the easiest-to-use scheduling solution with a tightly integrated communications platform, delivering fast ROI. The company also provides recruiting, retention, and onboarding solutions for its customers.

name: Socios Mayores en Salud
description: Socios Mayores en Salud is a Medicare Advantage health plan company serving beneficiaries in Puerto Rico and provides comprehensive medical and prescription drug benefits under a contract with the federal government’s Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)

name: Spinal Concepts
description: Spinal Concepts provides the surgical community with the most technologically advanced implants used in the treatment of spinal disorders, diseases and injuries. The company is a leader in technology, with more than 40 U.S. patent awards, 22 foreign patents and numerous additional patents pending on product innovations. Spinal Concepts was sold to Abbott Laboratories in 2003

name: Tebra
description: Tebra (formally PatientPop) offers a “practice growth platform” for independent physician practices that provides apps to attract, schedule, engage, and retain patients.

name: Teladoc
description: Teladoc provides members 24/7 on-demand access to a national network of U.S. board-certified physicians who can resolve many of their medical issues via phone or online video consultations. Teladoc works with the nation’s leading employers and health plans to provide access to care for patients. With over 7.5 million members and an average 8 min call back time, Teladoc is the leading provider of telehealth services in the nation.

name: Transcend Medical
description: Transcend Medical is a developer of novel devices for the treatment of glaucoma, the leading cause of adult irreversible blindness. The company has CE mark approval for its CyPass Micro-Stent, which is placed during cataract surgery to control and reduce intraocular pressure all day long. The Transcend Vold Gonio Lens was specifically created for micro-invasive glaucoma surgery and was designed to increase precision and stability with intraoperative gonioscopy and provides surgeons with excellent visualization and control for these procedures.

name: TriZetto
description: The TriZetto® Group (NASDAQ:TZIX) is focused exclusively on providing health care payers, providers and benefits administrators with a broad portfolio of IT products and services. Its payer customers serve more than 135 million health plan members, or approximately 40 percent of the insured population of the United States.

name: TYRX
description: TYRX delivers site-specific therapy by commercializing proprietary, implantable medical-pharmaceutical combination devices for the surgical markets.

name: Unified Growth Partners
description: Unified Growth Partners (UGP) is dedicated to bringing solutions to market that ensure eligible consumers are able to secure health insurance and related products and services that meet their specific needs.

name: Vaxcare
description: VaxCare is a propriety technology platform that allows independent physicians and health systems to outsource the entire vaccination administration process.

name: Vida
description: Vida combines a data and tech-driven approach with human-centered design, empathy and compassion to help people tackle even the most persistent health challenges.

name: VivaMas
description: VivaMas is building the leading advanced primary care platform for dual-eligible seniors in Southern Florida.

name: Wayspring
description: Wayspring has reimagined substance use disorder treatment by providing individualized care, delivered with a peer-centered approach. Wayspring focus on making sure patients have their basic needs met, like access to care, economic stability, and connection to relationships and community and then help each person find their own way to wellness.

name: Wedgewood Pharmacy
description: Blue Rabbit (acquired by Wedgewood Pharmacy) simplifies the coordination of veterinary care and improving treatment compliance through innovative technologies. description: Aventon，成立于2012年，是美国电助力自行车品牌，初期以固齿自行车起家，后转型专注于电助力自行车研发与销售，并在北美市场占有率领先。该品牌提供越野、城市通勤、折叠、胖胎和货运等多种车型，产品采用 SHIMANO 变速系统和 BAFANG 电机。

name: Beam Therapeutics
description: Beam Therapeutics（NASDAQ: BEAM），成立于2017年，是一家生物科技公司，在美国为患有严重疾病的患者开发精密基因药物。

name: Boss直聘
description: BOSS直聘Kanzhun（NASDAQ: BZ; SEHK: 2076），成立于2014年，是目前国内平均月度活跃用户数（MAU）最大的在线招聘平台。BOSS直聘率先引入了一种改变中国在线招聘业的颠覆性模式——直聘模式，促进了boss和求职者之间的即时直接聊天，为双方提供精准的推荐，并由强大的人工智能算法和大数据洞察提供支持。

name: Delivery Hero
description: Delivery Hero（DHER.DE），成立于2011年，是一家德国跨国在线食品订购和食品配送公司。平台整合国内外数万家餐饮商户资源，用户可通过线上系统完成订餐与支付全流程操作。

name: Eight Sleep
description: Eight Sleep，成立于2014年，是美国知名的智能睡眠科技公司，自定位为“睡眠健身（Sleep Fitness）品牌”。其核心产品 Pod 系列智能深眠系统 被誉为“床垫界的特斯拉”，通过主动液态温控和AI算法深度优化睡眠质量。

name: Golden Goose
description: Golden Goose，成立于2000年，是创立于意大利威尼斯的奢侈潮牌。品牌以“完美的不完美”（Perfect Imperfections）为核心理念，将传统威尼斯手工制鞋工艺与美式滑板文化相结合，因标志性的“脏污做旧”手工工艺而闻名全球。

name: Kurly
description: Kurly，成立于2015年，是韩国头部生鲜电商平台，以首创“清晨配送”闻名。用户在当晚11点前下单，次日早7点前即可收到全程冷链配送的生鲜杂货。凭借高品质选品与环保物流服务，其业务已扩展至美妆与生活日用品。

name: MARI
description: MARI，成立于2025年，专注于体育、艺术、生活方式和娱乐领域，致力于打造世界级的沉浸式现场活动与数字平台。

name: Marshall
description: Marshall，成立于1962年，是一家英国音乐器材公司，由Jim Marshall创立，总部位于英格兰布莱切利。该公司最初以设计和制造吉他放大器和音箱而闻名，其产品曾定义了摇滚和英式布鲁斯之声，并在后期将业务拓展到耳机、便携式音响等领域。

name: Musinsa
description: Musinsa，成立于2000年，是韩国顶尖的时尚电商平台与零售巨头，凭借“平台+自有品牌”双轮驱动模式，逐渐成长为引领K-Fashion（韩国时尚）走向全球的独角兽企业。

name: Opay
description: OPay，成立于2018年，是一家领先的非洲金融科技独角兽，公司主打数字钱包与移动支付，被誉为“非洲版支付宝”，致力于为中东及非洲庞大的无银行账户人口提供普惠金融服务。

name: Roivant
description: Roivant（NASDAQ：ROIV），成立于2014年，是一家创新的跨国生物制药和医疗保健技术公司。其核心特色是独特的“中心辐射”（Hub-and-Spoke）商业模式，即通过创建独立的子公司（Vants）来灵活推进各类药物管线。公司现专注于自身免疫、炎症性疾病及罕见病的研发与商业化。

name: Tabby
description: Tabby，成立于2019年，是中东和北非地区（MENA）领先的金融科技独角兽企业，主要提供“先买后付”（BNPL）服务。它允许消费者在线上或线下购物时，将账单分为四次免息付款。

name: Toss
description: Toss由Viva Republica于2015年推出，是一款韩国的移动金融服务应用，最初专注于个人对个人的资金转账，现提供包括转账、贷款、股票交易、信用评分查询及投资在内的超过 40 种金融服务。

name: 万达院线
description: 万达院线Wanda Cinemas (SHSE: 002739)，成立于2005年，前身为万达集团旗下的亚洲最大电影院线运营商。主营业务涵盖影院投资建设、院线电影发行及相关衍生业务。2015年成功登陆A股市场，成为首家在国内上市的院线公司。

name: 中创新航
description: 中创新航CALB（SEHK: 3931），成立于2015年，是专业从事锂电池、电池管理系统及相关集成产品和锂电池材料的研制、生产、销售和市场应用开发的新能源高科技企业。作为电池专家，公司致力于构建全方位能源运营体系，为以动力及储能为代表的新能源全场景应用市场提供完善的产品解决方案和全生命周期管理。

name: 中联数据
description: 中联数据ZDATA，成立于2014年，是行业领先的数字基础设施服务商和云基础设施服务提供商。公司专注于新型高算力绿色数据中心集群的建设与运营，为客户提供全方位的云基础设施综合解决方案。

name: 中通快递
description: 中通快递ZTO Express（NYSE: ZTO; SEHK: 2057），成立于2002年，是综合性物流快递公司。其主营业务包括国内和国际快递、物流配送和仓储服务。中通以其高效的运营模式、庞大的网络以及在电子商务领域的广泛合作而闻名，是中国规模领先的快递公司之一。

name: 乐普心泰
description: 乐普心泰LEPU ScienTech (SEHK: 02291)，成立于2021年，是国内最大的先天性心脏病封堵器及手术配套产品制造商之一，也是乐普医疗旗下的核心企业。公司专注于结构性心脏病介入医疗器械的研发、生产与商业化，其生物可降解封堵器系统处于全球领先地位。

name: 九号机器人
description: 九号公司Ninebot（SHSE: 689009）于2015年由赛格威（1999年成立于新罕布什尔州贝德福德）与Ninebot（2012年成立于北京）战略合并成立，是全球电动个人出行产品、动力运动和家庭机器人领域的领军者，专注于以用户为中心的产品技术和体验创新，提供多个品类的个人出行和家庭服务机器人产品系列。

name: 云鲸
description: 云鲸Narwal，成立于2016年，是一家立足家用机器人领域，致力于研发革命性科技产品的创新企业，同时还是一个生活方式品牌，倡导“自由自在、有所热爱”的品牌态度。

name: 亚玛芬体育
description: 亚玛芬体育Amer Sports (NYSE:AS)，成立于1950年，总部位于芬兰赫尔辛基，是一家全球顶尖的体育用品企业。旗下拥有始祖鸟（Arc’teryx）、萨洛蒙（Salomon）、威尔胜（Wilson）等多个世界知名户外及运动品牌。

name: 京东
description: 京东JD（NASDAQ: JD; SEHK: 9618; SEHK: 89618），成立于1998年，是一个领先的技术驱动型电商和零售基础设施服务商。以其自营模式的电商业务起步，现已发展成为一家综合型公司，业务涵盖零售、科技、物流、健康、产发、工业和国际等领域。

name: 京东健康
description: 京东健康JD Health（SEHK: 6618），成立于2019年，是在线医疗健康平台，致力于构建以医药及健康产品供应为核心、医疗服务为抓手、数字驱动的用户全生命周期健康管理平台。它提供零售药房、在线医疗服务等业务，以满足用户多样化的健康需求，并已成为医疗产业链数字化转型的领跑者。

name: 京东工业品
description: 京东工业品JD Industry，成立于2017年，是京东集团旗下的业务单元，专注于工业品领域的数智化供应链技术与服务。它通过整合海量商品，并结合大数据、供应链服务、金融服务等，为企业提供一站式采购平台，旨在满足企业客户的采购需求并实现供应链的数智化升级。其业务涵盖从寻源、采购管理到履约交付、售后服务，并已将服务范围从大型企业拓展到中小微企业，如通过“京东五金城”平台为中小微企业和个人提供服务。

name: 京东物流
description: 京东物流JD Logistics（SEHK: 2618），成立于2017年，由京东集团孵化、技术驱动的一体化供应链解决方案及物流服务提供商。它拥有仓储、快运、冷链、跨境等六大协同物流网络，为快消、家电家具、服装等六大行业提供服务。

name: 信达生物
description: 信达生物Innovent Biologics（SEHK: 1801），成立于2011年。它致力于开发、生产和销售用于治疗肿瘤、自身免疫疾病、代谢疾病和眼科等重大疾病的创新药物。

name: 健帆生物
description: 健帆生物Jafron Biomedical（SZSE: 300529），成立于2002年，专注于血液净化产品和生物材料的研发、生产与销售。公司产品广泛应用于肾病、肝病和危重症治疗等领域，并在国内和国际市场均有销售。

name: 健适医疗
description: 健适医疗Genesis Medtech，成立于2019年，是全球化医疗科技集团，致力于研发、生产和营销高值医用耗材，专注于微创外科、血管介入（神经介入、心脏介入、外周介入）和结构性心脏病领域。该公司通过建立全球创新网络和在多国设立研发中心，为国内提供优质医疗产品和服务，并在中国拥有强大的市场覆盖能力，其愿景是打造一个开放的医疗科技平台。

name: 傅利叶智能
description: 傅利叶智能Fourier，成立于2015年，是一家行业领先的智能机器人企业, 致力于通过全栈式机器人技术赋能人类生活，拓展未来生活方式的边界。

name: 元气森林
description: 元气森林Genki Forest，成立于2016年，是一家中国健康食品饮料企业，以“0糖、0脂、0卡”的气泡水闻名。其产品主打年轻化与健康无负担概念，现已覆盖无糖气泡水、无糖茶（燃茶、纤茶）、电解质水（外星人）及乳茶等系列，并出口至全球40多个国家和地区。

name: 兆维科技
description: 兆维科技Hongene Biotech（SHSE: 600658），成立于2001年，是一家专注于核酸药物核心原材料研发和生产的生物化工企业。主要生产核苷、核苷酸、亚磷酰胺基因单体、靶向示踪剂和生物酶等产品，广泛应用于基因药物、mRNA疫苗、基因测序和分子诊断等领域。

name: 再鼎医药
description: 再鼎医药Zai Lab（NASDAQ: ZLAB; SEHK: 9688），成立于2014年，是一家创新型生物制药公司。公司致力于通过“授权引进+内部研发”的模式，在肿瘤、自身免疫、神经科学和感染性疾病等领域发现、开发、生产和商业化创新药物，以满足中国及全球患者的医疗需求。

name: 凯莱英
description: 凯莱英Asymchem Laboratories（SZSE: 002821; SEHK: 6821）成立于1998年，是一家全球领先的CDMO公司，为全球新药提供高质量的研发、生产一站式服务。以加速新药上市，延长生命的质量为己任，依托持续技术创新，为国内外制药公司、生物技术公司提供药品全生命周期一站式CMC服务，加快新药开发及应用。

name: 剂泰科技
description: 剂泰科技METiS TechBio (SEHK: 07666），成立于2020年，是一家应用人工智能（AI）与量子模拟技术，专注于革命性纳米材料与创新药物递送的生物技术公司。

name: 北芯生命
description: 北芯生命Insight Lifetech（SHSE: 688712），成立于2015年，是一家专注于心血管疾病精准诊疗创新医疗器械的研发、生产与销售的国家高新技术企业。

name: 博睿康
description: 博睿康Neuracle，成立于2011年，源自清华大学神经工程实验室，是中国脑机接口（BCI）领域的领军企业。公司专注于无创、微创及侵入式脑机接口技术的研发、生产与临床转化。

name: 卡游
description: 卡游Kayou，成立于2011年，是中国泛娱乐产品行业中最具影响力的品牌之一，坚守“品质·乐趣”发展理念，以智造为驱动，是深耕动漫、创意文具产业的文化创新公司。

name: 古茗
description: 古茗Goodme（SEHK: 1364），成立于2010年，作为中国头部茶饮品牌之一，古茗致力于向消费者提供新鲜美味、价格亲民的高质量产品。

name: 可画
description: 可画Canva，成立于2013年，于2018年进入中国，是一个全球性的在线设计平台，提供易于使用的拖放界面和海量的设计模板、素材，让用户即使没有设计背景也能轻松创建视觉内容，如社交媒体图片、演示文稿、海报等。

name: 同心医疗
description: 同心医疗CH Biomedical，成立于2008年，致力于独立研发、生产及销售具有技术突破性的心室辅助装置(VAD)，通过持续为专业医疗团队和患者提供卓越服务，让全球更大范围的心衰患者及其家庭重享健康快乐生活。

name: 君乐宝
description: 君乐宝Junlebao，成立于1995年，是一家专注于奶业发展的企业，提供婴幼儿奶粉、酸奶、液态奶等产品。公司建立了涵盖奶草种植、奶牛养殖、生产加工的全产业链一体化模式，并在全国建有多个生产工厂和现代化牧场。

name: 启明医疗
description: 启明医疗Venus Medtech (SEHK: 02500)，成立于2009年，是中国心脏瓣膜微创介入治疗领域的龙头企业，致力于结构性心脏病创新医疗器械的开发、生产与商业化。

name: 唯品会
description: 唯品会VIPShop（NYSE: VIPS），成立于2008年，是一家在线名牌折扣特卖电商平台。它以“精选品牌 + 深度折扣 + 限时抢购”的模式，通过限时特卖的方式销售服饰、美妆、母婴、居家等多种品类的正品商品。

name: 喜茶
description: 喜茶HEYTEA，成立于2012年，是新中式茶饮连锁品牌。它以原创“芝士现泡茶”起家，致力于用“真茶、真奶、真果”等优质原料，将传统茶饮与现代审美相结合，开创了“新茶饮”时代。喜茶以其差异化的门店设计、社交媒体营销和对产品品质的坚持，快速发展壮大，并在全球多地开设了分店。

name: 嘉立创
description: 嘉立创JLC（SZSE：001232），成立于2006年，是行业较早实现数字化转型的高新技术企业之一，专注于PCB打样/小批量、SMT贴片、激光钢网等领域，为全球电子行业企业及电子工程师提供“价格优、品质高、交期快”的高性价比服务。

name: 地平线机器人
description: 地平线Horizon Robotics（SEHK: 9660），成立于2015年，是一家专注于智能驾驶和AIoT领域，提供边缘人工智能芯片及解决方案。公司由前百度深度学习研究院创始人余凯创立，以“软硬结合”的策略，研发并量产了车规级人工智能芯片“征程”系列和AIoT芯片“旭日”系列。地平线是中国首家实现车规级智能芯片前装量产的公司，其解决方案已被包括大众、比亚迪在内的多家车企采用，致力于推动智能汽车的商业化进程。

name: 塔斯汀
description: 塔斯汀Tastien，成立于2012年，是主打“手擀现烤中国汉堡”的知名餐饮连锁品牌。其以“就是中国胃，就爱中国堡”为口号，将传统中式面点工艺与西式汉堡结合，凭借高性价比与国潮风格，已在中国大陆发展超数千家门店。

name: 天合光能
description: 天合光能Trina Solar（SHSE: 688599），成立于1997年，主要业务包括光伏产品、储能业务、系统解决方案及数字能源服务四大板块。

name: 奕瑞科技
description: 奕瑞科技iRay Group（SHSE: 688301），成立于2011年，主要从事数字化X线探测器、高压发生器、组合式射线源等核心部件的研发、生产与销售，掌握传感器设计、CT探测器等核心技术，是全球少数具备数字化X线探测器全链条技术能力的生产商之一。

name: 嬴彻科技
description: 嬴彻科技Inceptio Technology，成立于2018年，是全球领先的卡车自动驾驶独角兽企业。公司聚焦干线物流场景，自主研发L2-L4级自动驾驶技术，并与主机厂合作实现智能重卡量产。

name: 字节跳动
description: 字节跳动ByteDance，成立于2012年，是一家以人工智能为基础的全球化互联网科技公司。其愿景是“建设全球创作与交流平台”，使命是“Inspire Creativity, Enrich Life”（激发创造，丰富生活）。公司已在全球推出了众多产品，包括综合资讯类应用“今日头条”，短视频应用“抖音”（在中国大陆）和“TikTok”（国际版），以及视频平台“西瓜视频”等。

name: 它石智航
description: 它石智航Tars，成立于2025年，是一家中国具身智能技术公司，致力于以物理世界AI和通用机器人技术为核心，构建可信赖的超级具身智能系统。

name: 宇树科技
description: 宇树科技Unitree（SHSE: 688836），成立于2016年，是一家机器人公司，专注于高性能通用足式和人形机器人的研发、生产和销售。宇树科技拥有四足和通用人形两大机器人产品线，在机器人核心零部件、运动控制和感知决策等领域拥有全球领先的技术，并已将产品销往全球超过一半的国家和地区。

name: 客路旅行
description: 客路旅行Klook，成立于2014年，是一家在线旅游平台，提供涵盖全球热门景点门票、当地体验、交通票券、住宿和美食预订等服务。它致力于通过其网站和应用程序为旅客提供便捷、经济的旅游产品，用户可以通过平台即时预订，享受如免排队入场等优惠。客路旅行在各地设有办事处，支持多种语言和货币支付。

name: 富途
description: 富途Futu Holdings（NASDAQ: FUTU），成立于2012年，是一家领先的金融科技公司，致力于为全球投资者提供覆盖多个市场的数字化金融服务，从而变革和提升投资体验。

name: 小红书
description: 小红书Rednote，成立于2013年，是一款集购物与社交于一体的平台，用户可以发布和浏览图文、短视频等内容，分享生活方式和购物心得。它最初以海外购物分享社区为特色，后逐步发展成一个拥有数亿用户的“生活美学分享社区”。小红书的社区内容非常丰富，也被称为“种草神器”，吸引了大量年轻人，尤其是女性用户。

name: 小马智行
description: 小马智行Pony.AI（NASDQ: PONY），成立于2016年，致力于提供安全、先进、可靠的全栈式自动驾驶技术，实现未来交通方式的彻底变革，最终达成“让自动驾驶触手可及（Autonomous Mobility Everywhere）”的美好愿景。

name: 小鹏汽车
description: 小鹏汽车XPeng Motors（NYSE: XPEV; SEHK: 9868），成立于2014年，是中国领先的智能电动汽车公司，设计、开发、制造及营销吸引庞大且不断增长的热衷科技的中产阶层消费者的智能电动汽车。其使命为成为全球用户喜爱的智能科技企业。

name: 希音
description: 希音SHEIN（SEHK: 0625），成立于2008年，是以快时尚为核心的全球跨境电商平台。它最初由许仰天在中国南京创立，以B2C模式运营，主营女装，后拓展至男装、童装、家居及配饰等品类。公司利用柔性供应链和“小单快反”模式，能够快速响应市场潮流并提供高性价比产品，业务已覆盖全球150多个国家和地区。

name: 彼悦
description: 彼悦Ubras，成立于 2016 年，是女性内衣品牌，主打舒适和“无尺码”概念，并已成为该领域的开创者。该品牌以创新技术为基础，研发产品涵盖无尺码内衣、肌底衣、软支撑内衣等，旨在提供更舒适的贴身衣物。

name: 得物
description: 得物DeWu，成立于2015年，是一个集正品潮流电商和潮流生活社区于一体的App，前身为“毒App”，于2020年正式更名为“得物”。其核心特色是首创“先鉴别，后发货”的模式，通过专业的鉴别团队对商品进行多重查验，以确保用户买到的商品是正品。得物平台覆盖鞋、服饰、配饰、潮玩、数码产品等多种品类，并构建了一个面向年轻用户的潮流文化社区。

name: 德邦物流
description: 德邦物流Deppon Logistics（SHSE: 603056），成立于1996年，是一个综合性快递物流企业，以大件快递为核心业务，业务范围涵盖快运、整车、仓储与供应链以及跨境物流等领域。

name: 快手
description: 快手Kuaishou（SEHK: 1024; SEHK: 81024），成立于2011年，前身为“GIF快手”，在2012年转型为短视频社区，是中国一家领先的短视频社交平台公司。用户可以通过短视频和直播记录、分享生活。快手提供多元化的内容和服务，包括娱乐、营销、电商、游戏和知识分享等，并且持续拓展业务，例如布局本地生活服务。

name: 思灵机器人
description: 思灵机器人Agile Robots，成立于2018年，是一家全球领先的智能机器人明星企业，立足全球化发展。以德国宇航中心为技术依托，致力于推动机器人技术探索与创新，并拓展机器人在更多领域的推广应用。

name: 思特威
description: 思特威Smartsens (SHSE: 688213)，成立于 2017年，是一家专注于高性能CMOS图像传感器（CIS）芯片研发与销售的高新技术企业。

name: 恩和生物
description: 恩和生物Bota Bio，成立于2019年，是一家全球领先的合成生物学与物理人工智能驱动的生物制造公司。公司致力于将先进的生物技术转化为可靠、可规模化的工业生产力引擎，生产可持续、绿色且高性价比的生物基产品

name: 慕思
description: 慕思DeRUCCI（SZSE: 001323），成立于2004年，是中国知名的健康睡眠系统品牌与软体家具企业，企业致力于人体健康睡眠研究，专注于高端床垫、床架、沙发及智能睡眠系统的研发、生产和销售。

name: 懂车帝
description: 懂车帝Dongchedi，上线于2017年，以“享受汽车 科技驱动产业发展”为使命，致力于成为最受信赖的汽车信息、交易、服务平台。

name: 拼多多
description: 拼多多Pinduoduo（NASDAQ: PDD），成立于2015年，以“拼购”模式核心，通过用户社交分享实现低价购物。该平台以农产品起家，现已发展成为一个提供各类商品的全品类综合性电商平台，并于2018年在纽交所上市。其商业模式在于通过C2M（客户对制造商）模式和拼团，连接消费者和生产者，以优惠价格提供商品，并融合了娱乐和社交元素。

name: 新产业生物
description: 新产业生物Snibe Diagnostics（SZSE: 300832），成立于1995 年，是专业从事体外诊断产品研发、生产、销售及服务的国家级高新技术企业。公司自成立以来， 一直专注于化学发光免疫分析领域的研究， 经过十多年的潜心努力，于 2008 年 9 月成功推出中国第一台全自动化学发光免疫分析仪。

name: 易瑞生物
description: 易瑞生物Bioeasy (SZSE: 300942)，成立于2007年，是中国A股首家食品安全快速检测上市公司。作为国家级“专精特新”小巨人企业，公司专注于食品安全、动物疫病防控及体外诊断（POCT）领域，构建了“核心原材料+试剂+设备+服务”的完整闭环体系。

name: 昭衍新药
description: 昭衍新药Joinn Labs（SHSE: 603127; SEHK: 6127），成立于1995年，是一家专业的药物研发服务外包企业（CRO）。它提供药物研发全生命周期的服务，包括药物的安全性评价、药理毒理研究、临床试验以及药物警戒等。公司服务范围广泛，并拥有符合国际规范的质量管理体系和多项GLP资质。

name: 普瑞眼科
description: 普瑞眼科Bright Eye Hospital（SZSE: 301239.SZ），成立于2005年，是国内大型专业眼科连锁医疗机构之一。现已在全国20多个城市设立数十家眼科专科医院及门诊部，致力于为全年龄段患者提供覆盖全视觉场景的眼科诊疗与医学验光配镜服务。

name: 景昱医疗
description: 景昱医疗SceneRay，成立于2011年，总部位于苏州工业园区，是全球少数能够研发并提供脑机接口（DBS，脑深部电刺激）产品的创新型高科技医疗器械企业之一。公司专注于植入式神经刺激系统（即“脑起搏器”），产品广泛应用于运动障碍疾病（如帕金森病）与精神类疾病的治疗。

name: 晶泰科技
description: 晶泰科技XtalPi（SEHK: 2228），成立于2015年，是一家以智能化、自动化驱动的药物研发科技公司，为全球生物医药企业提供药物发现一体化解决方案，首创智能计算、智能实验和专家经验相结合的研发模式，打造三位一体的药物研发平台。

name: 智元机器人
description: 智元机器人AgiBot，成立于2023年，是一家科技公司，专注于以AI和机器人融合的通用具身智能机器人研发，致力于打造可在现实世界提供劳动力服务的下一代机器人产品。其产品包括通用人形机器人系列，如“远征”和“灵犀”系列，并已率先实现人形机器人的规模化量产和商业化落地。

name: 智慧芽
description: 智慧芽PatSnap，成立于2007年，是一家科技创新情报服务商，提供大数据情报和知识产权信息化服务。公司利用机器学习、计算机视觉和自然语言处理等人工智能技术，为全球的科技公司、高校、科研机构和金融机构等提供知识产权和研发情报服务。其产品矩阵包括全球专利数据库、知识产权管理系统和研发情报库等。

name: 智谱
description: 智谱Zhipu AI（SEHK: 2513），成立于2019年，源自清华大学计算机系知识工程实验室（KEG），是一家专注于打造通用人工智能（AGI）底座的中国人工智能领军企业。

name: 曦智科技
description: 曦智科技Lightelligence（SEHK: 1879），成立于2017年，是一家专注于光电混合算力的全球化高科技企业。公司=由麻省理工学院（MIT）博士沈亦晨等人在波士顿创立，总部位于中国上海。

name: 月之暗面
description: 月之暗面Moonshot AI，成立于2023年，是一家中国人工智能初创公司，致力于通用人工智能（AGI）的研发。其最知名的产品为旗舰人工智能助手 Kimi。

name: 极兔
description: 极兔J&T Express（SEHK: 1519），成立于2015年，是全球综合物流服务运营商，最初在中国和东南亚市场占有领先地位。其核心业务包括快递、快运、仓储和供应链服务，并通过智能化的基础设施和数字化的物流网络为客户提供服务。

name: 林氏家居
description: 林氏家居LINSY，成立于2007年，是互联网家居企业，集研发、制造、销售、售后于一体，并以新零售模式为特色。公司在2022年升级品牌并拓展了全屋定制等业务，以“让生活过得更好”为愿景，通过多品牌、全品类和全渠道布局，为消费者提供多元化的家居解决方案。

name: 梅卡曼德
description: 梅卡曼德MechMind(SEHK: 9615)，成立于2016年，是国内知名的AI+3D+智能工业机器人解决方案提供商，专注于3D视觉领域软硬件产品研发、生产及销售的高新技术企业。

name: 正泰安能
description: 正泰安能CHNT，成立于2015年，是正泰集团旗下的户用光伏产业公司，致力于为农村用户提供屋顶光伏系统的“合作开发、销售、勘测设计、安装及售后运维”全解决方案。

name: 正浩创新
description: 正浩创新Ecoflow，成立于2017年，专注于移动储能和清洁能源领域。在全球向可再生能源转型的浪潮中，我们以行业领先的便携式电源产品、太阳能技术和智能家居能源解决方案引领前进方向。

name: 比亚迪
description: 比亚迪BYD（SEHK: 1211; SZSE:002594）,成立于1994年， 总部位于广东省深圳市， 是在香港和深圳两地上市的世界500强企业，业务横跨汽车、电子、新能源、轨道交通四大产业，从能源的获取、存储，再到应用，全方位构建零排放的新能源整体解决方案，致力于用技术创新，满足人们对美好生活的向往，助力为地球降温1°C。

name: 汉邦科技
description: 汉邦科技Hanbon Sci.& Tech.(SHSE: 688755），成立于1998年，总部位于江苏淮安。作为国内综合规模最大的液相色谱装备制造商之一，公司专注于生物医药及生命科学领域，提供从实验室到工业化生产的分离纯化设备、耗材及一体化工程解决方案。

name: 泡泡玛特
description: 泡泡玛特POP MART（SEHK: 9992），成立于2010年，是一家专注于潮流玩具的文化公司，以“盲盒”这一核心产品和其创造的IP（知识产权）如Molly、DIMOO等而闻名。公司围绕艺术家挖掘、IP孵化运营、消费者触达等构建了一个覆盖潮流玩具全产业链的综合运营平台。

name: 海柔
description: 海柔创新Hai Robotics，成立于2016年，是箱式仓储机器人系统专家，致力于通过机器人技术和智能算法，提供高效、智能、柔性的仓储自动化解决方案，为每个工厂和物流仓库创造价值。

name: 满帮
description: 满帮Full Truck Alliance（NYSE: YMM），于2017年由“运满满”和“货车帮”于2017年合并而成，一家中国领先的互联网+物流平台公司。该公司利用大数据和技术连接货车司机和货主，通过信息匹配提高物流效率，降低成本。其主要业务是为公路货运提供撮合交易，并逐渐从平台型企业向智慧物流生态平台转型，扩展至金融、能源等增值服务。

name: 火星人集成灶
description: 火星人集成灶Marssenger Kitchenware（SZSE: 300894），成立于2010年，以“让厨房生活更健康”为使命，专注于集成灶、集成洗碗机等高端集成厨电的研发、生产和销售。公司拥有强大的自主研发能力和创新技术，产品以解决油烟问题为核心，例如“低空近吸·智能全净吸系统”和“驭风智驱引擎”技术。

name: 燃石医学
description: 燃石医学Burning Rock DX（NASDAQ：BNR），成立于2014年，使命为“用科学守护生命之光”，专注于开发创新可靠、具有临床价值的癌症伴随诊断与早检产品，是一家专注于癌症精准医疗的生物技术公司。其使命为“用科学守护生命之光”，核心业务涵盖肿瘤患者精准医学检测、全球药企伴侣诊断合作以及基于液体活检的多癌种早检。

name: 爱奇艺
description: 爱奇艺iQiyi（NASDAQ: IQ），由百度集团旗下创办，于2010年正式上线,是中国领先的在线娱乐服务提供商。其品牌内涵为“品质、青春、时尚”，致力于为用户提供丰富的视频内容，包括电视剧、电影、综艺、动漫等，并已成功构建了包括短视频、游戏、电商等在内的多元化娱乐生态系统。爱奇艺以其先进的AI和大数据技术为驱动，通过会员服务、在线广告等多种盈利模式，为用户提供高品质的娱乐体验。

name: 瑞科生物
description: 瑞科生物RecBio (SEHK: 02179)，成立于2012年，是一家以自主研发为核心驱动力的创新型疫苗公司。公司秉持“创制一流疫苗，守护人类健康”的使命，专注于开发覆盖宫颈癌、带状疱疹、呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）等重大疾病的创新型疫苗。

name: 稀宇科技
description: 稀宇科技MiniMax（SEHK: 0100），成立于2022年，是全球领先的通用人工智能科技公司，致力于”与所有人共创智能”，自主研发了一系列多模态通用大模型，并面向全球推出一系列AI原生产品，已服务逾2亿名用户。

name: 稳健医疗
description: 稳健医疗Winner Medical (SZSE: 300888)，成立于1991年，是一家以“棉”为核心的大健康上市企业。该公司以医用敷料起家，逐步发展为涵盖医疗卫生、个人护理及家庭生活用品的综合性集团。

name: 空中云汇
description: 空中云汇Airwallex，成立于2015年，是一家金融科技公司，提供全球支付和金融服务，旨在帮助企业实现无国界交易和发展。其核心是通过技术构建全球金融基础设施，提供包括全球收款账户、国际付款、货币兑换、以及支出管理和多币种公司卡等一站式解决方案。空中云汇服务于各类规模的企业，涵盖跨境电商、在线平台等多种场景。

name: 立景创新
description: 立景创新集团LUXVISIONS，成立于2018年，公司拥有强大的研发团队，成功量产业界第一个三摄模组于手机产品中，针对未来AIOT智能物联网应用，3D与车用市场产品的开拓以稳健姿势持续发展，立志成为世界影音整合首屈一指的领导者。

name: 精锋医疗
description: 精锋医疗Edge Medical (SEHK: 02675)，成立于2017年，是一家全球化的手术机器人研发与制造企业。公司由麻省理工学院及哈佛大学联培博士团队创立，致力于微创外科手术机器人的自主研发，现已成长为中国手术机器人领域的领军企业。

name: 纳微科技
description: 纳微科技Nanowin（SHSE: 688690），成立于2007年，专注于高性能纳米微球材料的研发、生产与销售。公司通过自主研发的“种子法”等技术打破国外垄断，成为全球少数能规模化生产单分散色谱填料的企业之一。

name: 纽福斯生物
description: 纽福斯生物科技Neurophth，成立于2016年，是中国首家针对眼科疾病的基因治疗公司。 作为一家临床阶段的研发企业，公司致力于为全球眼科疾病患者探索和开发新的疗法。

name: 美团
description: 美团Meituan（SEHK: 3690），成立于2010年，是一家科技零售公司，使命是“帮大家吃得更好，生活更好”。它是一个领先的生活服务电子商务平台，业务涵盖餐饮外卖、到店消费、酒店旅游、共享单车、生鲜零售等200多个品类，服务覆盖全国的县区市。美团于2018年在港交所上市，并通过“零售+科技”战略不断进行数字化升级和服务拓展。

name: 聚水潭
description: 聚水潭JST Group (SEHK: 6687)，成立于2014年，创始人兼CEO骆海东拥有近三十年传统及电商ERP的研发和实施部署经验。聚水潭创建之初，以电商SaaS ERP切入市场，凭借出色的产品和服务，快速获得市场的肯定。随着客户需求的不断变化，如今聚水潭已经发展成为以SaaS ERP为核心，集多种商家服务为一体的SaaS协同平台。

name: 艾康特
description: 艾康特VisionXlab，成立于2018年，专注于眼视光领域医疗器械全套解决方案的研发和生产。公司研发产品管线近20个产品，目前在上海、珠海、杭州等地拥有配置完备的医疗器械研发和生产设施。公司目前全职员工约170人，研发人员占比超过40%。凭借国际化视野和创新产品矩阵，艾康特致力于驱动中国眼视光器械领域的革新与进步。

name: 英矽智能
description: 英矽智能Insilico Medicine (SEHK: 03696)，成立于2014年，利用专有的 Pharma.AI 平台，连接生物学、化学和临床试验，极大加速创新药物的研发进程，聚焦癌症、纤维化、免疫等未满足医疗需求的疾病领域。

name: 药康生物
description: 药康生物GemPharmatech(SHSE: 688046)，成立于2017年，是一家专注于实验动物小鼠模型研发、生产及相关技术服务的高新技术企业。

name: 药明康德
description: 药明康德WuXi AppTec（SHSE: 603259; SEHK: 2359），成立于2000年，是一家全球性的医药、生物技术和医疗器械研发服务公司。它通过提供一体化的、端到端的新药研发和生产服务，包括化学药研发生产、生物药研发生产、基因测序、临床前测试和临床试验等，赋能全球创新者，助力新药研发。

name: 药明生物
description: 药明生物WuXi Biologics（SEHK: 2269），成立于2014年，是一家开放式、一体化生物制药技术赋能平台，为全球生技公司提供从药物发现、开发到商业化生产的全流程端到端服务。核心业务包括抗体药物、疫苗等生物制剂的研发与生产，并专注于双特异性抗体、连续生产及mRNA疫苗等技术平台。

name: 蓝湖
description: 蓝湖Lanhu，成立于2017年，是一款专为互联网产品研发团队设计的云端在线协作平台。它面向产品经理、UI设计师和前端工程师，提供设计图自动标注、切图下载、版本管理及团队实时在线协作等功能，旨在打破沟通壁垒，大幅提升产品从设计到研发的落地效率。

name: 蔚来
description: 蔚来NIO（NYSE: NIO; SEHK: 9866; SGX: NIO），成立于2014年，是全球智能电动汽车市场的先驱及领跑者。蔚来致力于共创可持续和更美好的未来，实现Blue Sky Coming的使命。蔚来的愿景是成为技术与体验领先的用户企业。蔚来设计、开发、制造及销售智能电动汽车，推动新一代核心技术的创新。

name: 蜜雪冰城
description: 蜜雪冰城MIXUE，成立于1997年，是全球知名的现制饮品连锁品牌，主营冰淇淋、茶饮、果饮和咖啡。自创立以来，品牌坚持“高质平价”路线，凭借极高的性价比、完备的自产供应链以及极具辨识度的“雪王”IP，迅速风靡全球。

name: 观夏
description: 观夏To Summer，成立于2018年，是一个开创性的东方艺术香氛品牌，主打东方植物香调，产品涵盖香水、家居香氛与身体洗护。它将东方的诗书画卷与当代文化结合，致力于通过“五感融通”的香气，唤起人们对故土与传统文化的记忆。

name: 诺禾致源
description: 诺禾致源Novogene（SHSE: 688315），成立于2011年，专注于开拓前沿分子生物学技术和高性能计算在生命科学研究和人类健康领域的应用，致力于成为全球领先的基因科技产品和服务提供者。专注于分子生物学技术和高性能计算在生命科学与人类健康领域的应用，是全球领先的基因科技产品和服务提供者。

name: 贝咖
description: 贝咖Babycare，成立于2014年，是由设计师创立的母婴品牌，以其高颜值、高品质和高安全性的产品而闻名，产品线覆盖了从孕期到儿童6岁的各个阶段，包括尿裤、喂哺用品、玩具、童装等。它最初以婴儿背带切入市场，通过持续的设计和迭代不断拓展品类。

name: 贝壳找房
description: 贝壳找房Ke Holdings（NYSE: BEKE; SEHK: 2423），成立于2017年，是一个技术驱动的居住服务平台，隶属于链家集团，以线上线下一体化模式为特色。该平台提供二手房、新房、租赁、家装等多种业务，并运用VR看房、楼盘字典等技术提升服务体验。

name: 贝泰妮
description: 贝泰妮Botanee（SZSE: 300957），成立于2010年，是以“皮肤健康互联网+”为定位的大健康产业集团，集研发、生产和营销为一体。它致力于打造中国皮肤健康生态，旗下拥有多个护肤品牌，其中“薇诺娜”是中国知名的皮肤学级护肤品牌。

name: 贝达药业
description: 贝达药业Betta Pharmaceuticals（SZSE: 300558），成立于2003年，是以创新药物研发为核心的中国高新技术制药企业，专注于恶性肿瘤、糖尿病和心脑血管疾病等领域的治疗药物研发、生产和销售。公司由海归博士团队创办，拥有包括国内第一个获批上市的小分子靶向抗癌药盐酸埃克替尼（凯美纳®）在内的多款自主研发新药。

name: 货拉拉
description: 货拉拉Lalamove，成立于2013年，是一个互联网物流平台，提供同城/跨城货运、搬家、零担、汽车租售及车后市场服务。它通过共享模式整合社会运力，并利用移动互联网、大数据和人工智能技术，搭建了一个能够提供即时智能调度的货运平台。货拉拉为个人、商户和企业提供高效的物流解决方案，并且其业务范围已覆盖中国内地及海外多个国家和地区。

name: 辐联科技
description: 辐联科技Full-Life Technologies，成立于2021年，是一家全面整合的国际化放射性药物治疗公司，致力于构建集研发、生产与商业化为一体的全产业链平台。公司成立于2021年，总部位于上海，并在比利时和德国设有分支机构，专注于攻克放射性药物领域的根本性难题，造福全球患者。

name: 远景动力
description: 远景动力Envision AESC，成立于2018年，是一家全球领先的智能电池科技公司，致力于动力与储能电池系统的研发、设计、制造及销售。公司成在日本、中国、美国、英国、法国及西班牙设有13大制造基地和多个研发与工程中心。

name: 远景智能
description: 远景智能Envision Digital，成立于2014年，是远景科技集团旗下从事低碳和Alot技术的公司，其研发的智能物联操作系统EnOSTM已连接管理了超过2亿个智能终端设备和400GW的能源资产。

name: 远景能源
description: 远景能源Envision Energy，成立于2007年，是全球领先的绿色科技企业——远景科技集团（Envision Group）的核心业务板块。它致力于通过智能风电、智慧储能以及绿色氢能等综合解决方案，为全球客户提供清洁能源与零碳转型服务。

name: 迪哲医药
description: 迪哲医药Dizal Pharma（SHSE: 688192），成立于2017年，是一家创新型生物医药企业，专注于恶性肿瘤、免疫性疾病领域创新疗法的研究、开发和商业化。公司坚持源头创新的研发理念，以推出全球首创药物（First-in-class）和具有突破性潜力的治疗方法为目标，旨在填补全球未被满足的临床需求。

name: 途虎养车
description: 途虎养车TUHU Car（SEHK: 9690），成立于2011年，是一个线上线下O2O汽车服务平台。它为车主提供线上购买汽车产品和预约服务，再到线下门店进行安装和维修等一体化服务。其主营业务包括轮胎、机油、汽车保养、美容等，同时也在积极拓展新能源汽车服务。

name: 锦欣生殖
description: 锦欣生殖Jinxin Fertility（SEHK: 1951），成立于2003年，是一家国际化、专业化的辅助生殖医疗集团，在中国和美国领先，提供包括生育力评估、生殖外科、生殖男科和辅助生殖等在内的不孕不育诊疗全流程服务。

name: 阿里巴巴
description: 阿里巴巴Alibaba（NYSE: BABA; SEHK: 9988; SEHK: 89988），成立于1999年，是一家中国的跨国科技公司，总部位于杭州。其业务涵盖电子商务、云计算、数字媒体和娱乐、本地生活服务等多个领域，主要平台包括淘宝、天猫、阿里云和支付宝等。阿里巴巴致力于为商家提供技术基础设施和营销平台，并以“让天下没有难做的生意”为使命。

name: 零跑汽车
description: 零跑Leapmotor（SEHK: 9863），成立于2015年，是掌握新能源汽车核心技术全域自研能力的中国新能源汽车公司，业务范围涵盖智能电动汽车整车设计、研发制造、辅助驾驶、电机电控系统、电池系统开发，以及基于云计算的车联网解决方案。

name: 香港亚洲医疗集团
description: 香港亚洲医疗集团HK Asia Medical Group，成立于1999年、专注于心血管领域的医疗集团。它已发展成为亚洲最大、技术最先进的心血管医疗集团之一，业务遍及中国内地、香港和日本。集团致力于医疗实践、教学和研究，并拥有包括武汉亚洲心脏病医院和日本札幌心脏中心在内的多家医疗机构。

Adazza’s solution helps business users bypass IT teams, and replaces the hours they spend in spreadsheets with pre-built analytics and ML/AI apps on a SaaS subscription. As a result of centralizing data about how people use their phones, Adazza can unlock this data for the broader fintech ecosystem building insurance & credit scoring applications.

Their platform functions like a search engine for materials, allowing users to request specific properties for new materials on demand. This enables the rapid generation and evaluation of a vast number of novel structures, ultimately leading to the discovery of materials with precise functionalities.

Its self-learning AI is modeled on the human immune system and used by over 3,000 organizations to protect against threats to the cloud, email, IoT, networks and industrial systems. This includes insider threat, industrial espionage, IoT compromises, zero-day malware, data loss, supply chain risk and long-term infrastructure vulnerabilities. The company has over 1,000 employees, 44 global offices and headquarters in San Francisco and Cambridge, UK. Every 3 seconds, Darktrace AI fights back against a cyber-threat, preventing it from causing damage.

It’s not a chicken chow mein and a night on the sofa anymore, it’s your favourite local restaurant, it’s a dinner party, a date. They’re over a decade in, and along the way the team have taken hundreds of ideas from brainstorms to global roll-outs, like Deliveroo Editions – bespoke kitchens designed to host a locally-curated selection of restaurants. Editions are our solution to ensuring that our customers have access to the best of the food-scene, no matter where they live. And that’s just what they’re like at Deliveroo, no compromise allowed and lots of food-inspired challenges to get your teeth into. Out-of-the-box thinking is actively encouraged and they move quickly to make great ideas happen. They’re energetic, fast-paced and blow off steam with free-for-all Friday lunches. It’s a formula that’s working too – they’re bringing great food to customers in 13 countries and over 200 cities.

SuperAwesome has reshaped the kids’ digital media landscape with their kid-safe tools and technology including AwesomeAds (the biggest kid-safe ad platform in the world), REX (the first kid-safe programmatic ad filter), PopJam (social content tools for U13 engagement) and Kids Web Services (kids/parent authentication). TourRadar lists over 1 million tour departures, so that travellers are guaranteed to find a trip that fits their needs. On top of that, it is also the hub of over 100,000 real traveller reviews for customers to sift through and learn from. With global offices, there’s a dedicated Customer Support team available 24/7 to ensure customers have the best possible experience while booking and on vacation. As a member with TourRadar, customers receive special savings, tips and expert advice to help them book their next adventure. Since launching in 2010, the company has made massive strides, becoming a leader in its industry and continuing to grow rapidly. With travel styles from marine to cultural to festivals to luxury and more the company caters to every demographic. TourRadar also founded the annual Guide of the Year and Tour of the Year awards, recognizing the industry’s top rated guides and tours.

Our machines will be capable of solving problems that would take even the most powerful supercomputers millions of years to solve with applications ranging across a broad range of different industries including pharmaceutical, finance and aerospace.

Through a single integration, merchants gain access to domestic routing, leveraging lower payment costs and deliver payments seamlessly. This network is overlaid with Vitesse built treasury platform and can be connected to via API or an intelligent UI. We continue to invest and adapt our technology in an ever changing market, facilitating specific industry requirements, improving operational efficiencies and transparency. Vitesse prides itself on its growing relationships with Tier 1 in-country banks and partners across the world, collating industry and regulatory knowledge providing a robust and compliant solution. Vitesse is registered as a money transmitter for HMRC (12833959) and authorised by the FCA as an E-Money Institution (900646) meaning not only can we make your payments but hold your liquidity securely. The smart way to make global payments.

name: Wanted
description: Wanted is a new talent agency whose mission it is to eliminate recruitment bias that often causes discrimination when offering a salary. The factors include but are not limited to: race, gender and belief. Wanted requires those looking for employment to enter their required salary and upload a CV/LinkedIn profile, before being matched to employers who are not able to see the full profile of the employee. This maintains their anonymity and allows for a non-biased review of their profile. The company is tackling a lack of job transparency that exists far too often in the employment world, which results in interviews existing just to waste the time of the employee who at the end will realize that the job will not even cover their bills.

name: XYZ Reality
description: XYZ Reality is the UK start-up behind HoloSite, the world’s first Engineering Grade Augmented Reality device. On a mission to eliminate 2D in its entirety and bring an industry in decline back to life, XYZ Reality is enabling construction workers around the world to build from holograms and it’s making a huge dent on the 77% of megaprojects that overrun globally. Construction workers can now view and position design models on site to 5mm accuracy and make real-time decisions in the field. The ground-breaking technology also significantly eliminates errors out of tolerance and reduces the time taken from set-out to build. Named one of the top five construction technology firms, XYZ Reality is focused on making the lives of all construction workers easier by democratising the skill-set, boosting productivity and closing a skills-gap. They term AR, Assisted Reality, existing only to enhance the role of the construction worker.

name: Yieldify
description: Yieldify is a customer journey optimization platform that brings personalization to the full customer journey. It combines award-winning software with a proven CJO methodology to deliver measurable results quickly and easily. To date, Yieldify has influenced over 100 million sales through more than 200,000 journeys. It currently delivers customer journey optimization for over 1,000 leading e-commerce websites, including Domino’s Pizza, L’Oreal and Megabus.

name: Finches
description: The startup develops an AI-powered sourcing intelligence platform for enterprises that source agricultural raw materials. It combines unstructured field data, external climate signals, and ERP data within a proprietary contextual intelligence engine to detect supply risks early and generate autonomous, opinionated sourcing actions. Target customers include procurement, finance, and quality leaders across food & beverage, life sciences, and industrial raw material sectors.

name: TODAY
description: TODAY, based in Copenhagen and Berlin, was founded in 2024 with the mission “Peace of Mind at Scale”. Its AI sales operating system supports financial and insurance advisors before, during and after client meetings, so they save time and give their clients better advice. Advisors see up to 10% more revenue, save up to 5 hours per week and capture on average 50x more insight from client conversations. More than 3,500 advisors in DACH use TODAY in their daily work, from large insurers and distributors to independent brokers. TODAY was co-founded by Michael Gackstatter (CEO) and Artem Demchenkov (CTO), who previously held roles at Fintechs and InsurTechs including CLARK, Funding Circle and Billie.

name: Kontext
description: Kontext is a runtime security platform for AI agents. It gives teams visibility into how agents behave and control over what they are allowed to do. Kontext evaluates activity in real time using identity, task context, security policies, and cyber-risk signals. It can identify risky behavior, deny unauthorized actions before execution, and create an auditable record of what each agent attempted, what was allowed or denied, and why.

name: Arcos
description: Arcos is a civil security provider. Arcos builds and operates the infrastructure of civil security: from the highly secured infrastructure where the signals converge to the technology it runs on. Arcos’s ambition is that what our societies depend on never goes unprotected. Arcos is based in Munich. Its investors include High-Tech Gründerfonds (HTGF), Bayern Kapital, Pact, Haufe and Robin Capital as well as strategic business angels.

name: Depotcharge
description: Depotcharge operates a manufacturer-neutral network for shared depot charging infrastructure in electric road freight. Logistics companies open unused charging points at their sites to other fleets and generate additional revenue from existing infrastructure, while Depotcharge handles access control, invoicing and payment processing. The company was founded by Joscha Specks and Julius Wilhelm, who together bring more than 20 years of experience in e-mobility and previously helped build Digital Charging Solutions, a joint venture of BMW, Mercedes-Benz and BP Europa SE. Depotcharge is active in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the Benelux countries. The operating company behind the Depotcharge brand is Evolve Energy GmbH.

name: Veridue
description: Veridue is the AI-native due diligence and M&A platform purpose-built for energy infrastructure and data centres. It accelerates investment and project financing for investors, IPPs, developers, lenders and insurers – enabling buyers to increase returns by identifying higher-quality assets and winning more deals, while getting owners and sellers to bankability or a better exit, faster. Veridue brings slow, manual and expensive transaction processes, which cannot keep pace with rising deal volumes and complexity, into the age of AI. Its platform acts as a single source of truth across the entire deal lifecycle, from origination and deal screening to VDR, Q&A, due diligence and beyond. Veridue combines the latest AI models with its own proprietary deterministic agent layer, trained across thousands of risk factors, and a human layer of expert judgement from its in-house energy transaction specialists — delivering organised data rooms, screened deals and full due diligence in hours instead of weeks. The result is an independent, objective foundation for moving capital into bankable energy infrastructure at scale, enabling deal teams to move with greater speed and rigour at the same time.

name: Jaipur Robotics
description: Jaipur Robotics AG develops computer vision and AI solutions for industrial sites such as Waste-to-Energy (WtE), cement, and biomass plants, making them safer, smarter, and more efficient. Founded in 2024 and headquartered at Technopole Ticino in Manno, near Lugano, Switzerland, it is one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the sector, with a 40-person team and two R&D centres in Switzerland and Asia.

name: REVIER Therapeutics
description: Revier has established the first therapeutic approach to selectively target Class IIa HDACs to treat cardiometabolic diseases. Our orally available small molecules are designed to inhibit the pathogenic enzymatic activity while preserving healthy biological function and avoiding canonical HDAC inhibition. We are advancing a pipeline of novel disease modulators starting with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) as our initial indications. Our goal is to define a new class of treatments that directly improve cardiometabolic health and provide life-saving, long-term benefits for patients with related diseases.

name: EPIX Sports
description: EPIX Sports is developing an operating system for the European sports market: The company identifies, finances, and scales local sports concepts into pan-European category brands. The focus is on urban, community-driven experiential formats such as boutique padel, bouldering, Reformer Pilates, and social running. In addition to equity and debt financing, EPIX contributes operational expertise in the areas of site development, branding, technology, and operational structure. The model addresses a fragmented and capital-inefficient market through standardized processes and a scalable brand portfolio. Proprietary community formats further foster brand loyalty among both operators and end customers.

name: kausable
description: kausable is a deep tech AI startup founded in 2025 by Johannes Haux (CEO), Dr. Benjamin Herdeanu (CTO), and Gregor Ramien (COO), three physicists with ties to Heidelberg University and Black Forest Labs (BFL). The company is developing a reasoning-first foundational AI model that learns from minimal data, requires no retraining, and adapts to scenarios that could not be anticipated at build time. The team has published research in collaboration with Columbia University and developed TipPFN, a zero-shot model for forecasting rare, high-impact events in complex dynamic systems. In 2026, kausable raised 12 million EURO in their Seed Round from the European investors UVC Partners, Entourage, HTGF, and Mätch VC. Additionally, kausable is backed by private angel investors from the AI industry and academia.

name: Pixel-Flo
description: Pixel-Flo develops a process for enabling scaled-up MicroLED display manufacturing. Founded on groundbreaking academic research from the University of Sheffield, the spinout’s Continuous-Flo mass transfer manufacturing process addresses a key industry bottleneck in traditional mass transfer methods, which scale poorly with panel area. Their Continuous-Flo platform is based on two Pixel-Flo owned technology elements: MicroLED ink and the equipment extension of industry-standard coating tools. Pixel-Flo’s Continuous-Flo technology extends the industry-standard coating approach, reducing processing costs with panel size, lowering material costs, and improving wafer utilisation.

name: reverse.fashion
description: reverse.fashion was founded in 2024 as a spin-off from the Technical University of Berlin (Chair of Micro and Precision Devices, Prof. Dr. Dirk Oberschmidt). The technology is based on intellectual property (IP) developed during joint research projects between TU Berlin, Freie Universität Berlin (FU Berlin), and circular.fashion GmbH. The company was founded by Dr. Karsten Pufahl, Paul Doertenbach, and Mario Osterwalder and currently employs 12 people.

name: Auxilius
description: Auxilius.ai GmbH, founded in late 2025 and based in Unterföhring near Munich, automates enterprise control activities by converting policies and control rules into deterministic, executable code. Its platform automates the design, execution and testing of enterprise controls for internal audit, internal control and operational teams. The company is led by co-founders Christian Hoppe (CEO) and James Barnes (CTO) and currently employs a team of four AI- and Tech-Engineers. More at www.auxilius.ai.

name: CollimateHealth
description: Munich-based Startup CollimateHealth GmbH is developing a clinically scalable microbeam technology for oncological treatment. Microbeam therapy uses micrometer-scale radiation beams that trigger an immune response against tumors while causing less damage to surrounding healthy tissue than conventional radiotherapy. The technology was developed in collaboration with the Technical University of Munich (TUM), TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, the University of Mainz, the Helmholtz Institute Mainz, Forschungszentrum Jülich, the Institute of Cancer Research, and the Royal Marsden Hospital in London. CollimateHealth plans to begin first clinical applications by the end of 2028.

name: Qurie
description: Qurie GmbH was founded in 20 26 as a spin-off of the Fraunhofer Institute for Physical Measurement Techniques IPM in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. The company develops next-generation electrocaloric cooling systems – quiet, compact and completely free of conventional refrigerants. Founded by scientists with deep expertise in materials research and thermodynamics, Qurie works at the intersection of fundamental research and industrial application – with the goal of transforming global HVAC infrastructure. The company employs more than ten experts at its Freiburg location.

name: NanoStruct
description: NanoStruct is a startup at the intersection of biotechnology and nanotechnology, headquartered in Würzburg, offering an analysis platform for the rapid identification of harmful bacteria in food. Spun out of Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg in 2021 by Dr. Henriette Maaß, Enno Schatz, and Kai Leibfried, NanoStruct is now ready to bring its system to the food market.

name: Mobility Signage
description: Mobility Signage develops a central passenger information system for public and long-distance transport operators, cities, and rail companies. The platform connects fragmented IT landscapes, standardises interfaces, and enables reliable real-time information across all channels — modular, scalable, and hardware-independent. Founded in Munich in 2023, the company counts BVG, SSB, Deutsche Bahn, and RSAG among its customers.

name: Primogene
description: Primogene GmbH is a biotechnology start-up founded in 2023 by Dr.-Ing. Reza Mahour, Valerian Grote and Linda Karger based in Leipzig, Germany. The company specializes in the development of enzymatic biomanufacturing processes for the production of functional ingredients for nutrition and personal care in addition to pharma raw materials. Primogene’s technology enables the sustainable and scalable manufacturing of complex, high-value molecules.

name: VREY
description: VREY is a leading provider of solar solutions for multi-family buildings. The company enables collective building supply (“ gemeinschaftliche Gebäudeversorgung ” and tenant electricity models (“ Mieterstrom ”) through a combination of certified smart metering operations and automated billing software. Founded in 2024 by Cedric Jaeger and Julius Pahmeier in Berlin, VREY has quickly become a pioneer of the new regulatory framework in Germany. With a team of around 20 employees and a three-digit number of project s across all 16 federal states, the company serves private landlords, housing cooperatives, project developers, and large real estate companies.

name: brainjo
description: brainjo GmbH is a digital health startup founded in 2022 and based in Regensburg, Germany. The company develops VR-based digital health applications (DiGA) for psychotherapy. Its mission is to create evidence-based, immersive therapy solutions that complement and scale existing treatment approaches. The interdisciplinary team currently consists of 10 employees, combining expertise in technology, psychology, and healthcare. brainjo is about to launch its first clinical study.

name: Mycoverse
description: Mycoverse is a Danish biosolutions company developing fungal-based biological crop protection solutions. A spin-out from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Mycoverse uses an AI-driven discovery platform and advanced fungal production technology to develop biocontrol solutions that can replace chemical pesticides. The company’s platform is designed to support scalable, data-driven solutions across multiple crops, with an initial focus on potato late blight and future applications including grapevine. Mycoverse has previously been supported by BioInnovation Institute with € 1.9 million, bringing Mycoverse’s total fundraising up to € 4.3 million.

name: Noxon
description: Founded in 2022, Noxon is a MedTech company focused on non-invasive neuro- and muscle technologies. Its mission is to integrate evidence-based, digital care concepts into both clinical practice and everyday life.

name: Clee Medical
description: Clee Medical SA is a Swiss medical technology company based in Geneva developing minimally invasive neurotechnology solutions. Its flagship platform, Neuro Access, combines ultra-high-resolution real-time intraoperative Optical Coherence Tomography imaging with advanced navigation capabilities to support precision neurosurgery. The company’s mission is to forge a new era of highly targeted neuro therapies by improving surgical visibility and enabling safer access to deep brain targets. Clee Medical was founded in October 2024 and has gained recognition within the Swiss innovation ecosystem, including being named one of the Top 100 Swiss Startups in 2025, and has received support from leading Swiss innovation programs and partners.

name: INLEAP Photonics
description: INLEAP Photonics is a German high-tech company that develops, manufactures and sells ultra-fast and highly precise laser beam steering systems. The company builds and industrialises high-performance laser technology for two key applications: increasing efficiency and productivity in industrial manufacturing, and enabling safe and controlled drone defence to protect people and critical infrastructure. Based on the industrially proven INLEAP® FASTLIGHT® technology, INLEAP® FASTLIGHT® SHIELD has been developed as a laser-based solution for controlled and eye-safe drone defence. It enables deployment in sensitive and urban environments – reliably, precisely and without collateral damage. INLEAP Photonics was founded as a spin-off from Laser Zentrum Hannover e. V. and combines deep expertise in optics and laser systems engineering with industrial robustness. The company addresses industrial users, public-sector clients and security-relevant organisations across Europe.

name: Twogee Biotech
description: Twogee Biotech is a biotechnology company founded in 2024 and headquartered in Martinsried, Munich. Based on their innovative platform, the company develops customized enzyme and strain solutions for the industrial conversion of biogenic side and residual streams into sustainable second-generation raw materials. Twogee enables efficient utilization of biomass residues and supports the chemical industry in transitioning toward circular, low-CO₂ value creation—economically, scalably, and customer-focused.

name: Co-reactive
description: Co-reactive GmbH is a climate-tech start-up founded in 2024, supported by the EXIST program of BMWE and headquartered in Düsseldorf. The company is developing a continuous CO₂ mineralization technology that uses captured CO₂ and magnesium-/calcium-containing silicate minerals such as olivine or metallurgical slags to produce novel, highly reactive supplementary cementitious materials (CO-SCMs). The CO-SCMs have a negative CO₂ footprint and enable a significant reduction of the clinker content in cement and construction materials without compromising performance. Co-reactive works along the entire value chain with CO₂ and raw material suppliers, cement and concrete producers as well as certification bodies to pave the way from pilot plants to large-scale industrial plants in the 100- to 300-kilotons range. The team combines expertise in CO₂ mineralization, plant engineering, commercialization, and brings experience in scaling sustainable technologies.

name: Cancilico
description: Cancilico is a Dresden-based health-tech startup founded in 2023 as a spin-off of the EKFZ for Digital Health at TUD Dresden University of Technology and University Hospital Dresden. The company develops AI-driven diagnostic solutions for hematology, aimed at automating and improving the accuracy of blood and bone marrow analysis. Its mission is to bring cutting-edge AI technology into routine hematology labs, improving the state of care for blood cancer patients around the world and the development of digital biomarkers in hematology. The founding team includes Markus Badstübner, Dr. Moritz Middeke, Tim Schmittmann, Sebastian Riechert, Dr. Jan Eckardt, Dr. Karsten Wendt, and Angel Investor Prof. Gerhard Ehninger. Cancilico is deeply embedded in the Saxon life science ecosystem, engaging with the regional biotech network Biosaxony, and strongly contributing to the SaxoCell and SEMECO Clusters4Future initiatives. Within these clusters, startups such as Cancilico can further develop their strong founding dynamics and combine them with rapid translational pathways.

name: CoolSem Technologies
description: Based in Eindhoven (NL) and founded in 2025, CoolSem Technologies develops wafer-level thermal management technology to reduce thermal resistance and mechanical stress in advanced semiconductor and photonic devices. With its WaLTIS multilayer stack, CoolSem Technologies replaces conventional substrates with an engineered stack designed to enhance heat flow, mechanical stability, and reliability, enabling higher performance and longer lifetime for next-generation devices.

name: lytra
description: lytra is an industrial tech company based in Munich that helps mechanical engineering companies transform their after-sales service business into a real revenue driver. With an industry-specific AI operating system for mechanical engineering services, lytra offers its customers a fully integrated platform on which service requests are processed automatically and scalable by AI agents.

name: TECregen
description: TECregen is pioneering thymus rejuvenation to address conditions driven by impaired T-cell responses. The company’s innovative approach focuses on revitalizing and expanding thymic epithelial cells (TECs) to replenish T cells and achieve durable improvements in immune function. By developing a pipeline of differentiated thymopoietic biologics, TECregen aims to strengthen immune recovery following transplantation or cytotoxic therapy, promote immune health, and enhance immune surveillance against cancer, ushering in a new era of immunotherapy.

name: Zentio
description: Zentio is a Berlin-based startup building an AI-powered production planning platform for manufacturing companies. Our mission is to empower factories to turn operational data into strategic advantage — improving productivity, adaptability, and decision quality at scale. Founded by Julian Rose, Immo Polewka and Christophe Kafrouni in 2025, Zentio is currently collaborating with a broad network of pilot customers and strategic partners across Europe to further accelerate their vision of AI-native production planning.

name: FION Energy
description: FION Energy was founded in 2025 in Berlin. The cleantech startup makes industrial battery storage systems economical and easy to use – through manufacturer-independent project development and AI-optimised real-time operation. Target customers are industrial companies with an annual electricity consumption of more than 2 GWh. Several battery systems are already installed at industrial customer sites; further projects in Germany and across the EU are in the pipeline.

name: spoks
description: spoks is building a tech-enabled, brand-agnostic workshop network that makes bicycle repair, maintenance, and service processes more efficient, transparent, and customer-friendly. Through standardized workflows and a fully digital customer journey – from appointment booking to diagnostics and billing – spoks modernizes a traditionally fragmented and under-digitalized service market. Focusing exclusively on service, the company addresses the increasing technical complexity of e-bikes and premium bicycles and relies on a data- and process-driven roll-out model to expand its workshop network at scale. Community formats and loyalty programs further strengthen customer engagement and brand trust.

name: SereneDB
description: SereneDB is a German company founded in 2025 by Alexander Malandin, Andrey Abramov and Valery Mironov. SereneDB is building the open-sourced distributed, real-time search database bringing search and analytical processing together for fast performance and eliminating data duplication. SereneDB’s mission is to provide an easy-to-use uniﬁed search and analytics solution to change the way applications store and retrieve their data.

name: AILOS Robotics
description: AILOS Robotics builds the next generation of robotic actuators through its patented R2poweR gearbox — combining quasi-direct drive-like agility with class-leading torque density. Originating from the VUB BruBotics research group and backed by strong EU innovation programs, AILOS delivers the core component for safer, lighter, more sustainable and more affordable robots.

name: Marble Imaging
description: Marble Imaging is a big-data EO company founded in August 2023 in Bremen, Germany, building its constellation of VHR satellites to provide up to hourly EO data and analytics for time critical insights of our planet. The data and derived EO-based analytics will be vital in supporting rapid decision-making with regard to defence, climate security, crises & disaster management, green and sustainable energy transitions, infrastructure and mobility and much more. Marble already offers advanced data analysis services, including object detection for situational intelligence, terrain analytics and trafficability assessment, coastal asset monitoring and land cover classification.

name: dotega
description: dotega is the first provider of fully digitalized self-management for apartment owners’ associations. The PropTech company, based in Stuttgart, enables apartment owners’ associations to organize their administration independently, legally compliant, and efficiently—without a traditional administrator. With this approach, dotega aims to provide small and medium-sized appartment owners’ associations with up to 20 units—which today can hardly find a professional property manager—with access to a transparent and legally compliant administration solution. The platform is seen as a response to structural market failure in the property management industry and offers a digital, future-oriented alternative to traditional property management.

name: Zeeg
description: Zeeg is a booking CRM platform from Berlin that seamlessly combines appointment scheduling and customer management. Founded in 2023 by Mohammad Moghaddas and Florian Horbach, the software enables companies to automatically create a complete CRM entry from every booked appointment, without manual data maintenance, switching tools, or data protection compromises.

name: Factor2 Energy
description: Factor2 Energy is a German climate-tech company developing CO₂-based geothermal power systems. By using carbon dioxide as the working fluid, the technology accesses moderate-temperature geothermal resources. Compared to conventional systems, the technology can deliver up to twice the power output, without fracking, ultra-deep drilling, or water-intensive processes. Founded by a former Siemens Energy team after a successful proof of concept, the company is backed by leading climate investors, with its latest round led by At One Ventures. Factor2 Energy’s mission is to unlock scalable, clean, baseload geothermal power while supporting permanent carbon storage.

name: Rement
description: The building material concrete consumes large quantities of fossil resources every year and at the same time causes immense CO2 emissions and waste streams. Rement is developing a technology to extract new, high-quality raw materials from mineral waste streams and CO2. As a technology enabler, we are helping the construction and recycling industries to close material cycles and replace the linear economy with the urban mine.

name: Mevaldi
description: Mevaldi is a biochemical company and a pioneer in the field of bio-based building blocks for sustainable polymers, polyesters, and polyurethanes. Since 2020, the company has been developing 3MPD: an innovative building block derived from sugars and wood residues, produced through a patented bio-thermochemical process. This results in high-performance materials with low environmental impact and competitive pricing – with the entire production chain located within Europe. In this way, Mevaldi contributes competitively to the EU’s strategic autonomy, circular economy, and climate goals.

name: Pactos
description: Founded in 2023 by Antonio Zill and Philipp Eckert, Pactos offers an AI-powered platform that enables companies to manage external workforces digitally and in full legal compliance – from procurement and planning to invoicing. Operating in the entire DACH region, Pactos brings structure and transparency to a previously analogue domain.

name: TrustNXT
description: TrustNXT is a corporate spin-off of computer vision expert Basler AG, founded in Hamburg in 2024. The founding team combines deep technical expertise in visual data processing with deep legal and business skills. The company develops a software trust layer for distributed, autonomous systems that makes Physical AI deployment-ready. By providing full data lineage directly at the source—tamper-proof, in real-time, and EU-compliant—TrustNXT gives businesses in robotics, critical infrastructure, and logistics the traceability needed to meet regulations and successfully scale Physical AI in practice.

name: RedMimicry
description: RedMimicry GmbH was founded in 2023 by Alexander Rausch and Stefan Steinberg and creates a product that empowers companies to perform realistic and repeatble purple teaming exercises. Both founders have many years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, gained through their work at Proofpoint and the German Cyber Security Organisation (DCSO). RedMimicry’s innovative platform is already in use by medium-sized and large companies, as well as by managed security service providers and consulting firms.

name: Genow
description: Genow is a deep-tech startup based in Darmstadt (Germany), empowering companies to efficiently and precisely interact with their unstructured, fragmented enterprise knowledge through its Wingman platform. The Knowledge Operations AI platform enables organisations to easily and securely scale specialised AI applications, making knowledge processes more efficient and effective by preserving and generating new knowledge. Genow was founded in 2023 by Dr. Timo Koppe, Adrian Glauben, Dr. Sara Jourdan, and Prof. Peter Buxmann.

name: paddy
description: paddy is an AI platform developed by DigitalErleben GmbH, based in Bielefeld, supporting teachers across the entire teaching cycle. Founded in 2024 by Matty Frommann, Lukas Portmann, and Tobias Schröder – all children of teachers – and joined later that year by CTO Lukas Kaufmann, the company developed a solution to help teachers manage their overloaded school routines. paddy eases the workload in planning, conducting, and reviewing lessons and supports educators in giving personalized attention to their students. With over 12,000 active users (teachers) just six months post-launch, paddy is well on its way to transforming education in the DACH region through AI.

name: Stackgini
description: Stackgini is the AI-powered co-worker for IT decision-making and demand management in medium-sized and large enterprises. Our SaaS solution reduces the workload for IT teams, promotes the reuse of existing solutions, and automates compliance checks. It brings together all teams and tools – from IT service management and enterprise architecture to compliance and procurement. The platform enhances the internal IT knowledge of its customers with millions of market data points. With the help of our proprietary AI, companies gain deep insights into their IT portfolio for intelligent, data-driven IT decisions.

name: EvlaBio
description: EvlaBio is a life science company focused on developing first-in-class therapeutics for cardiovascular and cardiorenal diseases. Its lead program targets the FGFR4/FGF23 signaling axis, a critical driver of cardiac remodeling in chronic kidney disease. By advancing novel mechanisms grounded in strong translational science, EvlaBio aims to redefine treatment paradigms for CKD patients with high unmet medical need.

name: nuuEnergy
description: Founded in 2023, nuuEnergy specializes in the planning and installation of heat pumps. With a unique business model, the company combines the advantages of digital processes with the quality and proximity of traditional craft businesses. The goal: to make the switch to climate-friendly heating as simple, efficient, and high-quality as

name: ESG Score
description: Sustaynr GmbH is a specialist rating agency that provides companies and public authorities with digital sustainability data that can be integrated into purchasing systems and processes, enabling buyers to make better-informed decisions. Sustaynr’s core product is the ESG Score, which labels the sustainability of office supplies, ICT products and many other standard products in digital catalogues and can be used by users to sort products in online shops according to their sustainability based on this standardised indicator.

name: Medical Decision Alliance
description: MDA was founded in 2023 by Dr Gunter Trojandt, Annett Christ and two business angels, Jozsef Bugovics and Nils Kröber. MDA has a total of 10 employees and is based in Leipzig, Germany. The founding team has been working together for more than 10 years and successfully sold their last joint company, SPI – Surgical Process Institute, to Johnson & Johnson – a leading global manufacturer of medical devices and surgical robots – in 2017. The focus of SPI and MDA is on the operating room and improving the quality of patient outcomes. All developments are carried out in close collaboration with leading physicians, clinics and medical device companies. With the capital from the current round of financing, MDA will double the size of its team, recruit additional clinics (knowledge providers) and medical device companies (collaborators), and develop AI-based surgical training and assistance solutions.

name: desk.ly
description: desk.ly is the AI-powered workplace management platform that organises hybrid work environments in an efficient, sustainable and user-centric way – from desk sharing and smart booking recommendations to data-driven office management. For over two years, desk.ly has been the category leader in workplace management and desk booking on platforms such as OMR Reviews. Further information: www.desk.ly

name: eyeo B.V.
description: eyeo B.V. is redefining imaging with the world’s most advanced nanophotonic color-splitting technology. For the first time, image sensors can capture all of incoming light, overcoming the current 30% limit imposed by decades-old color filter technology. Instead of filtering photons, Eyeo B.V.’s breakthrough technology guides them directly to individual pixels, unlocking full light sensitivity and native color fidelity, even in the most challenging conditions. Compatible with any CMOS sensor platform, Eyeo B.V.’s single-photon guiding capability also breaks resolution barriers, enabling sub-0.5-micron pixels for ultra-compact, high-performance imaging in XR, industrial, security, and mobile applications where image quality is critical.

name: DXI
description: DXI GmbH was founded on October 1, 2024, in Munich and specializes in AI-driven customer twins. With its PersonaX® platform, the startup offers companies a revolutionary way to interact with digital representations of their customers on eye level – dynamically, realistically, and in real time. The company’s proprietary Latent Insight Amplifier (LIA) technology combines deep data analysis with intuitive UX and leading AI. In addition to customer twins, the platform also trains expert twins and automates complex business processes. DXI has been honored with the iF Design Award 2024, among other awards, and is one of the innovation leaders in the field of “digital customer twins.” Frank Rauchfuß and Stefan Trebbin are AI pioneers with experience from over 800 projects in the B2B/B2C sector.

name: mo:re
description: mo:re has developed a groundbreaking lab platform, combining automation and software for planning, executing, and analysis of cell culture studies. The user-friendly platform aims to simplify cell culture, making organoids accessible as a standard lab technique and providing verifiable results. The lab automation device covers all relevant process steps, setting a new benchmark for scalability, reproducibility, and standardization of 3D cell culture models.

name: TRIM TX
description: TRIM TX is developing best-in-class Gamma-Secretase-Stabilizers (GSS) for the prevention and treatment of Alzheimer Disease.

name: Steuerboard
description: Founded in July 2023 and headquartered in Düsseldorf, Steuerboard is a B2B SaaS company on a mission to rethink tax workflows. Its AI‑native platform centralizes data, automates routine tasks, and provides transparent collaboration between tax advisors (“Steuerberater”) and their clients (“Mandanten”), helping firms overcome specialist‑staff shortages and improve service quality.

name: Alpine Eagle
description: Founded in 2023, Alpine Eagle is a team of machine learning practitioners and aeronautical engineers building the world’s first airborne counter-drone system. The company’s Sentinel Counter-UAS System detects and classifies small drones. Its Sentinel-OS software platform can be integrated into various hardware to protect military and national assets and infrastructure. Apart from HTGF, Alpine Eagle is backed by leading investors including IQ Capital, General Catalyst and HCVC.

name: ctrl+s
description: ctrl+s is a climate-tech company based in Berlin that helps businesses actively manage their supply chain emissions. More than 35 industry leaders – including Siemens and TÜV Süd – already rely on ctrl+s to turn CO₂ management into measurable actions. Through its platform, the company enables emissions reductions across more than 10,000 suppliers, embedding sustainability deeply into complex value chains.

name: ai-predict
description: ai-predict has developed a software platform that calculates the properties of a product. For our customers in the specialty chemicals industry, existing customer data (e.g. formulations and laboratory data) is used to calculate new formulations. Typical industry AI models are combined with physics/chemistry and expert knowledge. Properties that could not previously be determined using traditional methods, including many tests, can now also be determined. The process is superior to traditional formulation software, as this cannot map complexity or interdependencies. The result is a drastic reduction in development time with better results.

name: Akribion Therapeutics
description: Akribion Therapeutics is developing a unique, RNA-guided, nuclease-based technology for programmable cell depletion. Our G-dase® E nuclease has the ability to kill cells by shredding DNA and RNA, but only if there is a highly specific match between the guide RNA and an intracellular RNA sequence, ensuring that only the targeted cells are affected, leaving healthy cells unharmed. The flexibility and broad potential of Akribion’s technology makes it a promising platform for various therapeutic areas, as by simply changing the guide RNA, the technology can be quickly adapted to target different cells, making it much faster to develop new treatments compared to traditional methods. Initially targeting HPV-induced Oropharyngeal Head & Neck Cancer (OPSCC), Akribion is exploring additional applications in oncology, autoimmune diseases, fibrosis, and infectious diseases. Founded in 2024 and based in Zwingenberg, Germany, Akribion was spun out of BRAIN Biotech AG, the specialist in biosolutions for industrial applications.

name: alteva
description: alteva was founded in Cologne, Germany, in 2023 by Ida Milow and Aiko Bernehed. The start-up develops innovative, ultra-lightweight and high-performance battery cells for the decarbonisation of the global transport sector. Building on the research work of the German Aerospace Centre (DLR) and with the support of renowned investors, alteva aims to make a decisive contribution to the electrification of aviation, long-distance and heavy goods transport.

name: AUDAVIS
description: AUDAVIS is a Munich-based startup that leverages a scalable cloud application to access data from ERP and accounting systems. It prepares this data for audit actions and employs various AI systems to comprehensively check for accuracy, consistency, and risk-free nature, adhering to and exceeding audit standards.

name: pagent.ai
description: Behind pagent.ai is aihumin GmbH, founded a year ago in Bonn, which pursues the development of application-oriented AI solutions in the field of communication. The team, with employees from five different countries, works with companies throughout Europe.

name: Dimericon
description: Dimericon is a private biotech company focused on exploring the novel modality crosslinked helix dimers (Dimericons) to target hard-to-drug intracellular protein-protein interactions using rationally designed mimetics of helix dimers. The Seed round of financing will support preclinical studies to further develop the current lead compound to be an IND ready clinical candidate in hematological and solid malignancies.

name: Refoxy Pharma
description: Refoxy is the first biotech company purposely developing FOXO3 activators to leverage the therapeutic effects related to this master regulator of biological homeostasis. Refoxy’s discovery platform, F.act finder (FOXO activator finder), delivers molecules that specifically modulate FOXO3 and elicit unique therapeutic effects.
