name: Fast Travel Games
description: Fast Travel Games is a game developer and publisher, building world-class virtual reality games. Founded by game development veterans, the company is on a mission to change the way we play. They build games where players are free to explore their surroundings, experience-rich narratives, and interact with others in new and interesting ways.

name: Fibbl
description: Fibbl is the world’s first cost-effective end-to-end solution for 3D and AR focused visual marketing. Integrate 3D & AR into your e-commerce and marketing in minutes.

name: Fishbrain
description: Connecting with other fish enthusiasts? There’s an app for that! Fishbrain is the world’s most popular app for connecting fishing enthusiasts. Fishing fans use the app to log and track their catches, share tips within the network and boast about ‘the one that got away’. By doing so Fishbrain provides fishers with the tools and skills needed to perform better.

name: Footway Oaas
description: Footway is building a data-driven ecosystem for modern e-commerce where our four business areas work together to create growth, efficiency and sustainable development.

name: Freemelt
description: Mass collaboration is needed to solve the complex challenges of additive manufacturing. Freemelt’s advanced 3D metal printers for metal together with its open-source platform accelerates this process, making it possible to develop new materials, shapes, and applications the industry has yet to see.

name: Funnel
description: Data without context is meaningless – or even misleading. Funnel offers a solution for performance marketers to make sense of all data by providing fully automatic data imports from >500 data sources and turning it into “business-ready data”. The data and insights are presented in real-time, allowing for marketers to optimize their performance marketing.

name: Gårdsfisk
description: Gårdsfisk (Scandinavian Aquasystems AB) has developed a vertically integrated recirculating aquaculture system that enables land-based fish farming with minimal environmental impact. By working with partner farmers, Gårdsfisk ensures that its high-quality fish, including catfish and trout, are farmed locally and sustainably, providing Swedish consumers with a responsible protein alternative.

name: Gesynta
description: Gesynta Pharma develops novel anti-inflammatory, pain-relieving pharmaceuticals. The company currently focuses on endometriosis – a painful, chronic, inflammatory and estrogen-dependent disease that causes great suffering to millions of women.

name: Hopsworks
description: Hopsworks has set out to make machine learning easy for every company, providing tools for data scientists and engineers to manage features and develop and deploy models in production. The company has developed a platform for data-intensive artificial intelligence with the industry’s Python-centric enterprise feature store.

name: HVR Cardio
description: The majority of mitral valve disease patients are not able to undergo treatments involving open heart surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass. HVR Cardio provides a new treatment option that is safer, faster, and less traumatic cardiac intervention for mitral regurgitation patients worldwide – without compromising clinical efficacy

name: Inriver
description: Inriver’s software for product information management enables B2B and B2C organizations to bring compelling product stories to life for highly customized purchases, obtain actionable guidance on what influences buying decisions, and then quickly adapt to put insights into action. Industrifonden sold its entire holding in Inriver to Thomas H. Lee Partners, L.P. (THL), a premier US private equity firm investing in growth companies in 2022.

name: KISAB
description: KISAB is an innovative provider of silicon carbide substrates, striving to define the future of the semiconductor industry. The company has developed a new process for providing silicon carbide substrates at superior cost and quality. This enables the device manufacturers to further push the limits of performance in future power electronics.

name: Limina
description: Limina is modernizing investment management workflows for asset managers. The platform includes order management, portfolio management, risk management, and compliance and empowers its customers to make superior investment decisions while reducing complexity and operational risk.

name: Melt&Marble
description: Most fats on the market come with trade offs in functionality, consistency or sustainability. Melt&Marble was founded to change this. Melt&Marble designs next generation fats and lipids. Through precision fermentation and advanced lipid design, Melt&Marble create high performance ingredients that elevate sensory experience, functionality and sustainability.

name: Meniga
description: Meninga transforms the way banks use transaction data with a framework for next-generation digital banking and is a global leader in white-label digital banking solutions – serving over 100M banking customers across 30 countries. They help banks use data to drive digital engagement, build customer loyalty and increase revenue.

name: Micvac
description: Micvac is a food-tech company that brings smart technology to the world of fresh ready-to-eat foods. The company has created an innovative method for preparing and packaging food, minimizing pasteurization time while maximizing nutrition and flavor. Best of all, the long shelf life that prevents food waste throughout the value chain.

name: Minervax
description: To protect infants from GBS-induced diseases – a maternal vaccine given to pregnant women is the only long-term viable option. Therefore, MinervaX is developing a maternal vaccine for Group B Streptococcus (GBS) – the leading cause of life-threatening infections in newborns.

name: Movimento
description: Movimento is a company within the automotive industry originating from Gothenburg. Their vision is to help create the software-enabled car, the vehicle through which we are forging the integrated and increasingly autonomous driving experience. The company has completed millions of vehicle and module updates for some of the leading companies in the world. The company was sold to Delphi Automotive in 2017.

name: Nextory
description: Since the company was launched, it has developed into a fast-growing platform that enables the unlimited distribution of stories and knowledge in various digital formats. For a fixed monthly fee, customers can get unlimited access to popular titles across all genres. Today, Nextory is launched in 10 markets and is one of the Nordic region’s largest subscription services for audio and e-books.

name: Nodica Group
description: Nodica Group consists of four specialized companies: ScandiNova, Scanditronix, IECO and Microwave Amps. By pushing the boundaries of technology, all companies design and deliver advanced power systems for new findings and progress in areas such as radiotherapy, scientific research and various industrial processes. The portfolio includes world leading key sub-systems such as high-voltage pulse modulators, electromagnets, RF- and power amplifiers, and precision power supplies.

name: Novatron
description: Fusion power has the potential to provide a limitless supply of emissions-free, reliable, safe, and affordable energy for all. Novatron Fusion aims to revolutionize the field of fusion energy production.

name: Nuevolution
description: Nuevolution is a biotech company with the goal to deliver drugs of the future for the treatment of cancer and inflammatory diseases. Nuevolution has a patent-protected drug research platform to identify small-molecule drug candidates against cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was IPO:ed in Stockholm in 2015 and acquired by Amgen in 2019.

name: Nuvoair
description: Severe COPD is managed in crisis. NuvoAir replaces that with continuous care: home monitoring, a dedicated clinical team, and same-day access when symptoms turn. Their unique approach leads to fewer hospitalisations and readmissions than patients receiving standard care.

name: Oatly
description: Oatly is the original oat drink company and a company that is built on the idea of change and in the 1990s, they set out to create a plant-based drink that was in tune with the needs of both humans and the planet. Oatly’s patented method uses natural enzymes to transform fiber-rich oats into a nutritional liquid. At the US IPO in 2021, the company was valued at $10 billion.

name: Occtoo
description: Occtoo is an Experience Data Platform built to accelerate the way companies create relevant customer experiences everywhere. With Occtoo the user can easily unify all experience data (customer, product, transactional, behavioral, content, and more) and make it accessible in real time in any front-end of choice.

name: Oncopeptides
description: Oncopeptides is a biotech company focused on the development of targeted therapies for difficult-to-treat hematological cancers. The company is science-driven and committed to bringing innovation to patients with unmet needs and improving patient lives. Industrifonden exited in 2018 and 2024.

name: Open Payments
description: Open Payments provides the groundbreaking market infrastructure required for open banking. The company has sorted out how to implement Open Banking in businesses and connect multiple banks through one single unified API. This removes the complexity and frictions of many diverse integrations.

name: Photon Sports
description: A value driven brand and advocate for healthy physical performance optimisation for everyone that aspires to be a high performer.

name: Pixelgen Technologies
description: Pixelgen has developed Molecular Pixelation, a DNA-based visualization technology for analyzing cell surface proteins, to gain novel insights into cellular activity that will advance better medicines and diagnostics.

name: Purpose Pharma
description: Purpose Pharma is a patient-centric European based pharmaceutical company focusing on the development and commercialization of novel rare disease and specialty care products in areas of high unmet medical need.

name: Qlik
description: Qlik offers an Active Intelligence platform, delivering end-to-end, real-time data integration and analytics cloud solutions to close the gaps between data, insights, and action. By transforming data into Active Intelligence, businesses can drive better decisions, improve revenue and profitability, and optimize customer relationships. The investment in Qlik provided Industrifonden with a return of almost 40x the invested amount. in 2016 Thomas Bravo acquired Qlik for $3 billion.

name: Realforce
description: Marketing tech company Realforce leads the new wave of digitization in residential real estate. Their platform makes it easy for marketing professionals to automate and scale recurring marketing activities for brokers and sellers with unparalleled control and flexibility.

name: Retein
description: Retein adapts nature’s finest separation for use in the recovery of clean water from any accessible water mixture. The patented molecular separation technology was developed at Chalmers University of Technology with the purpose of accelerating the transition towards a resource-efficient and sustainable world from the bottom up.

name: Roots Bio
description: Founded in 2023, Roots Bio is building an AI-powered molecular discovery platform that identifies and develops novel molecules for agriculture, food, and sustainability applications. By combining computational biology, machine learning, and experimental validation, the company is accelerating the discovery of breakthrough solutions while reducing development cost and time.

name: SaltX
description: SaltX is on a mission to reshape heavy-emission industries by eliminating their dependency on fossil fuels. Our main focus is the quicklime and cement sectors, responsible for a staggering 8% of the world’s CO2 emissions. We’re driving innovation and scaling up electrification and carbon separation technologies with one clear goal: to catalyze a massive shift towards zero industrial emissions at a gigaton scale.

name: Scalado
description: Scalado is a world leader in the mobile imaging industry, with a long history of developing innovative platform-independent imaging solutions. Based on Scalado’s unique Random Access JPEG and more than 50 patent and patent-pending technologies, these innovations are currently being used by the world’s leading global telecom and platform players.

name: SeaPattern
description: SeaPattern is pioneering innovative turbine technology that enhances electricity generation in existing hydropower plants by between 7-10%, without requiring new large-scale infrastructure. The company offers a fully integrated solution that combines modular, floating turbines with AI-enabled software for dynamic turbine positioning and performance optimization. With thousands of hydropower plants across Europe, SeaPattern has substantial potential to contribute significantly to the energy transition.

name: Senseworks
description: Senseworks audit and analytics platform allows you and your colleagues to work more effectively together, find more insights in financial data and deliver more value to your customers, based on a common source of truth for business data.

name: ShardSecure
description: ShardSecure is changing the nature of data security. Their patented Microshard technology cloud-enables data by distributing sensitive data for use in the multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environment, while at the same time reducing management complexity and improving business continuity.

name: Soundtrack Technologies
description: With Soundtrack Your Brand, you can find the perfect music for your business in the world’s largest commercial catalog with over 58 million songs – all legal to use for your business. The platform gives businesses the freedom to play the music they want and the tools to make it easy; music scheduling, AI, and an explicit-lyrics filter.

name: Soundtrap
description: Soundtrap is a collaborative, cloud-based recording studio, on a mission to make music creation and storytelling simple and collaborative for everyone. With an easy-to-use creation platform, Soundtrap empowers creators to build original content using a combination of software instruments, real instruments, and audio recording.

name: Teitur Trophics
description: Teitur Trophics is a biotech company dedicated to developing new treatments for patients suffering from neurodegenerative diseases. The company has developed a platform of first-in-class cyclic peptides with a novel mechanism that preserves neuronal function. The peptides have the potential to treat patients suffering from a broad range of neurodegenerative diseases.

name: Texray
description: Texray has developed the world’s first radiation protection textile to address the need for comfortable and safe personal protection equipment (PPE). The Texray material is currently used in products designed for healthcare professionals exposed to X-ray radiation during surgical interventions. The Texray material may also provide value for professionals in various industry sectors, including nuclear, aero, and space.

name: ToxoTech
description: ToxoTech is a research development biopharmaceutical company that uses expert knowledge in structural biology to design and develop novel toxin-based biological products for the treatment of neuromuscular and neurological disorders.

name: TrackPaw
description: Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Lund, Sweden, TrackPaw Scientific is on a mission to address one of the key reasons behind over 90% of failures in clinical development: subjective and inconsistent conclusions from animal-based preclinical studies. By combining machine learning and sensor technology to monitor animal behaviour and weight in real time, the company provides scientists with objective, high-resolution data across a wide range of disease areas. This leads to more robust study outcomes, improved animal welfare, and faster access to effective new medicines.

name: Treebula
description: Treebula is a Swedish company, up until now known as Virkesbörsen, dedicated to unlocking the full potential of forests. With a vision to utilize the true and upgraded value of forests, Treebula aims to be the premier source of forestry information, providing services and a digital meeting place for forest owners, buyers, and other stakeholders. By offering comprehensive forest management solutions and facilitating informed decision-making, Treebula strives to drive sustainable practices, promote biodiversity, and contribute to a greener future.

name: Trialbee
description: Identifying, matching, and enrolling the right candidates for clinical research programs is the number one challenge in the global clinical research industry. Trialbee combines advanced digital technology and life science to create a next-generation platform that simplifies the enrollment process for patients and supports the successful completion of clinical trials and access to medicine.

name: Tribune Therapeutics
description: Tribune Therapeutics is a preclinical biopharmaceutical company building a promising pipeline of novel medicines to treat patients with a wide range of fibrotic diseases.

name: TrusTrace
description: TrustTrace’s technology empowers brands and suppliers around the world to standardize how supply chain and material traceability data is captured, digitized, and shared. With all of the trusted supply chain traceability data stored on a single platform, brands get the right evidence in the right place to back-up product claims and meet regulatory compliance.

name: Valdyr (Telness Tech)
description: Valdyr (Telness Tech) is a next-generation cloud-based B2B telecom solution for companies looking to enhance innovation capacity while reducing cost and complexity. The product offering consists of an end-to-end Digital Telco on Demand and a White-label Private Branch Exchange (PBX). The company’s flexible and modular telco platform can be deployed and run on any of the major cloud solutions, as well as incumbent IT systems.

name: Vesiro
description: Vesiro delivers a high-performance plugin for Elasticsearch designed to cut infrastructure cost and energy use for large-scale search workloads. Powered by Vesiro’s search technology, the plugin significantly improves search performance, enabling companies to achieve the same (or better) search experience with fewer servers. This results in lower cloud spend, improved scalability, and reduced data-center energy consumption.

name: Viking analytics
description: Viking Analytics is a company developing AI-based machine health monitoring technology. They are on a mission to enable every industrial service company like maintenance companies, OEMs, and system integrators to monitor more machines reliably and sustainability.

name: Yangi
description: Yangi sprang to life fueled by a love for sustainability, relentless curiosity, and a mission to safeguard our planet. It all began with one bold question: What if packaging could move beyond causing harm – and instead contribute to smarter, more sustainable consumption? Enter Yangi Cellera – a leap forward toward a future where packaging works in harmony with both people and planet.

name: Zalvac
description: Zalvac AB is founded around the research of Birgitta Henriques Normark and Staffan Normark. Their research explores the role of membrane vesicles – small nanosized particles released by bacteria – in the immune response. ZalVac aims to create effective vaccines that can induce robust immunity against various strains of bacteria.

name: ZeroPoint
description: Digitalization quickly accelerates energy consumption and maximizing performance per watt in servers and smart devices is critical to breaking the trend. ZeroPoint technology delivers up to 50% higher performance per watt by removing unnecessary information from microchips in data centers and smart devices.

name: Zymego
description: Zymego is a leading healthtech solution helping healthcare providers reduce wait times, fill empty appointments, reduce DNA’s and eliminate booking admin – all through intelligent automation.

description: Powering lunar infrastructure with high-efficiency power transmit and receive terminals

description: Delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions for the commercial and defense sector from the ground to space

name: Xona Space Systems
description: Developing the most accurate and secure real-time PNT capabilities to enable the future of autonomy

name: Xplore
description: Delivering Space-as-a-Service through sensors, data, and satellites for commercial and environmental use

name: Radiant Nuclear
description: Radiant Nuclear is redefining advanced nuclear energy through its flagship 1MW portable microreactor, Kaleidos. Designed for military bases, data centers, remote industrial sites, and grid-constrained environments, Kaleidos delivers reliable baseload power for up to 20 years using TRISO fuel and passive helium cooling. Unlike traditional nuclear projects that require decade-long development cycles, Radiant is transforming nuclear into a repeatable, factory-manufactured product that can be deployed by truck or airlift. The company is positioned at the intersection of Defense Technology and AI Infrastructure, where reliable, dispatchable power is becoming the defining constraint of growth.

name: Anduril
description: Anduril is at the forefront of modern defense innovation, leveraging advanced AI and autonomous systems to tackle complex security challenges. Their cutting-edge technology includes unmanned aerial systems, surveillance towers, and mission-command software, designed to enhance situational awareness and provide real-time actionable intelligence. By merging technology with mission-critical objectives, Anduril empowers defense agencies to safeguard democracy effectively. With a clear focus on innovation and a mission to defend democratic values, Anduril represents a compelling investment in the rapidly evolving defense tech sector.

name: CoreWeave
description: CoreWeave is a leading provider of GPU-accelerated cloud computing infrastructure, designed to meet the computational demands of modern artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and rendering workloads. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave has evolved from its origins in cryptocurrency mining to become a critical partner for businesses requiring high-performance, scalable cloud solutions. By leveraging industry-leading NVIDIA GPUs, CoreWeave offers unparalleled speed and efficiency, making it a preferred choice for developers and researchers pushing the boundaries of AI and ML innovation. CoreWeave’s unique approach to cloud computing focuses on delivering specialized, cost-effective solutions that outperform traditional general-purpose cloud providers. With data centers strategically located to maximize performance and reduce latency, CoreWeave supports a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, media, and gaming. Its rapid growth and emphasis on customer-centric solutions have solidified its reputation as an industry innovator. As the demand for GPU-powered computing continues to rise, CoreWeave’s commitment to scaling infrastructure and advancing cutting-edge technology presents a compelling investment opportunity. The company’s ability to adapt to emerging trends and cater to specialized needs ensures its position as a vital player in the AI-driven future.

name: Exowatt
description: Exowatt is addressing the defining constraint of the AI era: megawatts. As artificial intelligence accelerates global electricity demand, particularly from data centers, Exowatt provides a scalable, deployable solution that combines solar capture, long-duration thermal storage, and on-demand electricity generation in a single containerized system. Its modular platform stores heat for up to five days in a patented silicon composite battery and converts it into reliable baseload power without grid dependence. At roughly $1.5 million per megawatt and deployable in under 12 months, Exowatt offers similar stability to nuclear approaches at a fraction of the capital cost and timeline.

name: Abnormal Security
description: Abnormal Security uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence to combat advanced email threats like phishing, business email compromise (BEC), and ransomware. By analyzing user behavior and communication patterns, the platform identifies and neutralizes threats with unmatched accuracy. Its people-first approach ensures seamless integration and reduced false positives, protecting organizations’ most critical asset—their people. As the threat landscape continues to evolve, Abnormal Security’s innovative solutions position it as a leader in email security and a prime investment opportunity in cybersecurity.

name: Redwood Materials
description: Redwood Materials is redefining the future of energy with innovative recycling solutions that recover valuable materials from used batteries. By closing the loop on battery production, Redwood reduces waste and lowers the environmental impact of energy storage technologies. Their mission aligns with global sustainability goals, making them a vital player in the transition to a cleaner, greener economy. With growing demand for electric vehicles and renewable energy, Redwood Materials is a visionary company leading the charge in sustainable innovation.

name: Epirus
description: Epirus is revolutionizing defense technology with its breakthrough directed energy systems designed to neutralize drone swarms and other electronic threats. By harnessing electromagnetic pulse (EMP) capabilities, Epirus provides military, government, and commercial clients with innovative, scalable, and energy-efficient solutions for modern security challenges. Their proprietary software-defined power approach enables adaptable and precise threat mitigation, setting them apart in the evolving defense landscape. With the rise of autonomous and unmanned aerial systems (UAS), traditional defense measures struggle to keep pace. Epirus’ flagship product, Leonidas, delivers a next-generation counter-electronics solution capable of disabling drones and electronic devices with pinpoint accuracy. This game-changing technology is compact, portable, and adaptable to various defense applications, from critical infrastructure protection to battlefield operations. By focusing on rapid deployment and sustainable power efficiency, Epirus is shaping the future of electronic warfare and national security. As the demand for advanced counter-drone and EMP solutions continues to grow, Epirus stands at the forefront of this sector with its innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Its strong leadership team and commitment to pushing the boundaries of directed energy make it an attractive investment opportunity in the defense and security space.

name: Proofpoint
description: Proofpoint specializes in protecting organizations’ greatest assets—their people—from advanced cyber threats and compliance risks. Their comprehensive suite includes email security, data loss prevention, and security awareness training, all designed to mitigate human-centric vulnerabilities. By focusing on the behaviors and interactions of users, Proofpoint effectively identifies and neutralizes threats such as phishing, ransomware, and insider threats. Their innovative approach ensures that organizations can safeguard sensitive information and maintain regulatory compliance in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

name: Groq
description: Groq is at the forefront of AI hardware innovation, developing the Tensor Streaming Processor (TSP) architecture to accelerate workloads in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and high-performance computing. Their product suite, including GroqCard™ and GroqRack™, offers unparalleled compute speed and energy efficiency, enabling enterprises to deploy AI applications at scale. Founded by Jonathan Ross, who previously initiated Google’s Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) project, Groq continues to challenge industry norms, providing faster and more efficient solutions for complex computational tasks.

name: Databricks
description: Databricks combines data engineering, machine learning, and business analytics into a single, unified platform. Built on the open-source Apache Spark framework, the platform accelerates data processing and enables businesses to derive actionable insights faster. With a focus on collaboration and innovation, Databricks empowers teams to solve complex problems and drive better decision-making. As data continues to grow in scale and complexity, Databricks offers an essential solution for enterprises aiming to stay competitive.

name: xAI
description: Founded by Elon Musk in 2023, xAI is developing AGI designed to integrate across a vast technology stack—including X (formerly Twitter), Tesla, Neuralink, Optimus, SpaceX, and Starlink. Created as a “maximally truth-seeking” alternative to other labs, xAI is positioned to lead the next era of machine intelligence through massive-scale infrastructure and ecosystem synergy. Its supercomputer, Colossus, is the most powerful AI training cluster in the world, scaling to 200,000 GPUs in just seven months.

name: Palantir Technologies
description: Palantir Technologies specializes in making sense of vast amounts of complex data. Their platforms, such as Palantir Foundry and Gotham, are trusted by governments, defense agencies, and corporations to inform high-stakes decisions. By integrating, analyzing, and visualizing data, Palantir enables clients to unlock insights that drive results. With its unmatched capabilities in big data analytics, Palantir is a transformative force in industries ranging from national security to financial services.

name: Vercel
description: Vercel provides developers with the tools to create, deploy, and scale modern web applications effortlessly. Their powerful serverless platform optimizes performance and simplifies workflows, allowing teams to focus on building great user experiences. With its flagship product, Next.js, Vercel has become the go-to solution for developers seeking speed, reliability, and scalability. By streamlining the development lifecycle, Vercel is revolutionizing web development and enabling businesses to achieve faster time-to-market.

name: Shield AI
description: Shield AI develops cutting-edge autonomous systems and AI pilots designed to enhance operational effectiveness and safety in defense scenarios. Their flagship AI pilot, Hivemind, enables drones and aircraft to execute missions without GPS, communications, or human intervention, adapting in real-time to dynamic environments. Since its deployment in combat in 2018, Hivemind has demonstrated capabilities ranging from indoor building clearance to complex aerial engagements. Shield AI’s commitment to innovation and protection positions it as a leader in the defense technology sector, offering transformative solutions that safeguard lives.

name: CHAOS Industries
description: Founded in 2022 by industry veterans from Epirus, Palantir, and 8VC, CHAOS Industries has become the fastest-growing defense tech company in the world. The company’s solutions span early-warning detection, battlefield communications, and secure data networks designed for real-time operational environments. Its $5.2B pipeline and massive Series C round led by NEA, Accel, and 8VC reflect deep confidence in its mission and momentum.

name: Space X
description: SpaceX is transforming the future of space travel with groundbreaking technologies like reusable rockets and advanced spacecraft. From launching satellites to sending astronauts to the International Space Station, SpaceX’s innovations lower costs and open new frontiers for exploration. The company’s long-term vision to colonize Mars underscores its commitment to humanity’s survival and advancement. With a proven track record of delivering success on ambitious projects, SpaceX is redefining what is possible in aerospace and making space more accessible than ever.

name: Afropolitan
description: The Afropolitan Group is a Community As A Service Company (CAAS), which was founded because of the lack of opportunities, resources and unique experiences available for members of our African Diaspora community.

name: Alvin
description: Alvin is building Africa’s first embeddable money management suite designed to help banks increase savings deposits and cultivate more creditworthy retail customers.

name: Bamboo
description: Invest Bamboo is a digital investment platform that provides Africans, primarily in Nigeria and Ghana , with access to global and local financial markets. The app simplifies investing by allowing users to purchase fractional shares and earn returns through various financial products.

name: Bitnob
description: Bitnob is a financial services company built on top of Bitcoin technologies. Bitnob offers automated Bitcoin savings and purchases, collateralized loans, and remittance services.

name: Bridgecard
description: Bridgecard helps individuals link multiple cards and bank accounts to one card and one app.

name: Carry1st
description: Carry1st is a full-stack publisher of social games and interactive content with a focus on frontier markets like Africa.

name: Complete Farmer
description: Complete Farmer is an end to end digital farming platform that makes it easy for local and global industries to source agricultural commodities. Individuals can own farms using IoT and data technology.

name: Evolve credit

Health Plus is based in Uniondale, New York, and employs approximately 250 dedicated team members.

name: Heritage Foods
description: Founded in 2015, Heritage Foods is a buy-and-build platform of leading condiments and sauces brands with long-standing history, including Hamada Shoyu in Japan (established in 1818), Bidor Kwong Heng in Malaysia (established in 1945) and Woh Hup Food in Singapore (established in 1936). Headquartered in Hong Kong, with regional head offices and manufacturing plants in mainland China, Japan, Singapore and Malaysia, the company employs over 300 people and has a global network of over 30 distributors in China, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, Europe and the US.

name: HWG
description: HWG provides cybersecurity operations and consulting services to large and midsize enterprises with advanced security requirements that don’t plan to keep security expert teams and infrastructure internally. Founded in 2008, HWG operates globally from the HQ in Italy (Verona) and offices in Vilnius, Dubai and Singapore. A team of cyber security experts monitors customers’ digital environments 24×7 and is instantly ready to recognize cyber-attacks and fight them back. Being a trusted security provider for companies in over 20 countries, HWG knows how to improve cybersecurity resilience across complex and sensitive sectors like finance, automotive, industrial, telecom and others.

name: ICR
description: ICR is a leading strategic communications and advisory firm. ICR helps companies manage credibility and reputational risk to optimize shareholder value. ICR specializes in investor relations, public relations, crisis and special situations communications, digital branding, social media management, and capital advisory solutions. The firm works with more than 1000 clients across its seven offices in the US, London and China.

name: IDX
description: Established in 2000, IDX is a leading provider of digital corporate communications and marketing services to blue-chip institutions globally. It is headquartered in London with over 500 digital experts across nine offices in the Americas, United Kingdom, Europe and India. Through its proprietary ConnectedContent™ approach, IDX combines compelling communications, intelligent digital experiences and performance marketing to help more than 1600 global companies build deeper connections with audiences, manage corporate reputation and drive business performance.

name: Innova Semplice
description: Innova Semplice is a leading Italian tech-enabled intermediation platform connecting millions of consumers with service providers across utilities, insurance, financial products and long-term automotive rental. Headquartered in Rome, Italy, Innova Semplice initially launched its ComparaSemplice.it brand in 2013, quickly gaining market share and establishing itself as a leading player in the utilities segment. In recent years, Innova Semplice has added new product lines to its offering, which now also includes insurance, financial products and long-term automotive rental, and has built out its omni channel distribution capabilities, which today include online channels as well as a tech-enabled offline network of stores and agents.

name: Insurance Dekho
description: Insurance Dekho is today India’s #1 POSP (Point of Sales Person) insurance distribution platform. It focuses on motor, health, life and SMB insurance products across India. With a complete digitization of the sales process, Insurance Dekho has a cost-efficient and viable distribution platform to reach beyond the well penetrated Tier 1 and Tier 2 markets. Leveraging its transparent and quick process team, Insurance Dekho has served over five million satisfied customers.

name: Intergrow Brands
description: Intergrow Brands is a group company of Kerala based Synthite Group, the world’s largest producer of value-added spices, with operations in India, USA and China. Started in 2014, Intergrow offers an array of products including packaged spices, marinades, sauces, seasonings, premium gourmet food, green tea and chocolates under Kitchen Treasures, Sprig and Paul & Mike brands. Apart from India, Intergrow’s products are available across the GCC, USA and Australia.

name: Jianuo
description: Jianuo is a leading provider of specialty premium components used in fast-growing high-end applications such as electric vehicles power management, battery charging infrastructure, solar and wind power generation, and 5G base station infrastructure.

name: Kanawha Scales & Systems
description: Founded in 1954, Kanawha Scales & Systems is a provider of weighing and total industrial control solutions, offering calibration, maintenance, and repair services for complex industrial systems. The company operates more than 25 offices across the eastern, midwestern, and southern United States and supports customers through a nationwide network of certified partners, delivering scale systems, loadout solutions, and customized automation technologies.

name: Kindstar Global
description: Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Wuhan, Kindstar is a leading independent medical testing provider in China, offering patients and physicians broad access to advanced specialty testing services across hematology, gynecology and pediatrics, infectious diseases, oncology and neurology.

name: KS Group
description: KS Group is a value-added, industry-leading distributor of quality replacement auto body parts servicing over 10,000 collision repair shop customers across 25 locations in 17 states. The company provides automotive aftermarket body parts across several product categories, including headlights, front and rear bumper covers, fenders, hoods, taillights, grills, radiators, and mirrors.

name: Linkedcare
description: Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, Linkedcare is a leading Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) and supply chain management provider serving more than 30,000 dental and medical aesthetic clinics in China.

name: Lu Daopei Medical
description: Founded in 2001 by hematology expert Dr. Lu Daopei, Lu Daopei Medical Group has become the leading private specialist medical group in the field of hematology in China and a pioneer in bone marrow transplants. Lu Daopei operates three hospitals in Beijing and a fourth one set to open in Shanghai and is now the largest bone marrow transplant group for leukemia treatment in the world.

name: Marblegate Asset Management
description: A leading US distressed and specialty lending firm founded in 2008.

name: Metra
description: Founded in 1982, Metra is a family-owned value-added technology distributor with a strong presence across the GCC and wider MENA region. The Company generates approximately 70% of its revenues from the GCC and holds leading positions in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Egypt. In 2025, Metra surpassed US$1 billion in sales, serving a broad network of channel partners and working with approximately 40 global technology brands. Its portfolio spans AI, cybersecurity, data centers, computing devices, and a B2B online marketplace.

name: Miebach
description: Founded in 1973 and headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Miebach offers supply chain and logistics consultancy services. The offering encompasses development of supply chain strategies and implementation of engineering designs. Miebach is the partner of choice for many of the world’s leading companies operating in a diverse range of industries, including fast-moving consumer goods and pharmaceuticals. Since inception, Miebach established a truly global presence, operating seamlessly in 20 countries across five continents and employing more than 500 professionals worldwide.

name: MML Capital
description: A leading European middle market structured capital and infrastructure firm founded in 1988.

name: Mo Xiaoxian
description: Mo Xiaoxian is a leading and fast-growing instant food brand in China, offering a portfolio of over 40 SKUs across three core product categories: self-heated instant hotpot, self-heated instant rice, and self-heated instant noodles. The Company is ranked among the top five players in each of its categories and boasts extensive omnichannel distribution, with products available in more than 200k points of sale nationwide, complemented by a significant and rapidly expanding e-commerce presence.

name: Monomoy
description: A leading US middle market buyout and private credit firm founded in 2005.

name: Namet
description: Established in 1998 and acquired in by the Kayar family in 2005, Namet Gida SanayiveTicaret A.S. (Namet) is the largest integrated producer of fresh cut and packaged processed red meat products in Turkey. The company processes and sells unpacked and packed fresh cut meat, delicatessen products, frozen products and further processed products. Products are sold under the brands Namet and Maret (acquired in September 2014) or as private label products to the retail and B2B (hotels/restaurants/catering) channels.

name: NDT Corrosion Control Services Co
description: Established in 1975, NDT Corrosion Control Services Co. LLC (NDTCCS) is the largest non-destructive testing (NDT) service provider in Saudi Arabia employing over 2,000 technicians in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain. NDT is an essential service which involves the evaluation and testing of pipes, pressure vessels, oil platforms and other key industrial components to identify faults, cracks or defects without causing damage. NDTCCS provides conventional and advanced NDT services for a range of industrial sectors including oil and gas, petrochemicals, mining, nuclear and utilities.

name: NephroPlus
description: NephroPlus is India’s largest dialysis network and has 196 centres across 115+ cities of India. Each NephroPlus center is a one stop shop for all of dialysis guest’s needs. With a strong commitment to quality, NephroPlus is spearheading a change in the way dialysis is done in India. NephroPlus has a strong focus on patient centric care where each patient is treated as a “guest.” One of the main goals at NephroPlus is to enable dialysis guests lead lives as close to normal as possible. NephroPlus strives to ensure that dialysis sessions remain a small part of a guest’s life, encouraging them to do things everyone does – work, travel, have fun. It is the only dialysis network in India to have a Holiday dialysis network with 15 tourist destinations across the Country including Agra, Goa, Alleppey, Dehradun, Rishikesh, Tirupati, and Varanasi. It is the only dialysis network in the World which conducts Dialysis Olympiad every two years with next edition coming up in Pune on December 22 nd .

name: Netop
description: Netop is a provider of secure remote access and remote support software for organizations operating in complex and highly regulated environments. The company enables customers to securely access, manage and support critical systems, legacy infrastructure and distributed devices through a security-focused platform designed for reliability, compliance and operational resilience. With more than four decades of experience, Netop serves customers across sectors like healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and public sector. Its solutions are particularly well suited for mission-critical environments where secure connectivity, auditability and control are essential, offering flexible deployment options across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise infrastructure

name: NetRom
description: Headquartered in Utrecht, the Netherlands, NetRom is a leading cloud-first, digital transformation and software engineering firm in the Benelux region. The company provides business-critical software engineering solutions, development support and adjacent services to a portfolio of diversified and blue-chip customers in Western Europe and North America, including for example VodafoneZiggo, Transdev and LeasePlan. NetRom currently has approximately 500 highly qualified engineers across 4 offices in the Netherlands and Romania.

name: NourNet
description: NourNet was established in 1998 in Saudi Arabia as a wholly owned subsidiary of a Saudi business conglomerate. NourNet began as an internet service provider (ISP) to business-to-business (B2B) clients and has gradually expanded its technical and personnel capabilities to a fully integrated ICT services company offering value-added ICT services, including cloud, managed IT services, cybersecurity, and data center management. The company operates in a large and growing ICT market in Saudi Arabia, supported by strong demand fundamentals as part of the Saudi Vision 2030. NourNet has over 550 employees serving a large and diversified client base of more than 1,500 businesses across 20 sectors and 30 cities in the Kingdom. The company also runs 3 data centers. NourNet continuously invests in its technical and personnel capabilities with the view to increase its service offering and better support clients across all industries.

name: NSEIT
description: NSEIT was established in 1999 as a tech enabler to NSE, supporting it across various trading functions. It acquired Aujas in Mar-19 and Cloudxchange.io in Jul-21 to expand to adjacent cybersecurity and cloud offerings. Today, NSEIT runs independently as a leading cybersecurity and digital services provider specializing in BFSI and capital markets. It leverages its domain expertise to serve marquee clients in the US, Middle East and India. It provides a comprehensive suite of services including Identity & Access Management (“IAM”), Security Verification Services (“SVS”), Cyber Defense Centers (CDC), App development, Data Analytics, Cloud Migration, DevOps and FinOps services.

name: NuSummit
description: Founded in 1999 as a technology enabler to NSE, the world’s largest derivative exchange and the 3rd largest stock exchange by number of trades, to support it across various trading functions, it subsequently developed capabilities in Cybersecurity and Cloud through acquisitions and extended its services to other customers. NuSummit’s key offerings include: Today, NuSummit services some of the largest players in Capital markets, Asset management and Insurance across US, Middle East and India.

name: Outcomes First Group
description: Outcomes First Group (OFG) is the UK’s #1 provider of inclusive education services. Best-in-class outcomes are delivered through a unified platform spanning the entire inclusive education profiles: high-acuity special education needs (SEN), privately paid all-ability inclusive schools, mainstream integration & clinical services, and virtual education. Since Investcorp’s investment in OFG, the group has expanded into Continental Europe and the Middle East. OFG’s schools are characterised by exceptional ratings: 97% of OFG’s schools are rated Good or Outstanding by the UK national education inspectorate, compared to the national average of 89%, reflecting its exceptional ability to educate pupils with a range of needs, through smaller school and class sizes, tailored curricula, and a proprietary outcome-tracking system. OFG operates ~120 schools throughout EMEA and educates more than 6,000 pupils.

name: PKF O’Connor Davies
description: PKF O’Connor Davies is based in Harrison, New York. PKF O’Connor Davies is a leading provider of accounting, tax and advisory services in the Northeast United States. The Company has 14 offices in 6 states and over 1,000 professionals.

name: POC
description: Established in 2005 in Stockholm, Sweden, POC is a leading manufacturer of premium skiing and cycling helmets, apparel, and accessories. With a mission to protect lives and reduce the consequences of accidents for athletes and anyone inspired to be one, POC is a safety and sports performance pioneer using research and rigorous testing to develop innovative products utilized by both the world’s best athletes and enthusiasts. POC’s product portfolio, including helmets, body armor, performance and casual apparel, goggles, and eyewear, is sold globally through premium dealers and direct to consumer on poc.com.

name: Project Highway
description: A leading US lower middle market buyout and private credit firm founded in 2007.

name: Project Mountain
description: A leading US special situations private credit firm founded in 2016.

name: PT Multitrend Indonesia
description: PT Multitrend Indonesia is a leading baby and kids omnichannel platform in Indonesia. It offers a one stop shop for baby and kids products with extensive distribution across Indonesia, with ~100 specialty retail stores in key shopping malls across Indonesia and an extensive distribution network through a variety of channels including modern & general trade, and ecommerce. It is the exclusive franchisee for key global baby and kids brands including Mothercare, Early Learning Centre, Gingersnaps, The Entertainer, Adikids, and Pumakids and established distribution partnerships with over ~100 leading international global brand principals including Philips Avent, Aveeno, Baby Jogger, Playgro, etc.

name: Resultant
description: Resultant is a modern consulting firm with expertise in data, technology, and digital transformation. The firm delivers solutions that pair the deeply technical with the deeply human to deliver transformative outcomes and lasting success for clients.

name: RoadSafe Traffic Systems
description: RoadSafe Traffic Systems, Inc. is the nation’s largest provider of traffic safety and pavement marking services, and innovative safety products to heavy highway, building and specialty contractors, state transportation departments, local governments, special events organizations, U.S. railroads and utility companies.

name: rTekk
description: Founded in 2016, rTekk operates innovative and award-winning payments platform and e-wallet solutions. The company has more than one million registered users in 180 countries across the globe, including customers in the UK, Germany, Italy, Canada and the Netherlands. Its offering includes some of the world’s most innovative wearable contactless payment technology which integrates seamlessly with its popular e-wallet and ‘MasterCard’-branded prepaid debit cards.

name: S&S Truck Parts
description: S&S Truck Parts, LLC., is a leading distributor of private label and branded aftermarket truck parts. Under its proprietary “NewStar” brand, S&S offers a wide breadth of products for heavy and medium-duty trucks. S&S’s customers include OEMs, truck dealerships and independent warehouse distributors across the US and Canada.

name: Salla
description: Salla was established in 2016 in Mecca to promote the entrepreneurial ecosystem in Saudi Arabia by providing SMEs and aspiring entrepreneurs with a proprietary SaaS solution to deliver on their e-commerce ambitions. Today, Salla enables merchants to tap into a $20 billion e-commerce market expected to grow over 25% year-on-year in the coming years. Since 2020, Salla has enabled over $10 billion in e-commerce sales and currently serves over 100 thousand active merchants on the platform. Founded by Nawaf Hariri and Salman Butt, the Company now has over 160 developers focused on technology and product development. It offers merchants a fully-digitalized and automated solution, allowing them to build their e-commerce website, start selling their products online within a few hours, accept online payments, and ship their products to the end user. Beyond being fully integrated with online payment solutions and logistics companies, Salla has over 400 applications on its platform supporting its merchants throughout the lifecycle of running an online business.

name: Sanos
description: Sanos Group is a leading provider of specialized clinical trial services to the global pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. Based in Denmark, the Sanos Group consists of NBCD, a global Contract Research Organization (“CRO”) specialized in osteoarthritis (“OA”), and Sanos Clinics, a Site Management Organization (“SMO”) with a broader indication range focusing on lifestyle and age-related diseases. Sanos has built a worldwide reputation for its scientific expertise, ability to recruit patients and track record of executing safe and efficient clinical trials.

name: SEC Newgate
description: SEC Newgate is an insights and research-driven, global strategic communications and advocacy group, headquartered in Milan, Italy. It works at the nexus of business, politics, communities, markets and media to deliver positive outcomes for clients and communities in a connected world where companies increasingly need communications partners with strong local roots, global reach and true entrepreneurial spirit, driven forward by talented people. The SEC Newgate team operates seamlessly in 22 countries across five continents, helping clients clearly demonstrate their purpose and value, delivering around the clock counsel and support, implementing campaigns locally, nationally and internationally. Clients span finance and financial services, health sciences and wellbeing, manufacturing and industry, TMT, real estate and infrastructure and consumer sectors.

name: Shearer Supply
description: Founded in 1983 by the Shearer family, Shearer Supply is a leading replacement-focused HVAC distribution platform of scale providing residential and commercial equipment, parts and supplies to a highly fragmented base of 5,500+ local contractor customers in the Southern U.S. region. The Company serves customers from over 30 branches across Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Tennessee, Mississippi, Louisiana and New Mexico. Headquartered in Dallas, TX, Shearer’s core product lines include American Standard Residential and Commercial HVAC, Ameristar Heating and Air Conditioning and Samsung HVAC. The Company also offers parts, supplies and accessories sourced from over 300 vendors.

name: Smart Managed Solutions
description: Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, Smart is a specialist provider of critical M&E maintenance services, including HVAC, electrical, fire, water and gas systems. The Company focuses on high-quality commercial office buildings and technical end-markets such as life sciences, education, digital infrastructure and public sector assets. Smart has built a differentiated reputation through consistently high service quality, data-led delivery model and strong relationships with blue-chip managing agents and direct clients. The business has delivered strong performance in recent years, driven by increasing demand for high quality, reliable, mission-critical facilities management services in a large, resilient and highly fragmented market.

name: SPGPrints
description: Based in the Netherlands, SPGPrints is a leading global manufacturer of consumables for printed textiles and labels. The product offering primarily consists of consumables used in the printing process (rotary screens, lacquers, digital inks and digital engraving) complemented by a full range of printing systems/equipment and after-sales spare parts, installation and maintenance services. SPGPrints is represented in more than 100 countries worldwide and commands a leading market position in each of its segments.

name: Stowe Family Law
description: Established in 1982, Stowe is a fast-growing, tech-enabled family law firm operating across England & Wales, Scotland and Australia. Headquartered in Leeds, Stowe has more than 90 offices and over 200 family lawyers supporting more than 5,000 clients each year. Stowe has built a differentiated and scalable business model combining digitally-led client acquisition, with the vast majority of new enquiries generated online, and a centralized corporate platform supporting its lawyers. This model has enabled Stowe to become the largest family law firm in the UK and establish a growing international presence. Under Investcorp’s ownership, Stowe has continued to invest in technology, data and AI to enhance the client experience, improve operational efficiency and support the continued growth of the business.

name: Sunrise Produce
description: Sunrise Produce is recognized as a leading wholesale produce distribution company in Southern California, providing customers across the specialty and white tablecloth restaurant and resort, education, healthcare and retail sectors with the freshest produce and perishable foods available.

name: TPx Communications
description: TPx Communications (formerly TelePacific) is a provider of network and communications services headquartered in Los Angeles. In business since 1998, the company is the nation’s premier managed services provider, delivering unified communications, managed IT and network connectivity to 55,000 customer locations across the country.

name: TruKKer
description: Established in 2016, TruKKer is the largest digital truck freight aggregator in the MENA region which connects shippers and carriers via a proprietary cloud-based platform. The company leverages technology and AI driven processes to optimize the supply chain and offers its transporters greater utilization by increasing reverse loads and reducing idle time between loads. The company operates in a highly fragmented road freight market across seven countries including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, Turkey, and Kazakhstan representing a total addressable market of over $50 billion. TruKKer is the largest player in the MENA region with over 1,200 B2B enterprise clients including blue chip customers across the FMGG, retail, metals, petrochemicals and construction sectors and has an expansive carrier network of over 70,000 trucks inducted on its platform leveraging it’s on the ground infrastructure of stations spread across the network. TruKKer continuously invests in innovation with the view to increase economics for all stakeholders of the logistics ecosystem and contribute to the region’s sustainability goals.
location: Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates

name: Ubisense
description: Ubisense is an enterprise software and sensor platform that generates and interprets vast amounts of location data to create digital visibility of real-world objects and their interactions in real time, enabling complex manufacturing processes with high levels of variability to be more flexible, easier to manage and easier to control. Ubisense’s service solution generates meaningful and demonstrable return on investment to Ubisense’s blue-chip customers. Ubisense is present in a number of verticals, including Aerospace, Commercial Vehicles, Passenger Vehicles, General Industry, and Transportation among many others.

name: Unifyr
description: Headquartered in North Carolina, US, Unifyr (formerly Zift Solutions) is a leader in Partner Management Software. Their cloud-based platform unifies partner relationship management (PRM), partner marketing automation (PMA), learning management (LMS), channel operations, and generative AI-driven productivity in one system designed to scale. With nearly two decades of category experience, Unifyr has powered millions of partner leads and generated billions in cumulative channel ecosystem revenue. The platform gives companies a unified view of the entire partner funnel and the intelligence to drive revenue through predictable, scalable channel growth.

name: Unilog
description: Unilog is a global technology company that delivers powerful, affordable e-Commerce solutions and product data enrichment services for the B2B marketplaces in US. Unilog’s cloud-based commerce platform help distributors, manufacturers, and wholesalers increase online sales, reduce cost to serve, and enhance their digital footprint. It is headquartered in greater Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and has international headquarters in Bangalore, India with a team of ~800 employees globally. Unilog currently provides software solution services to more than 320 small and medium enterprises across the distribution & retail businesses operating in the US.

name: V-Ensure
description: Established in 2010, V-Ensure is a regulated market focused, fully integrated specialty pharma company with more than a decade of experience in development of complex generics formulations. It has proprietary technology platforms and an established R&D track record with successful delivery of over 150 formulations including multiple 505 (b)(2), FTF and FTM opportunities. It has a fully equipped formulation & API R&D center and USFDA approved analytical lab supported by a recently set-up USFDA and EMA approvable oral solids manufacturing facility. V-Ensure is now working towards developing and launching its own products in regulated markets.

name: Veda
description: Headquartered near Aachen, VEDA is a leading developer of full-suite HR software. The company provides software for payroll, time & security and people management as well as payroll-as-a-service to enterprise customers in the mid-market in Germany.

name: Vivaticket
description: Established in 1999, Vivaticket S.p.A. is a leading global provider of integrated ticketing software solutions to the leisure and entertainment, sport, culture and trade show industries. With twenty years of experience in the field and relying on the most innovative technological solutions, Vivaticket offers a wide range of services to support events, including through its unique turn-key offering, which addresses the full customer experience from ticket purchasing to on-site activities. Headquartered in Bologna, Italy, Vivaticket has an extensive global presence with over 2,200 clients spanning 50 countries, including some of the world’s leading brands such as Musée du Louvre and FC Barcelona, among others.

name: Viz Branz
description: Established in 1988, Viz Branz is a leading, family-owned manufacturer and distributor of market leading instant cereal and beverage brands across China and Southeast Asia, including the popular Gold Roast, Calsome, Royal Myanmar Tea and Cafe 21 brands. Headquartered in Singapore, Viz Branz has approximately 1,300 employees with manufacturing facilities and operations in China and Myanmar.

name: Wakefit
description: Founded in 2015 by Ankit Garg and Chaitanya Ramalingegowda with the mission to enhance sleep health and overall well-being, Wakefit is India’s #1 direct-to-consumer sleep and home solutions brand. Wakefit’s product portfolio includes mattresses, pillows, beds, sofas, and other home furnishings, all designed with a focus on comfort and support. Started via e-commerce, it has built an omni-channel presence with 80+ stores across 30+ cities in India. The company emphasizes innovation and in-house manufacturing to maintain high standards of quality and affordability.

name: Warwick Capital Partners
description: A leading European special situations and distressed-for-control firm founded in 2010.

name: WeDoctor
description: WeDoctor is an online healthcare services company founded in 2010 by artificial intelligence expert Jerry Liao. The company has more than 240 million registered users for its online doctors consultation, prescription and diagnosis services. The company builds, owns and operates one of China’s largest digital healthcare infrastructure platforms by linking hospitals and doctors with patients, pharmacies, insurance programs and financial services.

name: Wingreens
description: Founded by Anju and Arjun Srivastava, Wingreens is a niche brand in packaged foods with a health positioning. Having started with fresh dips, it diversified into sauces, spreads and an assortment of organic products. It also acquired Raw Pressery, adding healthy beverages to its product portfolio. Wingreens’ network reach spans India across retail format: modern and traditional channels, as well as eCommerce. They have a deep commitment to sustainability and empower women through their Women’s Initiative Network.

name: XpressBees
description: Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Amitava Saha and Supam Maheshwari, Xpressbees is amongst the leading technology-led express logistics service provider in India. Along with its market leading p​resence in e-commerce logistics, Xpressbees is in the process of transforming itself into a technology driven supply chain company with presence across Express Cargo, 3PL and Cross Border logistics

name: Zacco
description: Founded in 1870, Zacco is a leading full-service Intellectual Property (IP) provider, offering end-to-end solutions across the entire IP lifecycle. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Zacco has a strong footprint in the Nordics, Germany, the UK, India, and the US, with over 450 professionals serving 4,000+ clients worldwide. Leveraging its proprietary technology platform, IPView, Zacco provides comprehensive IP services and solutions – from initial patent and trademark filings to ongoing portfolio management, IP asset renewal, online security, and brand protection. Zacco combines a people-first and technology-led approach, with an end-to-end delivery model that provides a “one-stop shop” to its customers, enabling them to safeguard their intangible assets in an increasingly digital world. With a strong market presence and deep industry expertise, Zacco continues to be a trusted partner for multinational corporations and mid-sized enterprises looking to protect and manage their intellectual property. Zacco and its team of IP experts have repeatedly earned top-tier rankings and recommendations from industry bodies such as World Trademark Review, Intellectual Asset Management, Managing IP, and Legal 500.

name: ZoloStays
description: ZoloStays (Zolo) provides convenient full-stack co-living services to young professionals and students in India who are looking for long-duration stays across budget-friendly or premium pricepoints. Zolo is disrupting the traditional paying-guest (PG) market in India by providing professional facility management services, catering and utilities through a plug-and-play model in carefully-curated living spaces. With headquarters in Bangalore, Zolo provides co-living solutions in ten Indian cities. Zolo was founded in 2015 by three individuals:Dr Nikhil Sikri, Sneha Chaudhury and Akhil Sikri.
