Since 2007, Zendesk has been providing just that, with pioneering B2B software that helps organizations engage with their customers in ways that foster long-term customer happiness and retention. Their customer service and sales products are beautifully simple and omni-channel, allowing organizations to interact seamlessly with their customers and clients over email, phone, chat, social media and more. Backed by a user base that absolutely loves their products, Zendesk's popular SaaS platform will continue to grow its reach far and wide.

name: Zenefits
description: Zenefits is a next-generation HR software provider that gives growing companies a solution to easily manage payroll, benefits, compliance and more through a single online dashboard. Previously, HR software was only available to massive companies who had the resources to purchase expensive, enterprise systems from vendors like Workday, SAP and Oracle. By contrast, the extremely affordable Zenefits has made powerful but streamlined HR software accessible for the millions of U.S. companies with fewer than 1,000 employees. The SaaS application is amazingly simple and eliminates the paperwork and hassle of traditional HR management, providing better service and automated tools to create an experience that users love.

name: Zerto
description: Zerto is the world’s leading B2B provider of disaster recovery, ransomware resilience and workload mobility software for both on-premises and cloud environments. When pre-existing disaster recovery solutions were rendered unworkable by the paradigm shift to virtualization and hybrid cloud deployments, Zerto swiftly responded to solve a complex task previously constrained by physical technologies. Zerto moves data/application protection and replication into the virtual layer, working “across the aisle” to connect disparate technologies for the benefit of IT and business leaders. Additionally, Zerto provides the ability to build infrastructures using private, hybrid or public clouds to help IT organizations become more agile in supporting changing business needs. The result is unparalleled flexibility, scalability, and protection of mission critical infrastructure.

name: ZipRecruiter
description: While the recruiting industry began its transition from offline to online almost as soon as the Internet was commercialized, the market is large and small- and medium-sized businesses have remained largely underserved—until now. ZipRecruiter’s pioneering B2B suite of hiring products and subscription plans deliver a better way to recruit and hire for companies of all sizes, including the SMB segment that makes up roughly half of the US workforce. Fast and easy to use, the successful HR hiring platform helps employers distribute and manage job postings across the web. By providing an efficient and flexible subscription product, ZipRecruiter makes job distribution and candidate management simple for companies that may otherwise find enterprise-class software cumbersome and expensive. Meanwhile, candidates benefit from ZipRecruiter’s proprietary matching technology, which greatly simplifies and expedites the process of finding a new job.

description: ReadySet’s software is designed to create a seamless supply chain between hospitals and medical device manufacturers, generating significant cost savings for both parties and the patients they serve.

name: Renalis
description: Renalis is a digital health company creating platforms to improve experiences and outcomes for people with pelvic health conditions.

name: Rhove
description: Rhove was founded on the belief that our democracy is strongest when everyone has ownership. That’s why the company is on a mission to expand access and opportunity for everyone to own in our communities.

name: Roosense
description: Roosense is the manufacturer of SweatID. SweatID is a wearable training optimization technology company that provides users with the data they need to accurately rehydrate during work, training, or competition. SweatID is a disposable, nonwoven fabric sensor that can specifically measure the sodium concentration of a person’s sweat in real time. The sensor can be integrated into clothing or gear that athletes are already wearing. The data from the sensor can then be used to create a personalized hydration plan.

name: S4 Medical
description: Founded in 2017 by biomedical industry veterans William Fuller and Dr. Emile Daoud, Cleveland-based S4 Medical is a medical device company focused on innovative solutions for cardiac procedures to treat atrial fibrillation.

name: ScriptDrop
description: ScriptDrop’s team of healthcare experts has revolutionized prescription delivery by seamlessly connecting pharmacies to a nationwide network of trained, professional couriers.

name: Securus Medical Group
description: Securus Medical Group is developing clinical tools to monitor core body temperature within body cavities.

name: Segmint
description: Segmint is a technology company committed to facilitating online delivery of pertinent and compelling offers to customers of financial institutions through identification of customer spending patterns and Key Lifestyle Indicators (KLIs).

name: SHARE Mobility
description: SHARE is a mobility company that helps organizations and cities solve big transportation problems with mobility-as-a-service. People schedule and share rides, it costs organizations less, SHARE’s software makes it run, and the service is delivered by safe, professional drivers in reliable, connected vehicles.

name: SNO Bio
description: SNO Bio is an early-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics targeting enzymes associated with S-nitrosylation, a post-translational protein modification operating as a fundamental biological mechanism controlling cell signaling.

name: Society Brands
description: Society Brands is a tech-enabled consumer products company that acquires e-commerce native brands that primarily sell on Amazon and their own DTC sites. The company was built for and by founders, providing entrepreneurs meaningful liquidity while at the same time affording them an opportunity to stay on board, build their brand and roll equity into Society Brands’ platform.

name: SoLo Funds
description: This Cincinnati-based startup has created a mobile peer-to-peer lending exchange that provides affordable access to loans up to $1,000, allowing users to lend to or borrow from anyone in the country using only their mobile device while eliminating the strain of payday loans.

name: SPR Therapeutics
description: SPR™ Therapeutics is commercializing a novel therapy for severe pain with its patented peripheral nerve stimulation products. The company’s pipeline of neurostimulation pain therapies will exploit the same physiologic mechanism of action, proprietary technology and clinical approach.

name: Stack Media
description: STACK Media is the nation’s leading producer and distributor of sports performance, training and lifestyle content for high school athletes and the high school sports community.

name: Strongsuit
description: Strongsuit is a smart, scalable, household-chief-of-staff that relieves the mental load and helps busy professionals manage life outside of the office.

name: Synapse Biomedical
description: Synapse Biomedical is focused on the development and commercialization of minimally invasive neurostimulation technologies for the diagnosis and treatment of neurodegenerative impairments.

name: Talmetrix
description: Talmetrix, a Cincinnati-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) company, turns HR metrics into actionable data to boost business results.

name: Thrivable
description: Thrivable is the health care industry’s only on-demand market research platform for teams that want to ensure the voice of the patient drives everyday business decisions.

name: Time2Talk
description: Time2Talk is a mobile app that connects Spanish learning students in the US with native Spanish speakers in Latin America on-demand.

name: TonDone
description: TonDone is the end-to-end business operating system for building and facility service companies. TonDone’s web and mobile platforms are used to streamline work at over 800 facilities covering millions of square feet of commercial space. TonDone’s technology helps contractors, frontline employees, and the facilities they serve to simplify communication and demonstrate work was done on time and as expected.

name: TPA Stream
description: TPA Stream was founded in 2014 to make health benefits easier for employees and administrators.

name: Tranztec
description: Tranztec is a premier provider of technology, networking, application development, software and support solutions for companies of all sizes and in all industries nationwide. The company can assume the role of advisor, system designer, support resource or the management of your entire technology infrastructure.

name: Unific
description: Unific is the leader in e-commerce integrations for HubSpot. The company’s suite of technology and expert services help aspiring e-commerce brands exceed their growth goals.

name: Unify Jobs
description: Unify Jobs is an integrated technology solution that transforms the hiring experience for employers and job seekers. It is designed for diversity, equity and inclusion at its core for employers and job seekers striving to have a competitive advantage and self-direct their future.

name: VitalXchange
description: The VitalXchange app is a health network, ensuring that no one ever feels alone or isolated.

name: Vizzle
description: Vizzle is a special education software for teachers, school administrators, speech-language pathologists and parents.

name: Vlipsy
description: Vlipsy is the video clip soundboard—use it to quickly find and reference clips from your favorite internet videos. Vlipsy’s content is made to help you communicate better everywhere you go on the internet.

name: Vox Mobile
description: Vox Mobile is a Cleveland-based provider of complete enterprise mobility and IoT services for domestic and international organizations.

name: Wireless Environment
description: Wireless Environment designs light-emitting diode (LED) lighting products that improve the convenience and energy efficiency of current lighting solutions.

name: Wisr
description: Founded in 2016 by three EdTech and SaaS veterans, Cleveland-based Wisr has developed higher education’s leading knowledge-sharing community.

name: Wizest
description: Wizest is an investment platform that democratizes access to financial experts, heralded in Forbes as an “anti-Robinhood” solution. Wizest provides access to an exclusive community of vetted financial experts, sharing their knowledge, actively managing portfolios, and explaining their moves. Users follow experts, like influencers, and build their own team of experts to invest on their behalf, making investing easy and approachable.

name: Xploro
description: Xploro is an award-winning and clinically validated health information platform that uses augmented reality, gameplay and artificial intelligence to deliver health information to young patients, in a way that makes them feel empowered, engaged and informed, whilst having fun at the same time.

name: Zuga Medical
description: Zuga Medical is a medical device company developing a series of proprietary products, accessories and programs to make dental implants simpler and more cost-effective.

name: Moglix
description: Moglix is South Asia’s largest MRO (manufacturing, repair and operating supplies) procurement provider. It has built a unique industrial products marketplace focused on procuring and supplying utility-based products for the B2B sector, without any owned assets.

name: Kredivo
description: Indonesia’s largest consumer lending app. Kredivo leverages deep data analytics across users’ digital footprint to automate credit risk scoring and streamline access to credit for ecommerce purchases in Indonesia. The company’s flagship product, Kredivo Buy now, Pay later, enables ecommerce buyers to apply and qualify for instant credit and pay back over time. Merchants using Kredivo benefit from providing Point of Sale financing using a 2-click checkout to all eligible buyers.

name: Livspace
description: South & South East Asia’s largest home decor & furnishings platform. Livspace is a new online shopping destination where you can design, decorate and furnish your dream house. It is the industry’s first comprehensive technology online platform that serves end-to-end home interior ecosystem via a three-way marketplace curated for designers, suppliers and home owners.

name: Turtlemint
description: India’s largest insurance advisor focussed InsurTech platform. Turtlemint's unique hybrid (online-offline) model equips the insurance advisor community with digital tools to efficiently tackle an otherwise cumbersome offline selling process and at a scale. Through its simple mobile app, Turtlemint provides a wide variety of products, customized recommendation tools, and a wide range of courses on financial products to empower insurance advisors to be truly digital and future-ready.

name: Sociolla
description: Sociolla is the largest beauty e-commerce platform in Indonesia that aims to give equal access for beauty products to every woman in Indonesia. Starting with B2C e-commerce, the company has evolved to a beauty ecosystem that connects people in their community (“SOCO”), an online media portal provides viewers with product information, reviews, tips, news, and much more (Beauty Journal), and has exclusive brand partnerships as sole distributor in Indonesia.

name: Leap Finance
description: Leap is India's leading digital platform offering tailored products to the international student community. Its one-stop B2C solution offers test prep, admission counseling, and assistance to India outbound students going overseas for Masters and similar programs. Once admitted, the platform provides collateral-free education loans in the destination market currency and interest rates, utility financial products like bank a/c and credit cards, and visa application services.

name: Atomberg
description: Atomberg Technologies is a smart and efficient motor-technology based home appliance company, focused on making the consumer lives better through innovation and technology. Over the last few years, Atomberg has won multiple accolades like the ET Startup of the Year Award (Best on Campus), Global Cleantech Innovation Award by United Nations, and the Climate Solver Award by WWF.

name: Waresix
description: Waresix digitizes freight logistics with a network of haulers and warehouses in Indonesia. Their digital-first product reduces the complexity for users, connects shippers and businesses with available warehouses and transporters across Indonesia, providing better transparency, quality of service, and improved incomes for asset owners.

name: Vida Digital Identity
description: VIDA offers identity verification, legally binding and verifiable digital signatures, and verifiable credentials. It helps companies to verify identities digitally, using biometrics, machine learning and computer vision, big data and more, to run checks on identity cards and facial biometrics against government databases.

name: Infinity Fincorp Solutions
description: Infinity is a RBI-registered NBFC enabling credit access to micro entrepreneurs and small businesses in tier 3 and 4 cities and towns across India, including tea shop owners, vegetable vendors, small machine enterprises, restaurants, provision stores, textile shops, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, milkmen, laundry service providers, hairdressers, and financially underserved small-scale manufacturers.

name: Citymall
description: CityMall is India's first community based e-commerce platform for the next 200-300 million Internet users new-to-internet users in tier 2, and below towns in India. Through its deep network of neighbourhood community leaders, the company aims to create thousands of micro-entrepreneurs, while empowering them to create the go-to-e-commerce platform for emerging India.

name: Reddoorz
description: RedDoorz is the largest and fastest-growing budget accommodation brand in South East Asia. It is the region's first asset light budget accommodation brand which provides high quality standard services and brand guarantee to its guests. It aggregates standalone budget accommodations, provides hotel owners with technology and training, and ensures consumers receive standardized services across RedDoorz-branded hotels.

name: Betterplace
description: India’s largest tech platform for blue-collar workforce management. Betterplace uniquely addresses the requirements of both enterprises and the workforce in a fragmented and underserved ecosystem. It enables employers to manage the entire life cycle of their workforce by providing them services such as hiring, assessment of job seekers, digital on-boarding, KYC, training, attendance management, payroll, compliance and more, while helping blue-collar employees get trained and up-skilled, with access to financial and healthcare services.

name: Ofload
description: Australian freight logistics startup, Ofload, is digitizing and optimizing the Australian trucking fleets by managing the end-to-end freight journey for customers- from discovery to planning and booking, right through to delivery and payments.

name: Pomelo
description: Pomelo is a leading international online fashion company based in Bangkok. With an undisputable sense of style at an unparalleled price, Pomelo aims to offer women everywhere their best look to become their best selves. Products are proudly designed and produced around Asia for today’s global consumer.

name: Vayana
description: Vayana is a short-term SME trade finance platform based in India. It is the simplest way for buyers and sellers to get their trade transactions reconciled, filed and financed. Vayana Network has lending partners including PSU Banks, Private Sector Banks, global MNCs and NBFCs. The network today covers 500+ pin codes in over 150 cities in India across 14 different industries.

name: KiotViet
description: KiotViet offers a cloud-based POS and store management software suite with inventory management, cash flow management, marketing, and management solutions. Established in 2014, Kiotviet today services more than 100,000 micro-businesses and SMEs in Vietnam.

name: Evermos
description: Evermos is the leading Social Commerce platform in Indonesia for halal and sharia-compliant goods. It is an online sales platform utilizing resellers, who are incentivized to share and sell products from the Evermos app via their messaging application or social media. Has signed up more than 20000 resellers across Indonesia since its launch in 2018.

name: Sleek
description: Sleek is a back-end operating system for start-ups and SMEs. The platform streamlines, automates and integrates company set-up, financial and regulatory reporting, book-keeping and banking services.

name: Deskera
description: South East Asia’s largest cloud ERP software platform for SMEs. Deskera is a leading cloud-based and GST-compliant Enterprise Suite provider for SMEs in Southeast Asia and India. It works with customers and clients worldwide to deliver ERP, CRM, PM, and HCM solutions to help thousands of companies of all sizes run better.

name: The Ayurveda Experience
description: The Ayurveda Experience (TAE) is the largest Ayurveda products company offering comprehensive Ayurvedic solutions and services across North America, Europe, Canada, Australia, and India. It manufactures, sells and distributes products in the complementary and alternative healthcare sector related to Ayurveda. With a strong focus on quality and authenticity, TAE has built a reputation for delivering effective and traditional Ayurvedic formulations.

name: Hypefast
description: Hypefast is Indonesia’s leading Direct to Consumer (D2C) brand scaler. Hypefast partners with local D2C brands once they have early traction online to co-own the brand with the commitment of rapidly scaling the brand’s online presence and revenue by leveraging data science, standardised tech modules, teams, growth marketing, and sourcing.

name: Walko Food
description: Walko Food's NIC is India's fastest growing ice cream brand and a leading quick-service restaurant (QSR) company. NIC is revolutionizing the ice cream industry through innovative value chain optimization, delivering high-quality and delicious ice cream products. It has gained widespread popularity and a strong presence in over 100 cities across India.

name: Dat Bike
description: Dat Bike is a technology startup whose mission is to drive mass adoption of green transportation. Dat Bike makes the most compelling and dependable electric bikes that match traditional gas-bikes performance so that customers can just switch without making any compromises.

name: Dachin
description: Dachin is Southeast Asia’s leading data-driven, direct-to-consumer brand builder, creating and scaling consumer brands across home and living brands. It includes accessories and consumer electronics. Leveraging its in-house data analytics engine, end-to-end fulfillment infrastructure, and performance marketing expertise, the company transforms marketplace insights into category-leading brands. Its portfolio includes top-ranked brands such as Ecentio, Freemir and Cooger.

name: Saltmine
description: Saltmine is a cloud-based collaboration and orchestration software platform which is revolutionizing how real estate teams in large enterprises are designing workspaces for employees. It is a seamless, first-of-its-kind, software solution that aligns workplace design needs with business goals, including workplace re-entry planning in a post Covid world.

name: Pratilipi
description: Pratilipi brings together India’s largest community of language storytellers, with 950,000 writers, 30 million readers, and products spanning audiobooks, comics, and books. Available in 12 Indian languages.

name: Escape Plan
description: Escape Plan is transforming travel in India with an all-in-one platform for thoughtfully designed luggage and accessories. Built for the new generation of Indian travellers, Escape Plan brings together quality, style, and everyday convenience making modern travel gear more accessible than ever.

name: Believe
description: Believe is a D2C beauty company serving the global Muslim audience with brands spanning skincare, fragrances, make-up and hair care. Its house of brands include Lafz, ZM and Dr.Rhazes. For more: https://arab.news/rkgc3

name: Waterfield Advisors
description: Waterfield Advisors is India’s premier independent multi-family office, offering bespoke wealth management and advisory services. With a focus on integrity and transparency, they provide comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and succession solutions, empowering families to preserve and grow their legacy across generations.

name: RED.Health
description: RED.Health is the leading medical emergency response platform in India. Founded in 2016, RED.Health is reshaping the traditional emergency value chain with its technology-driven approach and focus on skilled first responders. Operating across 16 cities in India, RED.Health commands a fleet of 450 ambulances and a network over 6000 road ambulances to support inter- and intra-city emergency needs.

name: AMP
description: AMP is a platform of interconnected, high-performance solutions, built to power and scale eCommerce businesses while solving multiple problems from optimising sales, managing shipping and tracking analytics.

name: Sanlayan
description: Sanlayan Technologies is India's leading electronics system design and manufacturing company building advanced radar, avionics, and RF systems through cutting-edge hardware and AI/ML integration. Sanlayan's sophisticated technology stack includes core IP in radar systems, embedded electronics, and digital hardware solutions that power complex platforms for aircraft, surveillance systems, and next-generation electronic applications.

name: Infeedo
description: Asia's leading all-in-one employee experience platform with people analytics that help predict attrition, burnout & disengagement in top talent. Infeedo's proprietary A.I. bot called Amber acts as a Chief Listening Officer to the CEO, has intelligent conversations with employees to find hidden gaps in their culture, managers and wellbeing in real time.

name: Abra
description: Abra makes cryptocurrency investing simple, by enabling users to buy, sell, store, and invest in cryptocurrencies, plus manage all crypto investments, in a single app.

name: Marketwolf
description: Fintech stock trading platform MarketWolf aims to democratize the trading ecosystem with the vision of ‘Anyone Can Trade’. The company is making trading accessible to first-timers with low minimum investment amounts and a risk management system, as well as modules for practicing and learning about investing. Traders can invest in options, futures, ETFs, and stocks, starting with investments as low as $5.

name: BRIK
description: BRIK is a next-generation construction materials and solutions startup. It develops and delivers verified ready-mix concrete (RMC) designed to replace manual hand-mixing onsite, while reducing carbon impact through the use of industrial byproducts. With an end-to-end supply network spanning eight batching plants and more than 120 mixers, BRIK supports contractors with real-time delivery scheduling, compliance documentation, and full-stack service integration.

name: CloudEats
description: CloudEats is the largest cloud kitchen company in the Philippines. It operates a portfolio of delivery-first food brands built around a simple goal of making clean, affordable meals more accessible across the country. Its brands reflect what everyday consumers actually want and what the market still lacks. CloudEats runs a multi-brand “food court online” model through its own kitchen network and is now one of the most recognised digital food operators in Southeast Asia.

name: NirogStreet
description: NirogStreet is India’s first and largest Ayurveda tech startup, led with a vision to make Ayurveda mainstream in the global healthcare ecosystem. The company offers a wide portfolio of services including integrated doctor-led prescription e-commerce enablement, peer-to-peer learning for Ayurvedic doctors, digital health record management, and smart clinics.

name: AlphaGeo
description: Founded in 2022, AlphaGeo is building a leading AI-powered geospatial predictive location analytics platform. It uses advanced machine learning techniques to downscale projections of heat, storm, flood, fire, drought, sea level rise and other climate risks for any coordinate on Earth – as well as to capture the locations of all adaptation features such as sea walls, levees, desalination plants, fire stations and much more.

name: Mio
description: Vietnam’s leading social commerce platform, Mio, is a group buying platform for grocery and fresh produce for Tier 2 and 3 cities in Vietnam offering consistent quality at affordable prices with next day delivery. The company aims to drive financial independence for millions of Vietnamese women by democratising entrepreneurship opportunities through its Mio Partner model.

name: SmartKarma
description: Smartkarma is a collaborative marketplace that is radically changing the way market participants create, distribute and consume investment insights. As a trusted information source, Smartkarma provides unconflicted and unmatched analysis, transparency, and context into Asian markets to help global institutional investors confidently drive their investment strategies.

name: Edupia
description: Leading Vietnamese Edtech startup EDUPIA is on a mission to provide an easy and accessible English learning platform to eliminate language-based inequalities and build a more globally competitive youth population. EDUPIA started out as a self-learning platform and has since expanded into live classes and private tutoring.

name: Drivetrain
description: Drivetrain is a financial planning and decision-making platform that helps businesses scale and predictably achieve their targets. Companies can better manage their business and unlock sustainable growth using Drivetrain.

name: Crayon Data
description: Technology platform that democratizes the use of big data for the average business and consumer. Top-tier enterprises including banking, e-commerce, travel, and hospitality use Crayon’s personalization engine, maya.ai, to deliver digital, personal experiences centred around taste.

name: Medici
description: Medici’s vision is to make healthcare and insurance more accessible and affordable to the masses in Vietnam. The company brings a unique approach to increasing healthcare access and protection in Vietnam through its holistic healthcare ecosystem that has expanded from telemedicine to a marketplace and most recently, insurance.

name: Sweet Escape
description: SweetEscape, a travel and event photography platform, connects travellers to local professional photographers in more than 500 cities around the world, with professionally edited photos available in 48 hours through an AI-enabled photographer workflow.

name: Coto
description: coto is a Web3-based online social platform exclusively for women. It aims to function as a safe space, and help women find identity, independence, and inclusion. The platform seeks to build a positive and valuable digital experience for women worldwide, where young girls and women of all ages can create and consume content, share opinions and thoughts, engage, and build connections in a responsible, safe virtual environment.

name: Showroom B2B
description: Showroom B2B is building a one-stop shop for the clothing trade. It is disrupting the decades-old apparel supply chain network with its unique, non-traditional model that directly connects manufacturers with retailers, eliminating middlemen, hence empowering micro retailers and wholesalers who were previously left out.

name: Livein
description: LiveIn is a marketplace for students and young professionals to find long-term room rentals in South East Asia. LiveIn currently operates as a tech-enabled, asset-light property management service which provides standardized rooms and full management of the property across 20+ buildings in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok.

name: iPiD
description: Founded in 2021, iPiD’s vision to make cross-border payments easy, secure, and seamless. The platform enables market participants to simplify the cross-border payment experience, reduce failed payments, and prevent fraud attempts thanks to a first-of-its-kind global bank account validation and proxy addressing service.

name: Distil
description: Distil is an R&D-led specialty chemicals platform that offers fully customisable, scalable solutions, dependable quality, tech-enabled convenient purchasing with on-time delivery, and extensive after-sales support for manufacturers worldwide.

name: EnerZolve
description: EnerZolve is building the indigenous hardware and software stack that India's energy transition is missing. This stack spans smart meters, transformers, battery storage systems, power conversion, and protection relays in a market where 85% of critical components are still imported from global OEMs. Backed by powerful government tailwinds including the RDSS scheme, Make in India mandates, and the Positive Indigenisation List, EnerZolve is an integrated domestic player with proprietary IP across power electronics, magnetics, and embedded

name: Neurowyzr
description: Neurowyzr is a deep neuroscience and brain capital company that uses the latest discoveries in neuroscience to optimize brain performance, brain health, and brain longevity. Built by neuroscientists and powered by advanced analytics and AI, Neurowyzr offers a digital platform and software as a service to unlock the potential of individuals and organizations. Neurowyzr has supported leading organisations in Asia in growing their brain capital to build stronger, more resilient, and innovative teams.

name: KisaanSay
description: KisaanSay is India’s first cross-category direct-from-origin food brand, committed to transforming the way food is sourced and consumed. By partnering with farmer collectives in diverse agro-ecological regions, KisaanSay delivers minimally processed, provenance-driven products that are grown, packaged, and processed at source. With a mission to create healthier food options for consumers and sustainable livelihoods for farmers, KisaanSay is building a transparent, scalable farm-to-fork ecosystem.

name: Prosperr.io
description: Prosperr.io sits at the intersection of enterprise payroll compliance and employee financial wellness—a white space between legacy HRMS platforms, fragmented expense tools, and consumer fintech that none of them own. Enterprises use Prosperr's AI-enabled CFO stack to automate flexible benefits and reduce compliance overhead, while their employees use the Super Saver suite to optimize taxes and build wealth, all unified by the Prosperr Tax Graph: a proprietary data layer that gets smarter with every payroll cycle, tax filing, and invest

name: Off Foods
description: Off Foods is championing the alternative protein movement in SEAsia. The company's first product Off Meat, a chicken-like protein, has witnessed rapid adoption through partnerships with restaurants. With its great-tasting products, strong go-to-market strategy, and best-in-class cost structure suited for developing markets, Off Foods is on a mission to make alternative proteins mainstream in the region.

name: Xweave
description: Xweave is a non-custodial orchestration layer that enables instant, compliant cross-border money transfers using stablecoin rails. It supports fiat-to-fiat and fiat-to-stable transactions without holding funds or requiring pre-funding, and powers real-world use cases like remittances, treasury flows, fintech wallet transfers, and merchant payouts.

name: Desty
description: Desty provides tools for sellers, influencers, and creators to create their online presence and build their own branded online store in minutes for free. Key features include Desty Page, a landing page generator, and Desty Store, a simple & easy-to-use online shop creator.

name: Timo
description: Founded in 2016, Timo is the first and leading digital bank in Vietnam. Timo partners with Viet Capital Bank to offer a wide range of banking services to Millennial and Gen Z customers, ranging from savings and deposits, to lending, wealth management and insurance, along with a 24/7 instant and free inter-bank money transfer facility.

name: Kyklo
description: Kyklo has developed a best in class Plug & Play e-commerce platform with enriched product catalog for Electrical and Automation Distributors which includes webstore & mobile product selection tools for sellers, enriched product data, add on sale product suggestions and professionally developed customer quotes.

name: Paysense
description: PaySense is a seamless digital app and mobile-based consumer credit enablement platform. The application retrieves financial and non-financial aspects from the handset device, and leverages on data science in its KYC and verification to offer instant loan and credit opportunities to consumers. PaySense partners with many credit-worthy customers who are not addressed or targeted by conventional players. Paysense was exited to Naspers in 2020.

name: Pokkt
description: Pokkt is an in-app ad platform that includes video ads and app performance marketing. It uses machine learning to help its over 200 advertising partners better target their audiences. Pokkt was exited to Anymind Group (5027.T-JP:Tokyo Stock Exchange) in 2020.

name: Voyagin
description: Voyagin is a marketplace to help you discover and book the best things to do, attraction tickets, and unique local tours. Voyagin connects you with hosts providing the best experiences all across Asia. Voyagin was acquired by Rakuten in 2016.

name: Imoney.my
description: iMoney explains and compares financial products for Southeast Asian consumers and helps them find the best product for their specific need. iMoney was acquired by iSelect in 2019

name: Travelmob
description: Travelmob is a leading social stay marketplace where people can find, offer and book unique accommodation in Asia Pacific.Travelmob was acquired by HomeAway (Expedia) in 2015

name: Zipdial
description: Missed call marketing platform in India. Advertisers use ZipDial as a call-to-action across all media channels (print, TV, radio, product packaging, etc) to drive 2-50 times more engagement than other media. ZipDial Analytics creates intelligence and transparency in the performance of traditional media campaigns.Zipdial was acquired by Twitter in January 2015.

name: Tradegecko
description: TradeGecko is a cloud-based inventory management platform for retailers and wholesalers. TradeGecko combines inventory management operations, critical business applications and online commerce to build the central core of wholesale business operations.Tradegecko was exited to Intuit in 2020.

name: Dathena
description: Dathena provides next generation data identification, classification & monitoring capabilities, empowering risk & corporate professionals to better understand the data within their organisations, enforce data privacy and regulatory compliance, enhance ongoing protection & monitoring of business critical data. Dathena was exited to Proofpoint

description: Tookitaki provides enterprise software solutions that enable financial institutions create sustainable compliance programmes.In the regulatory compliance space, their offerings cater to anti-money laundering and reconciliation spaces. Tookitaki was exited to Thunes in 2022.

Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication nonadherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address any medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by identifying and addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health. Over 120 customers across the healthcare landscape use our medication engagement program to improve medication adherence for patients with chronic and infectious diseases.

name: SchoolMint
description: SchoolMint provides a cloud-based student enrollment and school choice platform to PreK-12 school systems worldwide. Since its founding in 2013, close to 4000 schools have chosen SchoolMint to streamline all aspects of student enrollment – student registration management, application, lottery, and school choice management, and digital forms and document uploads. Available online and on mobile devices, SchoolMint integrates with leading student information systems (SIS) and transforms the end-to-end enrollment experience for school staff and parents.

name: Schoolzilla
description: Schoolzilla delivers timely, actionable insights to teachers, principals, and district leaders through a SaaS data and business intelligence platform. By merging data from dozens of different sources such as attendance, test scores, online learning tools, human resources and financial accounting, Schoolzilla empowers educators to make smarter, faster decisions to increase student achievement.

name: Searchlight
description: Searchlight is a full-cycle talent platform that uses science to help companies hire more top performers and diverse teams, by winning talent in today’s competitive market. Their best-in-class Reference product gives teams predictive data on competencies, working styles, and areas of growth. The full platform integrates their data across the hiring process to better align recruiters and hiring managers, assess candidates objectively, and provide information that helps companies hire better.

name: SeedFi
description: SeedFi is a financial health startup that helps Americans build credit, save money, access funds, and plan for the future. Created by founders with years of fintech experience and firsthand knowledge of common money pain points, SeedFi’s mission is to help Americans break the cycle of debt and realize their financial potential.

name: Selected
description: Selected is a platform that matches teachers with schools they love by streamlining the job search and hiring process.

name: SendHub
description: SendHub enhances business communication by providing companies with free and low-cost telecommunication options. With SendHub, colleagues receive free phone numbers in any area code accessible on any device, simplifying communication and providing instant analytics with a single click.

name: Shifted Energy
description: Shifted Energy is clean technology startup working to enable the transition to a fully renewable grid through a distributed energy aggregation software platform. We use machine learning, data analytics, and smart controls.

name: Simple HealthKit
description: Simple HealthKit (SHK) is healthcare from anywhere. Re-built for everyone. We build affordable, accessible and accurate end-to-end diagnostic and digital health solutions. Because world-class care for everyone means better health for all.

name: Sivil
description: Sivil is a public safety software company with a mission of creating a safer world for everyone. Their goal is to help cities and counties make data-driven decisions that increase transparency of police conduct, decrease taxpayer money spent on use of force claims, and improve the relationship between police and the community.

name: Socialize
description: Socialize is a drop-in social platform that creates a community around apps, leveraging networking features through a single interface. It was acquired by ShareThis in 2013.

name: Stretch
description: Stretch is reimagining grocery shopping. As shoppers seek smarter ways to manage their grocery spending, our platform creates unprecedented opportunities for retailers and brands to understand behavior, refine strategy, and uncover new opportunities as households evolve their shopping habits to make every dollar count. Our platform provides new opportunities for retailers and brands to understand behavior, refine strategy, and uncover growth as shoppers seek smarter ways to manage their grocery spending.

name: Strive
description: Strive helps high potential, low credential candidates land the middle-class careers they desire and deserve. Strive’s hiring platform helps companies source and evaluate candidates based on competencies and potential rather than credentials and pedigree.

name: StyleSeek
description: StyleSeek is a personalized style discovery site that enables users to establish their own unique Style DNA. They can find inspiration for their style, browse and shop for items, and receive sophisticated recommendations based on their specific preferences.

name: SV Academy
description: SV Academy is a workforce accelerator that provides millions of non-traditional job seekers, who lack prior industry work experience or insider connections, with direct access to a career in tech sales. No coding experience is required.

name: Sweep
description: Sweep is a platform that allows users to plan ahead for bills, expenses, and savings goals by providing a complete forward-looking view of their cash flow.

name: Swing Education
description: Swing Education is an online system for educators that helps prevent interruptions in the classroom by matching substitute teachers with schools.

name: Talko
description: Talko is an app designed to unlock the potential of voice. It allows people to use their voice to increase communication and social productivity.

name: Tastebud
description: TasteBud is a product discovery platform. We leverage AI to get to know your family — preferences, dietary restrictions, what works and what doesn't — and send you perfectly matched products from premium brands. For free.

name: tEQuitable
description: tEQuitable is an independent, confidential platform that helps users address issues of bias, discrimination and harassment in the workplace.

name: Thalamus
description: Thalamus is a premier, cloud-based interview management platform designed specifically for application to Graduate Medical Education (GME) training programs. The platform integrates with existing application systems to assist both applicants and administrators streamline their processes and conduct virtual interviews.

name: Thrive Market
description: Thrive Market is an online wholesale buying club that aims to make healthy living easy and affordable for every American family. It currently offers 4,000 of the most popular natural and organic products at 25-50 percent off the retail price. These products can be shipped anywhere in the U.S for free. The company also gives a free membership to a low-income family, veteran, or teacher, for every paid member on the site.

name: Tinybop
description: Tinybop is a studio of designers, developers, and artists who are building a suite of educational iOS apps for kids. They believe in the power of learning through play, experimentation, and inquiry, and strive to create immersive games that encourage exploration and creativity.

name: TomoCredit
description: TomoCredit offers credit cards to Americans who are cash-rich but have been overlooked by traditional lenders because they have no credit score. It was founded by a team of immigrants from MIT and UC Berkeley who were determined to build a better credit system. TomoCredit’s proprietary underwriting technology identifies and offers credit cards to users based on real-time cash flow behavior.

name: True Link
description: True Link is a fraud protection service for the 11 million at-risk seniors who lose a total of $52 billion per year. Their specialized Visa card automatically blocks unwanted charges, protecting seniors’ money and enabling them to live happily and independently for longer.

name: Twilio
description: Twilio allows software developers to programmatically make and receive phone calls, and send and receive text messages using its web service APIs.

name: Uber
description: Uber captures the elite limo experience and transforms it into an on-demand service that fits an efficient and modern lifestyle. Uber provides a seamless experience on mobile to book and pay for your on-demand car service.

name: Uncharted
description: Uncharted is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) company that helps cities and developers reduce the cost and complexity of deploying and managing last-mile infrastructure. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in New York, Uncharted is an award-winning, MWBE-certified company focused on the mission to accelerate the equitable development of smart, sustainable infrastructure worldwide.

name: UpLift
description: UpLift delivers collaborative psychotherapy and psychiatry tightly integrated with local providers to drive value for patients, providers, and payers at meaningful scale. We're rebuilding the behavioral healthcare delivery system to thrive under current fee-for-service payment models, and are driving the market towards value-based care.

name: Vault
description: Vault is an employment benefit platform that helps companies hire and retain employees for longer by saving them thousands of dollars. They help employees by in paying down their student loans, contributing to 529 plans, providing tuition reimbursement and more.

name: Velano Vascular
description: Velano Vascular‘s technologies transform care by reducing the stress and anxiety related to drawing blood during hospitalization. The company’s vascular access devices aim to reduce pain and discomfort for patients, while enhancing safety and efficiency for providers. The company’s collaborators include leading U.S. hospital systems and cutting-edge patient care organizations.

name: Verificient
description: Verificient Technologies provides scalable continuous identity verification solutions through its patent-pending application ProctorTrack.

name: Via
description: Via is a revolutionary technology platform that is changing the way people move around cities. Via's phone app offers users a ride that costs a little more than the bus. It’s on-demand transportation on a mass scale that’s friendly to our planet.

name: Visually
description: Visual.ly makes it possible to present information in a bite-sized visual way that makes sense for the age of big data. Their platform democratizes the creation and sharing of visualizations, making it possible for everyone to participate.

name: WePow
description: WePow’s scalable and customizable video and mobile recruitment solutions simplify talent acquisition. Their innovative clients are increasing productivity and efficiency, and significantly reducing interviewing costs while improving the quality of their engagement with candidates.

name: WorkAmerica
description: WorkAmerica unites education and employment by building job guaranteed pathways for vocational education students at community colleges. They help de-risking students’ enrollment decisions while solving the skill gap that plagues America’s employers.

name: Worklete
description: Worklete is an advanced technology for frontline teams that reduces injuries, costs and inefficiencies using predictive analytics and smart skill-building. It also provides visibility and connectivity to the frontline workforce.

name: WriteLab
description: WriteLab is a web-based software that gives students immediate feedback on any piece of writing. It blends data-driven analysis with proven pedagogical principles to address many areas in revision, such as clarity, concision, cohesion, and logic.

name: Yobongo
description: Yobongo is a mobile communication startup that enables users to chat based on location, real-time and identity. Yobongo was acquired by Mixbook in 2012.

name: Zing Health
description: Zing Health Choice IL (HMO) is a Medicare Advantage plan serving Medicare-eligible beneficiaries. They take the time to get to know you and partner with you to develop a plan that meets your health needs and goals.

name: Zoobean
description: Zoobean’s SaaS platform, mobile app, and reading logs help organizations and families read more and read together. The company’s Beanstack product is the #1 solution for managing public libraries’ reading challenges and is licensed by over 1,500 schools to motivate students to read independently. For consumers, the Beanstack app is often likened to a Fitbit for Reading.

name: 99 minutos
description: 99 minutos currently operates within 40 major markets across Mexico, Chile, Colombia, and Peru and offers four services: less than minutes delivery, same-day delivery, next-day delivery, and CO2-free delivery.

name: Alice
description: Health tech that makes people's lives healthier through value-based healthcare Alice is Brazil’s first primary care-driven health insurance, offering companies and their employees a new model that enhances health outcomes while optimizing costs. Through an integrated, technology-driven approach, Alice is redefining healthcare with a focus on preventive care and seamless coordination between primary and specialized services. By prioritizing value-based care and aligning incentives with health outcomes, Alice delivers efficient, personalized healthcare solutions. In 2024, Fast Company named Alice the second most innovative company in Latin America.

name: Aplazo
description: Empowering consumers in Latam with simple and financially responsible payment solutions Aplazo is a “buy now pay later” service based in Mexico that allows consumers to live their ideal lifestyle, making it easier to acquire the products they want. Through our platform, consumers can split their online and offline purchases into multiple installments without needing a credit card and avoiding the debt trap.

name: ARQ
description: ARQ is the global financial platform for affluent consumers across the Americas. ARQ opens the world’s strongest assets and markets to travelers, investors and professionals across the Americas—so they can spend, receive, send and grow their money wherever they are.

name: Arvo
description: Driving healthcare’s financial sustainability through accurate, intelligent payments. Arvo is a company specialized in Artificial Intelligence and data integration for healthcare payment processes. By enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of auditing, Arvo helps health insurers prevent fraud, errors, waste, and financial losses. With more than R$130 billion in medical claims processed and AI models achieving over 90% accuracy, Arvo is driving efficiency and trust across Brazil’s private healthcare sector.

name: Ayenda
description: Building the largest and most loved budget hotel chain in the region Ayenda is the fastest growing asset-light hotel chain in Latam. We are redefining the whole hotel experience and creating a recipe for success that hoteliers follow and guests love.

name: Azos
description: Democratizing life insurance to protect Brazilian families Azos is a technology company democratizing life insurance in Brazil and transforming the industry through better products and an outstanding experience. Their technology allows them to reduce inefficiencies that hold back and slow down carriers, to seamlessly adopt a multi-channel distribution model and to have better risk assessment through advanced analytics.

name: Belvo
description: The standard Open Finance API platform for Latin America Belvo allows innovators all over Latam to connect their end users financial information through its Open Finance API. By connecting to Belvo, companies can extract information through its aggregation product, process it thanks to its enrichment solution and move money using its bank to bank payments platform.

name: Bia
description: Bia Energy is a pioneering company at the forefront of the energy industry. Bia seamlessly merges smart metering infrastructure data with energy retailing, offering a customer-centric, data-driven platform that empowers users to take control of their energy consumption and costs. Bia is rapidly becoming the standard in Colombia’s energy sector and beyond, transforming the region’s energy service landscape.

name: Bitso
description: Bitso is Latin America’s leading and most trusted cryptocurrency platform with a community of millions of users. The company offers simple and intuitive crypto products for individuals, traders, and businesses and is one of the few crypto platforms in the world, and the only one in Latam, to be fully regulated. Founded in 2014, Bitso is working to redefine money by making crypto useful.

name: Brandlovrs
description: Empowering every creator to make a living from their passion Brandlovrs offers a pioneering platform that empowers content creators to amplify their earnings and achieve revenue stability with an intuitive digital wallet and comprehensive financial services. Swiftly setting the benchmark in Brazil’s vibrant creator economy, Brandlovrs is redefining the landscape, ensuring every creator has the opportunity to unlock their assets’ full potential.

name: Brinta
description: Brinta revolutionizes tax compliance in Latin America for global companies. Their platform seamlessly manages taxes across 19 countries and 6000+ jurisdictions, offering real-time tax calculations and customizable reports. Brinta enables automatic tax declaration preparation, filing, and issuance of locally-compliant e-invoices via API in milliseconds. This streamlines processes, reduces administrative burden, and ensures compliance. With Brinta, businesses can focus on core activities while efficiently managing taxes across multiple jurisdictions. It optimizes tax management and keeps companies ahead in Latin America’s complex tax landscape.

name: Camino
description: Providing affordable, high-quality, digital education to all learners Camino is tackling the most pressing opportunity in basic education worldwide today: connecting classrooms with the future brought by the Digital Revolution. Through our end-to-end learning digital platform, Cloe, we support public and private schools and teachers across all regions and income segments in Brazil to migrate from print to digital learning, and from passive, content-based learning to active, data-enabled, project-based learning, at affordable prices. Cloe teachers are trained and certified online via a course designed with Columbia University and through weekly instructional sessions led by the teachers of our proprietary trilingual school in São Paulo, Camino School, where we design and apply our unique teaching methodology.

name: Casai
description: The next-generation of hospitality, merging technology, design, and locality. Casai is a CDMX-based hospitality concept with carefully curated travel apartments across Latin America. They create intimate high-end experiences for the nomadic generation, with a personalized 24/7 concierge service and a focus on cultivating a sense of home-away-from-home for their guests. Casai merges the best of luxury and locality by offering apartments in the region’s best neighborhoods and outfitting each space with stunning interior design, artisanal locally-sourced amenities, and the latest smart home technology.

name: Cicada
description: Bringing the last analog giant of financial markets into the digital era Fixed income is the world’s largest financial market — yet much of it still trades over the phone. Cicada brings this legacy market into the digital era with a modern electronic platform that connects banks, investors, and dealers directly. Built for emerging markets, Cicada combines live prices, anonymous execution, and seamless post-trade workflows to make bond trading faster, fairer, and more efficient.

name: Clara
description: The end-to-end corporate spend management platform for businesses in Latin America Clara offers an end-to-end corporate spend management solution for companies throughout Latin America. Clara’s solution includes an easy-to-use corporate credit card, a bill pay product, and a spend management system. This all-in-one spend management solution enables entrepreneurs in the region to grow with agility while maintaining sound visibility and control of their finances.

name: Cobre
description: Treasury management to accelerate money movement for companies in LatAm. Cobre is a corporate treasury platform that allows companies to centralize, digitize, and automate their payment processes.

name: Cometa
description: Maximizing school revenues to increase access to quality education Cometa unlocks schools’ potential and maximizes their revenues by optimizing payment collections and automating revenue operations. Their vertical infrastructure enables schools to not only survive, but thrive, in Latin America by helping them collect tuition more efficiently, attract and retain students, and build new revenue streams.

name: Comp
description: Reducing guesswork behind every compensation decision Comp hosts the largest and most updated total rewards database in Latin America & offers easy-to-use SaaS tooling to manage compensation internally.

name: Compara

It offers a platform where users can easily relate to the different options for Auto Insurance, Travel Assistance, Consumer Credit and other financial products. ComparaOnline offers possibilities for everyone with accurate information so that they can understand the main value proposals and thereby hire or request 100% online.

name: Contabilizei
description: Contabilizei is the largest accounting firm in Brazil and a pioneer in digitizing accounting processes Contabilizei is the largest accounting firm in Brazil and a pioneer in digitizing accounting processes. Offering a more practicality and better service for SMEs, the company makes use of technology to automate processes and routines ensuring the regularity of businesses, in addition to generating up to 90% of monthly savings for small and medium business. Contabilizei tens of thousands of customers spread over 50 cities in Brazil.

name: Cora
description: Cora is a complete digital account created to eliminate bureaucracies, reduce costs with bank taxes and simplify financial management of small business. Made from entrepreneurs to entrepreneurs, Cora’s purpose is to make accounting routine easier and to contribute toward small business growth. In order to do so, Cora has built a modern and intuitive platform with powerful features that are capable of reducing the amount of repetitive work related to resources management.

name: Covalto
description: Covalto is a leading digital banking and services platform for SMEs in Mexico. The company provides a one-stop solution by bringing together a multi-product credit offering, banking services, and a full suite of business analytics tools.

name: Crabi
description: Making insurance effortless and accessible for millions in LATAM Crabi is a full stack, digital car insurance company, initially operating in Mexico.

name: Crack The Code
description: Crack The Code is preparing Latin American K-12 students with the skills they need to be globally competitive. We provide live-online computer science classes to students aged 5 through 19 in over 22 countries globally. Our classes are engaging and dynamic and incentivize students to continue learning and exploring STEM fields. We are on a mission to transform K-12 education by rethinking what needs to be taught to kids.

name: Creditas
description: Changing the credit market to help people achieve their goals. Creditas is the leading 100% digital lending and consumer solutions platform in Latin America built around three ecosystems: real estate, automotive and employee salaries and benefits. We are actively changing the credit market in Brazil and Mexico through our user experience and proprietary technology built to help customers achieve their goals. The company’s collateralized lending portfolio integrates home equity loans, auto equity loans and payroll-deducted personal loans to create access to otherwise out of reach products and services with integrated financing and refinancing options. Founded in 2012, employs 1900 Crew Members and has offices in São Paulo, Porto Alegre, Recife, Valencia (Spain) and Mexico City.

name: Cuenca
description: Cuenca is a FinTech company that offers fast, reliable, convenient and safe digital financial services for everyone in Mexico; we provide the best user experience sending and receiving money, as well as paying different services, in real time, through our App and a physical card. Cuenca was founded in March of 2018, to provide a financial solution based on trust, innovation and inclusion.

name: CXC
description: The leading private credit platform in Latin America. CXC serves as the backbone of private credit operations in Latin America, revolutionizing the industry with its proprietary end-to-end platform that integrates APIs and AI capabilities to enhance certainty and transparency in private credit transactions.

name: Digital House
description: Digital House is the coding school that teaches technology skills to new generations of coders and digital professionals. Their goal is to generate a community of IT talents that can quickly acquire a job, or develop their own projects and ideas. Digital House biggest commitment is to train talent to close the digital industry gap.

name: Dr. Consulta

Sports fans can easily place bets on their favorite teams, players, and matches while enjoying an engaging live experience that brings the action closer than ever. Powered by cutting-edge technology, an intuitive user-friendly interface, and personalized experience, Draftea maximizes the excitement of sports by offering users the chance to turn their passion into profit.

name: Eden
description: Creating exceptional software to enable outstanding healthcare for all Eden is revolutionizing medical attention through cloud-based platforms for end-to-end radiology operations. By developing a streamlined digital ecosystem with access to advanced diagnostic tools and the power of Artificial Intelligence, the company has increased radiologist productivity and now processes over 400 million medical images annually.

description: The missing piece in DeFi credit is now going mainstream Exactly is a decentralized, non-custodial, open-source protocol that enables anyone to earn interest or borrow crypto at fixed and variable rates, directly from their wallet, with full transparency and without intermediaries.

description: Gringo is an online platform that helps drivers monitor their vehicles and licenses by leveraging technology and data to transform the painful and bureaucratic processes into a simple and delightful experience. Gringo provides drivers a reliable and trustworthy concierge service that helps people to make better decisions in a simple way, while saving time and money.

description: Grão Direto is the largest digital grain trading platform in Latin America, connecting farmers, feed mills, cooperatives, intermediaries, and major trading companies. With a rapidly growing transaction volume and the most widely used trading app worldwide, the company is at the forefront of market digitalization in agriculture. Operating in a neutral, open, and independent manner, Grão Direto enhances efficiency and security in spot, futures, and barter transactions. The platform also offers market intelligence, financial services, and ESG solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools—including its proprietary AI. Recognized globally, Grão Direto is transforming agricultural trade by making it more connected, agile, and transparent.

name: Guiabolso
description: Open Banking pioneer transforming the Brazilian financial system Guiabolso is the fintech transforming the Brazilian financial system by pioneering Open Banking, to bring the benefits of open data access and analytics to millions of consumers and a fast-growing number of corporate customers.

name: Guiche Virtual
description: Connecting passengers to bus companies for the best travel experience Guichê Virtual is the leader on bus travel online sales in Brazil. Created in 2013, its mission is to connect passengers with bus companies through its own marketplace. The company is revolutionizing the way people travel, making possible for customers to find travel destinations effortlessly, while bus companies can connect with them online.

Our mission is to allow people to have the freedom to work doing what they love, creating an audience and earning a living by sharing their talent and expertise with the world.

description: Empowering deskless workers with an AI-powered, mobile-first HR app. Humand is the complete employee app that connects and unifies the entire company on an intuitive, accessible, AI-powered, mobile-first platform. It provides a private digital community that centralizes internal communication, organizational culture, operations, and HR management through more than 30 integrated modules. description: Unlocking the potential of B2B commerce in LatAm through digital payments The first B2B checkout platform in LatAm built for online businesses selling to businesses. name: Kanastra
description: Enabling private credit originators and investors to thrive Kanastra builds the world’s best fintech infrastructure for private credit funds and securitizations, based in Brazil.

description: Kavak is the #1 player in Latam’s pre-owned car industry, with a presence in Mexico, Argentina, and Brazil. The company has tens of showrooms and inspection hubs in 7 cities, as well as thousands of cars in inventory at any given time. It also offers financial services in-house. With very strong operational and tech capabilities, Kavak offers a highly integrated pre and post-sale omnichannel experience. Putting the most advanced technology in their customers’ hands, Kavak has already helped thousands of people find their dream car.

By connecting to Kushki, companies gain access to expert advice and support from a dedicated team of payment specialists. Kushki has been a key player in the development of new regulations in different countries, aiming to standardize online payments in Latam and improving the region’s economy.

name: LaHaus
description: La Haus is a real estate market network that standardizes and facilitates home buying and selling in Latin America. The Latin American housing market is a mess. Our digital products and data solutions are rebuilding it from the ground up.

name: Legiti

Fraud and conversion are two sides of the same coin, and Legiti’s data-intensive solution uses machine learning models to eliminate fraud threats and allow e-commerces to focus on their bottom line. Legiti’s strength lies in its ability to analyze and authorize legitimate purchases that would be otherwise blocked by simplistic and less precise antifraud systems.

name: Lemon Energy
description: Catalyzing clean energy in Brazil through technology. Lemon connects retail power consumers with clean energy generators. Remote plants pump clean energy into the grid, generating a supply of credits to consumers to cover their power demand. Small and medium-sized businesses save on their bills, have a vastly improved digital customer experience, and access to clean energy without installation or upfront investment. On the other side, decentralized generators can up to double their earnings by accessing the retail market, while Lemon handles all the billing, collection, and energy management duties.

name: LivUp

Combining technology, accessible prices and an excellent relationship with the providers, local farmers and small organic producers, we offer an exceptional gastronomic experiences.

name: Loggi

Loggi is unlocking the growth of the on-demand economy, supporting new commerce for Brazil’s large, young, urban population.

name: Melvi

In just a few clicks, the platform provides popular and premium options in an extensive catalog of consultations, therapies, procedures, and exams.

name: Minka
