name: Abselion
description: Abselion is an analytical tool developer commercialising a hardware system and consumable sensor chip component that together enable the Simple, rapid, low cost acquisition of ELISA data. The intent is to enable any scientist or technician with minimal training to get ELISA data in 1min/sample (1-100 samples) at-line from this accessible benchtop system. The platform uses electrochemical sensing of the free electrons in the ELISA TMB-HRP reaction, providing a highly sensitive, rapid & robust result. With broad applicability across life science research and bioprocessing, the initial focus is on applications where providing quick and accurate titre and purity info at the point of process can be disruptive to current workflows. Abselion is headquartered in Cambridge, UK and backed by a top-tier life science investor syndicate.

name: Actithera
description: Actithera is discovering and developing novel Radiotherapeutics for the treatment of cancer. Actithera’s technology is based on unique medicinal chemistry approaches promising to deliver Radiotherapeutics with with significant differentiation and larger therapeutic windows . Current pipeline includes differentiated best- and first-in-class small molecule and peptide based programs targeting various solid tumors. Company was incepted by M Ventures and Arkin Bio-Holdings in 2020.

name: Akili
description: Akili is building clinically-validated cognitive therapeutics, assessments, and diagnostics that look and feel like high-quality video games. Their aim is to develop a new type of Digital Medicine that can be deployed remotely directly to any patient anywhere, prescribed and tracked by physicians. Akili functions on the premise that advances in neuroscience research and consumer-facing technology are enabling a new way to sensitively measure neural function, and intervene in any measured deficits, wherever the patient may be. Akili's products address both quantitative measurement of and intensive intervention in cognitive functions in a variety of patient populations. Akili was co-founded by PureTech, leading cognitive neuroscientists, and top-tier entertainment software creators.

name: Altoida
description: Altoida, Inc is creating a new gold standard in brain health with Precision Neurology. Their innovative approach combines novel digital biomarkers (dBM) with immersive augmented reality (AR) and powerful artificial intelligence (AI). The result is a validated device and platform built on more than twenty years of cutting-edge scientific research. Altoida’s products are backed by peer-reviewed publications and multinational clinical trials, and are built by their expert team of scientists, clinicians and engineers.

name: Ambrx
description: Ambrx advanced protein biosynthesis, enabling the company to genetically engineer proteins with new amino acid building blocks beyond the existing 20 natural amino acids, enabling the biosynthesis of proteins with new physical, chemical and pharmacological properties.

name: Anavo
description: Anavo’s mission is to pioneer systematic drug discovery and development approaches aimed at phosphatases, a rich and largely untapped therapeutic target class. The company has world-leading scientific expertise in phosphatase-driven disease biology and drug discovery to unlock the full potential of phosphatase-targeted allosteric modulators. In oncology, Anavo is developing multiple first-in-class therapeutic programs and will build on partnerships around its platform to establish a rich pipeline across several indications. Anavo is backed by blue-chip investors M Ventures, INKEF Capital, Taiho Ventures and Bioqube Ventures.

name: Anjuna Security
description: With the advancement of AI and data collaboration, protecting privacy and sensitive information has become a top business priority. Confidential Computing offers an effective solution to prevent data breaches and unauthorized access, particularly in multi-tenant cloud environments. This technology is rapidly gaining traction, with major cloud providers and tech companies adopting it to enhance security, build user trust, and enable secure multi-party data analytics use cases. Palo Alto-based Anjuna Security, founded in 2018, is led by a team with decades of senior-level experience in security, cloud, and cryptography businesses. Anjuna's flagship product, Anjuna Seaglass, is a cloud- and application-agnostic platform designed to isolate workloads in a hardware-assisted Zero Trust environment for both code and data. This facilitates enterprise-grade deployment of Confidential Computing and precise control over application-level trust policies. Anjuna has successfully supported customers in the Healthcare, Government, and Financial Services sectors with their cloud migration, secure data collaboration, and secure AI use cases. Recently, Anjuna partnered with NVIDIA to deploy LLM models on NVIDIA H100 GPUs for the U.S. Navy. Anjuna's investors include Insight Partners, Playground Global, SineWave Ventures, AI Capital Partners, and Y Combinator.

name: Artios
description: Artios is on a mission to kill cancer by exploiting DNA damage repair (DDR) responses that are leveraged by cancer cells to promote their survival. The DcoDeR platform integrates Artios’ leadership capabilities, expertise and experience in DNA damage biology and drug discovery to systematically discover and develop medicines targeting the totality of the DDR. Artios pipeline is designed to address areas of high unmet needs across solid tumour indications including ATR inhibitor and Polθ inhibitor as a monotherapy and with combination treatments. Together with their world-class strategic partnerships with Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany and Novartis, and research collaborations with premiere institutions like Cancer Research UK, The Institute of Cancer Research, The Netherlands Cancer Institute, and the Crick Institute, Artios is pioneering validated approaches to DDR drug discovery.

name: Asceneuron
description: Asceneuron is a clinical stage biotech company focused on the development of orally bioavailable therapeutics for debilitating neurodegenerative disorders with high unmet medical need. The pipeline reflects its ambition to develop treatments for a wide a range of neurodegenerative diseases including orphan tauopathies, Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease. Asceneuron has two clinical stage small molecule O-GlcNAcase inhibitors in development for the treatment of proteinopathies including one first in class for Parkinson’s disease, one best in class in Alzheimer’s disease and related disorders.

name: Astraveus
description: Astraveus is developing the next generation of cell and gene therapy (CGT) manufacturing solutions. Astraveus’ cell foundries miniaturize and automate cell and gene therapy manufacturing in a unique, modular, end-to-end, microfluidic solution that mimics the elegance of natural systems. The deep process optimization of the platform enables greater precision and therefore easier replication of optimal manufacturing, delivering better therapies in a more cost- and time-efficient manner, using fewer materials and with reduced environmental impact. With the full potential of cell and gene therapies restricted today by high costs and limited throughput, this transformative solution has the potential to enable a therapeutic revolution at scale, helping to make these lifesaving therapies accessible to the many thousands of patients around the world that need them.

name: beeOLED
description: beeOLED was founded in 2020 by OLED industry veterans Dr. Carsten Rothe (CTO, ex Novaled, Idemitsu) and Dr. Volodymyr Senkovskyy (COO, ex Novaled) with the goal to solve the last big challenge of OLED displays. Led by serial entrepreneur and Novaled co-founder Jan Blochwitz-Nimoth, the deep tech start-up develops an efficient & stable deep-blue emitter to improve displays in phones, tablets, laptops, TVs and other displays. Its technology is based on making elementary emission from atoms fit for use in today’s vacuum processed OLED displays. The company’s investors include ecapital, Innovation Industries, KBC Focus Fund, High-Tech Gründerfonds, TGFS, and Jan Blochwitz-Nimoth himself.

name: Biolinq
description: Biolinq is a medtech company developing novel intradermal sensing technologies designed to measure biomarkers important to the management of many clinical conditions, starting with diabetes and metabolic health. Biolinq’s patented technologies include a wearable sensor that uses an array of microneedles to measure glucose levels from the intradermal space just beneath the surface of the skin, and an integrated user interface that provides real-time feedback Biolinq was founded in 2012 and is located in San Diego.

name: Calypso Biotech
description: Calypso Biotech BV is a spin-off of the healthcare business of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany and develops novel biologics to address unmet medical needs in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, with unique expertise in IL-15 biology. IL-15 controls immune pathways critically involved in disease onset, maintenance and tissue destruction and has a broad effect on inflammation. Calypso’s approach could provide for unprecedented long-lasting disease-modifying effects in autoimmune diseases. Its best-in-class anti-IL-15 monoclonal antibody is currently in Phase I clinical trials for Refractory Celiac Disease and orphan indication Eosinophilic Esophagitis, with additional indications being explored preclinically. Calypso is backed by investors M Ventures, JJDC, Gilde Healthcare, INKEF and Fountain Healthcare Partners and is headquartered in Amsterdam, The Netherlands, with offices and labs in Geneva, Switzerland.

name: Celestial AI
description: Celestial AI was founded in 2020 by semiconductor industry veterans Dave Lazovsky, founder and CEO of Intermolecular, Inc. (NASDAQ: IMI) and Preet Virk (Macom, Mindspeed Technologies) who realized early on that artificial intelligence (AI) and machine-learning workloads would quickly become a data movement problem rather than a compute-limited problem for data centers. To solve this issue, Celestial’s CTO Phil Winterbottom (ex-Bell Labs, co-founded Entrisphere, Gainspeed) developed “Photonic Fabric”, an advanced optical interconnect technology designed to meet the growing demand for larger bandwidths in data centers. Unlike other photonic solutions, it delivers data directly to the point of compute on the silicon, offering >1.5 Tbit/s/mm2 package bandwidth (25X greater than CPO) and 10X lower latency. With high reach, protocol adaptability, and compatibility with standard interfaces, it outperforms electrical interconnects, enabling the connection and disaggregation of more servers while supporting latency-sensitive applications with remote memory usage. Additionally, its integration with high thermal design power ASICs sets it apart from traditional CPO technology. The company’s investors include Koch Disruptive Technologies, Xora Innovation, the early stage investment vehicle of Temasek, IAG Capital Partners, The Engine, Samsung Catalyst, Porsche SE, IMEC.xpand and others.

name: CellFE
description: CellFE is an innovative microfluidics company, whose mission is to transform the development and manufacturing of lifesaving cell therapies to make them more accessible to patients. The company uses a microfluidic-based cell engineering platform with highest cell health and payload delivery, streamlined scalability and automated workflows. Platform benefits include increased cell yield and reduced expansion times that translate to drastically reduced vein-to-vein times and manufacturing costs currently associated with advanced cell therapies. CellFE is committed to enabling their partners success through close collaborations that aim to solve the challenges associated with the development and manufacturing of next generation cell therapies.

name: ChEmpower
description: ChEmpower addresses a critical bottleneck in semiconductor manufacturing. As device scaling continues, conventional Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) struggles with defectivity and process limitations, constraining yield and cost efficiency. ChEmpower’s abrasive-free CMP technology offers a superior solution, reducing surface defects, improving etch rates, and enabling advanced process nodes, substrates and hybrid bonding. ChEmpower was founded in 2019 and is located in Beaverton, Oregon.

name: Concerto Biosciences
description: Concerto examines microbial interactions with unmatched experimental depth to discover breakthrough microbe-based products. Their foundational platform, kChip, was invented by the cofounders while at MIT and the Broad Institute and is a discovery engine that physically constructs millions of miniature, defined microbial communities simultaneously. By observing the behavior of each community, Concerto can rapidly identify the most promising microbes, prebiotics, and postbiotics for development into new products. In partnership with a diverse array of biotech and pharma companies, Concerto aims to unleash a new era of microbial research and microbe-based products.

name: Corvic AI
description: With the growing complexity of industrial data, efficiently processing and analyzing multistructural information has become a critical challenge. Emerging Generative AI (GenAI), particularly advanced Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, offers powerful solutions for handling diverse data types and modalities, enabling context-aware insights. Major industries are rapidly adopting this technology to enhance decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and unlock the full potential of their complex data landscapes. Founded in 2023 in Mountain View, Corvic is led by a team with extensive industrial experience in AI, machine learning, and data infrastructure. Corvic's flagship product is an end-to-end GenAI embedding management platform featuring a multi-space orchestrator that intelligently navigates multiple embedding spaces to derive insights and answer queries. This enables enterprise-grade deployment of advanced RAG technology and precise handling of complex, heterogeneous data. Corvic has successfully supported customers in the Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, and Advanced Manufacturing sectors across use cases in AI-driven knowledge management, manufacturing analytics, root cause analysis, and drug discovery. Recently, Corvic partnered with Bosch and was awarded the company's 2024 Open Bosch Award. Corvic's investors include Brian Long (Atlantic Bridge), Foothill Ventures, Bosch Ventures, and LAM Research Capital.

name: Cyllene Therapeutics
description: Cyllene Therapeutics is developing next-generation precision genetic medicines for prevalent chronic diseases using its proprietary non-replicative Herpes Simplex Virus 1 (nrHSV-1) HERMES platform, which enables safe, targeted, and durable transgene expression in peripheral neurons. The company's initial focus is on underserved bladder and neuro-urology disorders with high unmet medical need, with its lead programme EG110A currently in clinical development as the first non-replicative herpes vector-based genetic medicine evaluated in humans. Cyllene Therapeutics is headquartered in Paris, France, and is backed by an experienced investor syndicate including Andera Partners, Bpifrance, SCI, GordonMD, among others.

name: DISCO Pharmaceuticals
description: DISCO employs a disruptive proteomics technology to map the surfaceome of cancer cells and develop first-in-class cancer drugs. With the advent of new cell-surface, target-directed therapeutic modalities, it is critical to ramp up the discovery of meaningful targets. DISCO does so by comprehensively identifying druggable targets and protein communities (i.e., different proteins that form nanoscale organizations on a cell), across the entire cancer cell surface at scale, thus uncovering crucial new information that neither genome nor transcriptome sequencing can provide. By knowing which proteins are truly present on the cell surface, and how they are associated within protein communities, DISCO can design highly specific binders, boosting expected efficacy and reducing side effects. DISCO is backed by world leading life sciences investors including M Ventures, Sofinnova Partners, Panakes Partners and AbbVie Ventures.

name: DNA SCRIPT
description: DNA Script is a pioneering life sciences technology company developing a new, faster, more powerful, and versatile way to design and manufacture nucleic acids. The company has developed an alternative to traditional chemical DNA synthesis called Enzymatic DNA Synthesis, or EDS, enabling this technology to be accessible to labs with the first benchtop enzymatic synthesis instrument, the SYNTAX System. By putting DNA synthesis back in the lab, DNA Script aims to transform life sciences research through innovative technology that gives researchers unprecedented control and autonomy. The Company’s technology has the potential to greatly accelerate the development of new therapeutics, sustainable chemicals production, improved crops as well as data storage.

name: Electroninks
description: Electroninks has commercialized particle-free metal complex conductive inks for applications in semiconductor packaging, printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing, consumer electronics, wearables, medical devices and more. Electroninks works with world-class partners (including Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany), customers and OEMs to integrate conductive inks into high-volume manufacturing of electronic components.

name: Enara Bio
description: Enara Bio has developed an innovative immunopeptidomics and bioinformatics platform for the discovery of a novel and differentiated class of cancer-specific targets from the genomic dark matter, coined ‘Dark Antigens’. Dark Antigens are presented across solid tumor types, shared across patients, immunogenic and homogenously expressed within tumors. Enara Bio is developing an internal pipeline of TCR-directed immunotherapies targeting Dark Antigens with a proprietary format and working with big pharma through partnerships.

name: EpiTherapeutics
description: EpiTherapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company developing novel innovative cancer drugs based on the world leading research in the field of epigenetics. EpiTherapeutics' development programs are focused on enzymes involved in the regulation of transcription in cancer - current programs target histone demethylases and methyltransferases. EpiTherapeutics is based in Denmark.

name: F-Star Therapeutics
description: F-star is a clinical stage biotech developing next generation immunotherapies and working towards a future free from cancer and other serious diseases.

name: Ferroelectric Memory GmbH
description: FMC was founded in 2016 to commercialize a revolutionary memory chip technology based on hafnium oxide. The company has developed a new class of memory cells with its DRAM+ chip, which are more sustainable, faster, and more cost-effective. Thanks to its low power consumption, the technology significantly reduces the energy demand of AI data centers.

name: Forendo Pharma
description: Forendo is pioneering the translation of intracrinology science into first-in-class therapeutic solutions in endometriosis and PCOS.

name: Formo
description: Formo harnesses the power of precision fermentation to create the next generation of sustainable and indulgent animal-free products. Founded in 2019 by Raffael Wohlgensinger, the company is combining synthetic biology, advanced food science and state of the art product design to develop the holy grail of the animal-free food universe: cheese and egg products that are indistinguishable from the conventional benchmark product. Formo is the first precision fermentation company ever to launch products in the European market in 2023. Having been incubated by Atlantic food labs in Berlin, the company is backed by some of the most renowned investors across food (FoodLabs, CPT, Agronomics, Happiness Capital), deep tech (EQT Ventures, M Ventures, Elevat3 Capital, Grazia Equity) and climate (Lowercarbon Capital, Lionheart Ventures).

name: FoRx Therapeutics
description: FoRx Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing a new generation of first-in-class oral small molecule cancer drugs focusing on novel DNA Replication Stress pathways activated in cancer. Drawing on discoveries by Prof. Thanos Halazonetis and Dr. Sotirios Sotiriou, FoRx was co-founded in 2019 with M Ventures, Novartis Venture Fund and Omega Funds along with Pfizer Ventures, the venture capital arm of Pfizer Inc. (NYSE: PFE) and EQT LS.

name: Future Fertility
description: Future Fertility was founded in 2017, based on the scientific founder Dr. Dan Nayot's expertise and desire to make informed clinical decision-making during fertility care a reality. Future Fertility is a fertility technology company focused on AI-enabled and non-invasive diagnostic solutions to optimize decision making throughout the IVF journey, maximizing probability of positive outcomes in IVF workflows. The first product is an egg assessment software, which uniquely provides insights in egg quality and has the potential to improve success rates of IVF, egg freezing and egg donation cycles.

name: Galecto Biotech
description: Galecto is a clinical stage biotechnology company committed to the development of novel small molecule therapeutics directed at biological targets which are at the heart of fibrosis, inflammation, and cancer. Galecto was founded by leading fibrosis-focused scientists and biotech executives and is built on more than 10 years of research into galectin and fibrosis modulators. Our team has developed a deep understanding of the galectin family of proteins and the LOXL2 enzyme, and how both influence multiple biological pathways of these complex, often devastating, diseases.

name: Genopore
description: Genopore, founded in 2023, is focused on developing nanopore chip technology, to identify and quantify proteins in High Throughput. Company is a spin-off from the Israeli Technion, from the lab of Prof. Amit Meller, a world leader in the field of nanopore technologies for life sciences applications.

name: IKAS
description: IKAS offers smart manufacturing solutions for the semiconductor and optoelectronics industry. IKAS’ solutions guarantee factory wide data collection, asset monitoring, data mining, process optimization, defect analysis, and production dispatching, hence enabling real time and efficient end to end decision making.

name: Iktos
description: Iktos develops artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the drug discovery and new drug design. Iktos’ proprietary and innovative technology is based on generative deep learning models, which allow, from existing data, to design optimized molecules in silico to meet all the success criteria of a small molecule discovery. Iktos is the only company to offer generative modeling with built-in synthetic accessibility for successful drug discovery and has already validated its technology through more than 50 collaborations with pharmaceutical and biotech companies such as Chiesi Group, Galapagos, Janssen, Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, Teijin, Ono Pharmaceuticals, Pfizer, Servier, UCB, etc.

name: ImmuneBridge
description: ImmuneBridge is developing the next generation of allogeneic cellular medicines, starting with NK cell-based immunotherapies. ImmuneBridge’s proprietary expansion technology amplifies cord blood-derived immune stem cells while maintaining full immune multipotency—to create a consistent and abundant cellular source for immunotherapies. Based in San Francisco, ImmuneBridge is led by Nina Horowitz, CEO and Rui Tostoes, CTO and backed my M Ventures, Insight Partners, NFX, One Way Ventures, LongGame, T.Rx Capital and others.

name: Immunitas
description: Immunitas is a clinical stage precision immunotherapy company committed to discovering and developing novel, differentiated treatments for patients with cancer. A focus on human data, combined with fully integrated internal R&D capabilities and parallel discovery efforts, allows Immunitas to start with and stay closer to the most relevant and translatable biology for patients, accelerating the timeline from discovery to the clinic. The Immunitas discovery engine combines deep expertise in single-cell genomics with customized machine learning approaches to elucidate immune cell populations that are key actors in immuno-oncology. The company was founded by Longwood Fund with leading scientists from Dana-Farber, MGH, the Broad, and MIT. Since being founded in 2019, Immunitas has raised a total of $97 million in venture funding from a strong syndicate of investors including Agent Capital, Alexandria Venture Investments, Evotec, Leaps by Bayer, Longwood Fund, M Ventures, Medical Excellence Capital, and Novartis Venture Fund.

name: Immunorizon
description: Immunorizon is developing conditionally activated Tumor-Restricted T-and NK-Cell Engagers for cancer therapy. The company extends its pipeline and differentiate by using tri-specific constructs with additional tumor associated antigens and diverse engagers with both T-cells and NK-cells.

name: iOmx Therapeutics
description: iOmx Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing first-in-class cancer immunotherapies addressing novel immune checkpoints hijacked by cancer cells. Utilizing its iOTarg™ high-throughput screening platform, iOmx has identified a number of proprietary tumor-associated next-generation immune checkpoints and is advancing a preclinical stage pipeline of promising drug candidates that have the potential to address cancers that are resistant to current immunotherapies. The company’s lead program IMT-07 targets SIK3, an immune protective kinase in multiple solid tumors; the IMT-18 program is a first-in-class antibody designed to inhibit IGSF11, an immune checkpoint in PD1/PD-L1-resistant tumors. Founded in 2016 based on the work of its scientific founders Philipp Beckhove, MD, and Nisit Khandelwal, Ph.D., conducted at the German Cancer Research Center, iOmx is backed by international venture capital investors, such as Wellington Partners, Sofinnova Partners and M Ventures as well as MIG Capital and Athos Service. iOmx is based in Martinsried/Munich, Germany.

name: iOnctura
description: iOnctura is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focusing on novel therapeutics to treat tumors burdened by stroma and immune mediated resistance. Company’s pipeline consists of two clinical stage small molecule programs against PI3kd and ATX and multiple preclinical programs. iOnctura is supported by a world renowned scientific advisory board and, with its access to CRT’s drug discovery labs and network of academic collaborators, is well-positioned to rapidly establish novel combination therapies in the field of cancer immunology. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, iOnctura was founded by M Ventures in June 2017.

name: IonKraft
description: IonKraft develops innovative plasma-based barrier coatings that can replace non-recyclable barrier solutions and enable a fully circular economy in the packaging industry. Their novel high-barrier technology can be applied to mono-material plastics and renders containers both chemically resistant and fully recyclable, with a barrier effect comparable to that of glass. Their technology enables packaging producers to replace millions of tons of non-recyclable multilayer or fluorinated (PFAS) packaging with a fully recyclable solution. Furthermore, the barrier technology can provide sufficient protection to allow the incorporation of recycled materials into packaging for sensitive, food, or cosmetics products.

name: Kivu Bioscience
description: Kivu Bioscience is pioneering next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) in oncology. The company’s proprietary linker-payload technology delivers enhanced safety and efficacy, minimizing off-target effects to improve patient outcomes. With multiple ADC programs in development and a team of industry veterans, Kivu is advancing its first two lead candidates to clinical trials expected to begin in 2025. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. For more information, visit www.kivubioscience.com.

name: LabGenius
description: LabGenius Therapeutics ("LabGenius") is a drug discovery company pioneering the discovery of next-generation therapeutic antibodies. The company’s discovery platform, EVA™, integrates several cutting-edge technologies drawn from the fields of artificial intelligence, robotic automation and synthetic biology. While EVA™ is both modality and format-agnostic, LabGenius' internal pipeline is focussed on the development of selectivity-enhanced antibodies for the treatment of solid tumours. The company's novel approach is delivering a pipeline of antibody therapeutics with best-in-class killing profiles.

name: Lightcast
description: Lightcast Discovery aims to unleash new capabilities within the single-cell analysis field by developing a more accessible, scalable, and flexible platform for scientists in basic, translational, and applied research. These capabilities will empower new biological discoveries and accelerate the development of novel drugs, therapies, and biologics. Founded in 2019 and based in Cambridge, UK, Lightcast has invented a technology that uses light to control picolitre-scale droplets for functional analysis of individual cells, which can then be moved to other platforms for further interrogation.

name: Lucidean
description: Lucidean

name: Lumiode
description: Lumiode is a New York City-based semiconductor technology company specializing in high-brightness microLED microdisplays. In contrast to existing display technologies, Lumiode’s microdisplays provide the ultra-high brightness, high resolution and efficiency needed for untethered consumer and enterprise augmented reality devices. Lumiode offers a fully-integrated wafer-level manufacturing process that will ultimately enable the low-cost production for large-scale consumer and industrial applications.

name: Medisafe
description: Medisafe is the personalized medication management platform addressing all major causes of non-adherence. Medisafe’s cloud-based mobile platform personalizes content, resources and interventions — such as educational videos, coupons and motivational messages — based on each user's regimen, condition and specific circumstance. Medisafe fosters collaboration between patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals through caregiver tools and reports, and helps the care continuum improve health outcomes and sustain quality care initiatives.

name: MemryX
description: MemryX Inc. is a fabless semiconductor company that designs edge AI processing solutions powered by a proprietary compute-at-memory technology and dataflow architecture. By combining high performance and accuracy with low system power and a high-performance architecture, MemryX solutions are able to power AI needs in a wide range of industrial and consumer applications. MemryX’s Edge AI solution enables 1-click compilation and performance optimization of trained AI models without accuracy drop. No hand-tuning or model retraining is required. MemryX has headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, with offices in Bangalore, India, Taipei and Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Metalenz
description: Metalenz is a fabless semiconductor optics company on a mission to revolutionize optical sensing and empower billions of devices with new information. Metalenz is using metasurface technology built on foundational research from the Capasso Lab at Harvard University. Marking the beginning of this revolutionary optical technology in real-world devices, Metalenz launched meta-optics into consumer devices for the first time in 2022 in a range of consumer devices through its partnership with global semiconductor manufacturing leader STMicroelectronics. Metalenz is headquartered in Boston, MA.

name: Mosa Meat
description: Mosa Meat is set on the mission to create an affordable, reliable, and secure supply of meat products without slaughtering livestock. Mosa Meat’s technology development centers around widely deployed bioengineering techniques to develop an end-to-end industrial process for cultured meat production. Mosa Meat is focused, initially on developing nutricous and tasty cultured beef products with a commercially viable cost structure. Mosa Meat was co-founded in 2016 as a spin-off company from Maastricht University by Peter Verstrate and Prof. Mark Post, who in 2013 presented and cooked the world’s first cultured beef burger in London.

name: Multitude
description: Multitude is a clinical-stage ADC-focused platform company founded by successful serial entrepreneurs. Multitude's competitive advantage in developing industry leading ADCs is based on two proprietary platform technologies: MabArrayTM , an antibody platform for discovering novel cell surface tumor targets to build first-in-class ADCs, and T1000, a novel linker/payload technology for developing ADCs with a highly favorable balance of bystander effect, potency, and toxicity. The powerful synergy derived from combining MabArrayTM and T1000 enables Multitude to build an atlas of ADCs that has the potential to treat malignancies with high unmet needs and achieve higher and more durable responses. Multitude based in Shanghai and is backed by prominent investors including Northern Light Venture Capital, Co-win Ventures, Loyal Valley Capital, and M Ventures

name: NanoSyrinx
description: NanoSyrinx is an emerging biotechnology company developing a novel cell engineering system for targeted delivery of therapeutic proteins and peptides direct to the cytosol. NanoSyrinx was co-founded in 2020 by Dr. Healey, Dr. Waterfield and Dr. Hapeshi to commercialise the team’s research at the University of Warwick’s Medical School.

name: NeoLogic
description: NeoLogic is powering the next-generation processors by breaking the limits of the CMOS design paradigm that dominated VLSI design since the 1970s. The company’s patent-pending (Quasi-CMOS) technology cuts down the transistors count of digital cores by up to 3x at any technology node. Its design results in up to 50% reduction of power dissipation as well as up to 40% area saving thereby delivering up to 3X performance-per-watt superiority for any design at any technology node. NeoLogic was founded in 2021 by Dr. Avi Messica as CEO and Ziv Leshem as CTO and is backed by leading venture capital funds like Maniv Mobility, lool Ventures, and M Ventures, as well as the Israeli Innovation Authority.

name: Neurable
description: Neurable’s mission is to make neurotechnology easily accessible to everyone, everywhere. Based on a proprietary signal processing algorithm, Neurable’s Brain OS enables everyday devices to incorporate high performance brain-computer interfaces into consumer-level devices. As a spin-out from University of Michigan, Neurable is backed by 10 years of academic research. Neurable was founded in 2016 and is based in Boston, MA.

name: Nouscom
description: Nouscom's proprietary immmunotherapy platforms utilize a portfolio of uniquely engineered viral vectors of long strings of tumor neoantigens and comprise a powerful toolkit for the induction of broad and potent anti-tumor T cell responses. The Company's deep knowledge of vaccine manufacturing, and the platform’s capacity to reliably encode unprecedented numbers of neoantigens is combined with proprietary approaches to neoantigen identification. Nouscom's mission is to generate safe, innovative, and potent next-generation cancer immunotherapies that selectively eliminate tumor cells. Their published pre-clinical and clinical data indicate that the approach is able to induce strong immune responses with potential to expand the applicability and efficacy of existing immunotherapies while delivering high levels of safety and tolerability.

name: NovoLINC
description: NovoLINC was co-founded by Dr. Ning Li, Prof. Sheng Shen, and Dr. Rui Cheng. The team recognized early on that the ever-increasing performance and power requirements of electronic chipsets were leading to enormous heat generation. Advancements in thermal interface solutions had not kept pace, making thermal management a critical bottleneck in efficient cooling and effective heat dissipation, especially as AI datacenters transition to liquid cooling. To address this issue, NovoLINC's CTO Dr. Rui Cheng developed a breakthrough nanostructured composite thermal interface material at Carnegie Mellon University that significantly advances thermal performance beyond traditional materials. Their solution reduces thermal resistance to an industry-record low (<1 mm²·K/W), offering outstanding thermal performance and reliability for cooling high-power electronics such as CPUs and GPUs. With its unique design, it enables sustainable scaling of semiconductor and data center industries. The company's investors include M Ventures, Foothill Ventures, and TDK Ventures.

name: NRG Therapeutics
description: NRG Therapeutics is developing first-in-class, oral, small molecule neuroprotective therapeutics targeting mitochondrial dysfunction and neuroinflammation for treatment of neurodegenerative and peripheral diseases. Its lead program reduces mitochondrial permeability transition pore (mPTP) formation to restore mitochondrial function. The program has broad potential with initial focus on ALS and PD and will enter the clinic in 2025. NRG is headquartered in the UK and supported by experienced biotech investors, including M Ventures, SV Health Investors’ Dementia Discovery Fund, British Business Bank, Novartis Venture Fund, Criteria BioVentures, Omega Funds, Brandon Capital and Parkinson’s UK.

name: Nucleai
description: Nucleai’ technology leverages spatial AI-driven algorithmics to analyze and interpret complex cellular interactions in a patient’s biopsy, translating them into actionable insights that can accelerate the development of life-saving treatments and diagnostics. Nucleai's platform ingests images from various modalities (H&E, IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial transcriptomics), conducts advanced spatial analysis, and delivers actionable insights. These insights optimize biomarker scoring, determine biomarker prevalence and mechanism of action (MoA), and predict response to therapy, revolutionizing our approach to disease diagnosis and treatment.

name: Nucleome
description: Nucleome Therapeutics is decoding the dark matter of the human genome to uncover novel ways to treat disease. The dark genome holds more than 90% of disease-linked genetic variants whose value remains untapped, representing a significant opportunity for drug discovery and development. The Company has the unique ability to link these variants to gene function and precisely map disease pathways. Nucleome’s cell type-specific platform creates high resolution 3D genome structure maps and enables variant functional validation at scale in primary cell types, enabling the discovery and development of novel, better and safer drugs. The initial focus of the company is on lymphocytes and related autoimmune disease. Nucleome’s ambition is to build a robust pipeline of first-in-class drug assets, with corresponding biomarkers. Nucleome Therapeutics was founded by leading experts in gene regulation from the University of Oxford.

name: ObsEva
description: ObsEva is a Swiss-based company dedicated to the development of innovative drugs for women’s reproductive medicine. ObsEva’s main focus is on therapies for preterm labor.

name: Outrun Therapeutics
description: Outrun Therapeutics has developed a proprietary platform to directly target and inhibit E3 ligases. Company was founded by M Ventures and MP Healthcare based on the academic work of Prof. Satpal Virdee at the University of Dundee.

name: Pacific Light & Hologram
description: Technology start-up working in stealth mode to realize fully immersive 3D experience

name: Padlock Therapeutics
description: Padlock Therapeutics is developing medicines targeting protein-arginine deiminases (PADs), enzymes with an important role in the generation of autoantigens, inflammation, and immune complexes in autoimmune diseases. Padlock intends to explore the full biological and therapeutic footprint of protein deimination by PADs.

name: PictorLabs
description: PictorLabs is a digital pathology company advancing AI-powered virtual staining technology to revolutionize histopathology and accelerate clinical research with the goal of improving patient outcomes. Led by a team with deep expertise in bioengineering, artificial intelligence, and health-tech product development, the Company is reimagining existing histopathology workflows, accelerating clinical and diagnostic results, and improving process sustainability. From a single unstained tissue sample, PictorLabs’ proprietary platform can produce an unlimited number of virtual stains that are indistinguishable from analogous chemical stains. PictorLabs is developing products that replicate standard of care stains and is creating specialized virtual biomarker stains for indications in which there is a large demand for novel and accelerated diagnostic tests.

name: Plexium
description: Plexium is a next-generation targeted protein degradation (TPD) company, leading the way in the rational design and discovery of monovalent protein degraders across a wide range of modalities. Plexium has built a comprehensive best-in-class TPD platform, powered by a proprietary high-throughput cell-based screening (uHTS) technology. Plexium’s next-generation TPD programs extend beyond the limited applications of Proteolysis Targeting Chimeras (PROTACs) and cereblon imids, unravelling the boundless possibilities of true drug-like protein degraders.

name: Polaris Electro-Optics
description: Fast efficient data movement is needed at all scales of computing. Polaris Electro-Optics is developing electro-optic modulator technology on basis of ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals. As a spin-off from the University of Colorado Boulder, the company leverages decades of research on liquid crystals, advanced semiconductor engineering, and co-packaged photonics. Polaris Electro-Optics was founded in 2022 and has offices in Boulder, CO and Boston, MA.

name: Prexton Therapeutics
description: Prexton Therapeutics is developing programs in Parkinson’s disease focused on targeting metabotropic glutamate receptors.

name: Progyny
description: Progyny, the combined entity of Auxogyn, Inc. and Fertility Authority LLC, is the first company to provide fertility patients with easy accessibility to high quality doctors, price transparency, and financing, coupled with extraordinary clinical expertise and proprietary clinical solutions.

name: PxE
description: PxE Computational Imaging has developed a new, truly revolutionary 3D imaging technology. By augmenting the standard CMOS camera architecture with a simple, passive optical element, PxE’s proprietary algorithm is able to retrieve a high resolution (spatial and depth) 3D image of a any scene as well as an RGB + IR image in real time and at 3x the light sensitivity of a normal camera. PxE thereby enables the next generation of consumer electronics and advanced driver assistance systems. The company was founded in 2019 by seasoned tech innovator CEO Yoav Berlatzky and CTO Yanir Hainick, a graduate from the prestigious "Talpiot" program and incubated by M Ventures’ pre-seed vehicle PMatX. Investors beside MV include Koch Disruptive Technologies as well as the Israeli Innovation Authority IIA.

name: Quintessent
description: Quintessent enables the next generation of optical interconnects with highest bandwidth

name: Remepy
description: Remepy develops "hybrid drugs" that combine traditional pharmaceutical medicines with personalized, AI-driven digital software applications delivered via mobile apps. These integrated digital protocols target motor, cognitive, and mental functions to work synergistically with the active drug ingredients and enhance overall treatment effectiveness. Remepy is backed by experienced tech and biotech investors, including M Ventures, O.G. Venture Partners, NFX, TechAviv, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, and others.

name: ReproNovo
description: ReproNovo is a cutting-edge biopharmaceutical company developing innovative solutions to address critical gaps in reproductive medicine and women’s health. Lead clinical compound, RPN-001 (leflutrozole), is being developed to treat male infertility. RPN-002 (nolasiban) is a first-in-disease and first-in-class molecular entity to manage adenomyosis and increase the probability of embryo implantation in women undergoing assisted reproductive technology (ART) treatments. Both assets are Phase 2 ready. ReproNovo team is composed of proven experts with deep experience in reproductive medicine, drug development, regulatory affairs and business development who have throughout their careers successfully brought multiple therapies to market. ReproNovo is financed by founding investor M Ventures, Jeito Capital, AXA IM Alts, Ysios Capital and ALSA Ventures. Headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland, the company has its primary development team in Copenhagen, Denmark, and an additional development site in Barcelona, Spain.

name: Rewind
description: Rewind Therapeutics develops first-in-class therapeutics designed to re-initiate the process of remyelination in patients suffering from major debilitating diseases such as multiple sclerosis and other myelin related disorders. Rewind is led by a team with extensive R&D expertise and has built a strong patent estate for developing novel remyelination therapeutics. Based in Leuven, Belgium, Rewind is backed by top-tier life science investors such as Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund, M. Ventures, PMV, Sunstone Life Science Ventures, Gemma Frisius Fonds, and CD3/ KU Leuven.

name: ribometrix
description: Ribometrix is a biotechnology company pioneering a unique new class of small molecule therapeutics that directly target and modulate the function of RNA to treat human diseases. Ribometrix leverages its world-leading expertise in three-dimensional structural analysis of RNA and RNA biology to drive its discovery platform for the identification of novel small molecules that modulate the function of RNA and proteins associated with human disease.

name: SEEQC
description: SEEQC is developing the first fully digital quantum computing platform. SEEQC combines classical and quantum technologies to address the efficiency, stability and cost issues endemic to quantum computing systems. The company applies classical and quantum technology through digital readout and control technology and a unique chip-scale architecture. SEEQC is one of the first companies to have built a superconductor multi-layer commercial chip foundry. Through this experience SEEQC has the infrastructure in place for design, testing and manufacturing of quantum-ready superconductors. SEEQC is based in Elmsford, NY with facilities in London, UK and Naples, Italy.

name: Storm Therapeutics
description: STORM Therapeutics (STORM) is a clinical stage biotechnology company developing novel therapies that inhibit RNA modifying enzymes (RME) for use in oncology and other diseases. There are more than 150 RNA modifications reported and approximately 300 RNA modifying enzymes which represent novel therapeutic targets. STORM has leveraged its first-mover advantage to establish a novel drug discovery and RNA analytics platform leading to the identification of novel targets and a proprietary pipeline of first-in-class small-molecule drug candidates for potential use in oncology, inflammation, viral infection and CNS diseases. The pipeline is exemplified by STORM’s METTL3 inhibitor, STC-15, which is currently in clinical development. STC-15 represents the first ever RNA modifying enzyme inhibitor to enter clinical evaluation in humans. Additional programs are planned for advancement into IND-track activities. Fierce Biotech named STORM as one of its 2022 “Fierce 15”, designating it as one of the most innovative, exciting biotechnology companies in the industry, pioneering novel drug targets.

name: Synaffix BV
description: Formed in 2010, Synaffix is a Netherlands-based biotechnology company exclusively focused on continued advancement of a best-in-class antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology platform. As a leading innovator in the field of ADCs offering absolute versatility and state-of-the-art solutions, the vision of Synaffix is to become the preferred partner in the development of these complex biological therapeutics and realize its ambition - connect to cure.

name: SynSense
description: Founded in 2017 by two of the leading researchers in the field of neuromorphic computing, Professor Giacomo Indiveri and Dr. Ning Qiao of the joint institute of Neuroinformatics at the University of Zürich and ETH Zürich, Synsense is commercializing the most energy efficient AI chips on the market, inspired by the human brain. Synsense has 3 product families that cover vision-, auditory and bio-signal processing but as a “full-stack” neuromorphic engineering company it is able to apply its bio- inspired spiking neural networks and signal processing approaches to almost every real-time, low power AI tasks in edge devices. Since 2020, the company is based in Chengdu (China) and has raised capital from some of the most reputable investors in the Chinese VC ecosystem like CTC Capital CAS Star, Baidu Ventures and others. The investment represented the first investment of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany’s China Seed Fund Initiative, which was implemented in October 2019 by M Ventures in cooperation with the Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany China Innovation Hub.

name: Theolytics
description: Theolytics is developing category changing oncolytic virus cancer therapies. The company is pioneering a phenotypic screening approach to the discovery and development of efficacious, targeted candidates suitable for intravenous delivery and optimised for a chosen patient population. Theolytics, which was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Oxford, UK, is backed by international life sciences investors Taiho Ventures, Epidarex Capital, and M Ventures, as well as Oxford Science Innovation (OSI).

name: Thintronics
description: Thintronics Inc. is a California-based electronic materials startup supplying high-performance insulators for emerging AI datacenter, networking, and RF/millimeter-wave (mmW) applications. The company was founded on the idea that conventional assumptions guiding insulator material development limited the capacity of the industry to innovate. They have since developed a suite of high-performance materials that display electrical and mechanical characteristics that far outpace the state of the art.

name: TIGNIS
description: Tignis combines the precise insights of physics with the most advanced AI and ML data science to give semiconductor equipment manufacturers, wafer fabs, and components and materials suppliers unprecedented automation and process control. Tignis’ unique physics-driven AI models allow you to explore the future—understanding how your equipment will operate in modes never previously observed. Tignis gives you the ability to know what your equipment will do, select the best states of operation, and continually optimize your processes. Tignis is based in Seattle, WA.

name: Translate Bio
description: Translate Bio is a clinical-stage mRNA therapeutics company developing a new class of potentially transformative medicines to treat diseases caused by protein or gene dysfunction, or to prevent infectious diseases by generating protective immunity.

name: TRIMTECH Therapeutics
description: Trimtech Therapeutics is developing selective small molecule degraders of toxic protein aggregates for treatment of neurodegenerative and peripheral diseases, while leaving functional monomers untouched. The company’s proprietary degrader technology leverages TRIM21 biology as pioneered by the company’s founders Dr Leo James and Dr Will McEwan from the University of Cambridge. Trimtech is headquartered in Cambridge, UK and backed by an experienced life science investor syndicate, including M Ventures, SV Health Investors’ Dementia Discovery Fund, Cambridge Innovation Capital, Pfizer Ventures, MP Healthcare Venture Management (MPH), Eli Lilly and Company, Cambridge Enterprise Ventures, and Start Codon

name: TwoStep Therapeutics
description: TwoStep Therapeutics is developing a pipeline built around a unique tumor-targeting polyspecific integrin-binding peptide (PIP) that can selectively bind several targets that are highly expressed on solid tumors. This multi-targeting feature enables the agent’s broad applicability to a wide range of tumor types and patient populations, overcoming the limitations of single-antigen targeting approaches. The company has leveraged this technology to create a pipeline of targeted cancer therapies for cytotoxic drug delivery and radioligand therapy. The company is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.

name: UNISERS
description: UNISERS is a semiconductor metrology company founded in 2019 in Zurich, Switzerland. The company has been developing innovative wafer inspection and particle detection solutions to help semiconductor fabrication plants improve production yields. The technology can provide unique chemical IDs of particle defects which can significantly reduce the time to find the root cause of on-wafer defects. The company aims to facilitate effective defectivity monitoring of individual process chemicals, high-purity components, and production tools across the entire semiconductor fabrication ecosystem.

name: Wiliot
description: Founded in 2017 by industry veterans Tal Tamir, Yaron Elboim, and Alon Yehezkely (previously co-founders of Wilocity), Wiliot aims to revolutionize the way everyday objects interact with the digital world. Their groundbreaking technology centers around battery-free, paper-thin Bluetooth tags that can be embedded in various products and objects. These tags harvest energy from radio frequencies in the environment, eliminating the need for conventional batteries. Wiliot's cutting-edge approach enables seamless communication and data transfer between objects, providing valuable insights and enhancing efficiency across supply chains, logistics, retail, and smart home applications. By bridging the gap between the physical and digital realms, Wiliot is poised to drive the widespread adoption of intelligent and connected devices, fostering a more streamlined and interconnected world.

name: x.ilio Therapeutics
description: Xilio Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on harnessing the immune system to achieve deep and durable clinical responses to improve the lives of patients with cancer. The company is using its proprietary geographically precise solutions (GPS) platform to rapidly engineer novel molecules, including cytokines and other biologics, that are designed to optimize their therapeutic index. These molecules are designed to localize activity within the tumor microenvironment without systemic effect, resulting in the potential to achieve enhanced anti-tumor activity.

name: Anvilogic
description: AI-powered detection engineering platform to build and scale security detections.

name: Aurasell
description: AI-native CRM platform, a full-featured GTM application and true AI system of record built for the new agentic era in business software.

name: BrontoSource
description: Software refactoring with compiler-level precision for automated legacy code modernization.

name: Cascade AI
description: AI assistants for employee engagement and support.

name: ClearCOGS
description: AI-powered predictive analytics platform for restaurant operations

name: Climatize
description: Funding gateway for retail and institutional investors to crowd-fund solar and energy efficiency projects.

name: CVector
description: Industrial AI platform enabling companies with real-time recommendations to optimize margins in the context of dynamic feedstock, energy, and finished product prices.

name: Fused
description: Middleware serverless platform to enable interoperability between geospatial datasets and ML tools for real-time serverless runtime at any scale.

name: Joyride
description: Stealth.

name: Li Industries
description: Automated battery sorting by chemistry type and a novel direct recycling process that recovers battery electrode materials suitable for direct reuse by battery manufacturers.

name: LimaCharlie
description: Endpoint-driven information security tools, telemetry storage, a full incident response pipeline, and a hunting platform.

name: LinkSquares
description: AI-powered end-to-end contract lifecycle management platform with intuitive solutions for presignature, e-signature, and post-signature, built for legal teams.

name: Mojave
description: Novel liquid desiccant systems targeting superior energy efficiency, and lowest total cost of ownership when compared to alternative DOAS technologies.

name: Not Diamond
description: End-to-end multi-model AI framework that selects the best model for any prompt, continuously improving based on user feedback.

name: Novity
description: ML- and physics-based engine for predictive maintenance (PdM) of equipment, predicting failures with >90% better accuracy and lead times of months.

name: Oleander

By focusing exclusively on account and wallet payments, Nopan combines specialist infrastructure, operational expertise and performance optimisation to help turn payment methods into measurable business outcomes.

name: Lightbringer
description: Lightbringer automates, streamlines, and digitizes the entire patent lifecycle, from creation and filings to prosecution and ongoing management of patent portfolios. Real patent attorneys provide the judgment, while AI handles the heavy lifting. As a result, patent work is no longer constrained by manual workflows, billable hours, or surprise invoices.

name: TurnUp
description: TurnUp uses AI to predict no-show appointments in healthcare (with the dental space as a starting point). From there, they optimize capacity planning for the healthcare practice, handle patient communication, and gradually automate front office operations.

name: NjiaPay
description: NjiaPay offers a payment management system for African Merchants to help them accept online payments and increasing the payment success rate. Through a single API, merchants gain access to multiple Payment Service Providers intelligent routing, redundancy, fraud prevention, and a unified checkout experience that reduces friction. All this translates into higher conversion rates and more revenue.

name: Agileday
description: Agileday's professional services automation (PSA) platform connects talent, allocations, timesheets, and project financials for services firms, eliminating silos, surfacing smarter decisions, and turning talent into growth drivers.Unlike legacy tools designed for top-down control and reporting, Agileday is people-first by design. Every feature is built to engage teams, not just track them.

name: Birdsview
description: Birdsview powers an online retailer's customer communications end to end, enabling agents to send personalized messages to every customer and drive repeat purchases.

name: Clockin
description: clockin is building a software that digitizes HR and project processes of ‘deskless’ SMBs in Europe. That includes functionality such as time tracking, absence management, resource planning, documentation, etc.

name: SEQUESTO
description: SEQUESTO, based in Ghent and founded in 2020, is building a platform that supports tender teams with advanced, AI-driven technology that automates repetitive, error-prone, and time-consuming tasks. The platform structurally reduces content management costs, accelerates time-to-value, and demonstrably increases the win rate on complex RFx processes.

name: nuwacom
description: nuwacom is building a platform that enables marketing and communication teams to harness the power of GenAI in content generation. With strong emphasis on compliance and scalability, nuwacom’s platform is specifically designed for the needs of enterprises to drive the adoption of secure AI in organizations.

name: Koppla
description: Koppla, based in Berlin and founded in 2020, has developed a construction project scheduling and planning product. This solution can be considered a modern, industry-specific iteration of traditional project planning tools such as Oracle Primavera and Microsoft Project.

name: PartsCloud
description: PartsCloud supports machine OEMs in their spare parts operations and after sales logistics. The mission is to become the operating system for the spare parts business, to consistently improve OEMs ability to get the right spare part to the right place at the right time.

name: Churned
description: AI-driven Predictive Retention Platform, empowering subscription businesses with predictive insights and prescriptive actions to retain, reactivate, and upsell customers.

name: Neople
description: Neople is on a mission to solve customer support challenges. Consumers demand high-quality support, but support teams struggle with high workloads. Neople solves this problem by offering a digital co-worker. By now, over 100 leading Dutch and German e-commerce businesses have hired a Neople.

name: airfocus
description: As the world’s 1st modular product management tool, airfocus addresses core enterprise challenges like roadmapping, prioritization, customer insights, and OKR alignment with unmatched flexibility.

name: Ellie.ai
description: Ellie.ai is a Product Design and Collaboration platform for data teams.

name: delphai
description: With the power of AI, delphai revolutionizes big data and ingests millions of websites, press releases, job postings, and more every week to create a single source of business truth: A near real-time, highly accurate hub of company data that is accessible via a dashboard, API, or integration.

name: Occtoo
description: Occtoo is an Experience Data Platform that helps digital teams create relevant customer experiences with speed. Occtoos API technology is the missing piece in a modern composable stack by easily connecting all data, content and APIs, enabling speed in the “idea-to-deployment” process and ability to quickly build new custom applications.

name: VIKTOR
description: VIKTOR is the low-code platform empowering engineers to build and share user-friendly web apps with nothing but Python.

name: Alleo
description: Alleo (f.k.a. YourCampus) contributes to structurally better compensation for employees with attractive benefits packages. On the innovative Alleo platform, employees can compile these packages themselves, based on a budget allocated to them.

name: LegionellaDossier
description: LegionellaDossier eases legionella prevention and control in buildings. LegionellaDossier’s main mission is to guarantee safe drinking water.

name: Parloa
description: Parloa is a leading Conversational AI platform for automating omni-channel customer service. Parloa’s software combines automated speech recognition and natural language understanding to enable companies to build automated dialogs for phone, chat, voice assistants & messenger – all in one place.

name: Prepr
description: Prepr is the world’s first data-driven headless CMS. Prepr offers a new approach to headless CMS, as it allows to centralize content of different brands and helps to deliver and personalize digital content at scale for exceptional customer experiences.

name: Passendo
description: Founded 2016 in Copenhagen, Passendo has set out to commercialising newsletter inventory. Their state of the art email ad server and SSP provides value for publishers and advertisers worldwide, with over 4,000 premium publishing house newsletter inventories across the world.

name: Salonkee
description: Salonkee is the all-in-one solution for online booking tool and management software for hairdresser-, beauty- and wellness salons. Founded in 2018 in Luxembourg it now has a strong presence in Belgium, Switzerland & Germany.

name: Dexter
description: Dexter offers services to energy retailers and large-scale energy consumers to reduce power imbalance. The services consist of forecasting energy loads on asset-level or cluster-level as well as forecasting of short-term electricity prices.

name: Filestage
description: Filestage is the enterprise-ready online proofing software that helps teams to get their work reviewed and approved faster. Filestage streamlines, organizes and automates feedback on files throughout the proofing process, while reducing errors and ensuring compliance guides are met.

name: Objective Platform
description: Objective Platform, is a marketing measurement and prediction software designed to track and optimize multi-channel media investments. By maximizing the use of available data sources, marketing measurement models offer a holistic view across digital and traditional media without sacrificing granular information. As a result, advertisers gain strategic and tactical insights to support budget allocation across time periods, campaigns and channels.

name: Mediatool
description: Mediatool is a professional media planning collaboration software for marketeers and agencies. Marketeers and agencies use it to get an overview of all their marketing activities, campaign plans and yearly summaries in one place as a virtual marketing assistant. It also makes it easier to manage and change media plans in real time, collaborate within and between teams, and analyse and discover which media actions are giving the greatest ROI by comparing media spend to business outcomes.

name: Deliverect
description: Deliverect is a SaaS platform that integrates online food delivery channels directly with a restaurant's point of sale and stock management systems. By automating order flow and centralizing menu management across all delivery platforms, it reduces manual errors and improves operational efficiency for food service businesses.

name: APICBASE NV
description: APICBASE is a food management SaaS platform that helps food service businesses run their kitchen operations more efficiently and profitably. Starting from recipe data, the platform automatically calculates ingredient quantities, manages inventory across multiple outlets, and generates preparation instructions — eliminating much of the manual work in kitchen management. It also helps businesses control food costs and waste, ensure compliance with allergen and nutritional regulations, and scale their menus and processes consistently across locations.

name: ValueBlue
description: ValueBlue is the company behind BlueDolphin, a SaaS collaboration platform that can be used to map an organization’s digital landscape and business processes.Companies can lose their grip on the complex IT landscapes created by digital transformation. To reverse this situation, it is essential for companies to have a clear understanding of the relationships and dependencies between their IT landscape, their business processes and the underlying data.BlueDolphin combines all of the relevant data and translates it into management and improvement information with clear visualizations and reports.

name: REXai
description: REXai offers an AI-as-a-Service (AiaaS) solutions platform that enables companies to provide hyper-personalized experiences for their customers.Unlike labor intensive rule-based tools that require commerce and marketing professionals to collect data and micromanage rules in an attempt to make business and personalization decisions, the platform interprets the visitor’s intention based on real-time behavioral data, and aligns with pre-defined business goals when autonomously predicting which items or content to display throughout the customer journey.

name: SwipeGuide
description: SwipeGuide is a SaaS platform that enables manufacturers to quickly create and distribute digital work instructions and standard operating procedures. By replacing outdated PDFs and printed manuals with interactive, trackable guides, it helps frontline employees work more effectively while giving organizations the analytics to continuously improve their processes.

name: Roadmap
description: Roadmap is a customizable SaaS platform that streamlines corporate travel by integrating suppliers, policies, and traveler support in one place. It gives travel managers full oversight and policy control while providing business travelers with a personalized digital assistant that handles the logistics, so they can stay focused on their work.

name: PlayPass
description: PlayPass offers a plug-and-play infrastructure for access control and cashless payments at events.Large event businesses (such as open-air festivals and arenas) need technology to run their events. It’s the only way to manage processes and gather data to improve performance. They need to know who the guest is, they need to own the data, and they need to be in control of the transactions at their events. PlayPass is a software platform combined with a cashless RFID wristband payment system. Its infrastructure enables event businesses to improve processes, become data-driven organizations and create a better experience for guests.

name: TaxModel
description: TaxModel is a SaaS tax technology scaleup specializing in direct tax reporting, compliance and transfer pricing. The company bridges the gap between tax professionals and corporate and social requirements in terms of the cost-effectiveness of tax advice, tax behavior and transparency.

name: DataStories
description: DataStories is a self-service analytics company that uses augmented intelligence to help formulated product manufacturers optimize their products. Their platform helps companies understand how complex combinations of ingredients, processing conditions, and other variables impact product performance — replacing the slow, expensive, trial-and-error experimentation that currently dominates the industry.

name: Oxynade
description: Oxynade offers a SaaS-based e-ticketing platform that enables ticketing agencies and venues to deliver modern, feature-rich ticketing experiences without the cost of building their own technology. Their all-in-one solution covers front and back office needs across a broad range of verticals, helping partners grow their businesses and stay competitive.

name: Synple
description: Synple was a Breda-based logistics startup that developed an "Uber-esque" freight capacity marketplace to match available truck capacity with demand.

name: L1nda
description: L1nda is a cloud-based platform that simplifies the scheduling, finding, and paying of hospitality staff via mobile and desktop. Built with younger, digitally native workers in mind, the platform supports the flexible, dynamic planning that today's hospitality workforce expects.

name: The Next Ad
description: The Next Ad is a social media advertising platform for companies involved in e-commerce. In-depth expertise and a focus on automation make digital advertising effortless and accessible.The platform helps businesses grow by making it easy for brands of all sizes to publish and optimize their advertising campaigns. The platform also provides insights into the effectiveness of digital advertising so businesses can improve the efficiency of their campaigns.

name: Nallian
description: Nallian provides a cloud-based data-sharing platform that connects logistics partners — particularly in air cargo — enabling real-time collaboration across complex supply chains. Their platform allows entire cargo communities to operate in an integrated, transparent way, improving end-to-end efficiency without lengthy onboarding.

name: CustomerGauge
description: CustomerGauge is a Voice-of-the-Customer platform built specifically for B2B companies, using Net Promoter Score methodology to help them measure and improve customer experience and retention. By linking customer engagement data with revenue analytics, it enables businesses to prioritize the right accounts and take targeted actions for profitable growth.

name: Foleon
description: Foleon is a SaaS platform that enables brands, publishers, and marketing agencies to create responsive, interactive digital magazines and marketing content. Their intuitive tool handles all the technical complexity without requiring developers, while also providing analytics to track engagement and generate leads.

name: 24/i
description: 24/i creates and deploys TV apps for every screen, from set-top boxes, SmartTVs and media players to game consoles, tablets and mobile phones.24/i was acquired by Amino Communications, part of Amino Technologies PLC (AMO.L)

name: Reasult
description: Reasult offers financial forecasting and control software for the real estate market. In the current real estate market, there is an increasing need for transparency, sound financial control and risk management. Directors responsible for real estate are accountable for their investment decisions and want to be fully in control of their portfolios. Which is why Reasult’s financial forecasting and portfolio analysis solutions are the most widely used in the Netherlands.

name: iWelcome
description: iWelcome is a leading European SaaS provider of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, helping organizations securely manage digital identities across consumers, employees, partners, and IoT devices. Their cloud platform is built to handle complex enterprise security requirements while ensuring compliance with regulations like GDPR.

name: Collibra
description: Collibra is the market leader in enterprise data governance and catalogue software.Data governance is a set of processes which ensure that important data assets are formally managed throughout the enterprise. Collibra brings business and IT together to govern data as an enterprise asset.Now more than ever, the most innovative companies are fueled by data. Data has become our most valuable asset. Collibra puts organizations back in control of their data, helping them comply with changing legislation, embrace emerging technologies and capture the information that enables them to design future-proof services and solutions.

name: Mirror42
description: Founded in 2004, Mirror 42 was a cloud Business Intelligence company specializing in KPI and time-series analytics. Their platform provided KPI dashboards, scorecards, and data visualization tools, which were integrated into ServiceNow to become ServiceNow Performance Analytics. Mirror42 was acquired in July 2013 by ServiceNow Inc. (NYSE: NOW)

name: Servoy
description: Servoy offers a Platform as a Service (PaaS) solution for the development and deployment of cloud-based business applications anywhere, on any device.Enterprises are building more and more bespoke core applications that they see as a USP. Meanwhile, low-code platforms are operating at their technological limits when integrating and overlapping with core applications.Servoy is a high-productivity platform for the rapid development of complex applications. It helps organizations build enterprise-grade applications and transform their businesses faster. The platform includes advanced mobile capabilities and integrates easily with existing systems.

name: XVR Simulation
description: XVR Simulation develops VR-based training and assessment technology for safety and security professionals such as first responders. Their modular platform replaces costly, disruptive offline exercises with flexible, instructor-controlled simulations that deliver greater educational value at lower cost.

name: Q-GO
description: A Dutch software company specialized in semantic search and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology, founded in 1999. Q-GO was acquired by RightNow Technologies in Jan 2011, later becoming part of Oracle's portfolio.

name: LeanApps
description: LeanApps Life (now part of Keylane) is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform specialized for individual and collective life insurance and pension administration. Primarily used in the Netherlands, Belgium, and the Caribbean, it streamlines policy management, underwriting, claims, and product configuration to enhance operational efficiency for insurers.

name: Asysco
description: Asysco is a technology provider specializing in transforming legacy mainframe applications and COBOL code into modern, cost-effective solutions. Their turnkey approach allows organizations to preserve the value of their critical systems while enabling the flexibility needed for future innovation and growth.

name: Wisdom TMLC
description: Wisdom TMLC is an e-business solution for telecom operators, local government agencies, utility companies and health organizations, covering front and back offices. Founded in 1995, they provided total e-business solutions, including web application development, maintenance, system integration, and intranet/extranet services. The company specialized in front- and back-office solutions for sectors such as telecom, local government, utilities, and health, and was acquired by Ordina in 2006.

name: Propulsion
description: Propulsion is a B2B marketing and sales agency that bridges the gap between lead generation and sales by nurturing prospects early and qualifying their intent before handing them off. This ensures sales teams focus only on high-potential leads, while helping clients build a more structured and effective marketing process.

name: Minihouse
description: Minihouse provided specialized software for import and export customs compliance. In June 2010, Kewill plc, a provider of logistics and trade compliance software, acquired Minihouse to strengthen its European customs services.

name: Oxxio
description: Oxxio is an independent energy supplier, established in 2000, specializing in providing 100% green electricity and gas to residential and business customers. As a subsidiary of Eneco Energie, it focuses on sustainable, affordable energy, often positioning itself in the price-fighter segment

name: 3E
description: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Carlsbad, CA, 3E is a leading global provider of data-driven intelligent compliance solutions in the Environmental, Health, Safety & Sustainability space. The Company has a long history of innovation that has resulted in the development of differentiated and mission-critical data assets such as global regulatory content and a proprietary database of over 10+ million safety data sheets, 3,000+ regulatory lists and 30,000+ generic classes of substances. The Company’s differentiated solution allows its clients to maintain market leading chemical and workplace safety practices, and improve product safety and stewardship. 3E is relied on by many of the world’s largest companies across a variety of industries; among its 5,000 customers globally, 3E serves nine of the world’s top 10 chemical manufacturers, eight of the world’s top 10 retailers, and seven of the world’s top 10 pharmaceutical companies. New Mountain identified 3E as it sits at the intersection of its multi-year deep-dive sector initiatives in the data and information services, software, chemicals, and EHS&S sectors. NMC’s specific business building experience in these sectors includes companies such as Avantor, Blue Yonder, SNL Financial, IRI, Zep, Aceto, Sparta Systems, and Ascensus Specialties.

name: ABB Optical Group
