name: Connect Ventures
description: Connect Ventures is a thesis-led European seed VC specialised in product-led software companies. The firm’s investment lens is anchored in a clear product philosophy—backing “opinionated products, crafted with love and loved by many”—and it uses this as a practical framework to evaluate founders, product quality, user outcomes, and the scalability of go-to-market dynamics. Connect’s approach is designed for early conviction and high-touch partnership at the seed stage, with a strong emphasis on the craft of product building and the measurable signals of “product love” (retention, engagement, referral behaviour, and other category-appropriate usage KPIs). The firm has historically backed a range of defining European product companies, reflecting a consistent focus on teams that can build enduring product advantage and compound it over time.

name: Contactlab
description: ContactLab is Italy’s market leader in the field of direct digital marketing. The company has developed its own SaaS platform for managing and sending e-mail campaigns, sms and push notifications. The platform also integrates exclusive outbound messaging services to maximise customer engagement. Contactlab provides advanced solutions for engaging marketing platforms for commerce-focused companies and fashion & luxury brands. Thanks to its proprietary PaaS technology and the expertise of its team, Contactlab enables brands to receive insights relating to the context of each individual customer in order to make the retail experience more incisive and interesting, while creating a highly individualized, personal and multichanneled experience.

name: Cortilia
description: Cortilia is the first Italian online agricultural marketplace where you can buy short chain products directly from farmers. It connects farmers and consumers and arranges the delivery of fresh, seasonal and sustainable products to customer’s doorsteps. On Cortilia, customers can access a wide range of products, such as meat, fish, fresh cheese, pasta, milk, eggs, bread, jams, wine and craft beer, beauty and household cleaning products, as well as seasonal fruits and vegetables. Cortilia wants to meet the needs of all those people interested in quality, and sustainable shopping. The service is easily customizable and efficient and allows next day delivery.

name: Cosmico
description: Cosmico is a platform that connects organizations with highly specialized talent worldwide, focusing on the future of work. It provides businesses with access to a global pool of freelancers and skilled professionals, offering flexible work arrangements that prioritize freedom, connection, and personal fulfillment. Cosmico fosters a talent-driven work environment, helping companies innovate through top-tier talent while empowering individuals to take ownership of their projects and careers.

name: Cyber Guru
description: Cyber Guru’s mission is to increase employee knowledge around information security. Despite the advancements in cybersecurity technology, the “human factor” is still one of the primary vectors used by cybercriminals to attack an organisation. Some of the most common human errors that lead to data breaches include falling victim to phishing scams, providing unauthorised access to corporate devices, and poor password protection. As more organisations shift to remote work and full-scale cloud infrastructures, the need to educate employees on cybersecurity and social engineering attack techniques has become a top priority. Cyber Guru’s training and awareness platform strengthens the human factor, converting it from a weak link in an organisation’s defence chain against cybercriminals to the first line of protection. Organisations working with Cyber Guru have reported a 400% or more improvement in phishing resilience after only ten months of use.

name: DataKrypto
description: DataKrypto is an international company with strong Italian roots that specializes in cloud encryption. The company's unique mission is to protect strategic data, a goal it has pursued for over two decades. Through extensive research and development efforts devoted to homomorphic encryption algorithms, DataKrypto has developed an innovative and effective level of protection called "Encryption in Process". One of the company's key offerings is the DataKrypto Cloud (DK Cloud) system. This system encrypts data in a way that allows applications to perform searches and operations without a decryption key. The proprietary algorithm used in DK Cloud enables fast encryption, searches on encrypted data, searches on full and partial strings, and allows for math operations. It is highly scalable and efficient. DK Cloud is available as an SDK or as an ODBC/JDBC driver.

name: DayBreakHotels
description: DayBreakHotels is an online timely-based hotel booking platform for the day time. It enables travellers to find & book hotel rooms, meeting rooms, SPAs & swimming pools via the platform by making an online payment. Their app is available for iOS & Android devices.

name: Deporvillage
description: Deporvillage is an online retailer offering sports goods and accessories. It aims at becoming the reference space for all athletes looking for the best brands, by providing its customers with the broadest assortment of sports goods at competitive prices and an outstanding customer service.

name: FATMAP
description: FATMAP is the outdoor adventure platform for web and mobile. Wherever your inspiration takes you, you’ll be ready for any adventure. From those late-night planning sessions to those early morning summits. With the world’s first global 3D map specifically designed for the outdoors, you can create, plan and share every adventure life brings you. Built with best data, world-leading 3D technology and available for free on the web and for mobiles, your journey can always start with FATMAP.

name: Forcemanager
description: Founded in 2011, ForceManager is shaping the way in which field sales teams work, making the process more agile and less time consuming for sales representatives, while providing better information and real-time data to managers. ForceManager is dedicated to create the best mobile-CRM for field sales teams, with versatile product features and AI capabilities. ForceManager is transforming and advancing CRMs into personal sales assistants.

name: Gourmant
description: Gourmant is an ecommerce for food lovers. Through flash-sales events, its members can buy excellent Italian food products at affordable prices. Gourmant’s team carefully selects the finest craftsmen, in order to satisfy even the most discerning customers by offering the best quality food products on the market. An e-commerce for all food lovers and for all those who are curios to try out new niche products, which are usually offered at 50%, 40%, or – more rarely - 30% discount. Among the products: sweets, spirits, craft beers, mushrooms and truffles, oils and vinegars, meats and cheeses, and various types of salts and spices.

name: Habacus
description: Habacus is a forward-thinking platform dedicated to revolutionizing access to education financing. By leveraging innovative technology, Habacus provides students with tailored financial solutions to help fund their studies and achieve their academic goals. The platform combines personalized funding opportunities, performance tracking, and data-driven insights to empower students, making higher education more accessible and inclusive. Habacus bridges the gap between education and financial institutions, fostering a supportive ecosystem for student success and long-term impact.

name: Habyt
description: Habyt aims at creating the housing concept of the future, by providing a network of co-living spaces in the main cities of the world, while hosting tech-savvy millennials that add value to the community. The idea is simple: design a new standard of living spaces that combine superior comfort with cutting-edge design; curate a community of like-minded individuals that will populate it; integrate seamless technology that facilitates the rental experience, and allows communication between guests and community managers.

name: Hotiday
description: Hotiday is an Italian traveltech startup founded in 2022 that partners with independent hotels across Europe to create curated “Room Collections” designed for modern travelers. By using proprietary technology to identify and enhance underutilized rooms, Hotiday delivers a consistent, high-quality experience while boosting hotel occupancy and revenue. Guests benefit from 24/7 digital concierge services via WhatsApp, offering local tips and seamless support. Active in over 70 destinations and having hosted 40,000+ guests, Hotiday is redefining hospitality through a decentralized, tech-enabled model that combines authentic stays with smart convenience.

name: Incapto
description: Incapto is a specialty coffee company dedicated to delivering a premium coffee experience like no other. With a deep passion for the art of coffee roasting and a commitment to sourcing the finest beans from around the world, Incapto is known for its exquisite, handcrafted brews that cater to the most discerning coffee enthusiasts. Every cup of Incapto is a testament to their dedication to quality, sustainability, and the pursuit of the perfect coffee flavor. Incapto is a certified B Corporation with an Impact Business Model, which is designed to create a specific positive outcome for one of its stakeholders, such as workers or the community.

name: Join Capital
description: Join Capital is an early-stage venture capital firm focused on European deep tech that strengthens the backbone of modern economies—enterprise, industry, and defence. The team invests in technologies built for durability and strategic relevance, prioritising real intellectual property and clear differentiation versus legacy systems. Their approach is explicitly long-term: they aim to stay close to founders from the first institutional check through scale, helping translate hard technology into meaningful adoption and impact. From an investment perspective, Join Capital targets pre-seed through Series A, typically investing €1–5 million, and looks for tangible technical maturity (minimum TRL 4) supported by early user or customer feedback. The firm operates across major European hubs (Berlin, London, Milan), reflecting a cross-border sourcing and scaling mindset aligned with the pan-European nature of deep tech commercialisation.

name: Keyless
description: Keyless is a deep-tech cybersecurity company building the world’s first privacy-preserving biometric authentication and personal identity management platform. Keyless Zero-Knowledge Biometric (ZKB™) solutions provide passwordless multi-factor authentication that eliminates fraud, phishing, and credential reuse – all while enhancing customer and employee experiences and protecting their privacy. With Keyless, businesses are finally able to adopt zero-trust security, eliminate passwords, ensure privacy compliance and deliver unified authentication experiences across every touchpoint.

name: Libracyber
description: LibraCyber is a European human-centric cybersecurity company, formed from the strategic combination of Libraesva and Cyber Guru. Its mission is to help IT and security teams protect their organization and its people from cyber threats — the privacy-first way. LibraCyber is the only European vendor with international scale that combines privacy-first, AI-powered email security with security awareness training in a sovereign Human Risk Management platform. The company serves more than 3,500 customers globally through a network of over 500 resellers and managed service providers

name: Loquis
description: Loquis is a geo-podcasting platform that provides information about places all over the world through geolocated podcasts. The platform serves both B2C and B2B spaces in the Travel and Hospitality Tech market segments. Loquis allows users to listen to and publish geo-localized podcasts, providing an immersive travel experience. The platform features stories about places, buildings, monuments, street art works, famous film locations, historical events, excursions and itineraries, clubs and restaurants, legends, and anecdotes. It also offers a navigator function that tells users about the places around them. Loquis also provides an opportunity for businesses to promote and market their products or services using the app. It adopts an "open access publishing" model, giving institutions, corporations, and individuals the opportunity to disseminate tailored content in the desired language to different travelers.

name: Mama Health
description: Mama Health’s technology works by collecting experiences directly from people and organizing them with its process mining algorithms. The output is a model that educates individuals and informs healthcare organizations on the most urgent patient needs. We stand for empowering patients through crowdsourced information and peer-to-peer support, while progressing medical research.

name: Milkman
description: Milkman Technologies offers a Last Mile recipient-centric cloud solution that empowers Logistics and Retailer organizations to increase Revenues and Profitability thanks to convenient, cost-effective, and sustainable delivery options. Based on AI-powered algorithms, the Platform connects recipients’ and businesses' needs, eliminating unfeasible deliveries and reducing operational expenditures. Businesses can modulate their level of service, incentivizing wider slots for better distributed, more efficient, and greener services and preventing broken promises as well as delighting even the most demanding recipients with very precise appointments at low marginal cost.

name: Misiedo
description: MiSiedo provides online real-time reservations at the best Italian restaurants. The service allows users to consult the availability of a restaurant at any time and to receive an immediate confirmation of their reservation on their desktop or mobile device. MiSiedo was born in 2011 from the partnership between 2night and H-Farm with the mission of facilitating the management of reservations for restaurateurs by providing an easy to access digital application (Erb for iPad, thus allowing for the first time real-time online reservations.

name: Multiply Labs
description: Multiply Labs has developed personalized capsules that contain a variety of supplements, with the ideal dosage for each individual which are released over a specific time-period for prolonged therapeutic effects. Multiply Labs was founded to provide individuals the freedom to customize their intake of supplements to optimize their daily needs. Using patent-pending release technology developed at MIT and the University of Milan, Multiply Labs wants to revolutionize the perception around the supplement industry.

name: Mundimoto
description: Mundimoto is the leading i-buyer in the motorbike category. Users can search bikes by categories, view their specifications & price, calculate finance, see offers & place orders via the platform by making an online payment. It also provides vehicle appraisal, customized financing plans & more. Our mission is to transform the way people buy their next motorbike in Europe. We realised that while people love riding their motorbikes, they don’t always enjoy the process of buying or selling them. So we are creating a totally new way, providing transparency, convenience and peace of mind. We allow customers to browse, finance and purchase more than 1.000 motorbikes on the go via their mobile device, while also offering the convenience of selling your motorbike to us without ever having to step foot inside a dealership.

name: Musement
description: Musement helps travellers enjoy in-destination experiences to the fullest, sourcing local knowledge and recommendations to make the best use of time. Whether it’s activities, tours, tickets or just ideas for a great night out, Musement allows easy and secure bookings through Musement.com and their app (available bot for iOS and Android).

name: Musixmatch
description: With more than 70 million people using Musixmatch worldwide, the platform has become the most popular lyrics destination for mobile devices. Musixmatch’s lyrics catalogue is created, synched, and translated through its community and validated by a team of international supervisors. Users can connect Musixmatch with Spotify, Apple Music, and dozens of other music services.

name: Mymenu
description: MyMenu is a delivery service that enables customers to place orders from the best restaurants and have them delivered wherever they are in an average of 30 minutes. Mymenu was born from the idea of a few young entrepreneurs with a strong passion for food and the digital world. Their goal is to transform Mymenu into a reference point for quality food delivery in Italy. They are committed to Italianness, uniqueness and digitization, always trying to be one step ahead by selecting only the best restaurants for their customers.

name: Octorate
description: Octorate provides a SaaS-based hospitality booking management and sales optimization platform which is currently used by over 7,000 customers, such as hotels, b&bs, farms, and houses. The solution features a centralized calendar to manage presences, prices, availability to improve decision making processes and increase sales.

name: Opyn
description: Opyn is the first fintech platform that makes access to business loans easy and quick for small and medium companies and simplifies the work of banks. Founded in 2012 as an online loan broker, thanks to a proprietary, highly innovative and paperless technology, Opyn has grown exponentially. Today it offers, on one hand, loans to Italian SMEs in just a few days and, on the other hand, its software-asa- service to financial institutions and corporates that want to support their customers and give them fast and smart loans through artificial intelligence and machine learning.

name: Osteocom
description: Osteocom was born as a blog and has rapidly evolved into a leader digital communication platform for the dental sector, specialised in education services, through a video platform and collaboration with some of the most famous experts and professionals. The company has developed a proprietary solution that offers a versified range of services: from subscription to innovative, efficient, and user-friendly video courses held by the best professionals, to B2B web communication services for companies and associations in the dental sector.

name: Quadro
description: Quadro is a smart controller for your Mac and Windows computer, a new paradigm in desktop interaction. Its purpose is to simplify and empower computing tasks, streamline the workflow to help stay focused and be more productive. Quadro has been primarily designed for digital creatives: musicians and designers. Their product facilitates creative workers’ approach to computers, letting them work within their creative flow, eliminating all that is unnecessary and distracts them from focussing on their creations. Quadro allows them to control the most used softwares such as Photoshop or Ableton, with a simple tap, on their tablets and smartphones.

name: Sellf
description: Sellf is a mobile app for CRM that simplifies the management of business opportunities and customer relations. Sellf collects all relevant details on contacts, todos, emails, and appointments, to provide a complete and upto- date overview of sales activities. Sellf remembers activities and arrangements, monitors results, allows you to make quick decisions and easily understand where to focus. It collects data automatically, hence it minimizes the effort of entering data. It is a productivity app with the power of an innovative CRM, which allows you to dynamically manage relationship activities with customers and your professional activity.

name: Shoppable
description: Shoppable is an online shop for design, style and home products. The team of cool product hunters scouts for a careful selection of beautiful, yet unconventional artifacts. Shoppable is dedicated to people who want to find something original every day to enrich their style and their home. Every day, Juliette Bellavita and her team select the most interesting brands, the most creative designers and the most particular products to offer a well-balanced mix of Nordic Design, French Touch and Asian minimalism.

name: Sift
description: Sift provides fraud prevention solutions for payments. Its product offered to businesses include Digital Trust and Safety suite which protects businesses from account takeover, payment fraud, and scam content from destroying the brand’s integrity. It provides solutions for fintech, retail, food and beverage, and more.

name: Silicon Roundabout Ventures
description: Silicon Roundabout Ventures is a community-driven venture capital firm backing exceptional deep tech founders at pre-seed and seed across Europe. Its positioning is built around technical conviction and early access: the firm leverages a large, long-standing community of engineers and builders to meet companies before they are broadly visible, then supports them through the earliest institutional stages where specialist evaluation and founder support can be decisive. The fund focuses on foundational, high-leverage technologies in critical domains such as computing, defence, and energy. Its community platform—reported as 15,000+ entrepreneurs and engineers—has historically acted as both a sourcing engine and a filtering mechanism for deep tech and big data startups, reinforcing a differentiated funnel and an operator-to-investor feedback loop.

name: Snap
description: Snap is a mobile marketplace for buying and selling secondhand goods. Snap is the application that helps you sell objects on your smartphone through the use of photography alone. A quick app for those with little time that is based on the fact that one picture is worth a thousand words. The sale is concluded without physical contact through integrated tools such as a chat connects seller buyer. Payments can be made directly within the app and shipments can be tracked.

name: Soplaya
description: Soplaya is the digital marketplace where Chefs buy goods directly from the Producers, at the best possible price, without intermediaries, and have them delivered daily where they want (i.e. restaurants, hotel, bar, patisserie, etc.). They revolutionize the supply chain by bringing transparency and simplicity to the sourcing phase, increasing order frequency, streamlining inventory and reducing food waste.

name: Startupitalia
description: StartupItalia is an Italian website for startup news, events, and information. It tracks and covers startups, venture funds & investors, and events across Italy. Startupitalia! was founded in 2013 to shed a light on the world of startups and create a favourable environment for the development of solid and competitive companies. Startupitalia! aims at creating a virtuous circle that includes: the largest Italian network of innovation events with international visibility and participants, a digital hub, innovative companies, investors and professionals, a material place where startups and consolidated companies can be together, share good practices and develop open innovation projects.

name: Strava
description: Strava is the leading subscription platform at the center of connected fitness, with more than 100 million active people in 195 countries. The platform offers a holistic view of your active lifestyle, no matter where you live, which sport you love and/or what device you use. Everyone belongs on Strava when they are pursuing an active life. Join the community, find motivation and discover new experiences with a Strava subscription.

name: Streetbeat
description: Streetbeat is a fintech company that offers an AI-driven investment platform and app. The platform serves as a personalized investment advisor, allowing users to create their own investment strategies by leveraging generative AI. Streetbeat offers personalized investment portfolios that align with users' unique investment goals and risk appetite. The company employs several market-leading partners, including Alpaca Markets, Plaid, and Onfido, to enhance security and instill confidence. The company is an SEC-registered investment adviser.

name: Swite
description: Swite is a platform that allows users to create a personal website from the content they have already published on their social networks, by directly connecting their accounts. The website, is automatically updated as soon as users share new content. With Swite everyone can create their own website with a simple click, connecting their social networks and transforming the published content into a Social Website that shows the best of their online activity. Thanks to a section dedicated to content management, it allows to update content both automatically and manually, thus offering greater control over user privacy. Users can also create more than one swite, or create a swite starting from a Facebook page, which allows small businesses to promote their business to a larger audience.

name: Tannico
description: Tannico is the ecommerce dedicated to wine lovers. Every day Tannico carefully select the best Italian and foreign cellars through the help of a team of dedicated sommeliers. Tannico was born at the end of 2012 with the aim of becoming the first e-wine shop on the market and has successfully accomplished its goal. It has an extraordinarily wide catalogue, a stock of over 100,000 bottles and an exceptional delivery service – orders are delivered in 24/48 hours in Italy and in one day within the city of Milan. Tannico also launched an area dedicated to Small Producers to help smaller Italian companies that make excellent wine but find it difficult to access the distribution market.

name: Teiacare
description: Teiacare is a digital health company leveraging artificial intelligence to improve care delivery in long-term care facilities. Its platform provides real-time monitoring of residents, enabling care teams to detect risks early, respond more quickly, and optimize daily operations. By combining unobtrusive sensing technology with advanced data analytics, Teiacare transforms behavioral data into actionable insights. This helps reduce adverse events, improve staff efficiency, and enhance the overall quality of care. The company addresses a critical need in an aging society, supporting care providers in delivering safer, more proactive, and more scalable care.

name: Toduba
description: Toduba is a fintech startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in Turin, Italy. The company operates in the corporate welfare and digital payments industry, offering innovative solutions for managing employee benefits. Toduba provides a fully digital, secure, and customizable platform that allows companies to distribute meal vouchers, shopping vouchers, fringe benefits, and flexible benefits through a mobile app and digital wallet. By replacing traditional paper-based or card-based systems, Toduba simplifies the management of corporate welfare, reduces administrative burdens, and ensures greater transparency and regulatory compliance. Its value proposition lies in creating a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable ecosystem for both companies and employees, helping businesses save costs while enhancing employee satisfaction.

name: Unguess
description: UNGUESS is the tech-platform to bring collective wisdom in your company’s decision-making processes at speed and at any time needed. Unleashing the power of our highly vetted crowd of thousands of engaged humans, this solution provides a “fresh-eye” effect, to find answers and to share insightful feedbacks. Three powerhouses fuel UNGUESS: the technology (a flexible and easy-to-use platform), the people (the vast community of real people and the UNGUESS team itself) and the methodology (fast, effective, and consistent solutions). The platform offers solutions in four areas: Software Quality, UX/UI Research, CX Research and Insights and Cybersecurity.

name: Velasca
description: Velasca is a digital native high-quality footwear and fashion brand. Launched in Italy, it is now present in the US and throughout Europe with both digital and brick & mortar channels. Velasca's innovative business model allows to offer its customers high quality, Made in Italy fashion at affordable prices. Velasca represents the change of paradigm in fashion and in the 2.0 economy, where style meets innovation.

name: Viralize
description: Viralize is a technological platform that unites online Publishers, Video Creators and Advertisers. With their hub and technology stack, publishers distribute top video content while optimizing ad revenue, creators get exposure for their quality videos and advertisers connect to their next engaged customer. Viralize was founded in Florence, Italy and has offices in New York, London, Milan, Rome, and Madrid.

name: Waynaut
description: Waynaut provides multimodal directions comprising of transportation, from the subway to carpooling on a single platform. Also, provides Multimodal directions as a Service wherein website or app can show their users the best way to get where they need, from door to door, using traditional and innovative means of transportation. Charges fee to integrate the multimodal routing power.

name: Web3 Pro
description: Web3 Pro is a B2B SaaS platform that offers enterprise-grade applications for marketing, gaming, and record authentication. The company provides a white-label platform that enables global brands to create seamless and on-brand NFT campaigns. Web3 Pro's Hub Marketing Engagement Platform offers tools for gated content, loyalty programs, and community building to help businesses engage, incentivize, retain, and grow their customer base and ROI without using cookies. The company's solutions include enterprise-grade Web3 SDKs and low-code solutions. The company is also involved in the intersection of art, AI, and blockchain, exploring new frontiers for creative ownership.

name: WeSchool
description: WeSchool’s mission is the digitization of the Italian school system. They help teachers learn new teaching methods and work with companies on projects that bring value to the world of education. With WeSchool Professors can bring their classes online and make their teaching digital. WeSchool helps students too: with more than 15,000 hours of training provided every day, WeSchool Library is one of the biggest cultural dissemination projects in Italy.

name: Wiman
description: wiMAN has developed a technology that helps small business owners to increase social media presence through a Wi-Fi router. Customers can login to Wi-Fi via Facebook or Google. In 2015, they have launched a mobile app to allow customers to automatically find the best Wi-Fi around and connect based on the network conditions.

name: Wonderflow
description: Wonderflow is Europe’s leading provider of consumer feedback analysis. Operating globally, the company is changing how enterprises manage text analytics processes. In the last years, Wonderflow has helped several brands to become consumer-centric and more successful in their respective markets. The list of customers includes Philips, Samsung, Tomtom, Uber, Reckitt Benckiser, Beiersdorf, DHL, Kantar, AT Kearney, TUI and Estée Lauder.

name: ACTO
description: ACTO helps life science companies increase sales and brand awareness while reducing compliance risks.

name: ALT TEX
description: ALT TEX designs and manufactures sustainable and ethical textiles, engineered from food waste.

name: AgentField
description: AgentField is developing a security framework for the emerging agentic web, establishing the foundational trust layer needed for AI agents to perform complex, autonomous tasks. Its platform provides identity, control, and auditability for agent-powered workflows, particularly in sensitive enterprise environments.

name: Altrio
description: Altrio is building an AI-powered CRM to help commercial real estate investors do deals faster.

name: Angelhost
description: A concierge service that helps property managers and owners manage short-term rentals.

name: Aon3D
description: Industrial-grade 3D printers at a fraction of the cost.

name: Arvo AI
description: Arvo AI is building the natural language interface to your cloud infrastructure.

name: Asepha
description: Asepha makes it easy for pharmacists to automate manual tasks so they can focus on clinical work.

name: Beatdapp
description: Beatdapp is a B2B Distributed Application (DApp) that lets creative rights holders track their works and collect royalties.

name: Biossil
description: Gen AI for personalized drug trials to increase rate of phase 3 approvals.

name: Blume
description: Blume is a direct-to-consumer collection of ‘sustainable’ self-care products.

name: Botpress
description: An open-source conversational AI platform for building enterprise-grade bots.

name: Canada Rocket Company
description: Canada Rocket Company is an aerospace company building domestically controlled launch systems to give Canada sovereign access to space.

name: Carbide
description: Carbide Secure provides organizations with the tools they need to quickly and efficiently launch a cyber-security strategy.

name: CarbonRun
description: CarbonRun is a mission-driven environmental conservation company that focuses on river restoration and carbon dioxide removal. CarbonRun aims to restore rivers impacted by human activity.

name: Certn
description: Fast, compliant, affordable criminal and other background checks for businesses, landlords, property managers and others.

name: Chemshift Technologies
description: Chemshift builds planet-centric technology to address critical bottlenecks in lithium refining.

name: Clutch
description: Canada's first virtual pre-owned car dealership.

name: CoLab
description: CoLab is a web-based collaboration tool for mechanical engineering and industrial design teams.

name: Cybrid
description: Cybrid is a payment infrastructure for embedded finance. They provide KYC, ACH transfers, FBO virtual accounts, and on & offramps. They offer an end-to-end flow of funds solution, making it easier for businesses to implement crypto.

name: Deep Sky
description: Deep Sky is building infrastructure to large-scale carbon dioxide removal systems through Direct-Air-Capture (DAC).

name: Dfuse
description: Dfuse is building blockchain APIs that will help the next generation of developers build decentralized applications.

name: DreamFold AI
description: Dreamfold works with experimental scientists towards designing proteins with a range of unique biological properties. Dreamfold uses biotechnology and machine learning advances made by generations of scientists.

name: Dreamwell AI
description: Dreamwell AI is a software as a service (SaaS) platform that leverages artificial intelligence to enhance influencer marketing campaigns maximizing return on advertising spend for brands by launching profitable campaigns.

name: Edda
description: Edda helps professional investors power their investments from sourcing to exit.

name: Eli Health
description: Eli helps women take control of their health, by providing them with information on their daily hormone profile.

name: EnPowered
description: EnPowered helps companies in heavy industries control their energy usage with AI/ML.

name: FISPAN
description: FISPAN's API management platform allows banks to quickly deploy new business banking products.

name: Featherless AI
description: Featherless is a serverless AI platform that provides access to AI models hosted on its own infrastructure. Using a unique GPU orchestration system, it enables developers to run AI models efficiently on older-generation GPUs, significantly lowering costs.

name: FightCamp
description: FightCamp is a connected at-home boxing gym.

name: Fincura
description: Fincura is a treasury management and ERP intelligence solutions, starting with reconciliation and payments for US-based dental practices with one to several locations.

name: FleetOps
description: AI-powered freight dispatching platform using embedded ELD data.

name: Flinks
description: The financial data gateway between fintech apps and banks.

name: Forma.AI
description: Incentive compensation management (ICM) tool for large companies who struggle with calculating, organizing and maintaining a system to pay their sales people.

name: Gia
description: Gia (f.k.a. AgiEA) is the end-to-end delegation solution for busy founders.

name: Greeneye Technology
description: Greeneye utilizes artificial intelligence to disrupt the agricultural pest control process by providing precise spraying of chemicals in real-time.

name: HonestDoor
description: HonestDoor is a real estate intelligence platform for the Canadian market.

name: HumanFirst
description: HumanFirst augments live chat agents by giving them the best response, so they can engage more quickly, with more visitors, without typing.

name: Impro
description: Impro is a 100% text-based coaching service for middle managers that helps them reprogram their thinking patterns, and build and sustain new leadership habits.

name: InstaSwitch
description: InstaSwitch is building an AI-powered open banking layer for SMB bank switching, enabling more seamless customer conversion and onboarding for fintech providers.

name: Kiln AI
description: Kiln AI is building the infrastructure for AI product development. It enables teams to build better ML models by turning subjective product feedback directly into structured training data.

name: Korapay
description: Korapay is building a suite of plug-and-play payment tools to help local and global businesses accept and send payments in Africa.

name: Lancey
description: Lancey helps B2B SaaS companies embed interactive product demos into their websites to improve customer conversion.

name: Lotly
description: Lotly is making residential real estate investing accessible to all retail investors with their fractional ownership platform.

name: Matchbook AI
description: Matchbook AI is an enterprise data integration, governance and management solution that delivers clean and relevant data across enterprises.
location: Studio City, Los Angeles, CA, USA

name: Metacommerce
